l5y3cDj1biE.title: Lacertus
l5y3cDj1biE.description:
Level: Lacertus by waterpump
ID: 134779962
Lacertus has everything you would want in this style of platformer level: variety in weapons, enemies, locations, making every run unique. There are 3 different sections around the level that I could find, each one having a couple of variations, which changes the decoration, the enemies you can find there and the loot you can find breaking vases or killing enemies. There are 4 bosses in total, which are also in varied areas, each one has a unique design and attacks which makes it interesting since you don't know who you're going to find. The different weapons you can find of different levels, common, rare, epic and legendary also make every run different since you have to adapt to each weapons speed, range and special abilities.

After about 10 minutes of playtime a white mist envelops the entire level, forcing you to rush to the highest point to survive and get to the final boss, regardless of your gear and level, the boss has 2 phases with different design and attacks, with the 2nd phase having flashy, fast attacks, reminiscent of something from Sekiro. Every fight is fun in it's own way, which makes you want to do a new run every time you win.

ITmypXDq9cs.description:
[Botted Showcase]
Creators and Hosts:
Meatius & KugelBlitz Layout Hosting
Sebi & Marcy Deco Hosting

Percentage (GP Creators → Decorators)
0-17% (Rin04, Jawis → Xol)
17-32% (HaydenDom, Erina → Aris) 
32-39% (UFWM → Helbrein)
40-49% (Hyperbola → Hyperbola)
48-61% (Ncat → SwordK)
61-73% (KugelBlitz → domi)
73%-89% (maxmur → Verunya)
89%-100% (Meatius → Realvet)

Q&A 

Why was this version made?
As mentioned before the Cairox Version was never what the original creators of the level invisioned it to look like. This version is sort of an alternative, reimagined version, on what the level could've (or in the eyes of most of Cocy) should've been.

Why is it not the ldm of the Cairox Version?
There are 3 reasons why it is not the ldm as the Cairox version. First of all we wanted to keep the original balancing of the layout. Second of all we replaced one gameplay part. Third of all this version was made way later and completely separately from Cairox's version

Why was the gameplay of one part (34-40) replaced?
In this version the wishes of the people who made the layout were accounted for fully. Erina, who built the part, never really liked his gameplay and wanted it to be replaced in the Cairox version too, but it never came to this.

Is this version official?
This version is just as official as the one by Cairox. It is approved by all Gameplay creators and Hideki.

Why is the level called the same as the Cairox Version?
For the people in Cocy this version is what they imagined the level to be in the first place, so it should be called Thinking Space II

Who will verify this?
The level will be verified by one of the people in the group who initiated the level (Cocy). 
If no one in Cocy will verify it someone else will be picked, however this choice will be done when it comes to that

leu8emUJmWI.title: Wulzy's Final Level
leu8emUJmWI.description:
I remember uploading one of Wulzy's earliest levels back in 2018, which was also a couple months before he deleted his old channel by accident, and it's been really cool to see Wulzy's growth as both a content creator and level creator. His level, ''hue180'' is one I'll always look fondly at as the music and the effects mesh super well together. For me, the pastel colors really invoke a different feeling when you look at the level. Sadly, after 6 years of creating content on YouTube, he's retiring, so best of luck to his future endeavors, and thank you for all the great levels throughout the years.

As for One Last Woah, it's a level that feels and looks very alive, it's fast, bright and dark at the same time, due to the deep contrast between the red flashes and objects with the occasional black background. There's a nice variation in movement throughout, with some decorations and obstacles having snappy appearances and others a slower, floaty movement. The gameplay is mostly based around timings, but there's a good variance when it comes to gamemodes, you get a bit of everything.

Level: One Last Woah by Wulzy
ID: 122925699
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1287456

-Jg-gDGK5Jg.title: The Hardest Platformer Level I've Done
-Jg-gDGK5Jg.description:
Level: Hexagonestestestest by Enlightment
ID: 112346959
Hexagonest is a remake of the flash game Super Hexagon, which itself is an expansion of the original Hexagon, a game where you dodge obstacles as you spin around in different directions. 

The visuals of the level are almost exactly as you would remember them if you played the original, the different color combinations that change between levels, the flashing on beat with the music, the shape and design of the obstacles themselves, only thing you could say is different is the camera angle.

When it comes to difficulty, it follows a similar curve as the original, starting off relatively slow and simple, you can easily read the obstacles that are approaching and I'd you've played this before you could most likely beat the first 2 or 3 levels without dying.

In the original, the first level is Hexagon, then Hexagoner and finally, Hexagonest. The last couple of levels, from 5 to 8 I'd say are definitely a challenge and follow the same scheme, each one going faster than the last, changing the speed of the obstacles and sometimes moving the camera in a different direction. If you're not familiar with the gameplay it will take you a hefty amount of time to memorize each level, often progressing a couple of frames at a time. It's a brutal challenge but it is addicting to beat, such as the original.

U7MMQOOe-oY.title: Getting Over It
U7MMQOOe-oY.description:
A game that I've been expecting to be recreated since 2.2 was released, one of the most popular platformers, Getting Over it was a perfect match and we get to experience it in this level. From the movement that is notoriously frustrating at first, but fun and satisfying once you get the hang of, to the commentary from the creator speaking not only on our journey, but theirs as well.

All the different pieces of art, whether it's the references to other popular levels, icons and miscellaneous objects, they all add to the known mystique of these types of games.

The music is another center piece, the slow jazz and piano soundtracks that are there to make your falls even more painful, it's all here.

5EL2r32Rupo.title: Eye of Cthulhu in 2.2?
5EL2r32Rupo.description:
Terraria recreations have become more and more common as time goes on, especially with 2.2, all of them nailing the style and having something different to showcase from the original, whether it be from the regular game or Calamity. Resentment is no exception, and I expected this when I saw that Quadar was the creator, the atmosphere is dark, eerie and dangerous and you can see it in the colors, the effects and even the terrain. 

The actual bossfight itself is fantastic, the eye of cthulhu is an iconic boss in Terraria, and everything about it here is practically 1:1, the movements, attacks even the stage you have to build to fight.

Level: Resentment by QuadarVerse

WnhI444qUSc.title: G30W4R3

The minigames themselves are all different and unique, since the incorporate the apps they're set in, you get Excel, Photoshop, Blender, Maps and more, all recreated nicely to fit into the rest of the art.

A level that is based and inspired on Inside, a game that was released back in 2016, that at this point is a legendary game, a classic that if you've had the luck of enjoying you can understand why. This level has the same dark, gloomy, dystopian atmosphere as the original, which is one of the most compelling aspects of the original. 

But the atmosphere is only surface level of what OTHERSIDE has to offer, there's so much here to explore, having challenges, puzzles, hidden passages and even a secret ending. The quality of the effects, art, lighting and animations is top-tier, you could mistake some of these sections for the original. There is no room to question why Rob has already rated this as Legendary.

This is one of those special levels that you need to try for yourself, it's an experience, and a love letter to it's inspiration.

eMip97sJklw.title: ''Tornado'' by AbstractDark | Geometry Dash 2.2
eMip97sJklw.description:
Tornado is one of those levels that are really brought to life due to the sum of all its parts.  Every section here has something completely different to offer while keeping itself connected and grounded.

The beginning reminds me of the times when you're walking home, you're about to arrive when you suddenly start to hear thunder above you and it begins raining. The sense of urgency and uncertainty are nailed here. Going into the ruined castle and being able to hear the rain hitting the rooftop and the flashes of lightning through the cracks, the wind coming rushing in when you open the hatch, this is the life I was talking about.

After this it only gets crazier, once the tornado forms and you can see it in the distance, the feeling of urgency turns into fear, since you're swept up and now have to jump between what's left of the ruins, dodging giant rocks flying your way. It's all done beautifully, from a gameplay and a design standpoint. And we can't underrate the importance of sound effects and music, which play a huge part here as well.

Jump King is a game that was released about 5 years ago, that due to its popularity at the time and still now needs no introduction.

Robot King recreates the best and most recognizable parts of the original game, the pixel art style is done beautifully, the shading, colors and backgrounds all look one to one. Level: Double Dimension by GirlyAle02
ID: 88266256

Double Dimension was one of the levels created for the Discord Gauntlet earlier in the year, which had a duality/path theme. Another great level from Ale that utilizes the 3D elements in an interesting way, changing perspectives when it works best, showcasing the art, backgrounds and other effects spread throughout the level.

1st dimension is the Candy Dimension, using pastel coloring schemes and lighter hues. It takes on a trip full of sweets and desserts, giant lollipops and rivers of chocolate. It also has a nice layering of objects and a sense of depth that helps to immerse.

2nd dimension is de GD Dimension which is started by a fantastic transition once you hit the trigger in the beginning. This path takes you through different Geometry Dash styled sections, some with very familiar designs, using classic colors schemes, combining old blocks with newer ones.

Both paths are simultaneously different yet complementary to each other, striking a nice balance and having a choice of which to play is nice.

uEYcWTP88n8.title: ''Prismatic Domain'' 100% (Demon) by Edenharley | Geometry Dash
uEYcWTP88n8.description:
Prismatic Domain in Geometry Dash is a vibrant journey brought to life through its meticulous design. The rainbow color palette used is not merely a superficial choice; it's an integral part of the level's identity. Every hue in the spectrum is showcased brilliantly, creating a visually stimulating environment that keeps players entranced.

The artistry doesn’t stop at the color choice; the transitions, and background animations are great as well. The background, adorned with a slew of dynamic shapes and shades, moves in a harmonious dance with the foreground, creating a sense of depth and immersion. The use of light and shadow, along with the pulsating glow that syncs with the music, adds a whole new layer to the design.

Moreover, the aesthetic consistency throughout the level is another high point. The thematic adherence to the prismatic concept is essential here, yet each segment offers a fresh, visually pleasing scene, preventing any sense of monotony. The transitions between different color schemes and segments are smooth, maintaining a visual coherence that's easy on the eyes while keeping players engaged.

The design of "Prismatic Domain" strikes a beautiful balance between complexity and accessibility, ensuring players are not overwhelmed while still being able to appreciate the effort poured into the level

Level: Evanescence by NateRaven
ID: 94262476

An experimental, unique and interesting level from NateRaven, Evanescense has a great mix of realistic art, a wide color palette, unorthodox effects and a captivating atmosphere. YJAztlcbWJ4.title: ''Haywire'' 100% (Demon) by Mega0of | Geometry Dash
YJAztlcbWJ4.description: If there's ever been a level that absolutely nails the glitched/computerized theme, it's what Mega0of has achieved with Haywire. From the smooth and satisfying animations that are truly the heart of the level, being the vehicle that carries the rest of the design, the bright, vivid and saturated color palette, the striking lighting that portrays the intensity of what you see throughout, intensified due to the great implementation of glow. The other star of this level are the transitions, they're flashy, jarring in a good way and from the very beginning, set the mood for the rest of the level.

IMeWHcnYgkk.title: [Update] ''Duelo Maestro'' 100% (Demon) by Nacho21 | Geometry Dash
IMeWHcnYgkk.description: I originally beat Duelo Maestro in September of 2017, almost exactly 6 years ago, which is crazy to think about, and since Nacho released an update to this legendary level, making some darker sections a bit brighter, making the gameplay more visible and thus enjoyable, with some other small refinements, I decided to rebeat it. Apart from the fact that this level is very special to me, as I'm sure it is for many, many others, it is simply put, a fun experience. Being one of those levels that are XL, but once you're enjoying the design, it's 2 player gameplay, the music, it feels much shorter than it is. It is just fantastic to see Nacho back and showing some love to his older levels.

-5iMgQKvZDk.title: [2.0] ''Volcanic Rush'' 100% (Demon) by Manix648 | Geometry Dash
-5iMgQKvZDk.description: A classic at this point, from a creator that most of us remember fondly, Manix released Volcanic Rush years ago and it's effects, pixelated style and jumpy atmosphere still holds up nicely today. The volcanic/fiery theme fits well with the fast pacing of the gameplay, adding some intensity, along with the monsters that fly around the screen trying to stop you. Really fun to play this again.

fxgWpmLeuNM.title: VeritY Remake | ''VeracitY'' 100% (Demon) by BlueLite & fl:vio [Verified] | Geometry Dash
fxgWpmLeuNM.description:
VeracitY is BlueLite's newest level after 5 years, a remake of VeritY with help from a bunch of other creators both for the layout and decoration, and in my opinion the result is fantastic. VeritY is a 2.0 level that was amazing for it's time, the simplicity and detail in its art and effects that were brought to the table marked a lot of players and creators, including BlueLite. 

With this remake, you get to see the original idea and concept kept intact, at the same time being updated to current times, the backgrounds are fuller, I personally love the 3D aspect some of the backgrounds have, such as the city in the middle of the level. The way the windows light up as you go through including the eiffel tower is super cool. The lighting effects are also powerful yet precise, it fully respects the original while building on top of it.

NOhZip9oIvY.description:
Impossible Demon is the sequel to The Impossible Dash that was released a few months ago, this level takes you through a journey by travelling through all these different landscapes, starting from level 1 all the way to 5. One of my favorite things about this level are definitely the transitions and animations, they're very smooth, satisfying and well integrated into the overall theme, along with the minimalist/pixelated artwork. The design as a whole is cohesive, and most importantly the gameplay being fun.

PD2qGALWSJg.title: ''Tren 22'' 100% (Demon) by Vicolor | Geometry Dash
PD2qGALWSJg.description:
Vicolor is one of those creators that almost never misses for me, I'm always eager to see what he's come up with, since his levels tend to lean more towards longer form adventures, and Tren 22 is no different. 

Right off the bat we get to choose between 2 routes, which basically means we're getting 2 levels in one, the differences between the 2 paths range from the color and tone of the decoration, to the actual places we get to see. What I like most about these is that the paths still look and feel connected, so it feels like it's one big space and map that you're exploring.

Without a doubt the largest changes you see in these 2 choices are the effects and backgrounds, the first path has a darker atmosphere with less lighting, muddier colors, etc. While the second path is much brighter, with a bigger variety of scenery, but they both complement each other nicely.

f-O_TnxIZBA.title: Every End by MindCap
f-O_TnxIZBA.description:
[Showcase] MindCap recently asked me to showcase this, and even though I don't normally showcase levels I can't beat, I wanted to make an exception for this one in particular, Every End has a concept that hadn't even crossed my mind when it comes to Top 10 levels, one that only utilizes a single game mode, the cube, in a layout-style fashion.

At a simple glance the decoration isn't anything particularly special, instead you can see the other aspect that makes this so unique. What you see behind the gameplay isn't just decoration or filler, it's what is coming up next in the level, to be able to see a preview of the gameplay while playing is really cool.

The gameplay is also very unique, it has you jumping from an incredibly precise spot over an entire obstacle that seems like you have to land on, but it's just to reach the very edge of a spike or a block that's on the other side. The difficulty doesn't all come from the gameplay itself though, it comes from not being nervous by the time you start reaching the end of the level. The gameplay and music also remind me of the earliest days of GD, or even earlier than that, like something of off The Impossible Game, which is also super cool. This level is currently being verified by ViperVenom95, so good luck to them.

Creators: Pennutoh, MindCap, LeftUnknown, Blitzer, Djoxy, npesta, Koreaqwer, KrmaL, StarkyTheSalad, Surv, lolwut7 and Cobrablitz

G816T4k_tvQ.description:

A level that doesn't feel as long because of how entrancing it is, all wrapped up in a beautiful song.

My favorite section is definitely the one at 4:18. This is an effect I don't think I've seen before, the way the background slowly moves, while the block design being practically the same as the background, except it moves slightly faster and in different directions, creating this dizzy effect, making it look alive without being over decorated in any way.

Between Worlds is, for lack of a better term a jaw-dropping level, having a beautifully unique concept, that is executed near-perfectly on all levels. When you play or watch this level, the first thing you will notice is how perfect the sync is, that is due to the fact that the song was created by xLoco specifically for this, and it is honestly half of what makes this so great.

The masking and the effects, where you go through the rifts and the entire world changes, different colors, saturations and contrasts that just make the world feel more connected. xU44UyRN7cU.title: ''Magical Funk'' 100% (Demon) by EstebannGD | Geometry Dash
xU44UyRN7cU.description:
Magical Funk originally came out about 7 months ago, but with the 10 year anniversary, it got a well-deserved update, with some renovating and polishing of the design. I really enjoyed the color palette used here, it has a nice variety of softer, colder colors, and stronger, warmer colors, purples, blues, reds and many more that make everything pop out even more.

9G8LS6yXq_8.title: Todays The Day by Kruso & More | Geometry Dash

It was not the day

WUeKVsc6Z8M.title: Desastre PetrolerO by stanstanmansan | Geometry Dash
WUeKVsc6Z8M.description:
6 months ago, there was an oil spill in Peru caused by Repsol, which caught the attention of stan, thus deciding to make a level showing what happened, and the subsequent effects that these incidents have on the ecosystem. I feel like this is a concept that is still untapped, while this is a game, it's always good to bring light to issues that affect you and are important to you. 

The design for this level is great as well, putting aside what it's about, the art, progression and animations are well-made, being a minute long there is a ton of detail here, the rain, the water, the rig, everything is high quality.

65W1Aho6jeY.title: Made in 2.0! | (Extreme Demon) ''Turbulent Valley'' 100% by TwisterDude161 & More | Geometry Dash
65W1Aho6jeY.description:
A level that pays tribute to 2.0 megacollabs, but instead of taking old assets and making it look as it if were made today, they make an accurate representation of what 2.0 megacollabs looked like from that time period, and they nailed that aspect. The gameplay is also incredibly fun and consistent, as for the difficulty, I'd say this is a mid range extreme. 

Overall, you can definitely tell a lot of care went into this, probably one of my favorite extremes of the year.

Pj-e2wJEtS0.title: ''DANCE JAM DANCE'' 100% (Demon) Gostley | Geometry Dash
Pj-e2wJEtS0.description:
Dance Jam Dance is a level that shines due to it's combination of amazingly smooth animations, clever and snappy transitions, a great choice in soundtrack and a fun, well thought out, fitting boss fight.

I really liked the design choices here, starting from the colors, being mostly red with some splashes of different color here and there to emphasize a piece of art or decoration. The animations are fantastic, they flow nicely, have a purpose and are just fun to watch, especially the second half. The boss fight is also great, the attacks and dodging you need to do are unique, while having a couple reminiscent of Undertale, surrounded by the great remix of Spider Dance, it all culminates into a great level.

bNMN0_WzGiY.title: TRUSTFALL by DavJT | Geometry Dash

Empyrean is one of those levels where you feel there aren't enough words to describe the magnitude of detail found within them, the quality of the art, the colors, animations and the atmosphere that is created due to all this being intertwined. The art is subtle throughout the beginning but as you get further and further you get to see more and more detail, until you get to the end and see the amazing bossfight that wraps the level up. The design for the boss itself is terrifying, creepy and even though it's short, it's the perfect way to end.

lRhVMpWZlVQ.title: Geometry Dash
lRhVMpWZlVQ.description:
What Solex has created here is an homage, a tribute and a celebration of 10 years of this game. Taking the styles from the very first update up until the present, and not just simply copying and pasting their respective levels, but making his own gameplay. Which results in a combination of nostalgia and freshness at the same time. 

You get to play over 10 minutes of Geometry Dash's history, seeing how far it's come and how it's grown. And not just from the main game, you get all the levels from the spin-offs as well which are great in their own right. A longer level that simply doesn't get boring or stale at any point.

It's one thing to have great animations, art, effects and transitions, but levels like these that even have a story on top and lore in and of themselves is the cherry on top. Ocellios has everything you would want, the best word to describe this level is smooth.

Mhg3-lWGkkA.title: ''Monolithos'' 100% (Demon) by JonathanGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
Mhg3-lWGkkA.description:
Monolithos was meant to be Jonathan's Discord Gauntlet entry, but unfortunately didn't end up being possible in the end, but the level still ended up being completed as it's own standalone.

Since it was for the Gauntlet it does have two seperate "modes" one being a darker, purple/blue themed design and the other a brighter orange/brown palette. They both look great, each one switching up some of the decoration while still feeling connected and similar in small ways. One thing that I enjoy about his levels is that he can make both small detailed effects and also grandiose set pieces, the music are always good choices too, since they end up amplifying the effects to make them look and feel punchier.

The background art for both modes are the highlight for me, you get so many shapes, patterns and textures throughout, that have a nice depth and sense of scale to them, while the block design is a bit more subtle.

Once you can actually see the design, it's of a cryptic and surreal nature, different shapes and objects placed in strange patterns, with different pieces of text setting up the atmosphere, the lack of audio just amplifies it.

You get new effects, much more vibrant coloring, and even some 3D effects within the block design which look modern and clean. It's fun to imagine that this is maybe how we saw the original when it released.

jjMy13Tf4CA.title: ''UltraSonic'' 100% (Demon) by ZenthicAlpha & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
jjMy13Tf4CA.description: I beat this level 6 years ago when I was still playing on 60hz. I also remember this taking me an insane amount of attempts, If I recall correctly it was around 18k, memories

crG9_3akaCA.title: Best 1.6 Level? | Someplace by Awedsy | Geometry Dash
crG9_3akaCA.description:
When you hear "1.6 level" you would probably imagine something that's barebones, with not much going on, given that the update came out 9 years ago, but Awedsy disproves that altogether, taking full advantage of everything 1.6 has to offer, to make something that looks great to most people today. 

There's a unique use of blocks and effects to create new ones, that end up making the level look fresh and a lot fuller. Someplace goes to show how you can create something great, even with limitations and restrictions.

EDg5TAbMp4g.title: Page Not Found by TDP9 | Geometry Dash
EDg5TAbMp4g.description:
An amazing level from TDP9, an unknown creator, which at this point might not be the case for much longer, as I write this, this level has stars, was the daily etc, all for his first creator points which is very impressive. Page Not Found is very reminiscent of Not Triple Mode, Player vs. Creator, and other layout/editor levels, you can tell this style is very hard to execute correctly, but if you watch or play this, you can see that it was nailed.

Over 2 minutes of very fun meta effects and gameplay, all of them unique and taking advantage of every tool available, as is the case with these gamebreak theme. All I can say is I can't wait to see what TDP comes up with next.

Kcp8f14UKAo.title: ''Snow Flies in Fog'' by DeniPol [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
Kcp8f14UKAo.description:
One of the many fantastic entries to the Discord Gauntlet Contest, which actually ended up being 9th place, which just tells you right off the bat how great it is. The two separate paths can be defined as night and day which you select at the very beginning, each one has the same setting, but with the difference in lighting and effects completely changes the atmosphere and vibe of the entire level, and with it being a snowy/christmas theme, it lends itself really well to these changes.

The daytime path is what you would expect, bright, with an emphasis on the fierceness of the snow and the adventure of going through a small town within a blizzard, along with some amazing 3D effects woven into the backgrounds. The nighttime is my personal favorite, the lighting in the foregrounds and especially the backdrop overlooking the city, makes it look so much more lively and colorful.

_qlf0iu0VKQ.title: 1.4 Million Objects! | (Extreme Demon) ''Devoreur De Dieux'' by Hota1991 | Geometry Dash
_qlf0iu0VKQ.description:
Song: https://youtu.be/LM7dOIFq-AE

A level that tests the limits of the editor, where every single part is decorated to the fullest, and having almost a million and a half objects in total. Which unfortunately came with the price of playability. Hota had to split this level in 2 parts due to the extreme object count, and had to upload the levels separately. And with the level running at 0 FPS, making it physically impossible to record even if you had the best PC out there, I had to use some external tools to showcase this. So if you want to showcase this you need to use them.

rydA0L3Wqa8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Night Rider'' 100% by LmAnubis & More | Geometry Dash
rydA0L3Wqa8.description:
Probably the fastest I've ever beaten an Extreme. I only practiced this level for 1 day, once I started playing from 0% I got to 63% twice in about 20 minutes, after a little while I beat it, fluking it from 63%. Honestly this is one of those levels where instead of the gameplay getting progressively harder, it gets easier for some reason, for me after 60% you basically get through all the hard stuff, and you just coast to the end. Still had an absolute blast playing this. Would recommend if you have the skill to do it. GG :)

Song: Unknown Creature by WhiscasKaat
https://youtu.be/m_BtbeWnt7E

hGRIBX1RRyk.description:
Thanorok is a level where the first 10 seconds are the same, but in this case if you save the cat that is stuck in a sewer you either go to heaven or hell. These two paths are entirely different, each one could be it's own level, being entirely opposite of one another.

The design as a whole, the colors, scenery, effects and art are very high quality for both paths, you even get a different bossfight for both, it's a well rounded experience, and has everything you would want from a concept like this.

Dx7n2XV8q90.description: Pretty fun entry level extreme. Not much else to say about this, the difficulty felt really consistent all the way through, except maybe for that one slow wave at 0:45. If you just started doing extreme demons and are looking for ones that are on the easier side, I highly recommend this one.

kJVkRhB5NRU.title: Unnamed 7
kJVkRhB5NRU.description:
What is Etzer's last level, Unnamed 7 was released about 5 years ago, having a glitch/retro theme and design. I like this choice since there are many type of effects that are under that umbrella, you can use a pixel style or a more popular video glitch effect among other types. The design is definitely chaotic but there is a lot of variety here that can be appreciated and the wave section at 0:15 specifically is particularly trippy and unique, plus the variety in game modes help keep it fresh throughout.

Level: Unnamed 7 by Etzer
ID: 40037755

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/718786

9boJ4n_mIHI.title: Swing Copter in 2.1
9boJ4n_mIHI.description:
With each day that passes waiting for 2.2, creators get more refined in both 2.1 and what we have of the new update, if you saw this level without knowing what it is, you would probably say it's from the latter, but to get the swingcopter in 2.1 and have it be this seamless just goes to show what creators can do with every tool they have.

Velocity is a cool neon/futuristic level that has really good animation quality, being smooth, concise and satisfying to watch, it's just a minute long but you get a variety of pace, effects, locations and gameplay.

Level: Velocity by Horneet
ID: 77072447

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/718225

yH3H2kgNZaI.title: ''Sinless Ash'' 100% (Demon) by Whirl | Geometry Dash
yH3H2kgNZaI.description:
At this point we've had a handful of levels based on terraria, but what's special about this type of level is that they are all really well made, each one special in their own way, representing the game's design, art, music and even gameplay from time to time. Sinless Ash is an over 2 minute long adventure where you must battle with Providence, an enormous creature that is trying to stop you from progressing, using many different attacks to do so. 

But what makes this level stand out even more is the fact that it has two different routes to take, one above in the overworld, and a second one where you go underground, each with different designs, obstacles and art, being so different that each one could be it's own level. The bossfight itself is the best part, the design is menacing, with many different attacks being thrown at you, carried by smooth animations and fun gameplay.

ID: 90251922

Song: Unholy Insurgency by DMDOKURO
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/793089

GsbGgnsk15E.title: ''Voodooism'' 100% (Demon) by Gyrodog & More | Geometry Dash
GsbGgnsk15E.description:
Voodoism is a collab that does a great job at being mysterious, creepy while also being intense and powerful, the color choices, the lighting effects, the backgrounds and the bits of art you see throughout this experience all mesh together to make this level do justice to it's title, it's dark, gloomy in the first half, but once the drop hits it packs a punch.

Level: Voodooism by gyrodog, MeowMasterer, Rocipher, Delusional, iLone, JV, DemonKiller756, Kopre, Spectixx, BloxyYT, NotCyanide, TC & Wr3nchGD
ID: 82650838

-vWL5YfJt8w.title: ON AND ON by AudieoVisual | Geometry Dash
-vWL5YfJt8w.description:
ON AND ON has a very unique concept, it takes what would be a normal level and zooms out until your icon is only a small speck on the screen, where you can see a large chunk of the layout and design in this context. You see the spaces you'll go through from afar, the obstacles and spikes all scaled down along with the player. 

Apart from that the design, the neon/space themed decoration and the effects all work great with this concept. There are several sections, each with different obstacles you must go through while sharing the same design, which helps the sense of progression and makes it all feel and look connected.

Level: ON AND ON by AudieoVisual
ID: 90181712

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/895898

UFcX4zec288.title: Sync
UFcX4zec288.description:
To me, sync is one of the most satisfying parts about the game, it doesn't have to be present in every single level, but when it's done right it adds a lot of value and fun to a level, this layout from Pennutoh, a well known creator at this point has exactly that, and even though it is a layout, it has many blocks, spikes, some splashes of color here and there, and several other bits of decoration that make it cohesive and enjoyable for what it is.

Level: Decorated Layout by Pennutoh
ID: 59544919

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/63082

4cWeAb8ZYRs.title: Stereo Madness Full Version
4cWeAb8ZYRs.description:
Full Versions have always been fun and interesting "What If's", what if the level was longer, what if it got more difficult as it went on, how would the design evolve while keeping the same style, without getting stale. With most full versions you do get what could've been the natural continuation of the original, and what's more OG than the very first RobTop level.

What I like about this Full Version, is the slight difficulty bump when the extension starts, you get more spikes, more jumps and smaller spaces to fly through, it makes it more engaging than just having super easy gameplay the whole way.

Level Stereo Madness Full by JamDefend
ID: 90155855

Song: Forever Bound - Stereo Madness
https://youtu.be/JhKyKEDxo8Q

0aqKlSPrWmE.title: RobTop
0aqKlSPrWmE.description:
When you play or watch RobTop, you would probably think that it's been around for a couple of years, but it is in fact 5 years old, which is always crazy to think about and realize.

What I really like about this level is the overall vibe and atmosphere, it's slow, using colder colors, even having a sort of somber tone to it only emphasized by the music. The block design, effects and backgrounds all work together to push the theme forward, that being a combination of futuristic, modern, slightly mechanical, it all works together for this short experience.

Level: RobTop by TonyGato
ID: 39769638

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/652838

4buF9wM3y2A.title: ''Dark Dreams'' 100% (Demon) by YowelGD | Geometry Dash
4buF9wM3y2A.description:
When you play Dark Dreams, you get almost 2 minutes of clean, animated, lively design, colorful and vivid backgrounds, smooth and satisfying animations that go in hand with great sync, and a fun bossfight that works as the cherry on top to an intense adventure.

There are several fight sections that you go through, different effects and attacks that all have weight and power behind them, overall an enjoyable experience with the quality to back it up.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/985091

bfnFQo9GioI.title: 18k Objects! | Autopilot by Bli | Geometry Dash
bfnFQo9GioI.description:
When you see a level with this amount of art, animations, transitions and detail, the number of objects that you think of could be very high, so the fact that this was made with under 19,000 just goes to show that you don't need hundreds of thousands to make something great.

Autopilot is an Auto that is under a minute long but packs a punch in everything I mentioned before, the animations are smooth, the futuristic/space theme is done very nicely, and combined with the music and atmosphere it's a short but fun experience.

4RS-S__zgI8.title: Made in 7 days! | ''TRIPPY TRIPPY'' 100% (Demon) by Wulzy | Geometry Dash
4RS-S__zgI8.description: Levels that are made in a short amount of time, will always be impressive to me, getting a level of quality that you would see from something that could take a month or even more in a short span of time. And while this may not be the most complex or technical level, it is a complete experience, the trippy atmosphere works great, and every bit of decoration and design works together to make it possible.

XfyDkBdKFmM.title: ''The Reconnextion'' (Demon) by TheAcTekTAE | Geometry Dash
XfyDkBdKFmM.description:
Robotic/mecha bossfights have become a staple of this game over the last handful of years, and just when you think we're at the limit of what can be made, someone comes along, whether it's someone new or a veteran, and breaks that barrier, and this is what we see with The Reconnextion. 

The animations are incredibly smooth, the designs for all of the mechas are clean and makes a good use of space and scale so they look imposing. The effects are bright, flashy and perfect for the theme, the colors, lighting is also fitting, there's good sync with the movements and attacks as well.

jk1d__mU-NM.title: Alkabaebasic by Alkali
jk1d__mU-NM.description:
It's always really interesting to see creators take a different style, and recreate it, with their own personal spin, whether it's to get a hybrid of both designs or to see what they would make in modern times. Alkali made this for April 1st, as a late addition to the dorabaebasic trend that was going on months ago, and in my opinion he nailed it, so many references to other levels, inspired by dorabae who was an influental creator back in the day, so this also ticks the nostalgia box.

ID: 89856094
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/991968

M1jyOUQD1S0.title: Project Arrhythmia? | Factory Town by RedlixHD | Geometry Dash
M1jyOUQD1S0.description:
Project Arrhythmia is another rhythm/music game, similar to Just Shapes and Beats, where you have many different songs with different visuals, enemies and gameplay, that also has a dedicated fanbase. Seeing different games recreated into GD is always a treat, especially when it's also a rhythm game, it's always impressive to play. 

Factory Town is practically a perfect recreation of PA, the animations are smooth, the boss is menacing, it's attacks are heavy and flashy and the music sync is great, it all comes together.

The Aeon bossfight being the best part here obviously, simple and effective.

s76yRQRMtSY.title: (Extreme Demon) ''MulLuna'' 100% by Mulpan & K911una | Geometry Dash
s76yRQRMtSY.description:
A two-player collab between Mulpan and K911una, another talented creator that has a handful of levels uploaded, they have a soft style that is unique and satisfying, using lighter colors, tones of pinks, blues, purples with a touch of glow on the decoration. And in this level I think it has a great contrast with Mulpan's green and traditional style, the two halves mesh well together while being entirely different.

The gameplay is also very fun, it has the challenging factor and I also appreciate how you can practice each half individually, that is a nice touch and makes it less tedious for the players. The art that is featured across the level is also nice, Mulpan's ball, Icon and different faces and fanarts, and K911unA inserting emojis into their half, it's overall a fun level, both in design and gameplay.

Song: Tumba Ping Pong Song by Dunderpatrullen
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/980038

VX15EL06cPw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Low Death'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
VX15EL06cPw.description: Surprisingly a really fun level, I was very consistent in getting at 40%, though the robot jump at 2:05 always got me which made it pretty frustrating later on. About 3k of my attempts were from when this level came out, so I'd say this took me around 5k, still, very glad I was able to do it in a day of playing from 0%. GG :)

nsJe7GTepTk.title: Made in 5 days! | ''Slimestep'' by AudieoVisual | Geometry Dash
nsJe7GTepTk.description:
A great level from Audieo that was made in only 5 days, during streams on his channel, which is cool to see with these types of levels, where you can see the entire process especially when the result is something good. I enjoyed the neon/80's theme, the colors are strong and vibrant, the glow is smooth and there's a bunch of animations that serve as transitions or just to make the level bouncier and more dynamic. There's also variation in the effects, the glow, lighting, the decoration in the background or even the block design, it all meshes together.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/896203

AqWihkur7rA.title: ''Apollo'' 100% (Demon) by Cantis | Geometry Dash
AqWihkur7rA.description:
With space-themed levels, more often than not you get a slower paced exploration level, to showcase all of the art that goes into this genre, the planets, stars, and whatever else is put into the void, but in APOLLO you get something much different. 

It's fast paced, bright, flashy and intense after a short 15 second buildup. You get a space grey block design that looks like parts of a spaceship, that looks great, fitting in really well with the beautiful night sky, I also like the big amount of moving parts it has, makes it feel more alive.

The best part about this level has to be the background art in my opinion, the Earth looks great, the lighting, the terrain and the shadows on it make it looks realistic, and you can't help but notice it, even while blasting through the level.

5nL_yTkNizE.title: ''Anastasia and Koteev'' by MCAASJ [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
5nL_yTkNizE.description:
Anastasia and Koteev is unique because of the fact that you could consider it a 2 in 1, having 2 different routes, you hit a switch, grab a potion, or go a separate hidden path at the beginning and you see a different outcome, decoration or bossfight. And while this isn't the first level to do this, it's executed well and it's always cool to see this choice. 

For Anastasia and Kootev, the setting I would say is Circus/Showtime, very colorful, playful, bright lights and a lot of movement, the block design, effects, backgrounds, and character design all fits together nicely, this is the case for both routes. The first one is brighter, has subtler tones, while the second is a bit darker and a bit creepy with the character, the general layout of both is practically the same, but some of the decoration and effects change, but both are nice.

tmrfPKW1NgE.title: ''Night Terrors'' 100% (Demon) by Hinds | Geometry Dash
tmrfPKW1NgE.description:
Another nostalgic level for many, including myself, a level that at the time was being talked about a lot, and with good reason, the bright and sharp red design was very popular at the time, and this used that and combined with it's lighting and color effects, at the same time having great sync with it's intense song it stood out, a demon that many players had on their to-beat list.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/541008

ZrHuTeyxzjw.title: Inspired by Game Time? | ''Game Switch'' 100% (Demon) by Cubodix | Geometry Dash
ZrHuTeyxzjw.description:
Game Switch is short-burst minigame compilation, reminiscent of Wario-Ware, inspired by Game Time, that was released a while ago that was of the same nature, but featuring completely different classic and old school videogames, both from consoles and arcades, such as Tetris, World's Hardest Game, Arkanoid, the Google Dinasour game, Galaga and I wanna be the Guy, among others.

I enjoyed how the gameplay is very close to the original, while having slight variances that make it feel as unique as it can. The effects for each game are also great, getting the player icons, backgrounds and the obstacles on point.

Song: Kitsune^2 - Rainbow Tylenol

1e4rthrT8TE.title: ''Lit Fuse'' 100% (Demon) by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
1e4rthrT8TE.description:
I still remember the first time I beat this level years ago at this point, it always had a grandiose feeling to it, with it's mysterious synths humming in the background building up slowly until the drop hits, where it becomes a crash of different sounds, that go perfectly with all the bright, vibrant and slightly trippy effects. KrmaL has a classic in this level, it became many people's favorite at the time, and for some it still is.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/657081

DNKhznMGTAc.description:

W1NDDX9le8s.title: Overdecorated? | Dim Distorsionada by IDegelI | Geometry Dash
W1NDDX9le8s.description:
A level that was released 2 years ago, but Degel updated the entire level to give it a better look. This has a rainbow theme, but it uses the rainbow blocks in really unique way that I really haven't seen before, to a point where it almost looks overdecorated, but it's actually good.

ID: 62524823
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/516067

qKtQ0oLHxKc.title: Geometrical Dominator 2023 | ''Geometrical Rush'' by xVаinaja | Geometry Dash
qKtQ0oLHxKc.description:
Geometrical Rush isn't exactly a remake, since it isn't exactly the same as the original, altough it does have some of it's aspects, and takes from it's design, there are a lot of parts that are new, or switched around, I like to think that this is what the level would be if it released today. With new effects, sleeker implementations of glow and color, smooth transitions, overall a more modern feel and look. Robtop levels have so many reimaginings, remasters and remakes, it's always nice to see these classics get a new coat of paint.

Song: Geometrical Dominator by Waterflame
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/641172

foDJtW50efY.title: The Shortest Demon in Geometry Dash
foDJtW50efY.description:
Level: Speequ by tenzk
ID: 67447101

The shortest demon in GD, being exactly 30 seconds long, Speequ in terms of design is as fast paced as it's gameplay, using a dark atmosphere with color changes and combinations, and flashes of light to illuminate the way.

I really enjoy the buildup within this level, it follows the music perfectly, starting off slower and by the time the drop hits and the first boss appears there is a ton of movement on the screen, surrounded by bright and flashy effects.

The bossfights we get here are the highlight for sure, their designs are sleek, fitting in with the rest of the design, the attacks are varied and synced to the music which is always satisfying, and the animations are very smooth as well. Both are unique in their design and gameplay.

Putting aside the design, the gameplay has also been tweaked, in this case buffed, having more speed changes, tighter spaces and with the updated design visibility as well. It's always nice to see new life breathed into older levels, and this is done right.

This is Knots' entry for the Gauntlet Contest, which is why there are 2 modes. Knots is one of those names that grabs almost anybodies attention, especially if you played this game in previous years. A creator that established his own style, that is known as being consistent, high quality, and colorful, which made every release exciting, so seeing him participate in the Discord Gauntlet is great to say the least.

What this level has that sets it apart is the sense of scale, there are a handful of sections, starting off in what appears to be an underground water passage, and ending up high above with the clouds, with everything being connected along the way. That being said there isn't anything outrageously flashy here, but the small and subtle details are what makes it good, from water splashes, to the holographic effects, and a ton more. Overall a great level from an established creator.

cqmFrOXslQU.description:
The most impressive aspect about The X Files is the fact that you could take any section, any part and place and it could be it's own level. Due to the fact that each of the places that we visit, whether it's the fiery pits of hell, just above the earth's atmosphere, or a haunted graveyard, they all have their own design, colors, backgrounds and decoration that go perfectly together.

Even though each part is so different and unique, MAYEROSA manages to make it all feel and play connected, it also helps that the music is an integral part of the level, also a remix of the X files theme song. Speaking about that, that isn't the only reference to scifi/horror media we see, there are so many scattered around the level, from entire places, to small details, that to me adds a ton of replayability, just to see how many you can spot.

This level doesn't also include just one bossfights, but two, which are nicely executed, each with their own design and attacks, fitting into the spaces they are confined to, and the gameplay is fun too, satisfying sync and the pacing is great as well.

IY9hF5ROwis.title: 14,000 People Made This Level
IY9hF5ROwis.description:
Level: Place by Spu7nix
ID: 86917672

Spu7nix has been one of the, if not the most consistently innovative members of this community for years, creating and programming things that most of us could only dream of being possible, but with the help of dreaminginsanity and FlowGD, the barrier has been broken once more.

With the popularity of Place, I feel there's no need to explain the premise. But if you don't know, it is basically a way for creators or even normal members of a community to collaborate and create art, but in this context, a level where people could sign up and participate to create gameplay, decoration or anything they wanted.

As you may have imagined, there are practically hundreds of pieces of art in this level, references to different games, pieces of art, movies, pop culture and most commonly flags, both big and incredibly large, there is so much to see and find here, just going into the editor and looking at everything that was placed is an adventure in itself. Huge props to everyone who participated in this and especially to the people who made this possible.

According to the creator this is apparently a recreation of a Roblox game called Doors, but once I saw it was made by drren I knew it would be good. The effects, animations, even the monster that chases you throughout the level are all top notch.

GNcH-Vq8ggc.title: ''Hexagon Force Full Version'' by JamAttack | Geometry Dash
GNcH-Vq8ggc.description:
Hexagon Force is definitely one of the more popular main levels in this game, so making a full version for it just makes sense, and in this case it's really well done, the original parts are practically intact, but that's not the reason these types of levels are so popular.

The extension is great in my opinion, it keeps the design of the original, in a way that shows what a natural progression would look like if it was longer, with a bump in difficulty towards the latter half, but that is a given in these types of levels, although I do like that it's a bit more challenging. It has a nice variety in gamemodes and doesn't get stale at any point, with a nice conclusion.

VNQ7e2MjXLc.title: 3RROR by Angel996 | Geometry Dash 2.2
VNQ7e2MjXLc.description:
3RROR is one of those levels, that when you see it for the first time, you are left with your jaw on the floor, and I'm 100% sure I'm not the only one. The amount of detail and polish in this level is insane, the glitch theme in my opinion has never looked better, where normally it's an effect or two within a transition. 

But here it's in every single aspect of the level, the block design, the effects, backgrounds, colors and even different bits and pieces of decoration scattered around to fill up the empty spaces. Now mix all that together with the newest 2.2 effects creators have at their disposal, used in a masterful way, playing around with perspectives, fixed camera, split screens, etc etc.

3RROR is astonishing to me because the update hasn't even released yet, and we are able to see levels of this quality, if this doesn't get you excited for the future I don't know what will.

Song: Righten - Get Dat 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zLyyWE3XW_U

There are many colors sprinkled throughout the drop, in different places, not just the background, the blocks as well. All this combined with it's various unique transitions and animations, this level is a great example of short but sweet.

kZzhOac9l4Q.description:
Seeing this level gives me an inevitable sense of nostalgia, seeing that AOL logo reminds me of the early/mid 2000's where internet was dial-up and every page took minutes to load, I never expected to see a level themed around this now retro concept. 

The green color scheme does well to convey the cyberspace and technological atmosphere, with the different coding animations being a nice bonus to the immersion. Overall AMERICA ONLINE is a well-made reminder of simpler times, with good decoration and satisfying effects.

With that said, every other background, block and decoration throughout the level is great, and it does all feel connected, which is super important.

I also enjoyed the latter half, where the level takes a turn towards horror, making some references to creepypastas, it fit well with the rest and was a nice change of pace and scenery.

There are so many different sceneries and places we visit in this level, a futuristic city, a demonic underground world and even the inside of the christmas tree. Floating maze is practically it's own game within GD, having a start screen, different levels each with their own mechanics, and even an options/settings screen, which is something I've never seen being implemented before.

Not a Phobia is EnZore's newest level, a creator that has brought us great levels such as Leyak and MORYO, it's no surprise that this is just as good, even better in fact, in my opinion his best work yet. The visuals have an immense weight to them, the effects are punchy and intense, there's always something going on within each section, it gives no breathing room in the best sense.

This level is just over a minute of great art that is carried through the colors, lighting and block design that EnZore made, the sense of movement and progression you get while playing this is the best part, it makes you want to replay it a couple of times.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/986590

VQOJ_SZ0Nto.title: MikuMikuMikuMiku by OddMod | Geometry Dash
VQOJ_SZ0Nto.description:
When I first saw this Hatsune Miku themed level, during the first half I expected it to just be an art level with a nice and soothing style, with a slow upbeat soundtrack as Accompaniment, but as soon as you get past the first minute, everything about the level changes, the speed, intensity, the design and even the music.

Seeing and hearing Hatsune Miku inside GD is surprising, and goes to show how popular this character still is, even after many, many years from it's beginnings as a vocaloid voice bank, to the icon it is today. The aesthetic this level has, it's pacing among other aspects fits perfectly with Miku, allowing for a nice variety in design and gameplay.

Song: Hatsune Miku - Atama no Taisou by Hapi | https://youtu.be/gvJ7L_g28ng

iEbdpgFxz9E.title: ''Blast Processing Full Version'' by Abaso | Geometry Dash
iEbdpgFxz9E.description: I recorded this level back in July but didn't upload it for some reason, so here it is.

X6PMwVsxnXA.title: ''Boblo Adventure'' 100% (Demon) by MonsterVP [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
X6PMwVsxnXA.description:
Extremely underrated level that only has 59 downloads as of now, and for someone that has no creator points, this is really impressive.

ID: 82620233

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1100818

_s11j-5RYUc.title: ''No Mans Land'' 100% (Demon) by BlackRoseTeam | Geometry Dash
_s11j-5RYUc.description:
The first ever project from this new team, that is full of universally talented creators, such as Inex, Destrys, Magpipe, ValkyrieMaster, CTRX, Hitam, iMinay, KvPets, and pBreaker, with iReumii being one of the hosts, a level that took 12 months of extremely hard work from everyone involved, which is evident when you play or see the level.

A minute long adventure, No Mans Land has an abandoned ruin theme that is carried entirely by it's great backgrounds, ambientation and effects, taking you through different enviroments and settings, where the location, weather and time of day changes, fully immersing you into it's world. Very excited to see this teams future projects.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/751598

DMYn_YkssfA.title: ''Plummet'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Vicolor [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
DMYn_YkssfA.description:
As with most XXL levels, when it comes to the most important aspect of them, it's all about the journey, the atmosphere, the feeling of progression, going through many different places that are all connected but vary in their design and aesthetic, and Plümmet nails this perfectly. 

It's slower sections are calming and soothing, while the faster parts are intense and colorful, this in tune to the music is the perfect way to get immersed into a world.Vicolor is at this point an established creator in my opinion, seeing how every level he releases has something special, while also being high quality.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/885164

kI3jRN3uX_Q.title: ''Hallucination'' 100% (Demon) by MaximalDash | Geometry Dash
kI3jRN3uX_Q.description:
An incredibly fun, engaging and challenging minigame, Hallucination takes osu!mania and brings it into Geometry Dash, along with it's style, vibrant colors and intense gameplay. This is one of those levels and minigames, that even after you've beaten it, you want to keep playing, whether it's because of it's enjoyability or you want to get a better score, there's replay value here.

All that and even without mentioning the fact of how impressive it is that someone was able to make something like this, it's great to see how levels continue to evolve.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/568369

CoJwYszlPnU.title: ''High Flo'' 100% (Demon) by SpooFy [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
CoJwYszlPnU.description:
It's been over a year since SpooFy's last level, PinPoint, so it's really nice to see him back with something new and High Flo being this good is to be expected. A colorful level with high intensity, a bright and upbeat vibe and atmosphere that through it's animations and vibrant effects will grab your attention almost immediately. Everything about this level is smooth and you can see the effort put into it in every aspect of deco.

The design as a whole is unique to me, since the background is pitch black most of the time, with some colors or shapes appearing from time to time, but the amount of things going on in the foreground more than make up for that. Great level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1027844

VQPTwIpf0sU.title: ''Megalovania'' 100% (Demon) by LViper & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
VQPTwIpf0sU.description:
A beautiful remake of Blaireswip's Megalovania level that was released many years ago, that manages to keep the same spirit and design layout as the original, while revamping just about every bit of decoration at the same time. The art, the attacks, the obstacles, the block design, and especially the backgrounds, all look amazing. This is a level that I didn't expect to get a remake but I'm extremely happy it did.

What is most impressive to me is the fact that this was made in less than a week, but it isn't surprising when you see the great creators that participated in it's creation.

jkETeJV8KP4.title: 39 Objects! | Colliderscope by Flash | Geometry Dash
jkETeJV8KP4.description:
A simple level Flash made by using only 39 objects, and it actually looks really cool.
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/482139

3NoXn_Ef2Co.title: Trigger Finger by RHYTHMMASTER | Geometry Dash
3NoXn_Ef2Co.description:
When you see a level from RHYTHMMASTER, you know to expect something unique, interesting, funny or outright cinematic, but it's always a spectacle, and Trigger Finger is all of this combined.

We get to see an exceptionally satisfying animation, where your only job is to keep spamming, keep clicking and keep firing your weapons, adding onto this, the sync is perfect and makes it all the more fun to experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/896217

NDyZk23b4O0.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Quantum Processing'' 100% by Riot | Geometry Dash
NDyZk23b4O0.description: In the first hour of playing this, I almost fluked it from 47%, but died at the last cube at 87%, it took me a really long time to get back there again and when I did, I died at 90%. The biggest chokepoint in this level is definitely the ship at 1:13, with how hard it is plus the nerves it makes it really difficult to get past it, still better than hatred though. gg

_1W0KFniN3k.title: ''Froot Lupes'' 100% (Demon) by Dolphe & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
_1W0KFniN3k.description:
Froot Lupes is a fantastic collab, simply due to the fact that it's a joke level that transcends itself due to the high quality of it's design, you can see the effort that went into it.

I think that one of the best aspects that a level can have is when you can perceive that the creators had fun and enjoyed making it, the bosses, animations and backgrounds are fun due to this, making it fun to play, with the different tasks you must do for the coins an added challenge.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/791551

yorsyJK3nvk.title: Assembly Line by Splinter25 | Geometry Dash
yorsyJK3nvk.description:
At this point, there isn't anything new you can say about Splinter, a creator that consistently releases bangers, who has maintained his high quality throughout time, and Assembly Line is just the newest installment.

A level with a very interesting concept, where each and every ship, spider and cube is put together before going out into the world, a concept that is executed perfectly, the animations are smooth, the backgrounds are lively and the factory theme is filled with detail. The fact that the gameplay is subtly tied to the design and transitions is the cherry on top.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1088357

DnQ-CG2hrZE.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Hatred'' 100% by AZuLer4 & SrGuillester | Geometry Dash
DnQ-CG2hrZE.description:
This was so much harder than the past 3 extremes I've done, I really underestimated this level going into it. The ball at the beginning takes so unbelievably long to get consistent at, and the 3x jump right before the drop feels entirely luck based, this is the only thing that prevents you from getting anywhere. I don't know why the last 20% is so easy compared to the rest of the level, but I'm kinda glad it is or else it would be way worse. gg

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/553242

YLOeR8ZXMQA.title: Fury X by Angel Z | Geometry Dash
YLOeR8ZXMQA.description:
Fury X has as much detail and objects put into a single section as an entire level, the amount of minute decoration and art that went into every part of this is crazy to see, and impressive to say the least. I can definitely see people's opinions on this level being pretty divided, personally I think it looks really cool.

The colors used in this level fit the astral theme, the lighting effects serving to emphasize these different shades of purple and blue, with the fast pace only amplifying this effect, it's a trip for sure.

_pWvKNkusHA.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Killbot'' 100% by BoldStep | Geometry Dash
_pWvKNkusHA.description: This is REALLY fun for a memory level, everything is really consistent and fun to play. The last UFO is definitely the hardest part, since you can't see anything it takes thousands of attempts just to do it once, and I still wasn't very consistent at it even while beating it, but I still like the challenge it gives you. GG :)

f7nscS7RdoU.title: ''Erou'' 100% (XXL Demon) by JonathanGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
f7nscS7RdoU.description:
Erou is Jonathan's latest level, that's finally been released after 2 years of arduous and dedicated work. Many people, including myself have been waiting for it, and I'm happy to say it did not disappoint, which is always the case with Jon.

With Erou you get to see how far he's come with his style and creative output throughout the years, maintaining his uniqueness, while gaining more polish and a more solid, established style. So you still get the bright colors, the soothing gameplay and the duals as well, great level that was worth the wait.

Song: Veva - 1f1n1ty
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/699343

U7nn_HVknKA.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Digital Descent'' 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
U7nn_HVknKA.description:
Fun level, though I got pretty lucky by fluking the last 20%. I don't know yet if I will do Cybernetic Crescent since that is miles harder than both, but we'll see.

Song: Creo - Carnivores
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/690265

nNa3j2MOIsc.title: Made in 3 days! | ''Rojo y Azul'' by Apstrom | Geometry Dash
nNa3j2MOIsc.description:
If there were no evidence, it would be very hard to believe that this level was made in only 3 days, given it's insanely high level of quality, it's polish and fidelity. Rojo y Azul has it all and even though it's just under a minute long, you get just about everything you would want out of a level, it has strong, satisfying colors, a clean block design, intense and flashy effects, smooth transitions and even art with some animations.

If all that wasn't enough, Apstrom even managed to include a bossfight in the second half, it's short but it has an interesting design and it's attacks make for fun gameplay. What keeps coming to mind is that if he could make this in 3 days, what could he do with more time.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/994478

URwPErFdH7c.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Artificial Ascent'' 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
URwPErFdH7c.description: I love this level, I've always wanted to do this since it came out back in 2016, and I'm really glad it's done now. Not much to say about this other than this level is super fun, and I recommend to this to anyone that has the skill to do it. GG :)

s1XG-61UX7Y.title: ''CELESTIAL INERTIA'' 100% (Demon) by Eteruu & More | Geometry Dash
s1XG-61UX7Y.description:
Celestial Inertia is a great megacollab where a ton of extremely gifted creators got together to make something that is very special. A level where each and every section intertwines with one another smoothly. Where a high level of quality is maintained throughout the entire thing, which is not easy to do, so it goes to show how good they are.

Having an overarching theme that is executed through it's block design, it's spacy color palette, which include a variety of purples, blues and a couple other soothing colors, the space/techno ambiance is relaxing and intense when it needs to be. The punchy effects are also a strong point, the subtle shake effects, the moody lighting, it's all there and it helps to accentuate the buildup and the drop. Huge props to everyone involved.

Creators: Whata, Azure, Hypno, Kyoze, Koopazu, Py, Gianv, Landy, Ardi, PMaster, Ellip, Mazzedy, Skars, Eteru, Lightningsl, Jairo, GeometryPilot, Mzero, Miguelli35, Exvii, Gradientxxd, Liu, Vollerae, Xz, Tah, Viridyan

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/827327

lt01KIyEKdM.title: United by Unzor | Geometry Dash
lt01KIyEKdM.description:
A while has passed since Unzor's previous level, and since his levels are always great, the wait felt longer than it was, but if you've seen or played this level, I'm sure everyone can say that the wait was certainly worth it. 

A longer level, which is always welcome, with a sleek/animated style that fits perfectly with the art he created, the cute creatures that help you along the way, aiding you in your travel across this kingdom, which is a nice change of pace from bossfights, which ends up being a relaxing yet engaging experience.

The effects, art, backgrounds and entire atmosphere of this level are great, it really feels like you're going on an entire adventure, going through many different places, accompanied by your small friends, which I think we can agree are the best part about this.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/873544

ID: 79409828

An insanely fun level from Cursed Gang, featuring many talented creators that are known for their effect layouts. A level where you can see the amount of fun yet care was put into it, with the end product being almost 2 minutes of unique effects that don't adhere to any rules, that are very satisfying to watch. The chaos within this level is it's strongest point, so I highly recommend you play this for yourself.

Z_5yxBnwk2w.title: Dropdead by QuitoraSQR | Geometry Dash
Z_5yxBnwk2w.description:
Level: Dropdead by QuitoraSQR
ID: 50729215
Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ow4eYirS-2A

A 2.1 layout that looks like it came straight out of 2.2, which is crazy to say since this came out many years ago at this point, but it's still an incredibly original level from Quitora. A plethora of effects are here, which at the time, some hadn't even been seen, which makes it all the more impressive. A level with bizarre pacing due to it's music, with sharp changes to it's speed and intensity, while having great sync as well. It's one of those levels that you can't stop watching, because you don't know what could come next.

d84elx9uuDk.title: [2.2] ''Dark Complex'' by Angel669 | Geometry Dash
d84elx9uuDk.description:
Level: Dark Complex by Angel669
Played on 2.2 GDPS
Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kCaEkRaWqmo

A great layout from Angel, fast paced, a nice variety of effects, and best of all, it matches the intensity of it's music perfectly. A complete experience in my opinion, this and many other layouts are proof that you don't always need decoration, the fast movements, the simple lighting flash, and camera triggers make this layout stand out, a fun experience that offers a lot of enjoyement.

xYDTxxb3DjA.title: help
xYDTxxb3DjA.description:
A showcase of what the advanced follow trigger can do, with both blocks and spikes, and just getting to play this and see how the objects move and interact, it's exciting to see how this will be implemented into 2.2 with bossfights.

Played in 2.2 GPDS Lite
