253771
229088
247579

oAOW7AUKAyw.description:
Level: I made something by Yeqru
ID: 78163563
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/771738

Another level from Yeqru, a creator that definitely deserves more attention for their creations, since you can see the amount of polish that go into them, which in the end makes all the better. I made something is a layout that has an epic, slightly emotional vibe and atmosphere to it, whether it's due to the song or the effects, maybe a combination of both. I really like the fact that each section has something different to showcase, the unique progression mechanic in the beginning or the part that comes after with it's sense of verticality. The Michi tribute is beautiful as well.

f0yrml1m9kA.title: [2.2] ''Game Over'' by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash
f0yrml1m9kA.description:
Robotic24 has been making 2.2 levels for years now, and I'm so happy to see that he's still active and creating such high quality creations, of all shapes and sizes, with Game Over being no exception. A level that uses the effects, blocks and various other aspects that can be seen in the 2.2 sneak peek, implementing them into something original. Even though it's only a minute long, there is a lot packed into it, many effects that we'll see more and more in the future.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/802510

vIDnjdJviaY.title: PAINT MADNESS
vIDnjdJviaY.description:
Level: Paper Madness by Yeqru
ID: 78233036

Paper Madness is a level that will give a lot of people nostalgia, a genre of levels that was popular many years ago, it's always fun to look back into trends and find something that's more recent showcasing it, my favorite part about this level is the fact that each and every aspect of it is either paper or a sketch, and the fact that the drawings also move a bit adds life to the level as well. Overall just short and sweet.

pG2Oa7jwqoQ.title: [2.2] ''Nemesis'' by K76 | Geometry Dash
pG2Oa7jwqoQ.description:
Nemesis is an immensly fun layout to play, because of it's variety in gamemodes, using almost each one, it's 2.2 aspects and pacing, a level that utilizes these new effects tastefully without going overboard. My favorite section has to be the dual at 1:30, it's so different from a lot of things we get to see, it's fun and it shows the great potential the camera triggers have.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/732009

p7SIgTEqSOw.title: The Impossible Game
p7SIgTEqSOw.description:
Played on 2.2 GDPS Lite
Level: The Impossible Game by m1nt

m1nt has created what might be the best recreation of The Impossible Game we are going to get, from the classic orange cube, to the blocks and especially the gradient background that wasn't possible until recently, all that combined to give some a trip down memory lane, the game that inspired GD.

WLMzzl285RE.title: 3Dash by DelugeDrop (All Levels)
WLMzzl285RE.description:
3Dash By DelugeDrop: https://youtu.be/sjq_S-dPT9A
DelugeDrop: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUXrwrG7zeuvAiFD5kptw2Q/videos

3Dash is an incredible fan game created by the very talented DelugeDrop, where you get to experience GD in a 3D, with visuals and gameplay elements that incorporate this new dimension perfectly, Deluge made a video explaining in detail the process of making this game and how it works, which is linked at the top.

HUw5bp3onB4.title: [2.2] ''Showdown'' by K76 | Geometry Dash
HUw5bp3onB4.description:
K76 has made some of the best 2.2 layouts out there, and I think Showdown is a perfect example of that, utilizing 2.2 effects and triggers and their potential to make so many different things. A layout that uses camera controls, reverse gameplay, even having a bossfight, which just makes you imagine all the amazing ones we'll get in the future.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/753446

ReOkYZJBYIg.title: pibby
ReOkYZJBYIg.description:
Level: Save by YunHaSeu14
ID: 75776048

YunHaSeu is an extremely talented creator that has released a large and wide variety of levels, of all shapes and sizes, all being of very high quality, so it's exciting to see when a creator like this makes something as different and unique as this, taking on a glitch/horror level, inspired by the adult swim show pibby, the progression from normality to running for your life is done nicely, the effects building up over time, alongside the music, it's fast-paced, intense, creepy in it's own way and fun to play.

uwLfldpXuDs.title: ''Fingerdash Full Version'' by Music Sounds | Geometry Dash
uwLfldpXuDs.description: Another Full Version level from Music Sounds, this time it's FingerDash, the incredibly popular official level that was released alongside the 2.1 update, and one of his best, you can see the amount of thought that went into the extensions, instead of simply repeating sections or copying and pasting, there are new sections that connect to the old ones nicely, it makes sense, the gameplay and design is close to the original, but most importantly it's enjoyable to play.

vcnVVpIsPoM.title: Layout.exe
vcnVVpIsPoM.description:
Level: Dark Patience by KitsuneEdu
ID:57402376

A level/layout that shines through it's many effects, the lighting, glitching, the movement and speed changes, the backgrounds, everything that pushes the creepy vibe, that in perfect conjuction with the music that is used, complete a bizarre, unsettling, but very interesting experience, making a level like this can not be easy, but when it's executed well, it does the job.

8yq2z4zE-ok.title: The Backrooms in Geometry Dash
8yq2z4zE-ok.description:
Level: Followed by Trynon
ID: 80741266

Followed is to date the best recreation of the backrooms, that has become more and more popular in recent months, a deeply interesting concept and world that has been built, and seeing it in this game where horror levels are very enjoyable, this definitely deserved attention, the visuals are creepy, and it captures the essence of it's source material nicely.

GDKP5nDhHeU.title: [2.2] ''Power Trip Full Version'' by Music Sounds | Geometry Dash
GDKP5nDhHeU.description: Music Sounds has made a ton of Full Version levels, from every GD game we have, and they're all very well made, with it's original style and gameplay still there, but building on top of it, expanding with these both aspects in a way where they don't look or play out of place, fitting in with the first part, because I'm sure there are a bunch of players that wish many of these levels were longer and it's being delivered here.

Adx7lpmURcU.title: Press Start 2? | ''Start Buster'' by Darking128 | Geometry Dash 2.2
Adx7lpmURcU.description:
This level came out about 2 years ago and is obviously heavily inspired by the widely known and liked Press Start from SubZero. Start Buster has a ton of the same effects used in the original, and some that are unique to itself, which makes it creative and fun to watch, taking advantage of the camera triggers, fixed camera, etc, helps it a lot in terms of variety and enjoyabilty with it's different gameplay elements.

Song: https://youtu.be/iXj4wR70Xf0

ORNfs8Wmah4.title: NEW 2.2 EFFECTS | Geometry Dash
ORNfs8Wmah4.description:
Level: Test Lvl Effects by Nikita665

As 2.2 seems to be closer and closer by the day, it means that more features and tools start to come out as well, and today I'm showcasing some of the effect presets you may see when the update drops, which are all so different from what we're used to and will open up so many possibilities in the future.

Song: Hinkik - Explorers | https://youtu.be/fc1tg9qkGyI

rEnFUkSMWys.title: UFO
rEnFUkSMWys.description:
Level: Red vs UFO by Izhar
Played on 2.2 GDPS

Red vs. UFO is a fun and satisfying platformer level, where you climb up different obstacles, while dodging falling blocks and enemies, being reminiscent of Mario vs. Donkey Kong, the soundtrack is fitting, the effects are subtle yet engaging, the level design is good, having it's degree of difficulty due to the platforming controls and with the various things you have to dodge, and the best of all, it implements a bunch of 2.2 effects and triggers, that when you put everything together, it's simply a fun experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/871523

HikpP38yBBA.title: The Golden Circles by issanagаy | Geometry Dash

lty3HOhXIgo.title: Versus Mode?
lty3HOhXIgo.description:
Level: Bossfight III by JuStMax2m
Played on 2.2 GDPS

Another really cool sneak peek of what will be possible when 2.2 releases, which we can all hope is soon at this point, with the platforming mode having so much potential to bring us a wide variety of level types, and we can all be sure that bossfights as we know them will never be the same, the amount of interactivity that's possible here is exciting to say the least, and this level is just a snippet of that.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/641172

Te9A8CruSx4.title: [2.2] ''I Love You'' by Astraa | Geometry Dash
Te9A8CruSx4.description:
We've been seeing more and more of these types of levels be created recently, which can best be described, in my opinion as music videos, where the song and it's sync with the gameplay and design is the main point and aspect of the level, which has helped each and every one of these to stand out and be widely unique between one another.

Using a layout style with many different effects, both in the lighting and movement departments, with the added plus of 2.2 camera effects and triggers, that gives it a sense of novelty and makes it a lot more enjoyable to play.

yzMlVYHgYMw.description:
Level: Lay With Out by SiminaX
Played on 2.2 GDPS

A 2.2 level that has a bunch of unique aspects to it, the usage of the new teleport/spider orbs, that add a new dimension to gameplay, the different movements within the block design and the level itself that are ever present in these types of levels, and the best part towards the end where you the player and the obstacles split and multiply, where each line has to jump at a different time to avoid the spike, it looks really cool and adds a bit of difficulty as well, but being synced to the music is both satisfying and helpful.

02J1Cl3uc5s.title: ''Fuel'' by Bli [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
02J1Cl3uc5s.description:
The making of a game within a game has been done many times at this point within GD, but it still surprises me how there are so many creative and talented creators in this community, capable of outputting insane amounts of detail and enjoyment, sometimes even using few objects, it will never cease to amaze me, and this level is no different.

Fuel is Bli's newest level, a racing game, where you go against one other racer to see who can get the most amount of laps within the time limit, with the gameplay being centered around clicking within the purple and yellow parts of the speedometer to speed up, which is satisfying to click, especially when you do it perfectly, having different colors and effects depending how you do, which adds weight to what you do.There are a bunch of other effects scattered just about everywhere, all the different bits of info you see on screen, speed, time, laps, distance and all that, adding to the immersion.

The design is beautiful here, the backgrounds are vast and so different from one another, that you do feel like you're racing around the world, it's all so detailed with a strong sense of progression.

Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Onwxdg0YBhE&t=0s

P3DcQhqbq2U.title: Elements IV by Solacress | Geometry Dash
P3DcQhqbq2U.description:
When I see animations like this, that are longer and have a story that they follow, whether it's the first installment or a sequel, I always think about the amount of time and effort that must go into them, all the different places you visit, the characters, the movements and the ambience, especially when there are fight sequences, and to make it all connect with each other, that's what you get with Elements, a story where a group of protectors try to stop an evil lord that wants to take over the world using a strange artifact, a tale as old as time, but that continues to be effective in grasping the viewer or players attention.

All the art and different effects do a great job of putting you into the story, making you care about the characters, and wanting to see a good conclusion to this story, there are many settings you see, deserts, forest, snowy plains that all look different but you can tell they're connected, but at the same time there are hints of realism as well, with the damage the characters recieve while fighting, adding a sense of urgence to the story.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1137139

rlkHQP50R7k.title: Digital Essence by MAYEROSA | Geometry Dash
rlkHQP50R7k.description:
What is 100% the best level MAYEROSA has given us to date, the cybernetic/technological theme is done beautifully here, with so much detail brewed into the design, the block design, backgrounds, and all the art that go into them, it all goes together so nicely, and the cherry on top being the effects, especially when it comes to the lighting, that accent the colors and the decoration, to make it all stand out a bit more.

When it comes to making levels of this nature, using this theme, this is one of the best, it does everything right, it does make you feel like you're inside the mainframe, and the fact that it's longer than most makes it even better, since you can enjoy the design for a bit more.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/104608

E9elhh9EX68.title: ''Dimension'' 100% (Demon) by Jorgem1gue7 | Geometry Dash
E9elhh9EX68.description:
It really is amazing to see an absolute classic such as Dimension be used in new levels, especially when they are as high-quality as this, a level that goes by the same name, that captures it's essence and vibe perfectly, translating it into a banger of a level, one that takes you on a journey, a beginning middle and end, where you get a sense of story progression and conclusion, due mostly to the beautiful art that is showcased all throughout, in the background, foreground, block design and especially the boss towards the end.

You get so much detail in each part of this level, one of the best ways to immerse players into your level is to integrate parts of the design into the gameplay, instead of just making it a background, it adds a ton of weight to the decoration and makes each part of it feel and look important. This is one of those levels that is more of a short movie rather than just a short level.

The design for the bossfight is also amazing, it's powerful, frightening, it blends into the world perfectly, it's movements are smooth and it has a wide gamut of attacks, definitely one of the best aspects about this.

ID: 81162638
Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/709578

eyIupDXdvnA.title: PONG by Jasii | Geometry Dash
eyIupDXdvnA.description:
This level is the definition of short and incredibly sweet, with Dunderpatrullen's song being established in the community at this point, here we have Jasii capturing the intensity and fun that the music brings.

The first half is perfect at building up towards the drop, it's slower, but it isn't lesser when it comes to power in it's design, the lighting is there, the obstacles all have animations to them, to give a bit more life since there are few backgrounds, the colors are bright and vibrant, but most importantly it gets you pumped up in anticipation for the, at this point, iconic drop.

The effects, transitions and all the different details both big and small in the second half really makes you wish this level was longer, but with the quality at this level you can't complain, a fun level is what it is.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/980038

eP0HZnegYuk.title: (Insane Demon) ''Star World'' 100% by CarlosArt16 | Geometry Dash
eP0HZnegYuk.description:
When a creator grabs a theme, an aesthetic or a style and embraces it to it's fullest potential, you know the level is going to be great, and that is exactly what you get with Star World, an experience that incorporates the stars into almost every aspect of it's design, while managing to make every bit and detail blend together, but at the same time stand on it's own and grab your attention, this is an Insane Demon that you replay simply due to just how amazing it's design is.

And that's without even mentioning how satisfying the sync between song, gameplay and effects is, with the latter being incredibly varied, unique but most importantly fun and without constraints, especially the part at 1:04, that looks so different from the rest of the level, but the lighting, colors, just about everything is just right.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/878987

YB58oWnNL4k.title: ''RIGHT on TARGET'' 100% (Demon) by AlaskaFX | Geometry Dash
YB58oWnNL4k.description:
An fantastic nine circles level was made in less than 2 weeks which blows my mind, the fact that you can make something this enjoyable in that amount of time, with fun gameplay, an intense vibe, clean effects and a satisfying design, with the lighting and glow being the most visually appealing parts, and rightfully so.

The atmosphere hits you from the very beginning, partially due to the song being a banger, a remix of Bullseye made by desx, and the unique block design and color combinations you get to see, combining old themes and styles with new decoration teqniques will always look great, since you get the best of both worlds, amazing level, can't wait to see what alaska does next.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1133974

5ULYcv_O2Fo.title: (Insane Demon) ''Auroral Bloom'' 100% by Loltad | Geometry Dash
5ULYcv_O2Fo.description:
I love the dreamy/ethereal aesthetic that Auroral Bloom has, it's a perfect combination between gameplay, design and in this case especially, the music, everything combines and intertwines with each other in such a beautiful and satisfying way, that alone makes it stand out above many others, to me at least. Another aspect I appreciate about this is how open-ended it looks and plays, you don't feel like you're going through a narrow corridor, there's a ton of verticality involved, which gives you a better sense of freedom within the level.

The design is also a big plus here, the color palette is unique, using different tones of pink and purple, with some black to contrast, that fit into the theme perfectly, with the backgrounds, most likely being your main point of focus throughout, with all it's different patterns that sync with the music.

Song | Creo - Aurora: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1002120

-aPEvkR97q4.title: Dancing Moonman by XxJ0SHxX | Geometry Dash
-aPEvkR97q4.description: This got rated a few days ago, and the gameplay is actually so fun I didn't even use practice I just sightread the whole thing. Also would you even consider this a layout, it has a little bit of deco, effects and some movement so I'm not quite sure.

7FzBsQg_MpM.title: ''Dailen'' 100% (Demon) by iIRedCatIi [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
7FzBsQg_MpM.description:
A level where you can see the passion, intensity and emotion all over the place, from the pacing and gameplay, to all the different effects, backgrounds and animations, and the fact that the level is "backwards" is something that makes it unique, something you don't see very often. You can tell this level is important to RedCat because of the amount of detail, the refinement and especially all the insane effects in the 2nd half.

The colors are varied, strong and combine with one another nicely, and the fact that all of them including the lighting flash and change along with the music makes it very satisfying to play, also due to the gameplay, transitions being smoothed out.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/923742

5Du3wJ_rqKk.title: ''Crystalized Rebirth'' 100% (Demon) by nikiy0 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
5Du3wJ_rqKk.description:
A level from an unknown, yet extremely promising creator, an adventure that is very consistent with what is in my opinion a great boss sequence, where the first half is the perfect buildup, in terms of design, gameplay, and even storytelling, I enjoyed the mix between the slower sections, with the text showing up on screen giving you context and story, and the intensity of the entire second half that's taken up by the boss battle.

Speaking about design, the art is clean and it's brought to new heights due to the smooth animations that nikiy0 tied to it, having weight to them, while being fast and satisfying. The backgrounds have layers to them, fitting into the theme and even feeling connected in a cohesive way, going through the caves, then ruins and finally at a wasteland with what appear to be giant metallic structures.

Now onto the bossfight, which to me is the best part about this level, the design is unique and tied to the story, there are a wide variety of attacks, the animations are great, but most importantly it looks and plays threatening, which makes a good bossfight.

Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/702983

QyoCDUKUsdI.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Yatagarasu'' 100% by Trusta | Geometry Dash
QyoCDUKUsdI.description: Well, I wasn't planning to do a level from this difficulty, but I tried this and I actually ended up enjoying this level a lot. Took me about a week to beat this.

Z9JjyZb25aw.title: Yatagarasu 77%
Z9JjyZb25aw.description: Started practicing this like a week ago and got this pretty quick when I started playing from 0%, surprisingly fun level so far.

8tGJIi94hE8.title: [2.2] ''Prexium'' by Ultranox | Geometry Dash
8tGJIi94hE8.description:
It feels like the more time passes, the more 2.2 levels we get, so I can't even imagine the amount of levels that we are going to be able to experience when it comes, that will be at this level or even greater with time. Prexium is another sneak peek into the future of this game, and I'm pretty excited. That and with the gameplay and traversal being so unique, it truly feels special, fresh and new, and a genuine joy to play.

p0iFiTd5VgY.title: ''Mass Production'' 100% (Demon) by Optation & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
p0iFiTd5VgY.description:
Mass Production is a Megacollab between Optation and a bunch of other creators, a level goes above and beyond when it comes to executing it's factory/mechanical theme, the atmosphere is on point, the design is clean and concise, the music is an absolute perfect fit that adds so much to the effects and vibe, so it all comes together beautifully.

Everyone that had a part in this, whether it's gameplay or decoration did a fantastic job, the effects, lighting and colors look great and fit the theme nicely, with the backgrounds being  one of the strongest aspects about this level, playing a huge part in setting the tone, a great collab overall.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/859847

5oiD5Al-aTM.title: 28k Objects! | ''Everluscious'' by galofuf | Geometry Dash
5oiD5Al-aTM.description:
This level is the perfect proof that you don't need to have an enormous amount of objects to make something that is beautiful and filled to the brim with details, both big and small, 28k objects is what it took to make this amazing, magical forest themed level.

Everluscious has a sense of progress and grandure from the very beginning, you truly feel immersed into this world when you see all the trees, grass and plantlife surrounding you, the added particles giving a sense of realism as well, with the best part being the great backgrounds that layer between one another to add a feeling of depth to the decoration.

There's also a really nice contrast between the day and night sections within the same space, following the same style but with different effect, such as the lighting, and with all that there's still room for a beautiful end-screen as well, to top it all off.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/793815

qzsVQg-fx14.title: ''Shadows of Dawn'' 100% (Demon) by GhostAppleGD | Geometry Dash
qzsVQg-fx14.description:
Shadows of Dawn is one of those levels that is the perfect mix of intense and fast-paced, and slow, methodical build-up, a fantastic combination of light and dark, not only that, but with astonishing art and, a complete adventure/story and vibe to match.

From the very beginning when you get thrown into a dark cave, you see a bunch of different, small details, like the teeth surrounding you, some pools of liquid shifting around the bottom and various sources of light such as torches or holes in the ceiling, things that immerse you into the space that you're in, and the more you progress the more details and tidbits like these you can see.

And then there's the drop, which is obviously the best part of the level, after an almost minute long buildup, it goes from 0-100 fast, with dragons chasing and firing lasers at you, your surroundings start to break down and catch you, and every effect looks amazing, and unique from one another.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/709578

6rpqbGzcnPM.title: ZenthicAlpha's Final Level | ''Fuze II'' 100% (Demon) by ZenthicAlpha & GDSkele | Geometry Dash
6rpqbGzcnPM.description:
Zenthic is without a doubt a legend in this community, being here for so long and creating so many great and impactful levels, and participating in a huge number of collabs, many of us growing up playing his levels, so it's very sad to see him leaving the game. 

But before that we get one final level, a collab with the very talented Skele, Fuze II has that classic Zenthic style and decoration, combined with the more modern take in the second half.

The design overall has an older vibe to it, but it's still incredibly clean, having a great use of color, lighting effects and smooth movements in the blocks and obstacles, and the great choice of music is the cherry on top. I truly wish Zenthic the very best for the future and I hope he knows how much he means to the community.

Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/897494

jQ_4CZ-SP8E.title: Pilipinas by tisYuurei & More | Geometry Dash
jQ_4CZ-SP8E.description:
A megacollab from tisYuurei and a bunch of other talented creators that has finally been released after two years of what's clearly been a ton of hard work and dedication. 

Pilipinas is a beautiful homage to the Phillipines, showing the architecture, different places, symbols, etc, that are all portrayed by amazing art, every background is high quality, with the rest of the design following suit, at the same time each section being connected and following a path through these different scenes.

There are also a bunch of animations and movements tied to most objects, that follow the vibe of the music really nicely, while being smooth.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/919253

wKCiH5uvGF4.title: ForLife by JoseCalebCV | Geometry Dash
wKCiH5uvGF4.description:
Another amazing level from Jose, ever since Michito was released half a year ago, I knew he was just going to get better with time, and this is proof of that, you can't even call this level a "Layout", since it's so much more, having detail, style and looking more alive than so many other fully decorated levels. 

The animations are the best part to me, they are so fluid yet carry so much weight, it's incredibly satisfying to watch and play, it even adds to the atmosphere and vibe of the level, having platforms and objects floating around and seeming weightless, and the fact that they respond and interact with your icon, it immerses you even more.

The lighting effects and glow is another strong aspect about this level, in the middle of a pitch black space, the light emanating from the orbs and even your icon looks amazing, and it even syncs to the music, which is an added plus.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/840861

DHcFQdppcBk.title: (Extreme Demon) ''APEX'' 100% by StarkyTheSalad, para & Marwec | Geometry Dash
DHcFQdppcBk.description:
APEX is an Extreme Demon collab where you get input from a couple of very talented creators, with Starky being the sole decorator, and para and Marwec being in charge of the gameplay side of things which in the end, makes sure that it has a ton of strong aspects, from all fronts. From the clean, simple yet effective block design, to it's flashing lights and ever-changing colors, which combined with the fast paced soundtrack and gameplay, makes for a high-octane and enjoyable Demon.

The variation in brightness is also an interesting factor, some parts are darker in tones and lighting, slowing down the gameplay as well, helping add a bit more variety to the experience, and giving breathing room as well, where the backgrounds add the last bit of detail needed to paint the complete picture.

The gameplay was really fun overall, a couple of inconsistencies though, with the red orbs in the second ball section that are pretty difficult to pull off, and the last wave that feels much harder than the rest of the level, though it might just be the lag that makes the wave slightly more difficult. Other than that, I enjoyed my time with this level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/927398

Ej5HWgRS9cs.title: Almost Strange by Lespainsaucho | Geometry Dash
Ej5HWgRS9cs.description:
LesPainSaucho has been making these types of strange and unique levels for a while now, and they've all had their own aspects that make them stand out above other levels and this is no different, and while Almost Strange is tamer than some of his other creations, it's still a great layout level.

The movement, like many other creations of this type, is the most important and refined aspect of it, being incredibly smooth and satisfying visually and having perfect sync with the music, but most importantly, they're fun to play.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/845915

_MbsMPOLGV0.title: ''Quadratic Chamber'' 100% (Demon) by fruitsnack [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
_MbsMPOLGV0.description:
Fruitsnack is an OG, he was making levels long before some of the creators you may know now, he'd been gone for 4 years, but came back a few weeks ago with this new level, which came as a huge surprise to anyone who remembered him, and it's always nice to hear that someone who used to be in the community full time went to live their best lives, even more when they return to give a new level to the game.

The most impressive part about this level to me is the fact that it was made and verified entirely on mobile, which is still incredible to me, and after such a long break, he always had a style that was appealing to me, being clean and concise without abusing certain effects, a great implementation of color and lighting, and a bit of glow, so it's great to see that after a long time he hasn't lost his touch.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1096305

JdIZfsOFux0.title: HEMI by X1RON | Geometry Dash
JdIZfsOFux0.description:
An insanely cool modern level from X1RON, that is so incredibly polished and clean from top to bottom, sleek effects plaguing the entirety of this adventure, with satisfyingly simple block design that doesn't take your attention away from the pattern-filled and geometrical backgrounds, while still leaving an impact due to their smooth movements and great colors.

HEMI is one of those levels, to me, that is better in the second half, once the drop hits, since everything from the pacing, to the design pick up heavily, everything feels and looks much more alive, that being said, the first half is still fantastic and a great build-up, albeit a bit slower, speaking about the second half, the effects here are really cool, transitions, animations, lighting, it's all there and melded together perfectly.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1077346

ae83N8GceJY.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Enlightened Memories'' 100% by Nyseoul | Geometry Dash
ae83N8GceJY.description:
This beautiful Extreme came out about 3 months ago, and it will most likely be his last solo level in a while, as is said in the endscreen, which is a shame, but understandable, but at least we have this fantastic level for now. 

Enlightened memories has a sketch-like design and vibe to it, with it's dark outlines and it's black and white theme for most of the level until the very end, which I enjoyed and think it's fits nicely with the art, and switching the dominant color is a smart way to keep it monochrome without looking repetetive, and the amazing backgrounds help with that too.

The pacing is another great aspect about this level, starting off slow and ramping up slowly until the drop where it goes full throttle, following the music perfectly, with art and backgrounds to match, to make for an enjoyable adventure.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/713482

fwjIXntIiko.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Disruption'' 100% by Ka1sa & More | Geometry Dash
fwjIXntIiko.description:
This is actually so fun, just wish the waves were slightly easier, still had a blast playing this though. It also looks really good, I love that small transition with the cube splitting, and the lightning effects scattered throughout. 
 
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/486539

9c7VsaS5l8c.title: Red Mug by Lyriaki | Geometry Dash
9c7VsaS5l8c.description:
Lyriaki has recently done some work in various collabs, like THE LAUNCH, but this time we got a solo level, that's of the same consistent quality and standard like his other levels, having a strong connection between the effects, vibrant colors and a unique block design, that all ties together to make a satisfying experience, due to it's amount of refinement. Red and white is a combination that will never get old, especially when the effects and animations are so smooth, with the glow adding a way for objects to pop out even more.

One of my favorite parts about the level is the fact that the platforms, backgrounds and objects in the foreground are so different from one another and integrate into the gameplay, it makes the entire decoration feel much more interactive and alive, making you a part of it, there are also some glitch effects that are subtle but fit into the design really nicely.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1047247

JQ5nicXQLjc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Dole Damos'' 100% by Jeyzor | Geometry Dash
JQ5nicXQLjc.description:
Dole Damos is impressive visually, as is the norm when it comes to Jeyzor's levels, using solid colors that are all so different but work together at the same time, surrounded by dark outlines that really give it an inky/drawn aesthetic that looks very clean, the strong contrast between this and the softer backgrounds gives a sense of depth.

The effects are also great, the pixelized transition that appears a few times is very unique, which Jeyzor took a while to make those effects, and they turned out really good. There are also some small animations here and there throughout the level, especially the one at the end, that bring the design to life.

The gameplay is also very unique, though there are some unbalanced clicks in this level that almost feel like they're frame perfect, such as the black orb at 0:09 that you have to hit in an extremely specific way otherwise you'd miss the pink pad or the orbs that come right after, the blue orb at 0:23 is probably the most difficult click in the predrop. The green orb timing at 0:26, the yellow orb with the robot at 0:37, and the red orb at 0:43 where half the time the cube doesn't land properly on the red orb so it feels nearly frame perfect. 

The last ship is also pretty inconsistent, I could never really find myself doing that part all that often even after beating it. Without the unbalanced clicks, the rest of the level plays good in my opinion, just requires a bit of know-how. My favorite part to play was definitely the duals at 0:47, those were really fun and played consistently. I don't know if this level is list worthy, might be. So if you have the skill, I challenge you to beat this. I'm really curious to see how others do compared to me.

Song: Club Donnie Thornberry - JoelyMoley
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1028665

L8JPQePudGY.title: ''ENERGIZER'' 100% (Demon) by syndd & More | Geometry Dash
L8JPQePudGY.description:
Energizer is a level that is incredibly refined, embracing and perfecting it's stylized nature, the electrical/lightning theme is flashy and grabs your attention in the best way possible. Using the classic yellow and blue color scheme for this theme, while implementing more unconventional colors such as the purples and pinks and oranges.

The effects are 100% the most amazing part about this level, smooth, clean and grand, everything you would want and more, the lighting looks great, it's impactful and most importantly, it isn't overused, which is easy in levels like this, the animations are also very smooth.

 Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/882855

jk-r4_Nctes.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Reanimate'' 100% by Ilnm & More [Verified] | Geometry Dash
jk-r4_Nctes.description:
A brand new Extreme Demon made by Korean creators, and what I consider to be an absolute masterpiece, with different styles meshing together in this red, fiery and demonic style that is so well-known at this point, but creators still manage to make it interesting and input their own vision into the design. 

The effects scattered around each part are also amazing, having a ton of weight to them, the slightly different tones of red also help to make certain aspects of the design pop out, whether it's in the foreground or background, helping the layering as well. And the transitions are amazing to look at, I love when creators make animations when you transition into a part, it's really satisfying to see.

Gameplay is equally as fun and enjoyable as the visuals, being extremely consistent, where you can see yourself getting very far into the level each attempt, at least in my experience, which goes to show the level of quality in both aspects. A huge thanks to Illenium for letting me verify this, definitely one of my favorite extremes now.
