ZcDnsTvXd70.title: Rectangle by Knots | Geometry Dash
ZcDnsTvXd70.description:
As always, when Knots brings us a new creation, it's top-tier quality, very refined, interesting and well worth the wait, with Rectangle being no different, a level that looks simplistic on the surface, but has a ton of small details and complexities scattered all around, a level made entirely using pixel art, from start to finish, which adds so much charm and a slight coziness to the experience.

Apart from the art, the animations tied to it, the block design and transitions, etc, are incredibly clean and satisfying, connecting everything nicely also using a ton of unique effects, with the music being the icing on the cake, one of the most consistent creators to ever grace this game.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/942001

7LCOW8glrlU.title: ''CRUSH'' 100% (Demon) by Subwoofer [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
7LCOW8glrlU.description:
The latest installment in Subwoofers saga of levels that up to now, is comprised of Megalodon and Espionage, both great levels in their own right, having an overarching storyline that's fun, interesting, and not something you see everyday in GD, a longer level, compared to others, but since it's telling a story, it doesn't drag on by any means, it keeps to hooked from start to finish, also partially due to it's consistently high quality.

The variety in scenery, art, colors and block design are what carry these types of levels, and Subwoofer making everything himself shows the dedication to this story and these levels, and every bit is incredibly well made, the effects are punchy, the block design is sleek and fitting, the colors are vibrant and match nicely, with the art being the center piece and driving force, guiding you through the background and foreground, this is one you should play for yourself.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/175820

lP2BPP9nOLs.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Quaoar'' 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
lP2BPP9nOLs.description:
A collab hosted by Viprin that features creations from so many different creators, both known, established and unknown, but all incredibly talented nonetheless, a level that ended up being beautiful in every aspect of it's design, vibrant colors, bright and flashy effects, an intense pace that fits perfectly with the equally amazing soundtrack, you can really tell from the first few seconds that everyone involved gave it their all, the art is exceptional, the block design is clean and what I like most about this level is the fact that you can see the variety and differences in style with each section, but it all melds together nicely, making for a complete and very enjoyable experience.

The rainbow theme works wonders for the different aspects of the design, and I also liked how the intensity of effects, lighting and color changes sync to the music as well, it helps set the pace and makes it more satisfying to play and watch, at the end of the day, everyone who was involved with the creation of this did a fantastic job, props to everyone.

Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yjQmZBvi3WE&t=0s

MnYNzOyZRJg.title: ''Behold'' 100% (Demon) by Seokso | Geometry Dash
MnYNzOyZRJg.description:
Without a doubt, Behold is one of the best levels I've seen in a long time, an amazing experience visually from the first moment to the very last, incredibly unique in each of it's sections, starting with the color palette, having the majority of the block design and obstacles be gray is hard, but Seokso combines it with so many bright and vibrant colors, especially at 0:55 , where it changes depending on your icon colors, things like that, makes it all work perfectly for the futuristic/apocalyptic theme.

It's all so clean and polished, so it let's you immerse yourself into this world even more, that along with the excellent music choice, that fits the grand vibe of the gameplay and design, it's a joy to watch and play as well. Another thing I liked a lot about this level is the feeling of progression and story you get while playing, the scenes change along with the pacing, and where you start is so different than where you end but it all feels connected.

A severely underrated creator that deserves all of the attention for levels like these.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/957952

ua1NkLLPTyg.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Stellaluna'' 100% by SamMaxx | Geometry Dash
ua1NkLLPTyg.description: Stellaluna is a level that is beautiful stylistically and visually, the dreamy atmosphere with the purples, pinks and blues that are everywhere are a nice palette and work great to establish the vibe from the very beginning, the fog/clouds that make a vignette around the screen, the flashes of light in the background with the different shapes, everything together makes for a complete package, just wish the beginning robot wasn't there.

YYPHnCbRFAY.title: ''Cerebral Torment'' 100% (Demon) by SirPotatOwO | Geometry Dash
YYPHnCbRFAY.description:
A bizarre yet incredibly captivating experience, with an enormous variety in style, settings and design, that it honors the title and theme perfectly, a barrage of unsettling imagery that only gets weirder as you go along, but that's what makes it special and fun to watch. 

When you make a level as wild as this, you truly can make and put in whatever you want and make it work, such is the case here, the art is plentiful and it serves it's purpose, which is to be terrifying, with the backgrounds and block design being the perfect complement to it. There is also a 3D effect towards the end, that's so different from everything else but still manages to fit in. Overall, I enjoyed this level a ton visually, props to SirPotatOwO for making something outside of the box.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/590567

YzqZR6f0M0w.title: SEASIDE HILL by Sillow | Geometry Dash
YzqZR6f0M0w.description:
I truly believe that we need more Sonic themed levels in GD, since the style, music and pace of gameplay translate perfectly in my opinion, and because I'm a fan, so I'm really happy that Sillow made this, even more so after seeing how high the quality is, being an amazing recreation of Seaside Hill from Sonic Generations. The artwork is stunning, block design is spot on from the original and the backgrounds are full and have so much detail to them, that it's easy to immerse yourself into this world, and the water animation is one of the best I've ever seen.

There are also some cool and subtle visual effects, such as Sonic's spin move when going through a loop, the whales jumping out of the water in the background or the ring at the end of the level, it all helps to make the world look and play more alive, there are also some Chaos Emeralds scattered around which is a nice detail, overall if you are a fan of the series this is a ton of fun to play and see.

y3cvKK9wDUw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Bloodlust'' 100% by Knobbelboy | Geometry Dash
y3cvKK9wDUw.description: Here it is, Bloodlust is a level I could only dream of doing, and finally deciding to go for it is a huge step up for me. I poured an absolutely insane amount of hours into practicing this the last couple of weeks, I've been wanting to push my skill for so long and I'm happy I've finally been able to do so. My new hardest and definitely will still keep pushing even further, thank you all once again for 1 million and the absolutely incredible support. GG :)

bxdYykPvVb4.title: ''RETRO BLITZ'' 100% (Demon) by Danke & More | Geometry Dash
bxdYykPvVb4.description:
RETRO BLITZ is a level that executes it's theme and vibe perfectly, encapsulating so many classic stuff from years and years ago, made into original art which adds to the uniqueness and style of the design, which is incredibly varied but all fit into the same category at the same time.

The block design, the lighting, many different effects, the backgrounds and art, all fit together perfectly, which shows how well thought out the design was, while still having it's wild nature. My favorite part about this level are the couple of effects and pieces of art that blend into the gameplay.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/827441

rK4MKhfZJQ4.title: Bloodlust 95%
rK4MKhfZJQ4.description: ok WHAT, it might seem like I'm progressing really fast but I've actually been playing for 10 hours everyday since I started from 0%. I really wish I fluked TMN there. I also got 91% before this, and hopefully the next Bloodlust video will be 100%, be ready.

fhEwfj8kiQg.title: Bloodlust 80%
fhEwfj8kiQg.description: I got to the extension, went from 61% to 80% which is insane to me. Hoping I can consistently get to that point and the only big chokepoint for me is the swingcopter right now.

ZctCtampCDk.title: ''Brutal Calamity'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Whirl | Geometry Dash
ZctCtampCDk.description:
An XXL Demon that can be explained with few words, a love letter to Terraria, specifically Calamity, with so many different elements from the game, from the incredible variety in scenery, to the bosses, their designs, the arenas you battle them in, the attacks and everything else, the colors and just the entire atmosphere is flawless, executed with a ton of passion and care by someone who plays the game and knows what they're doing, it's always beautiful to see homages to other fantastic games in GD.

Making a level this long always comes with challenges, such as keeping the player engaged throughout the entire thing, but this doesn't skip a single beat, from start to finish there is action, intense visuals and a huge sense of variety and open-endedness that keeps you alert because you don't know which boss will come next, and I haven't even mentioned the fact that there are different endings you can get, the standard ending and a coin route ending, this is an amazing level and props to Whirl, can't wait to see his next level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/793250

R4S1QsfIf_g.title: Bloodlust 61%
R4S1QsfIf_g.description: Yeah, I'm beating bloodlust, was hoping to get to the extension on that one, ended up pretty dissapointed with how close I was to getting there. This will be the biggest thing I've ever worked on. Thanks again for 1 million.

sR0FsvbdAWs.title: ''True Nightmares'' 100% (Demon) by DeoxLiteVG | Geometry Dash
sR0FsvbdAWs.description:
True Nightmares is a minute-long experience that from the very beginning is beaming with so many different colors, brought out and accentuated even more due to the lighting, glow and neon effects on the block design and backgrounds, the futuristic/robotic theme taking full advantage of this. The sense of depth and progression is something hard to pull off, even moreso to make it look this good, there is a bunch of detail both in the foreground and backgrounds, with a ton of fluid and jumpy movements just about everywhere you look.

Now onto what is the best part about the level, at least to me, the bossfight, it begins about halfway through the level until the end, which is pretty long considering the overall duration, but every second of it is great, the design for the boss is unique, it's movements are smooth and it's attacks have a defined weight to them, it even has several phases/transformations with different weapons to keep you on your toes, which makes it fun.

XaSKm3c0U_4.title: Dance Massacre by Hinds | Geometry Dash
XaSKm3c0U_4.description: Hinds has so many good levels, this being no exception. A very recognizable 2.0 level and one of my first hard demons I think. Very fun

V1bl51q0zr4.title: Hand Eyelids by Viot | Geometry Dash
V1bl51q0zr4.description:
This is a very unique level to me aesthetically, being that it has a simple and classic style when it comes to block design and atmosphere, while using a wide variety of colors, alone and in conjuction with one another, but what truly makes it stand out above the rest are the effects, using transitions, lighting, and animations to take advantage of the wide and open spaces in each section. Being just over a minute long, you get to see a handful of parts, each different from the last that have their own aspect to stand out, it could be the lighting or block design, there's something different at every turn and it makes it a joy to watch.

Now onto the gameplay, this honestly is the best aspect of the level as a whole, it's fast-paced and intense or slow and methodical when it needs to be, following the music perfectly, and when there's good sync it makes all the more enjoyable. It's well balanced, consistent, clear, easy to read, but most importantly it's fun.

TZ3v8fiZjAM.title: Love Letter by TyphoonThunder | Geometry Dash

FmBERj3JrSk.title: theyaremanycolors by renn241 | Geometry Dash
FmBERj3JrSk.description:
Renn's newest level is a jaw-dropping experience that immerses you into a dark yet colorful, glitched and intense world where nothing seems to make sense, but this level is actually inspired by a music video, for the song used in this level, "theyaremanycolors" by Frums, and if you watch it, you can see just how well the visuals and vibe of the track were translated to GD, the effects are beautifully recreated, the same strong colors, but most importantly the sense of anxiety and loneliness, and the beauty of the visuals is that you can interpret it whichever way fits you.

The gameplay made for this is the cherry on top, it's fast paced or slower when it needs to, the music and design is elevated because of how good the sync and pacing is, that it does make you feel like you're playing a music video, I absolutely love this level and can't wait to see what's next for renn.

Song and Music Video | theyaremanycolors by Frums: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sqyHAbUaaSQ

z1U5T9ZPxDs.title: Colorful OverNight by WOOGI1411 | Geometry Dash
z1U5T9ZPxDs.description: It's actually been 5 years since I first beat this, which is insane to think about. I still love this level to bits.

_rV4h-5-p8A.title: Born Survivor by Splinter25 & DHaner | Geometry Dash
_rV4h-5-p8A.description:
Being Splinter's first duo level, makes Born Survivor seem like a special level, but after you play it, you can't help but confirm this level looks amazing and feels amazing to play, the color scheme is straight out of a music video of that era, the pink and cyan with the neon accents will never go out of style in my opinion.

The pacing is on point, following the song starting off slower, both in gameplay and it's design, but after the drop you get hit with a flurry of color and effects, movement in every direction and an overall fun and intense second half. 

you can tell a ton of care was put into it, can't wait to see what these two talented creators come up with next, recommend you try this one out.

ID: 79691289
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1100205

Okw72nZeddA.title: JusT DanZ 2020 by DanZmeN | Geometry Dash
Okw72nZeddA.description: DanZmeN made this 2 years ago and now it's here, Danz levels always had good vibes to them.

YBmA7VFfoT8.title: BB Circles by MindCap | Geometry Dash
YBmA7VFfoT8.description: Actually good, I would love to see this level get rated and for the amount of time it was built in it's really impressive.

LWjbGhQEodI.title: HamDuck Vortex by kr1j & More | Geometry Dash
LWjbGhQEodI.description:
A Nine Circles level, Hamduck Vortex has a green theme looks fantastic when done right, the contrast between lighter and darker tones, with a background that is sometimes pitch black or absolutely filled to the brim with flashing lights and all sorts of colors that make everything pop out more.

The effects are one of the, if not the strongest point of this level, the lighting, fast pace and glow are staples of this type of level, but they are incredibly polished here, without being overused or spamming the same effect, which makes it much more enjoyable to play, with it's variety.

xtL8_JQhU0o.title: ''Magic Mushroom Mania'' 100% (XXL Demon) by TropoGD | Geometry Dash
xtL8_JQhU0o.description:
The atmosphere and story-driven aspects of Magic Mushroom Mania are only some of the things that drive it to it's amazing potential and quality, when creating an XL level, the hardest aspect is keeping the attention of the player, on the edge of their seat anticipating what may come next and you get that here.

The decoration has a simplistic tone to it, with a block design to match, different shapes and platforms filled with solid color and a bit of glow, that being said it fits the theme nicely, so when the "different" section comes, it's all the more jarring, speaking about the part at 0:40, it comes out of nowhere, everything turns red, there's a heavy fog covering the screen and eyes are all around, a complete 180 from where we were, and it works great from a story-telling standpoint and design, with the creepiness at the top as well. The song is a perfect match too, the sync is on point and it even makes you a bit nervous towards the end, leaving you waiting for another drastic change, but it ends. Really great level.

qvjRp75l1Jw.title: Zipangu by Partition | Geometry Dash
qvjRp75l1Jw.description: A japanese themed level that is executed beautifully by Partition, who I'm happy to see creating again after 2 years, the scenery, Mt. Fuji with the Sakura Blossoms in the foreground flowing with the wind, the architecture is incredibly well done, but most importantly the vibe is there and the atmosphere along with the music fit the decoration perfectly, it really does look and feel like you're taking a walk through the streets of Japan, overall it's a fun, relaxing and well-made level, everyone should give it a try.

nXWCKASJNa4.title: THE LAUNCH by xyuns & More | Geometry Dash
nXWCKASJNa4.description:
The launch is a very special level, because of it's multiple paths and extremely consistent style, design and level of quality throughout. The quality being this high from start to end is even more impressive when you see how many people helped piece this together, helping here and there, each one adding a bit more, and the fact that each path has it's unique decoration, block design and backgrounds makes it look and play a lot more open, which is something we get too little of. It's incredibly enjoyable, trying to see each possible route.

Creators: xyuns, overdefo, Presta, Lyriaki, Zhiana, danerdogger, ninq, RapidBlaze, cerufiffy, NukeIIX, BelonziK and John265

ID: 79575587
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/985007

TL3esTNovYE.title: DKCR by Felixitron | Geometry Dash
TL3esTNovYE.description: DKCR is a beautiful trip down memory lane for everyone who has had the pleasure of playing Donkey Kong Country, in this case DKC Returns, done in a more modern style, being much faster paced than it's inspiration, but the vibe is present from start to finish, from the intense jungle themed song done by Boom Kitty, to the block design, the backgrounds that all immerse you into this world, and the boss fight against Tiki Tong is recreated really well, the design for him is on point and the animations are great, a fantastic way to end the level.

Pk0_VjmMHaE.title: Subterranean Animism by EVW | Geometry Dash
Pk0_VjmMHaE.description: Rebeat. Despite the inconsistent looking parts, the gameplay is actually really fun in my opinion. The creators did a really good job in that part.

ARjiOD0udsY.title: Forsaken Neon by Zobros | Geometry Dash
ARjiOD0udsY.description: A 7 year old collab between Zobros and TriAxis, one of the all-time classics, a level played and beloved by so many people, definitely one of Zobros' greatest works. The blue theme still looks amazing to this day, and the gameplay is pretty fun though the last ball section can be pretty annoying for some.

TtVTHzil87U.title: ''Terrabit'' 100% (Demon) by Gekou [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
TtVTHzil87U.description:
Gekou's latest level after 10 months of inactivity, a creator that shows so much potential with each creation and Terrabit is no different, the mechanical/robotic theme is done justice, from the grey machine-like tone that most of the decoration has, with some different colors such as red or blue to add a bit more contrast and detail to not seem monotone, the backgrounds being the most attention-grabbing aspect of the design, the robots, the machines moving around do help to get you into this world even more.

There are also more unique sections like at 0:40 where you get to see a short pixelated animation, or the bossfight at the end which is engaging, fun and the design for the boss fits perfectly with everything else. I can't wait to see what Gekou comes out with next.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/672286

MweR1UE8-qw.title: Nano Lights by NateFH | Geometry Dash
MweR1UE8-qw.description:
It's no secret that Nano Lights is inspired by BuTiTi, from the song to some of the color choices, but what truly makes it special and stand on it's own two legs is the fact that it has it's own atmosphere, Nate managed to give his creation it's own identity, while nodding to the inspiration, which is not easy to do.

Nano Lights has a fantastic song to work with, lending itself to variations in gameplay, pace and satisfying effects, transitions, etc, we get a sometimes dark, sometimes vibrant mix here, with beautiful backgrounds and effects, in every section, you get a minute and a half of pure fun design and gameplay as well.

RSQ1ENGpC4g.title: [2.2] ''In The Lab'' by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash
RSQ1ENGpC4g.description:
00:00 Normal Route
04:02 Piano Quest (Coin 1)
06:42 Future Route (Coin 2)

In The Lab is most likely the best platformer level that has been released until now, Robotic24 has brought us chapter 3 in his series of platformer levels, that have all been great, but this is by far the best, the design of every screen we see fits the theme perfectly, the platforming elements are fun and simple, and the fact that there are multiple routes and things you can do and see makes it all the better.

MKRzjQwBPDE.title: [2.2] ''Snowdown'' by pixellord | Geometry Dash
MKRzjQwBPDE.description: From the creator of Dash Destroyer, pixellord is back with a remake of one of his old 2.2 levels, Snowdown, which turned out pretty nice in my opinion

6nWzofmOXV8.title: ''METAL TEST'' 100% (Demon) by Overdefo | Geometry Dash
6nWzofmOXV8.description:
The art and effects you can find in Metal Test are on a different level, and 100% the best part about the level, there is so much detail within each aspect of the decoration, the uniqueness and dreamyness of the block design, the soft coloring, the grand and beautiful pieces of art that serve to immerse you even more into the experience.

Overdefo is very talented and this is their best level yet, it treads the fine line between simplistic and detailed, it's a nuanced level with a lot more than meets the eye, everyone should give this a try.

6SjpeZPda-M.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Eko'' 100% by PureDinoMight | Geometry Dash
6SjpeZPda-M.description:
This is a fantastic collab from PureDinoMight, who made the layout/gameplay, decorated by the incredibly talented KazVA and Gyrodog, and finally verified by Victurkey. After a year of hard work Eko has been released for everyone to enjoy, and the wait was very worth it.

From the very beginning of the level, you can see the strong influence of the Acu design, the colorful, smooth and even simplistic nature is perfectly in tune the entire way through, you get a nice mix of relaxing and intense, powerful sections, that are a good balance when it comes to atmosphere and even gameplay, dictating the speed and difficulty, as I said before, the design, colors and block design are all soothing, with a wide variety of tones and effects to make them pop out even more.

This is a great Extreme, as it looks amazing, and it was enjoyable to play as well. Though it has some inconsistencies in difficulty, such as the wave parts being much harder than the rest of the level, everything after that is fine in my opinion.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/723714

yVxKTQPzyus.title: Retro Circles by Nacho21 | Geometry Dash
yVxKTQPzyus.description: I remember when this level first came out 6 years ago, the glitch effects were groundbreaking at that time, but since you have to learn where the invisible speed portals are, it makes this weird to play.

ARL0iOLpsBU.title: Gold Temple by Serponge | Geometry Dash
ARL0iOLpsBU.description:
A 2.0 level that came out 5 years ago, by Serponge, that at the time, and to this day is someone that has had a lot of influence in the community. 

A golden theme that is done justice, art that is in tune with the overall design and an atmosphere that is varied yet intense, a classic at this point.

RiO5NKovWc0.title: Ion by Kyhros | Geometry Dash
RiO5NKovWc0.description:
A megacollab that includes Kyhros, Woom, Presta & many more great creators, a level that nails the futuristic/space theme, the color palette is perfect for it, using different tones of purple, blue and pink, even adding some other less common colors like green and yellow, but it all works beautifully together. The effects are the best part about this collab, taking the different art and block designs to a completely new height, elevating the impactfulness and it's intensity.

Speaking of the art and backgrounds, the different shapes, planets and stars are all fantastic, and even the sections that don't have much going on, there are so many details in the foreground, that it makes up for this. My favorite part is towards the end, specifically from 1:30 onwards, the 3D aspects surrounding the level and the effects and particles flying around look great and add a lot to the gameplay, the endscreen logo also fits nicely.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/141262

9T4fktyBOyg.title: Deadlocked Remake | ''FutureLocked'' 100% (Demon) by Optation | Geometry Dash
9T4fktyBOyg.description:
Deadlocked is probably one of the levels with the most amount of remakes, being it's a RobTop level and it's subsequent popularity, so it makes it all the more impressive when you make one that stands out above the rest, such is the case with Futurelocked, a revamped and a revitalized atmosphere, effects that have more impact and highlight the best parts of the design.

The block design is much more refined, having a shine to it, with some lighting and bright colors that make it jump out more, with smooth animations to top it out.

It really is a sign of skill when a creator can make an old level look modern while keeping the original vibe intact, highly recommended.

OLpqB59vV0M.title: Collab Level by MindCap | Geometry Dash
OLpqB59vV0M.description: What an experience this was, from watching it for the first time to playing it. It's gonna be difficult to top this one.

G9RnfxO5Dxs.title: Help Yourself by ColinT | Geometry Dash
G9RnfxO5Dxs.description: Help Yourself is a creation with a unique concept, both in it's gameplay and by extension, a level where you find yourself in dual mode from the very beginning, all the way to the end, where you find a wide variety of obstacles that prevent one of your vehicles from moving forward, where you must use it's counterpart to either activate a trigger, push a platform, grab a key and other unique mechanics.

kHAexLQr2dw.title: BRAINPOWER by BrainETR | Geometry Dash
kHAexLQr2dw.description:
BrainETR keeps getting better and better with each release and his newest level BRAINPOWER is proof of that, being a genuinely fun experience, colorful just about everywhere you look surrounded by an upbeat atmosphere, with a satisfying block design and effects that utilize the different hues and shades in the best way possible.

There are a handful of different sections that follow the rainbow theme, looking and playing connected, changing around the effects, both in terms of intensity and speed, having a nice variety, but what's important is that each part is great, and pretty fun to play in my opinion.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1098902

zHOYaleHY-Q.title: (Extreme Demon) ''SnowFall Fiesta'' 100% by Dorami & More | Geometry Dash
zHOYaleHY-Q.description:
This level is actually so good, I'm glad Dorami decided to nerf it in the end to make it more enjoyable and it's actually extremely fun to play.

The decoration is great as well, the snowy/ice theme is executed beautifully, it's present in each and every section while being unique, whether it's because of the art in the backgrounds, the different shades of blue used in the block design and lighting effects or the atmosphere, there's a lot of variety here and many details, both big and small. The different degrees of snowfall is also a nice touch, immersing you more into this world.

There's also a short bossfight with a Yeti about halfway through the level, it's relatively short but the design is good and it's attacks, while simple, look impactful, and it fits in with the rest of the design.

Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/710930

Jsvs70him4g.title: I Wanna Tell Ya by Hedgefox | Geometry Dash
Jsvs70him4g.description:
I came across this level that had 30 downloads, that was released 5 days ago, and from the first time I played through it I knew it deserved to be showcased, a level with an astonishing visual style, amazing effects that pack a punch and a vibe that is upbeat and fun to experience. There are a handful of sections here and each one is unique in it's own way, with each one having it's own set of colors, design, backgrounds, effects, pretty much everything which makes sure it never gets boring.

That being said about the design, the gameplay is a bit strange, it's inconsistent in it's difficulty, like the swingcopter section being awkward to play, the first wave as well, there are some spikes in difficulty that catch you off guard, but overall it's an enjoyable experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/754936

6PLoLFt61_4.title: Not Quadruple Mode by ItsDubVIP | Geometry Dash
6PLoLFt61_4.description:
The sequel to Not Triple Mode, this time it's a collab with MrBlackM, the first one had amazing ideas and this one is no exception, such as where the entire ground and obstacles are moving upwards, and the quadruple cube section where it gives you a perception of the cubes getting larger the closer they are to the screen. Great stuff.

#geometrydash

ooU7-rnp03M.title: Trust Me Once More by ItzMatthewPlayz | Geometry Dash
ooU7-rnp03M.description:
The third level to Matthew's ''Trust Me'' series. This was the definitely the hardest one yet because of it being entirely memory, still fun though.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/781880

#geometrydash

p15w9MB2eAc.title: VeritY by Serponge | Geometry Dash
p15w9MB2eAc.description: Classic level, I remember trying to do this when it came out and struggling a lot with the last dual, It's so fun playing them now.

nEpBUQE9u-s.title: TOE III by Manix648 | Geometry Dash
nEpBUQE9u-s.description: Another rebeat for quality, it's strange but 2.1 levels are actually nostalgic now, it's been that long.

BMmJJa1Vwes.title: LMAO by MazZedy & More | Geometry Dash
BMmJJa1Vwes.description:
Lmao is the third installment in a series of creations from MazZedy, with the help of many other great creators, with Dak being the first, Buh it's sequel and now this, and my favorite part about this series is how each level is better than the last, you can see the improvements, the progression in the designs, effects and even art, that being said, each level is great in their own way.

This level has a horror/clown/circus theme, that is executed beautifully, from the vibrant colors that are exactly what you'd see in an old carnival, shown in lights, the block design and just about every visual aspect of this level. From the very beginning you get immersed in the atmosphere, the intimadating art style and dark vibe, being pushed even further by the music, which is just as important, congrats to everyone who participated in this collab, it's great.

R-qFZm-vf-8.title: Igallta by Muonn | Geometry Dash
R-qFZm-vf-8.description:
Layouts are king right now when it comes to creating amazing effects and unique scenarios, and I think we can safely put Igallta in that category, simply by giving us 2 straight minutes of non-stop action, throwing effect, transition and incredible visuals at us, because from the movements, animations, to the lighting and overall atmosphere, I think the best way to describe this level is smooth, from start to finish.

But this isn't just flashy effects thrown together without purpose, if you look closely and pay attention you can see the nuance when it comes to the gameplay, how Muonn integrated parts of the decoration and effects into the player experience, which makes it even more enjoyable to play, and the sync with the song is just perfect.

Song: Se-U-Ra - Igallta | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w7duCaf4cbs

#geometrydash

W8fD8BV-Ghg.title: ''SpaceTime'' 100% (Demon) by SleyGD | Geometry Dash
W8fD8BV-Ghg.description:
Sley is one of those creators who just keeps getting better and better with each new release, as is the case with SpaceTime, a level that has fascinatingly flashy effects, beautiful colors and a refined design all around, absolutely nailing the cybernetic/space theme. The buildup is also fantastic, starting off slow, while the effects and colors follow the beat, and by the time the drop happens you can really feel the intensity of what's happening on screen, especially after 1:08, with the beams of light and starts flying past you. SpaceTime has everything that makes a good level and even more, highly recommend you play it for yourself.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1111447

DTIbgOIEQJY.title: Frontlines Remake | ''Backlines'' 100% (Demon) by GDParallax | Geometry Dash
DTIbgOIEQJY.description:
Backlines takes Frontlines by Edicts, a level that came out 5 years ago, and completely revamps and revitalizes it, from the simple things like colors and smaller details found in the block design or backgrounds, to the more complex like glow and lighting effects, even adding a bit of shake to make everything look and play more intense. 

I really like how this is much more detailed than the original, the design looks much more complete, leaving no room for empty spaces, while keeping the original atmosphere present.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/614535

9UJPgW7e938.title: ''ReCoding The DeCode'' 100% (Demon) by GamerKnight750 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
9UJPgW7e938.description: ReCoding the DeCode is a remake of a widely known level that has some years under it's belt, and it's one of those levels that was so great for it's time, although we do get some more polish and a bit more variety in colors and more refined effects, that being said it's always great to see remakes of classic levels.

jaNC4wn0590.title: Love Baba by Zobros | Geometry Dash
jaNC4wn0590.description: Another 2.0 classic. You may not see it but it's way harder than it looks, there being invisible saws at the last ship section.

DKRI2lK1oYE.title: [2.0] ''Psychosis'' 100% (Demon) by Hinds | Geometry Dash
DKRI2lK1oYE.description:
Rebeat for quality. 
An absolute classic from 2.0, and still my favorite Hinds level. Did it with all coins this time.

zehjwgvzPGM.title: ''Carpe Lucem'' 100% (Demon) by Zoroa | Geometry Dash
zehjwgvzPGM.description:
Zoroa has been a well known and respected creator in GD for a good while now, and it's levels like this that remind us why, with some of the most captivating, unique and intense effects seen to date, Carpe Lucem is a barrage of interesting visuals that grab your attention from the very first second, and keeps you hooked for under a minute.

There are too many cool lighting and color effects here, not to mention the transitions that also sync perfectly with the song, and they are all insanely high quality and different from each other, it is so satisfying to see, this is one of those levels that you can definitely see yourself coming back to often.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1074946

Cx1oQU1NX0c.title: Underworld by Presta | Geometry Dash
Cx1oQU1NX0c.description:
It's a great feeling when you see creators that have released fantastic levels in the past, all with consistently high quality, come back after some time, and give us yet another treat as if they never took a break, and this is the perfect example with Presta. The visual effects used here shine through their wavy and almost psychadelic nature, with the bright reds, purples and pinks highlighting these backgrounds and their movements, with some lighting effects to make everything pop out a bit more, it all fits together and you get an upbeat experience.

Song: Demonicity - Eight O'Eight
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1015241

oqQo66hcMNo.title: [2.2] ''Press Start X'' by Dorami & Astraa | Geometry Dash
oqQo66hcMNo.description:
A collab between Dorami and Astraa that was released about two years ago, and that fact alone shows you a small fraction of how long we've been waiting for the ever anticipated update, but back to this level, I enjoyed playing and watching it a ton, they both did a fantastic job with this, the 2.2 elements are implemented to make every section unique but most importantly fun to play, with the design being simplistic and linear but everything else making up for this 10 times over.

The effects are great and the short bossfights that pop up here and there featuring the skull from the original press start have smooth movements and fierce attacks that fit perfectly with everything else that goes on, overall a fun and impressive 2.2 experience.

Song: MDK - Press Start (Dex Arson Remix)
https://youtu.be/vleeZOEzkhE

#geometrydash

G3gsgl3dYXo.title: Cosmic Salad by GDSkele | Geometry Dash
G3gsgl3dYXo.description: Used tools to record this because of lag, even though it only has 80k objects. Level still looks fantastic nonetheless.

aF-74AW8iCQ.title: Strangely Cursed by Lespainsaucho | Geometry Dash
aF-74AW8iCQ.description:
Another really neat effect layout that came out like a week after I uploaded Stranvel Lege, my favorite part in this is definitely the cube with legs section, which is a concept I haven't seen used in other effect layouts, making it stand out.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/917623

o_mY21IO6AM.title: ''MIDFLIGHT SKYSPRITE'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Vicolor | Geometry Dash
o_mY21IO6AM.description:
The newest level from Vicolor, and the third level in his Sky Wanders series and from start to finish, you can clearly see how this is most likely his best level to date, it's always great to see a creator keep evolving and getting better at their craft with each new level they make. This 3 and a half minute journey has everything you would want in a level of this length, a beautiful theme that lends itself perfectly to beautiful art, landscapes and dreamy colors, taking us through the sky surrounded by clouds and sunlight, to the dark depths underwater and many more.

I enjoy the variety in tone here as well, the contrast between the uplifting first half and the more serious and dark second half make it much more interesting and work from a story-telling perspective as well, and it's all brought together in conjuction with the amazing music from Stardew.

Song: Midflight Skysprite by Stardew | https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/919530

arCsUtcjt3o.title: (Extreme Demon) ''FIREPOWER'' 100% by MrLorenzo | Geometry Dash
arCsUtcjt3o.description:
Old Extreme Demon that's actually really easy for its difficulty. If it weren't for the wave at the drop I would've had a better time playing this, doesn't take too long to get consistent at it though.

#geometrydash

hVXDu17mJyw.title: DeCode Remake | ''DeCone'' 100% (Demon) by Pennutoh & GrenadeofTacos | Geometry Dash
hVXDu17mJyw.description:
DeCone is one of those remakes that just make you happy when you play them or see them, revamping and updating a classic level, while some of the parts may not look very alike to the original, the incredibly well-made designs make up for that. Pennutoh and GrenadeOfTacos manage and exceed expectations, which isn't surprising for them.

The design is a breath of fresh air, the colors are all there, with a ton more added to add variety to the decoration, and with the lighting effects, there's a nice contrast between shades, hues and brightness, which makes it look fantastic, there are also some subtle movement effects that make the level look more jumpy and alive.

#geometrydash

IRTQZZ502J0.title: [4k] ''DeCode'' 100% (Demon) by Rek3dge | Geometry Dash
IRTQZZ502J0.description:
Was gonna upload this in February, but I realized DeCode day was a month away so I waited until now.

#geometrydash

tDpKf9N5Edo.title: Not Triple Mode by ItsDubVIP | Geometry Dash

i0R0Z1DcA_Q.title: ''Degenerate'' by Darwin | Geometry Dash
i0R0Z1DcA_Q.description:
An effect level from Darwin, with his last level being released almost two years ago, here we have his newest release, and it's great to see it's just as good if not better than his previous work, a level that has many incredible effects, all of them different to one another, while staying true to the intense and jarring nature of the level, and having perfect sync with it's song, which is also satisfying to listen to, intertwining with the theme, colors, movements and vibe of each section, some of the best sync hands down, that alone would make you want to replay it again and again.

I really enjoyed the uniqueness of each part, the transitions are fantastic, with the different logos and such, taking you through hugely different designs, the 3D effects are especially well-made. Overall, it's great to see a creator as prominent as Darwin come back, and with a bang.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/892764

pXP-pJqPDYQ.title: ''ULTRACHROMATIC'' 100% (Demon) by gmdmann | Geometry Dash
pXP-pJqPDYQ.description:
With levels like Ultrachromatic, you can tell from the get go, just how much effort, care and time went into creating, refining and polishing, and how important it is for the creator, and it's always nice to see. gmdmann has brought us an exciting, colorful, clean yet intense, all around amazing level that does complete justice to it's name. A two minute experience that you wish was much longer, and even despite it's length, each part is unique and brings something new and fun, while still staying on course with it's chromatic theme.

My favorite part is the contrast between the bright colors and the dark background, which just serves to bring more attention to the effects going on in the back, the shapes, dots and everything else flying around, which also goes perfectly with the fantastic song.

Song: Kyutatsuki - GALAXY_FRAGMENTATION 
Link: https://youtu.be/gDUmEN7ytFU 
Newgrounds: https://newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1098035 
Kyutatsuki. 九立つ気: https://youtube.com/channel/UCYfacB1Bye4VYVEr6ia60Ug

RoWLYCOlXZw.title: OutLay by ForeToken | Geometry Dash
RoWLYCOlXZw.description:
Each day we are closer to 2.2, and levels like this, and so many others we've seen are what keep the hype alive and gets us to imagine and speculate just how amazing levels will be in the future, especially with creators as talented as ForeToken, and here we have the perfect example with OutLay, with some of the best animations, use of triggers and effects. 

If anyone saw this a couple of years ago, you would think it was an animation made in a different program. This could very well be the best 1.0 layout styled level to this day, everything about is surprising and jaw-dropping, just when you think it's about to slow down and be simpler, it throws something even more impressive at you. You should play this as soon as possible.

#geometrydash

o4D3hqV2No0.title: ''BIG BANG'' 100% (Demon) by Wav | Geometry Dash
o4D3hqV2No0.description:
A level with a bright and shiny red coat of paint, that contrasts nicely with the white accents, brought to life by the intense and flashy effects that sync up in a satisfying manner with the music, which at the end of the day gives a lot of personality and a uniqueness to the overall level. There is a lot to appreciate here, even though there are only two colors and slight variations of them, the way the layout was made, intertwined with the design and decoration, there is a sense of depth, especially because of the effects and it's faster pace.

#geometrydash

c1REX1ueu6k.title: [1.9] ''Templarium'' 100% (Demon) by Kira9999 | Geometry Dash
c1REX1ueu6k.description:
A level created for a 1.9 creator contest, with a ton of references to nostalgic levels from those times, that is executed perfectly in my opinion, it has the classic atmosphere, the clean design and it encapsulates what made so many levels from 1.9 so great, it is a fantastic level.

There is a wide variety of designs, colors and blocks here, each section is unique in it's own way, even if it doesn't look connected, the bits and pieces are still satisfying.

FoenX9pr5ks.title: ''Sanic Wave'' 100% (Demon) by VladAAA | Geometry Dash
FoenX9pr5ks.description:
Level: Sanic Wave by VladAAA
ID: 76991343
Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/816213

A level that was released about 2 months ago by Vlad, extremely fun to play with it's variety of game modes and satisfying slopes, this combined with it's fast pace and bright, flashy design, makes for an intense but cohesive experience. The chaotic nature of the level fits perfectly with the remix of a song from the Sonic Unleashed soundtrack, giving off a sense of urgency and speed.

Another thing I vastly appreciate about this level is how spacious it feels and looks, having a great use of verticality and having a good structure within it's obstacles, which adds positives to the design and gameplay.

#geometrydash

74WlDwQKM5Y.title: ''Hold The Night'' 100% (Demon) by Rawin | Geometry Dash
74WlDwQKM5Y.description:
This level is just as vibrant, and fun as his previous levels. Here we have something that is extremely well integrated into it's music, which in my opinion always makes a level more personal and satisfying to play, a minute long experience that has beautiful effects, a unique color scheme and a clean, sleek block design.

My favorite section is the beginning, the synth in the song combined with the slow pace of the gameplay, the 3D elements, the sync with the percussion in the music, the design in the background, it all comes together nicely. At the very end the level becomes very simple, a white background, no effects, minimal movement and plain lines making up the obstacles, which I personally like, it's a good break as the music slows down, even if it doesn't really go with the previous design, overall a fantastic level.

Song: https://youtu.be/HClyQjRkJbU

GI3yk81Fz7A.title: [2.2] ''FIGHT OF LIGHT'' by TheMilkCat | Geometry Dash
GI3yk81Fz7A.description:
Fight of light is probably one of the best 2.2 levels that have been released in the long wait towards the update, a boss fight inspired by a Terraria mod, with amazing effects, smooth movements and most importantly of all, a menacing and engaging boss, that from the very beginning puts you at high alert, with it's many attacks, lasers, balls of lights and even a giant sword it can wield, all while you must dodge obstacles and crevices that come across the screen, it is as fun as it seems.

There is also an Expert Mode which makes everything much more difficult, more attacks, while being bigger and faster, giving you less space to dodge and less margin of error, all while receiving more damage. There is so much to do here and since it uses free roam, you can beat it anyway you want.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/793089

#geometrydash

2mesDtGh1Wc.title: ''The Tempest'' by Rafer [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
2mesDtGh1Wc.description:
The latest masterpiece brought to us by the incredibly talented and well known Rafer, a creator that has been consistent in their quality for so long, releasing levels that always blow us away because of their insanely high quality effects, atmospheres, themes and even bossfights, all of this and so many more details that can go without mentioning are what make up this amazing creation, needless to say it all fits together and combines perfectly with each other, taking us into this world and immersing us in this setting.

The pacing this level has is also fantastic, starting off slow before suddenly hitting the drop and throwing everything at you, making it much more fun to play and intense to watch, and the quality of the art just makes it even better, especially in the bossfights.

BP_R8gEoeCE.title: Dash Destroyer by pixellord | Geometry Dash [2.2]
BP_R8gEoeCE.description:
A really cool level inspired by the 2.2 sneak peek we got a while back, but with a unique twist, it uses the extra part of the new song that MDK shared, becoming a "new" section, using the same elements from the original, keeping the same style and even being high quality, but switching things around to look fresh, and it ended being really well made.

#geometrydash

o2OyEBlyhuY.title: Jeyzor Collab by BlowMyPooh | Geometry Dash
o2OyEBlyhuY.description:
A minute long level, with a simplistic style, that shines through it's playful and fun nature and unique art, Jeyzor Collab as you could've guessed is based around the creator, the color scheme, the art, characters and even what you play as, but the best part has to be the animations tied to all of this, they are incredibly smooth and satisfying to watch, which in turn makes the level look and feel so much more lively and animated, that combined with the hype music and lighting, it's just a party all around. Extremely fun.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1071465

QOxaQ66ECG0.title: RUN by Cdpre | Geometry Dash
QOxaQ66ECG0.description:
This is amazing, I don't think I've seen something like this before using 1.0 style.

ID: 78353144

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/475234

#geometrydash

lRPQh1HxN-c.title: ''Surge'' by Splinter25 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
lRPQh1HxN-c.description:
A level that is so incredibly refined and in tune with it's theme, which in this case is electrical. This is definitely one of the best Harder levels I've played recently, from a creator that has such a high standard for quality and always outdoes himself one level after another, and this time we get just about everything you would want from a high-quality creation, where every aspect is unique in that it implements the theme in it's design and even it's gameplay, from the transitions, to the backgrounds and effects, everything is connected beautifully.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/988172

BMngrt9bU4g.title: Half a million objects! | (Extreme Demon) ''Vivisection'' by Hota1991 | Geometry Dash
BMngrt9bU4g.description:
A level with just over 500,000 objects, covered with a coat of red, with some of the amazing details, both big and small in just about every corner, stacked with so many effects that really sell the demonic theme, all of this and a ton more come together to create this majestic creation. 

From all the bits of art, patterns and designs that cover the foreground and backgrounds, to the contrast between the different shades of red and black, and even including the awesome soundtrack, it all fits together perfectly to bring you into this hellish atmosphere.

I used tools to record this level since it was lagging a lot.

Song: https://soundcloud.com/waraku/reanimate

cweC4P6B0g0.title: ''Fratura'' 100% (Demon) by Joojmiguel | Geometry Dash
cweC4P6B0g0.description:
A level that once you play a few seconds, you can feel the inspiration that Hinds brought to this level, the design, the colors and the atmosphere are very reminiscent, but at the same time, you can see that Joojmiguel has his own style and it shines here, making for a nice fusion of old and new, and it ends up working extremely well. The clear design, the contrast between the darkness and different colored lighting flashing through in sync with the music, at the end of the day makes for an intense and most of all, fun level to play.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/433947

YwgP7IXERAc.title: Windows 10 by theGoT | Geometry Dash
YwgP7IXERAc.description:
A soothing experience, wrapped up in a color scheme we all know, that ends up giving us an air of nostalgia, with a clean block design, snappy yet subtle effects, that and much more is what you get when you play Windows 10, a well rounded experience that's fun to play and relaxing to watch. Levels that reference apps or something computer related are always interesting, and high quality for that matter, it's fun to try to spot all the references and each one is unique in how they present the source.

The minimalist approach to this level is what makes it stand out for me, the familiar colors, contrasting with the white spaces, while moving around due to some very smooth animations, there are also some 3D effects present in some areas, but my favorite section is the ending, where we get some glitch effects, that sync up perfectly with the music and is a nice way to end it off.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1091342

onkTQDYw4MA.title: ''Smarties Preferably'' 100% (Demon) by SubStra & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
onkTQDYw4MA.description:
Smarties preferably is a collab between SubStra and a handful of other talented creators, a level with a prominent rainbow theme, that is mesmerizing, exciting and most of all fun to play, we can see a ton of ideas and different designs come together to create a whole experience, where each creator shines in their own section, whether it's because of the effects they used, the animations they implemented or the uniqueness of their backgrounds, art or block design.

This minute and a half long experience has a wide variety of pacing, effects, colors and vibes as well, but if one thing is true is that the level of quality and standard of design is constant throughout the entire thing, between each persons input, with the music being absolutely phenomenal.

BTAu9F9HSJI.title: Infatuated by SylntNyt | Geometry Dash
BTAu9F9HSJI.description:
A clean design, a ton of cool lighting and color effects, and 2.2 effects that are well integrated and seem so natural. All of this and more is what you get when you play this level

The colors are bright and vibrant, the block design is satisfying and clear, everything comes together and harmonizes, this is definitely one of the most polished levels, with this type of theme at least. Great stuff.

h-3s83d1xcA.title: IGNITION by BrazilTeam | Geometry Dash
h-3s83d1xcA.description:
The newest level from BrazilTeam that have brought us fantastic creations such as Zacarias, Cryogenic Haze, and Vacuum Wave, now we have ignition, a level that was started back in 2019 by Helpegasus and in the end had input from the rest of the team, and you can tell the difference in styles in each section, within bits and pieces, but everything meshes together so well that you don't notice it while playing, and we end up experiencing a beautiful lava themed level, that has strong oranges and reds, bright lighting effects, a clean block design and even some animations in transitions and in the foreground.

The fast paced gameplay goes well nicely with the intense soundtrack and the flashes, movements and color changes have a great sync as well. The end screen is amazing as well. Overall another great level from this team, that you should play when you have the chance.

ID: 78086050

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/845915

Kt1G255g81Y.title: ''Playground'' 100% (Demon) by Ellninja | Geometry Dash
Kt1G255g81Y.description:
Playground is a special level, it has smooth movements, that and the design being refined as it is, you can't help but want to play it a few more times over, even after you've beaten it. In exactly a minute, you get to see a really nice design, wrapped in pulses and colors that sync together perfectly with the intense music.

The movements tied to the blocks and obstacles are the best part about this, as I previously mentioned, there is a ton neat stuff here, and in many other aspects of the level, such as the block design, that has small decorations and effects that make it stand out, which makes the entire thing more personalized and unique, fantastic level.

Us9_Xi2xiRA.title: ''BLRPL LGHTS'' 100% (Demon) Novaach | Geometry Dash
Us9_Xi2xiRA.description:
BLRPL LGHTS is a level with an incredibly satisfying buildup and drop, the purple and pink color scheme fitting in with the rest of the design and the intensity of the level, surrounded by lighting effects that are the star of the show, that shine through the transparent block design that is simplistic but goes with the overall aesthetic, setting the dark atmosphere and creating a contrast between background and foreground. 

A Demon that is just as fun to play as it is to watch, one you should definitely play when you get the chance, despite the difficulty, it's very worth it.

L9G-ZgPaDaU.title: ''EL DORADO'' 100% (Demon) by LmAnubis | Geometry Dash
L9G-ZgPaDaU.description: A 2.0 level that came out over 6 years ago, a level that was considered very difficult by many people, and became a classic as the years went by, and if you know The Golden, then you'll recognize this level.

pMFik1qRVEk.title: ''Carrefour City'' by Arcanin | Geometry Dash
pMFik1qRVEk.description:
A beautiful and relaxing level I saw today on Partitions channel, and when I watched it I knew I had to play it myself, a minute long experience that has unique visual elements and decorations, taking you through a computer desktop, using the windows as platforms, then taking you through the streets of Japan where you get to see the majestic Mt. Fuji in the background, before taking you inside of a store where you see many different items and foods that remind you of the place. 

My favorite part about this is how the art is simplistic, but there are small details and many different entities that fill up the screen, making the world look alive, there's also the fact that there's a small story and progression, which helps makes sense of where you are and where you're going, which is nice.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/816335

x_1VmORwhYY.title: ''Evolutionary Theory'' 100% (XXL Demon) by MAYEROSA | Geometry Dash
x_1VmORwhYY.description:
Evolutionary Theory is a 5 minute level that is a complete experience and adventure, with such a long runtime, you get to see an amazing variety of places, enjoy great art and even learn a bit along the way about how earth has evolved. The biggest benefit of a level with a theme like this is that you get a lot of liberty with what you can make, you can take the player anywhere on the planet.

The amount of palpable effort and dedication to make a level so detailed while being this long is impressive, that and making each part look and play connected, while maintaining the same level of quality from start to finish, the sense of space and progression is executed nicely.

My favorite sections are the ones towards the latter half, where we get to modern times and ultimately into the apocalypse, there's a ton of detail in the backgrounds, each section could be it's own level, a satisfying and fun level all around.

asQrt9B3aMo.title: ''DEATH NOTE'' 100% (Demon) by Ruf | Geometry Dash
asQrt9B3aMo.description: This level has been updated like 10 times, the current rated version is very nerfed so I beat the buffed version for fun.

qkLUtq1x9Lc.title: Stranvel Lege by Lespainsaucho | Geometry Dash
qkLUtq1x9Lc.description:
A layout style level that was made about a year and a half ago that has unique animations and effects that really make it stand out, affecting the gameplay as well which makes it even better. More than 2 minutes of gameplay that uses aspects we might find a lot more often when 2.2 comes out, coming up with all of these mechanics, putting them together to make a complete level. Even though it's a layout, you'll be too focused on the gameplay to care.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/724710

#geometrydash

GP4dL33Ii1k.title: Chalk Cave by LSEm | Geometry Dash
GP4dL33Ii1k.description:
Chalk Cave is a level with a unique style and decoration, being comprised entirely of small dots of chalk, from beginning to end, and from head to toe, everything you see, from a gameplay and design standpoint is made of this, which shows just how much time and effort it must've taken to finish this. I enjoyed the fact that apart from the colored chalk that makes up everything, the backgrounds are dark, it's a nice contrast and it helps to see the small details better, even allowing a bit of depth to be percieved.

This minute long level has nice buildup between gameplay and music, it's fun to play and interesting to look at, the rustic shape of the structures helps the theme out as well, almost as if it was hand drawn.

#geometrydash

fAl0GSB7ppQ.title: ''INSOMNIA'' by DiMaViKuLov26 [3 Coins] Geometry Dash
fAl0GSB7ppQ.description:
INSOMNIA is a fantastic level with interesting and unique effects, that also have a subtlety to them that prevent the design from going overboard and seeming too cluttered, the decoration is tastefully made and the fact that it's longer than average means there is a wide variety as well. In my opinion the black and white color scheme is the perfect choice for this type of level, especially since some of the effects and animations are tied to it and even the music.

Everything about this is incredibly smooth, which makes it fun to play and mesmerizing to watch, the fact that it's about 2 years old makes it all the more impressive and shows the talent of the creator as well.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/488781

#geometrydash

jJGkkbMA9rM.title: [1.9] ''Tetrix'' by Insendium | Geometry Dash
jJGkkbMA9rM.description:
A level that brings a lot of nostalgia for a lot of people, a 1.9 creation that at one point was the longest level, with it's subtle colors and lighting inside the block design, that has at this point a retro vibe to it, which shows the huge progression the game has seen since those times.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/162764

kGtAqQ5ThmE.title: Terraria by Skubb | Geometry Dash
kGtAqQ5ThmE.description:
A level that recreates the style, art and especially the atmosphere of Terraria, from the textures on the ground to the trees to the background and animals running around, it always amazes me how many games have been ported into GD, it also shows how much some communities can overlap a bit, and it's a nice change of scenery and pace.

The level is a minute and a half long, but it manages to showcase a ton of different biomes, along with some things that make them recognizable, the transitions between the biomes are also true to the source, the music is the cherry on top, a nice remix of the overworld theme.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/832902

7lsLVVujIvg.title: [4k] ''Jawbreaker'' 100% (Demon) by ZenthicAlpha | Geometry Dash
7lsLVVujIvg.description:
Didn't have a high quality video for this level, so I rebeat it, which is one of the most iconic Nine Circles levels there is

#geometrydash

cVDjTwTg5X0.title: Punching Very Fast by rhythmmaster | Geometry Dash
cVDjTwTg5X0.description:
A short but very satisfying animation by rhythmmaster, this level has a cinematic quality that we don't see very often, subtle effects like the flames all over the ground, the black bars, the speed lines and the transition to the spam click section especially, are on another level and make this stand out among other animations, the movements are smooth which is very important for something like this, the music is also a perfect fit for the intensity of what's going on in front of you. Overall short but very sweet.

ID: 77826884

#geometrydash

wJJSXx5tFt4.title: [1.9] ''Revolution'' by FunnyGame | Geometry Dash
wJJSXx5tFt4.description: Love 1.9, I want to upload some more iconic levels, they're really awesome. I still absolutely love the part at 1:00

CykRo9JuT_k.title: ''Coolio Levelio'' 100% (Demon) by Alkali & Renn241 | Geometry Dash
CykRo9JuT_k.description:
A lively and colorful level from two creators who specialize in hyped up visuals and high octane gameplay, these two doing a collab just seems right, especially since their styles mesh together so well. I've always liked levels that seem to have an older spirit to them, have a more classic design when it comes to backgrounds and block design, but looking a lot more modern, using a ton of different effects with it's colors and and lighting that make up for everything else and fill in the gaps.

There are also some small animations within the obstacles that give a feeling of quality and smoothness when it comes to the gameplay, it also fits in perfectly with the fast pace of the level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/410082

NuJngGfAsNw.title: Made in 2 days! | AT EVERYONE by Splinter25 | Geometry Dash
NuJngGfAsNw.description:
A level that was made in two days, and while it is simple in it's overall design, the level of quality inside of it's simplicity is undeniable, especially since it ties very heavily to the song, being amazing as well, using Discord sounds in the beginning which makes it instantly recognizable and unique, but back to the design, the effects are definitely top-tier, the animations, the structures and obstacles, transitions and lighting are great, making this level even more impressive because of it's short creation time, Splinter deserves a lot of recognition for that, Exyl as well for creating a great song.

Song: Ping! 2 by Exyl
https://youtu.be/8CYy9jNmpXM

vQk3iQrp4qY.title: ''New Year'' 100% (Demon) by LightningSL [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
vQk3iQrp4qY.description:
A brand new level from LightningSL, New Year, and I have to say that Lightning has improved a lot since their last level, the consistent use of a soothing yet exciting color palette, that fits the new year theme perfectly, the purples, pinks, even red and yellow, along with all the art in the backgrounds and the elegant block design, make for a very complete experience.

There is a ton of detail in each section, which is appreciated, since some sections tend to be a bit more empty than others, but here we get a nice variety but still maintain the level of quality all throughout.

Song: https://youtu.be/S7p9B7IAj3Q

BHTXSntAJrE.title: ''Abstract Haze'' 100% (Demon) by Cubiccc | Geometry Dash
BHTXSntAJrE.description:
A level with fantastic effects, smooth movements, and simplistic yet abstract block design and backgrounds, that together with it's vibrant colors make for a beautiful experience that you'll want to watch several times over. There are so many different shapes and colors to be seen here, each crafted in a way where you get to appreciate every small detail. I also enjoyed the buildup and change in intensity in both design and gameplay as the music picks up as well, it enhances the experience, the effects are my favorite part about this level, you can find them just about anywhere, when clicking an orb, during a transition, or in the background contrasting with the foreground. Really nice.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/751490

9MXFxPg6GVg.title: 163 by Diffuse | Geometry Dash
9MXFxPg6GVg.description:
163 is a very interesting level since it uses Fractals, which are fascinatingly complex structures that are infinite that seem to loop over and over, while being similar, and the way Diffuse integrates them into his level is mesmerizing and something I haven't really seen before. 

The fractal effects are extremely well made, and there is a wide variety of them, so many different shapes and colors, intertwining with the rest of the design in every aspect, which helps everything look and feel connected with each other and hypes up the atmosphere.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/718319

IJhJhtPga_I.title: ''Fusion Core'' 100% (Demon) by HeroZombie80 | Geometry Dash
IJhJhtPga_I.description:
A level that has that classic Fusion level style, but the main difference is that while simple in the larger scope, there is a lot of detail, the block design being heavily decorated with small shapes, lines and even orbs,  with some subtle lighting effects to have a bit of contrast so it isn't lost with the rest of design and the slow pace of gameplay and music, it helps you appreciate it a ton more and understand the gameplay as well.

My favorite part about this level is a smaller detail that might go unnoticed, the red and yellow glow that flashes in the background helps the atmosphere, along with the music creating a more ominous feeling, overall a nice tribute to old Fusion levels.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/353593

u2YxcS9w8sU.title: Peep Peep by Dorami | Geometry Dash
u2YxcS9w8sU.description:
A fun collab between Dorami and a handful of other talented creators where you can really see the strengths and style of everyone, differences in the colors they used, the design and even the vibe, but at the same time every part intertwines with one another really well, so it makes for a cohesive and enjoyable experience, basically half of the level was made by Dorami and the rest by toady, Nerhy and Akvaz.

I thoroughly enjoyed each section of this level, there are bright effects when it comes to lighting and colors, which go well with this type of fast paced level, especially when it has such great sync with the music, there are some subtle animations in the block design here and there, while more prominent ones can be seen on the edges of the screen, making these parts look more alive. The backgrounds are simple, but the focus is entirely on the foreground, overall a great level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/716489

Vq_PMoilVrk.title: Desperation by LViper | Geometry Dash
Vq_PMoilVrk.description:
Levels that have that unexpected twist from peaceful to horrifying are some of my favorites, especially when the quality is as high as this, the amount of detail and style to be found in Desperation is top-tier, the variety and smoothness of the animations, the mesmerizing and jarring effects, the dark spaces contrasting with the flashing lights, loud sounds and visuals, they fit the title and theme of the level perfectly, they make you feel the frightening ambience every second.

I feel a level is especially powerful and has a larger impact when it relates heavily to the creator, how they live or what they feel, good or bad, and it lets you know for sure just how much effort went into creating and perfecting it, and it gives insight to the intricacies of the design and and the images displayed.

ID: 77643208

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/694359

XWjKxl7R6HM.title: ''Mussum'' 100% (Demon) by Nidroo & More | Geometry Dash
XWjKxl7R6HM.description:
A remake of Firewall, a 5 year old classic level from Hinds, that back then was a favorite for many, many people and even now it still holds up, which isn't a surprise given the talent of it's creator. Levels like these are the ones that in my opinion should get remakes and a brand new coat of paint the most, especially when it's well done like Nidroo and everybody that participated in this level managed to create.

The style, feeling and design of the original are all there, with a more modern style and decoration, and a bit more variety when it comes to colors, basically every aspect of the level has been elevated in different ways and it's nice to see and still fun to play.

uZp1arJq38M.title: ''Blizzard'' 100% (Demon) by AutoNick [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
uZp1arJq38M.description:
Blizzard is a winter themed level with a sophisticated, modern and varied design, there are a lot of places, structures and sights to see throughout this experience, which I think is very important for themes like this, so you don't get stuck doing only 1 type of style, even if it is riskier, but here I works amazingly well.

My favorite part about this level is how it ramps up as time goes on and as the song picks up as well, with some of the decoration changing in sync with it, starting with a more rustic design and ending with a modern take with brighter colors and flashier effects, which all look great and is a satisfying transition to see and play, this is when making a longer level pays off.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/328252

lzv5G9EFaUI.title: ''Good Vibes'' 100% (Demon) by Danolex [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
lzv5G9EFaUI.description:
A level that truly does justice to it's title, the design is simplistic when it comes to the colors, shapes and block design, but at the same time that's what makes it stand out and charming, the neon lighting and borders along with the beautiful song fit together perfectly.

There is a sense of quality even though it's a minute long, I also really like the bits of art that show up in random places, simple but effective, with the end screen recreation of Super Mario Bros. looking very different, much more detailed and a good way to end this short experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/995331

QAUlqD4womo.title: ''YOQUIERO'' 100% (Demon) by Vrymer | Geometry Dash
QAUlqD4womo.description:
YOQUIERO is a level that has a satisfying and powerful contrast within it's color scheme cool and warm colors, darker and lighter shades, with a relatively simplistic yet sleek design when it comes to the blocks and obstacles, all of this and more combined with the upbeat and bassy music makes for an entertaining experience.

What I like most about this is how vibrant and lively everything looks, from the beginning you get to see bright colors with some nice lighting effects to make everything pop out a bit more, there are smooth animations in both layers of the level, the background has some decorations that fit nicely with the rest of the design without going overboard, which is nice.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1074946

jWEk8pf0AQ4.title: ''Pathway'' 100% (Demon) by Dominus | Geometry Dash
jWEk8pf0AQ4.description:
Pathway is an erratic yet mesmerizing and even relaxing experience, taking advantage of sync to fuse the gameplay, design and music into one, which is made interesting by using Jazz's weird chords and timings to their full potential, and with so many colors and effects at your disposal, you can make something really satisfying.

The fact that every bit of the design follows the song, makes it unpredictable, you could get any color, any effect, get a transition when you least expect it, that being said, it's still coherent, starting off slow and ramping up towards the end on all fronts. Overall a cool level with a ton of detail.

Song: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/964030

70nXpgzUFTk.title: First green user level rated after 6 years.
70nXpgzUFTk.description:
This was released over 7 years ago by an unregistered user with the name of Derek, now its been rated making it the first level by a green user to be rated after 6 years, the latest being in 2.0! Really cool to see :)

Eternity by DEREK

ID: 3865909
