#geometrydash

n3lxd2htEW0.title: ''Modern Nightspot'' 100% (Demon) by DanLom & More | Geometry Dash
n3lxd2htEW0.description:
A colorful and lively atmosphere, a varied yet satisfying pallette, stylish and flashy effects and a unique block design, these are only some of the things this level has to offer, a minute long rave that captures your attention from the very beginning.

The first section is by far the most surprising, the 3D obstacles and platforms work well with the rainbow aesthetic and subtle animation in the background, the lighting and glow effects highlighting the important parts of the decoration. There are also some text elements further down the line, that fit the theme nicely.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1021674

qVSStauwT2g.title: ''Found'' 100% (Demon) by Rowanm | Geometry Dash
qVSStauwT2g.description:
When you make a level that is short, under a minute long, it's hard to make it interesting and compelling, having enough detail and to establish the atmosphere and theme in such a short span to keep the players interest and attention, but this does all of that.

With it's relaxing aesthetic, the visuals, the black and white color scheme, the simplistic structures that make up the obstacles and backgrounds, the soothing animations and effects, some subtle and others on a bigger scale, it all goes together nicely, but in my opinion the song plays just as big a role as everything else.

ID: 73771178

Song: https://youtu.be/46i3LbIbbhI

#geometrydash #gd

9DHwZ-2O8bA.title: ''Starry Sandstream'' 100% by Furorem [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
9DHwZ-2O8bA.description:
Starry Sandstream is a level with a uniquely beautiful design and decoration, the multi-colored tiles that make up the block design look like something straight out of a book, not only that but the different shapes and structures they form are what make this level really stand out.

But it isn't just the block design that is fantastic, the backgrounds are just as, if not more detailed, having multiple layers of art with some subtle effects to make everything pop out a bit more, tying everything together to make a calming atmosphere.

_HORsFpKxiE.title: "too kiD frIEndly" 100% (XXL Demon) by ExtoPlasm | Geometry Dash
_HORsFpKxiE.description:
From the creator of Mr CrazyHands, with help from RealChaoz, we have a brand new level that has more or less a similar aesthetic, a theme that is very interesting to me and lends itself to a lot of surprises and uniqueness, especially being 3 minutes long. The idea of a level starting off innocent and clean and ending up corrupted and glitched isn't easy to pull off, but ExtoPlasm manages to make something with great design and transitions nicely from one point to another.

The art and backgrounds are the most important parts of this level, and they do deliver, we get to see a ton of different places and settings, we also get second-long animations that serve as either transitions or for progressing through the world, they have smooth movements and the art is fitting to the theme.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/772738

#geometrydash

Ffw1YthvHc0.title: Bloodbath Remake | ''Bloudeleuste'' 100% (Demon) by MrSpaghetti & Hydren | Geometry Dash
Ffw1YthvHc0.description:
A 1.9 level that is based on and inspired by Bloodbath, if you couldn't tell, that has a lot of style and manages to take one of the most iconic Extreme Demons and putting it into a time machine to give a more classic design, while still making it easily recognizable. That being said it isn't a one to one replica of the original, there are some changes to the layout, some spaces are made more open and easier to maneuver since this level isn't meant to be an Extreme, but it is very fun and enjoyable to play.

I also appreciate the different references to be found here from a couple of creators, especially the Lava Temple section close to the beginning, which looks great, it also flows nicely with the gameplay and serves as a transition.

Rh8xy0tvjxs.title: ''Undergound'' 100% (Demon) by Metalface221 | Geometry Dash
Rh8xy0tvjxs.description:
Old unrated level from 2018, still holds up pretty well in my opinion.

#geometrydash

qeU_r-CSCPQ.title: ''CARMINE'' 100% (Demon) by Dominus & More | Geometry Dash
qeU_r-CSCPQ.description:
Carmine is a level that has a nice progression, being rather soothing and slow at the very beginning, with softer colors, a more coherent layout with straightforward transitions and simpler effects, getting more intense, erratic and disjointed as it goes on, which is one of this levels advantages, it becomes unexpected and that makes this unique.

I enjoy the variety in pacing, it doesn't stay the same when going from one section to the next, and the design and gameplay shift as well to match this, helping add some variety to the atmosphere and feel of the level, especially in the second half towards the end, where it slows down almost to a crawl with some nice effects to go along, having great sync with the music, tying together every aspect.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1000485

KuMrRUFKFvI.title: Demon Park Remake | ''Fantasy Park'' 100% (Demon) by Unbihexium & More | Geometry Dash
KuMrRUFKFvI.description:
A remake of the very first Demon ever created so many years ago, and with these types of remakes, it's always nice to see levels that are older but were so important at the time, get remastered and revamped with a new coat of paint, some new effects, while still keeping the spirit of the original intact, which is also important in my opinion.

There's still something really stylish about vintage levels, that you can't help but give all of your attention to, and with such an iconic level, this gives you a sense of nostalgia but at the same time it makes you excited to be where we are now with so many great creators.

M9VO-GovktE.title: ''Mario Judas'' 100% (Demon) by Woom & Kyhros | Geometry Dash
M9VO-GovktE.description:
A short but very satisfying level, with an intense nature and flashy visual effects, the red theme works extremely well, it even goes with the song, with the white flashes being a nice way to create sync and contrast in the block design and backgrounds.

There are also some small animations and movements within the blocks and obstacles that are nicely done, smooth and make the gameplay more enjoyable, the backgrounds also have some nice effects, in the beginning and the end specifically, with a more solid color in between, overall a cool level.

1O0d1A6GuSA.title: ''White Space'' 100% (Demon) by Xender Game | Geometry Dash
1O0d1A6GuSA.description:
A level that has been highly anticipated, ever since it was shown 5 months ago, and finally after a couple of months it's been released and it's an absolute masterpiece in all of it's aspects, this level will be remembered for a long time, Xender Game constantly releases levels that blow us away because of their quality and amazing visuals, and this is one of the best.

From the smallest details like the colors and block design, to the biggest like the art, backgrounds and atmosphere, even the story that Xender has created and intertwined with the decorations is all spot on, top-tier.

Calling this a level isn't enough, it's more like an animated short, extremely enjoyable to play but even more to just look and admire, if you can, go play it.

Song: https://youtu.be/5zOXXYD4Wa4

bYjHrWp2LPA.title: Igallta by Puri1 | Geometry Dash
bYjHrWp2LPA.description:
Igallta is a level that features nice visuals, that stand out even more because of it's simplistic design, there are a ton of unique effects here, each one helping the level feel more alive while having fantastic sync with the music.

The best parts for me are the ones that show more than two icons on the screen, it's a unique effect and the fact that it's intertwined with the gameplay makes it even better, there's a lot of quality here, and it isn't held back at all because of it's simple decoration.

DFkc4lcqvvU.title: ''SPECTRUM SURGE II'' by BrainETR | Geometry Dash
DFkc4lcqvvU.description:
The sequel to Spectrum Surge, BrainETR has taken the original level and improved upon it in every aspect, maintaining the same level of intensity and vibrancy, while the effects look much more polished and varied, the animations look smoother and the design is a bit more varied.

I thoroughly enjoyed the vibe this level brings, starting right at the buildup towards the drop, which then slows down again at the very end, the changes in pace are welcome and add to the design as a whole, with the effects and decoration following suit

#geometrydash

GE0y_Yv-fTU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''DORADURA'' 100% by Ivashka | Geometry Dash
GE0y_Yv-fTU.description:
A beautiful Extreme Demon from a very talented Russian creator, it's always a treat to play levels of this difficulty with equally impactful visuals and effects, it makes it feel like the complete package, and this level goes beyond that. The art, both in the backgrounds and foregrounds look fantastic, the atmosphere is built from the very beginning, with the soft yet varied color palette serving to amplify this.

I also really like the block design used here, the neon effects make the obstacles and structures stand out and separates them from the backgrounds. My favorite part has to be the city section, it looks and feels alive and the song that's jamming with the lasers going off in all directions is perfect.

IzmkABRwSxA.title: Trust Me by ItzMatthewPlayz | Geometry Dash
IzmkABRwSxA.description:
Had this video saved for a while, never got around to uploading it. This was before Trust Me Again.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/781880

ID: 68584554

#geometrydash

_lHQIIb9cek.title: ''Crossroads'' 100% (XXL Demon) by mbed | Geometry Dash
_lHQIIb9cek.description:
To say that this level is mesmerizing, mainly because of it's surrealism and abstract visuals would be an understatement, Crossroads is a 5 minute experience that features gameplay that is entirely invisible, with the only way to navigate through the hidden obstacles and objects is following the musical queues and objects that make up the fascinating art in the background, and a bit of memorization.

I honestly think this is some of the best sync between the gameplay, visuals and music I've seen, it all fits together so perfectly, that you get lost in this strange world, with all of it's oddities and spaces, and the fact that you only see the art helps the immersion a lot.

Crossroads with all of it's aspects, has an atmosphere that sometimes feels hopeful and sometimes a bit more somber, but it is overall a very creative experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1091340

8G_8F2tXYpw.title: ''so'' 100% by neigefeu [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
8G_8F2tXYpw.description:
so is a simplistic level in it's nature, but through great use of color and satisfying effects, it stands out, the relaxing and soothing atmosphere serves to bring more attention to these aspects.

I also appreciate the fact that the backgrounds aren't empty, they have a variety of designs, that help give a layered aspect to the level.

There is also a nice buildup here that follows the music, starting off slow but ending off on a big note, although a bit short towards the end, it's cool to see the change in pace, overall a satisfying level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/752025

#geometrydash

I9oSXb0IC9E.title: SOS Earth by MAYEROSA | Geometry Dash
I9oSXb0IC9E.description:
An auto level that through it's beautiful art and backgrounds, tells the story about where the earth is heading and the desperate help it needs to heal from all the pollution and garbage damaging it's natural resources, and bringing across such a powerful point in only 2 minutes is impressive.

The visuals are fantastic, it has a lot of layers of detail, the inclusion of different icons being used as pedestrians and workers helps make the world feel much more alive, and going through so many different places gives a sense of adventure and progression, a great level that incites imagination.

#geometrydash

2GyEbTux7iE.title: Shattered Space by FunnyGame & Flosia | Geometry Dash
2GyEbTux7iE.description:
It's always great to see FunnyGame release a new level, this time it is a collaboration with Flosia, that have created a glitch themed level with amazing visuals, mesmerizing effects and an explosive atmosphere.

I really like how the buildup is managed here, with half of the level being clean and straightforward, only using a couple of colors and moving at a slow pace, but once the drop hits, everything becomes as erratic and intense as possible, there are so many great effects used in this section, so many colors and the backgrounds look fantastic as well.

#geometrydash

P1CVJN838JY.title: World Box by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash
P1CVJN838JY.description:
Subwoofer is back again with another level that leaves us completely speechless, not only because of it's visuals, atmosphere, and overall design, but because of it's meaning, A World Box is the perfect end and opening credits to bring in a new year, being dedicated to many many people in the community, both big and small, creators, players, music artists, etc.

There are so many references to figures that are important to this game, their levels and their legacies, this is a love letter to this great game, one of the most meaningful creations to be released.

#geometrydash

sAmyxggYCH0.title: Kita by RebeccaGD & More | Geometry Dash
sAmyxggYCH0.description:
If you played this level, without knowing anything, you would most likely assume this was made with months of work put into it with many many revisions, but what sets this apart is the fact that it was made in only 4 days, which is incredibly impressive to me, given the quality of just about everything the level has to offer, from the smallest to the largest detail.

There was so much detail and life put into this, a nice variety in each section with the drop being the best part without a doubt, having vibrant colors, beautiful effects and smooth animations within the obstacles and backgrounds. One thing I wish this level had though, is if the last 30% had more detail put into it, other than that this level is awesome.

#geometrydash

hYaC0t8hDU4.title: ZOZZ by YunHaSeu14 & KuraiYonaka | Geometry Dash
hYaC0t8hDU4.description:
Happy new year everyone! I hope you all had a good year even with everything that goes on in the world, and I hope next year is much better. For the last level of the year we have ZOZZ, a beautiful collab between two great creators, that has a simplistic and modern theme, full of nice effects, vibrant colors and smooth and satisfying animations.

The block design is nothing fancy, it's dark which goes well with the bright backgrounds full of life and color, I also really like the variety when it comes to the designs in the back, it all goes together nicely.

#geometrydash

ie_IwkriK70.title: ''Dystopia'' 100% (Demon) by RoyalP | Geometry Dash
ie_IwkriK70.description:
An intense level, with modern visuals and a very unique art style, Dystopia gets your attention from the very first section with it's multi layered background and harsh atmosphere, staying true to the title from the beginning, we've seen levels that have this futuristic, apocalyptic vibe, but this is special, not only because of it's quality, but because it doesn't just show the world in ruins, it has a strong contrast between a lonely world and showing humanity and love, showing all of this not only in a beautiful art style, but in text, both big and small, which makes sure you take notice.

This really does play and look like a sort of very short film, and what surprises me the most is the impact it has in just over a minute, with every section having it's own atmosphere, the backgrounds, colors, block design and effects all meshing together, and the song fits perfectly as well. I really recommend you play this for yourself.

#geometrydash

g2CjgSYRqRc.title: ''SUBVERT'' 100% (Demon) by qMystic, Konsi & More | Geometry Dash
g2CjgSYRqRc.description:
A level that feels very alive and energetic, with an enormous variety in it's parts made by a ton of incredibly talented creators, with every section being different and unique to it's owner, with their own creating style and ideas shining through, but managing to fit together at the end in a satisfying and cohesive way.

It's always really nice to see when a bunch of creators, whether it's big or small, come together to make something that's fun and high quality all around, meshing different designs and colors, to the tune of an upbeat song that fits the vibe perfectly.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/876650

ID: 76923891

#geometrydash

9onePdHhdRA.title: EXG by Grax | Geometry Dash
9onePdHhdRA.description:
A beautiful design level from the very talented Grax who's last level was the Extreme Demon Broken Signal, so it's nice to see him release something new, and it was definitely worth the wait, this is as good as you're gonna get when it comes to design, with fantastic effects and even better transitions to go along with it. There is a great balance in it's sections between fast and impactful and slow and methodical, and being on the more difficult side amplifies this notion.

I enjoyed how each section is slightly different from the last, while still staying cohesive, but surprising you with it's amazing effects and transitions.

#geometrydash

A0Qav559BM4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Astral Divinity'' 100% by Knobbelboy | Geometry Dash
A0Qav559BM4.description:
Finally, never thought I would be doing this level this year but I pulled through after playing 5 hours everyday for 6 days. It's great to have this out of the way, since gameplay wise this is probably one of the least fun Extreme Demons out there. Nonetheless It's still visually stunning, though I wish this was better optimized. And thank you all for 900k, GG :)

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/732596

#geometrydash

XW74iS08sAc.title: [2.2] ''Endless'' by K76 | Geometry Dash
XW74iS08sAc.description:
Another gem I never actually got around to upload, these are so fun to play.

#geometrydash

oVI0gh-bMvQ.title: mikusmas by Scrumpy, Para & Sminx | Geometry Dash
oVI0gh-bMvQ.description:
A beautiful christmas themed level, with a modern effects and block design, but simplistic in it's nature, which makes for a satisfying experience without going overboard with art and flashy effects.

My favorite part about this level are the effects in the backgrounds, the stars shining and glistening in the sky, the blurry lights that seem to form a tree and the giant christmas tree we see with all of it's decorations surrounding it and the pretty foreground to complement it, there's a nice variety in places we get to see, but it all has the christmas spirit.

Happy holidays everyone!

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/720020

#geometrydash

bThhgb0pnmQ.title: Virtualization by Splinter25 | Geometry Dash
bThhgb0pnmQ.description:
The newest level from the incredibly talented Splinter, that has some of the most unique visual elements I've seen in a long time, combining gameplay with the decoration and animations is not an easy thing to do, much less making it look this good, the sleek design surrounded by all different tones of blue portrays the virtual and cyber theme nicely, it amazes me how a creator can tell a story or take you on an adventure in only a minute or a bit more.

Everything about this level meshes together perfectly, from the simplistic yet effective block design, with all of it's glow and little decorations, to all of the components in the background that you would find on a real computer, the effects are also great, they feel impactful and fit the theme nicely, without going overboard, overall a great level.

#geometrydash

aGS27G_wK3M.title: ''A Newborn Star'' 100% (Demon) by Electro2012 | Geometry Dash
aGS27G_wK3M.description:
A level from an unknown creator that shows a lot of talent and potential, and you can see it clear as day in this, what I really like about A Newborn Star is the variety in it's sections and especially it's colors, with the most prominent being the bright and fiery oranges that are characteristic of the sun, but there are also darker sections that take advantage of the purples and blues to create a more mellow space atmosphere which looks amazing, but the best part about this section is how the block design is made to look like constellations, adds a lot of style and uniqueness to the overall experience.

This level has it all for me, great design, satisfying effects, beautiful art and most importantly a good atmosphere and vibe, the sync with the song is fantastic as well, it fits with the grand setting of space, I can't wait to see what comes next for this creator.

#geometrydash

4-gurKxtej8.title: [2.2] ''Rise Up'' by Astraa | Geometry Dash
4-gurKxtej8.description:
Absolutely love this layout, super fun, with a great song, and amazing to look at.

#geometrydash

ZdninZj1vJo.title: ''ILLUSION OF SPACE'' 100% (Demon) by Oasis & ItzKiba | Geometry Dash
ZdninZj1vJo.description:
A level with a ton of style and flare, Illusion of Space pulls you into it's world with it's amazing effects, flashy lighting and beautiful backgrounds. Nowadays, with so many space-themed levels out there, it's really hard to stand out and be unique, but this level manages to pull it off and in a major way.

From the very beginning you get hit with a trippy yet satisfying wave effect that sets the tone for the rest of the experience, being fast paced and lively due to the great song that was used. I really like the balance between the simpler sections that focus more on gameplay with the design being left to glow and some particles here and there and the much more detailed sections with a lot more going on, especially the backgrounds, the sync is great as well, not only guiding the pace of the gameplay but the design as well.

#geometrydash

sozXqMZDmIY.title: Crossover by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash
sozXqMZDmIY.description:
Crossover is overall just a fun experience, where you have beautiful christmas themed art from a bunch of characters from different shows and games, Grim from the Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy, Sans and Papyrus from Undertale, Squidward and some others, being the highlight of the level, these pieces of art stand out and apart from looking good, fit nicely with what's going on in the foreground.

The block design and the decorations surrounding it are another strong point to this level, being entirely different each section, combining with the character/s in the background, making it feel a lot more immersive, whether it's the coral in bikini bottom or the bones in Snowdin, it all meshes together nicely.

#geometrydash

cpo48NE0Ajk.title: Teleport Orb by AleXins | Geometry Dash
cpo48NE0Ajk.description:
This is another one of those levels that get you excited for the future of this game, where you have a very interesting concept that makes you imagine all the ways it could be implemented, in this case we have an orb that works exactly like the Spider, which RobTop implemented into the game after seeing a fanmade.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/679002

#geometrydash

yZyKIYp1JXw.title: Trust Me Again by ItzMatthewPlayz | Geometry Dash
yZyKIYp1JXw.description:
A very unique layout level that feels and looks alive, moving and shifting around every single second, placing it's blocks and obstacles in bizarre places in sync with the music, there's a lot of personality here when it comes to design, it's strange nature and the fact that every section has it's own effect that sets it apart from the rest is what makes this level fun.

This is a very satisfying level to play, especially the final section, where the gameplay is unique since the wall of spikes chases you and will kill you and it switches between different game modes which makes it more intense as it goes on.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/781880

#geometrydash

7bnlR3Zfh5A.title: ''BlastOff'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 | Geometry Dash
7bnlR3Zfh5A.description:
A remake of TakeOff, a level made by nasgubb a couple of years ago, a level comprised fully of neon colors and effects which at the time looked great, but now we have Alex taking a crack at remaking it and in my opinion he got it perfect. The spirit of the original is intact here but just about everything else has been improved and revamped, the colors look much more vibrant, the neon glow is prominent without going overboard and blinding you, the block design is much more detailed and the level as a whole looks and feels extremely lively.

The best addition to me are definitely the backgrounds, they look fantastic in both design and effects, giving a sense of depth to a level, especially in a remake really helps to elevate it, and in this case it makes so much difference.

#geometrydash

GXtOEVtDQaw.title: ''SPIDERS'' 100% (Demon) by MAYEROSA [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
GXtOEVtDQaw.description:
A level that has a really nice balance inside of it's own cartoony design, this is where this level really stands out, it's theme is executed very well and each detail is high quality and unique in it's own way.

When it comes to atmosphere, art and colors, they all combine in a satisfying way here, the darker tones, the purples and blacks in the beginning, to the browns and reds towards the middle, colors that fit well with the art in the background, with the boss battle at the end being the cherry on top, a great design and fitting attacks.

3sPkaXPge2Q.title: [2.2] Sneak Peek Playable by ShruGGie | Geometry Dash
3sPkaXPge2Q.description:
Probably the closest recreation of the 2.2 sneak peek that RobTop uploaded a couple of months back which showcases a handful of new effects that we're going to get with the update and a short section with the new swingcopter gamemode, just about everything in terms of design is spot on as well, very neat.

2.2 GDPS by Blaze: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfPtuop90e_JzxPkiZ6Q5Q

Shruggie: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvWccBKEVLynTBYHYiIpEYw

#geometrydash

pARqOBE6baU.title: [2.2] Non Inertial by Apatic | Geometry Dash
pARqOBE6baU.description:
Played this on SMJS' GDPS 2.2 server, which always has some really nice concept levels that help to hype us up even more for what the new update could have in store for us, and Non Inertial is the perfect example of that, showcasing so many unique and fun gimmicks when it comes to gameplay, using as many new effects and triggers as possible, which makes for a very fast paced and erratic experience.

I think the best part about this is how surreal it feels and looks, especially because of the camera work, the zooming in and out, the duplication and every other effect can elevate even the simplest of sections to something interesting, so it's fun to imagine what so many different creators can come up with.

#geometrydash

i-RbLKqdvu0.title: Divinity by Ragnarus | Geometry Dash
i-RbLKqdvu0.description:
Divinity is a level that has a very clean, refined and elegant design, to the point where I do feel the title of the level fits perfectly, there is a ton of detail here in just about every section, there's something to appreciate, whether it's the art found in the backgrounds or the beautiful and vibrant colors that shine through the clean block design, every part has its place and fulfills it's purpose.

The atmosphere and scenery are definitely my favorite parts, especially the one we get to see at 0:53, which sums up the quality of this level perfectly, highly recommended this.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/750873

UlPlC8PSPtQ.title: Unnamed H by R3XX3R | Geometry Dash
UlPlC8PSPtQ.description:
It's nice to see a creator like R3XX3R release something new, especially when it's something unique that strays from their usual style, taking risks to make something that stands out above the rest, and that's exactly what Unnamed H is. A futuristic, robotic and slightly apocalyptic level, with a strong metallic color palette and harsh effects, namely the lightning that strikes frequently.

I really enjoyed the atmosphere this level has, the darker colors contrast well with the bright flashes of light and glowy accents, there are also small artistic decorations that I feel add a lot of personality to this, some screens and structures in the backgrounds, it all comes together nicely.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1008040

yCgOX6_4sEA.title: Diyu by Coinlol | Geometry Dash
yCgOX6_4sEA.description:
Been a while since I've uploaded one of these types of levels, always nice to play and they're pretty satisfying to look at in my opinion.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/783614

3kGBrd_Uipc.title: Weirdcore by Kira9999 | Geometry Dash
3kGBrd_Uipc.description:
Weirdcore is a very interesting level, a concept that really hasn't been explored before, if you don't know, Weirdcore is an online aesthetic, like Vaporwave, where you take low quality photos and edit them to give off a feeling of disorientation or confusion, which may also provoke a strange sense of nostalgia, which is really bizarre to see in the form of a GD level, but it translates really well.

The entire experience is strange, unnverving and non-sensical, but that's entirely the point, and there is a slight sense of dread seeing this weird imagery, especially in the second half, where it takes a darker turn. The music choice also fits perfectly with this style and design. If you like this type of strange internet concept, highly recommend you play this.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/664475

IXgbUj8tlVg.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Misty Mountains'' 100% by We4therMan | Geometry Dash
IXgbUj8tlVg.description:
Misty Mountains is a level that really shines because of it's atmosphere and  theme, the snowy mountaintops you have to go through look fantastic, the effects are well-made and the block design is simple, but since it's very clean it works nicely together with the rest of the decorations, being more of an accent.

The best part about this level to me are the effects, since every section is different and unique, there's a ton of variety when it comes to the visuals, the mist clouds at the beginning, the snow falling with a beautiful glow surrounding it, or bright lighting in the backgrounds, it all adds detail to each part and work well with this winter theme.
 
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/822787

ID: 60708767

Attempts: 1797

dwh9iAs1TRs.title: ''Peeled Skin'' 100% (Demon) by akinawoo | Geometry Dash
dwh9iAs1TRs.description:
This is a level that uses it's dark color scheme, with some other colors used as accents really well, that combined with the glow effects and the smooth animations, make for a very impactful level.

One of my favorite aspects about this is how well the music is weaved into the gameplay and design, the sync is perfect, with the decoration popping in and out, lights flashing and things moving around to the beat, it works really well and gives more of a music video vibe while you're playing.

Overall this minute long level is short, but packs a big punch with it's unique color palette and strong effects, highly recommend.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/999304

8lnjACWtPxA.title: ''Follow Me'' 100% (Demon) by TheRealXFuture | Geometry Dash
8lnjACWtPxA.description:
Follow me is a really fun and unique level that executes it's theme and concept nicely, where you're basically following a mouse throughout the entire level, with it's trail helping guide you. Although It's not as easy as it may seem, theres still a bit of memory required to be able to do this, like knowing where the invisible portals and orbs are gonna be. After learning what to do I was able to beat it in around 10 attempts, the layout behind all the deco is pretty fun

ID: 76294880

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/965048

kxbXtBEtL7A.title: ''Circus Dash'' 100% (Demon) by MCAASJ | Geometry Dash
kxbXtBEtL7A.description:
A very creative and colorful level, Circus Dash has everything you would want from a level that has a theme this lively, and it gets every aspect right, the perfect combination between design and it's gameplay, which is extremely important when it relies this much on it's atmosphere.

Circus-inspired levels are always some of the best in my opinion, the best example being CraZy, since they have a lot of freedom with what you can create, there are no limits to how many colors you can use, the animations you give to the characters can be as exaggerated as you want, and you can even add a small horror vibe to them.

There are a handful of memorable characters that you meet throughout the level, each one with their own section to show off their design and attacks, with the surrounding area being unique to each one as well, which helps keep things fresh.

S0M0W77E-TU.title: ''Glimpse'' by ItsBon [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
S0M0W77E-TU.description:
This is one of those levels, that has such a high bar when it comes to the quality of it's decoration and design, that the first time you play through it, you forget it's GD, that if your icon wasn't visible, you would think this is from another game, this is the effect Glimpse has, it has a beautiful theme, with it's darker color scheme, the lighting effects that add a mysterious and slightly intimidating atmosphere and the art that is on another level.

I also really enjoy the many layers that can be found in the foregrounds and backgrounds, that make this small world feel much more alive and it also helps that a lot of these smaller details have their own movements, which are smooth and satisfying, and lighting. Overall this is an incredibly unique world with quality on all fronts to back it up.

foM4sPg8uEs.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Troll Level'' 100% by Arekushi14, Glitchy & Lena | Geometry Dash
foM4sPg8uEs.description:
This is an Extreme Demon that focuses mainly on memory and some precise timings, which is the root of it's difficulty, but once you play through the whole thing a bunch of times you get the hang of it.

The design is really nice in my opinion, the contrast between the light and dark backgrounds, and sometimes foreground, with the very colorful accents in the block design with some nice lighting effects that make these colors pop out even more, works well together, and the way there are obstacles and different shapes inside the blocks, along with many different colors make this even more unique. Great level overall, not a huge fan a memory levels because of how time consuming they are, but this was really fun. 

ID: 76196489

Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gWiHro7_lZ4

-C7d1P03-sQ.title: aTTEMPTS by 0347 | Geometry Dash
-C7d1P03-sQ.description:
Saw this level on Partition's channel which was inspired by ''What is it'' and I thought it looked really neat. The only complaints I have about this is the blind transitions and the inconsistent gameplay, otherwise I hope this gets rated soon

ID: 74891884

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/743863

ftYRGdCKc-c.title: ''Stimulation Sim'' 100% (Demon) by Yoonsr [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
ftYRGdCKc-c.description: This level is something special, I wouldn't call it a remake, since it's more of a retelling, a throwback to TamaN's work as a creator for this game, one of the best creators of all time, that always managed to impress and inspire with his clean style, nice colors and really fun gameplay. The largest chunk of this level is Endorphin Rush, but there are so many references and little parts from so many of TamaN's creations, sometimes to fill in the gaps, to connect one section to another or to give a bit more detail to a certain part, and it works really nice here, this is about the best you could do if you wanted to honor and make a tribute to many of his levels, even the ones that were never finished.

Fowye-quEMQ.title: ''PAY'' 100% (Demon) by PDKGD & More | Geometry Dash
Fowye-quEMQ.description:
A level that is short and sweet, being just about 40 seconds long, but that manages to completely grab your attention in such a short amount of time, which makes this even more impressive. I really like the dark atmosphere and backgrounds that are directly opposite to the bright and shiny colors and effects, the glow within the block design which is well used, illuminating a majority of the decoration.

There are also some glitch effects here and there, that add another layer of detail and makes certain sections pop out more than the rest, and I appreciate that they are used sparingly, since something that strong can tend to be overused a bit. The great song is just the icing on the cake, adding weight to every click, highly recommend this.

yub12mIMcH4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Conical Depreѕѕion'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
yub12mIMcH4.description: A level I always put off because it seemed incredibly annoying, came back to it yesterday and beat it in an hour. Not much to say about this other than I surprisingly enjoyed playing it, except for that one RNG click at 53%.

HSG-8NgOe1Y.title: ''CYBER DREAM'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Guppy28 & JamAttack | Geometry Dash
HSG-8NgOe1Y.description:
Cyber Dream is a 4 minute experience that leaves you in complete awe the first time you play or watch it, the amount of detail to be seen in each and every section here is awesome, the cyber/robotic theme is executed perfectly, from the clean yet strong block design, the color schemes, the different hues of purples, blues and generally colder colors, with many others used as accents to make everything pop out a lot more, the effects that immerse into this futuristic world, the lighting and small animations, all of this together to make an amazing atmosphere and adventure, all while having the perfect soundtrack in the background. 

But the thing I like the most about this, is the pace, the buildup and the progression, starting off slow and steady, and as the music starts getting more erratic, so does every bit of decoration, which is very satisfying for a level of this length, overall I highly recommend you try this out, it's worth every second.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/862247

T5X8TMbIfv0.title: ''Factory Part'' 100% (Demon) by Renn241 | Geometry Dash
T5X8TMbIfv0.description:
The newest level from Renn, a creator that keeps pumping out quality levels, and shows no signs of slowing down, Factory Part is a level that takes the 2.0 style and design and gives us a really fun and appealing experience.

There is a ton of variety here, in colors, effects and block design, which makes for a pumped up, bright and overall exciting journey, which goes to show that you don't need a set theme to create something that is enjoyable, I feel that you can tell when a creator makes something with passion and put effort into it, and this is one of those moments.

7mOu2vyU1Vc.title: ''Hey'' 100% (Demon) by rapidblaze & durianhead | Geometry Dash
7mOu2vyU1Vc.description:
An amazingly clean collab between two creators, rapid and durian manage to make something that is satisfying to play, and relaxing and enjoyable to watch. The pink and cyan color combination is one of my favorites, very nostalgic feel as a color palette to me, with a touch of yellows and reds here and there to add a bit more to the decoration, which works nicely.

Another aspect that I like about this is the block design, while it is simple in it's shape, the inside is what's special, the shifting colors and little bits of deco moving with a sort of parallax effect make it feel alive. There are also some parts that have clear obstacles which also look great. Overall, I'd recommend you try this out.

ID: 76048684

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1015156

5RVtfMjlxF0.title: ''3D Dash'' by GirlyAle02 [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
5RVtfMjlxF0.description:
A sequel to 3D World, being a step up from the first installment, improving upon the design and overall aesthetics, making it feel much more alive, vibrant and fun.

The 3D effects, which are the main attraction here, are more pronounced, feeling a lot bouncier in the blocks and obstacles movements, including the backgrounds, all of this coupled together with the vibrant colors that fade in and out along with the music make for an enjoyable experience.

My favorite parts about this level are the short sections that lean more on the 3D effect, including extra characters in the form of small animations that add a lot of detail and personality.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/754999

eMRd_Cv0yW4.title: In My Mind by Rawin & Overdefo | Geometry Dash
eMRd_Cv0yW4.description:
A collab between two very talented creators, that has a unique style, that differs from the traditional style and design choices, it's surreal atmosphere and dreamy colors makes it stand out.

I enjoy the variety when it comes to the different sections, since there isn't a defined theme, all of the different colors and effects, and while the backgrounds are simple and may seem empty, the blurry and misty effect used with solid colors help bring out the foreground.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/848797

xkcH_wVsdRw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Novasphere'' 100% by Klonex | Geometry Dash
xkcH_wVsdRw.description:
It's always nice to play an Extreme Demon that takes it's aesthetic as seriously as it does it's gameplay, and doesn't default to the same old themes since it's an Extreme, and this is one of those levels, we get over 2 minutes of great design, colors and deco that really elevates the quality to another level.

The gameplay is heavily based on timings, with a specific jump at 1:17 that requires an almost frame perfect click so you fall where you're supposed to, I hope this can be changed later. But overall it depends less on muscle memory and more on skill, still enjoyed it as a whole.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/49327

xK2a3_CTFjw.title: "Restart" 100% by ChrySpy | Geometry Dash
xK2a3_CTFjw.description:
Restart is a remake of Start, a level by Serponge that was released 5 years ago, keeping the spirit and theme of the original intact, but updating and upscaling just about everything the original had, which in a remake of a level that was so great when it was released, means you did it right.

My favorite section is the the entire ending, it wraps up everything nicely, the colors are vibrant just like in the original and the animations are smooth and satisfying and the backgrounds are a fantastic contrast in movement with the foreground. Overall I really enjoyed this remake, especially of a level as old as Start.

4PuwEQc3WfM.title: A Special Place by TomekD | Geometry Dash
4PuwEQc3WfM.description:
ID: 75450292

TomekD: https://youtu.be/t5AtAJqBNqo

Song: Melodic Metal Cover (Made by Stefano Italiano) Death Moon (SHK) https://youtu.be/WrXl7DIp4zg

Stefano Italiano: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCFGFEcZPLIXnAf1BSAwfwQ

This is some of the smoothest animation I've seen, I feel that one of the hardest things to get right in one of these types of creations is the setting and the atmosphere, along with world building if it's something with a big enough scale, which this level absolutely nails, among many other things.

I really like the relatively simple art that was created here, it's appealing and it conveys the story in a fun and understandable way, that with the great animations I mentioned earlier, the variety in places you visit, the day and nighttime, the rain, the water, the 3D elements as well, the sense of scale and depth, it's all here and it's very nice. The short story that was conveyed here was also short and sweet, with an entertaining and simple plotline.

vx0rl0uYc7c.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Freedom19'' 100% by GrenadeofTacos & More | Geometry Dash
vx0rl0uYc7c.description:
A remake of the legendary level, Freedom08, a 4 and a half minute level which at the time of it's release was considered the best level by many players, due to it's incredibly enjoyable and tight gameplay, which at the end of the day is what makes an Extreme Demon stand out above the rest. 

Freedom19 uses a 1.9 style from start to finish, which makes it that much more impressive, since the design is one of the best I've seen using that design, despite the limitations it has, there is so much variety to the decoration and blocks here, each section being different from the last, using different palettes, effects, and speed, all in perfect sync with the music.

The gameplay is also varied, changing it up at every turn, along with the frequent pacing changes, but that's what makes it fun in this case, it's comfortable and the process of learning the level is fun as well.

Bmr99wBPBII.title: ''SCREEECH'' by Shrympo | Geometry Dash
Bmr99wBPBII.description:
A level that only requires one input in the beginning and hold for the entirety of the level, the level is only 33 seconds long since it's part of a CC that has that time limit.

Because of the gameplay, we can focus completely on the design, which is fantastic, it's incredibly colorful, vibrant and in your face and I really like the dark borders used inside the block design, which makes the colors stand out even more. The movements and animations are satisfying, they're smooth and plentiful, without being too much.

ID: 75486991
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1000686

KJDvv9RybuI.title: (Extreme Demon) ''MAKE IT DROP'' 100% by Ryamu & More | Geometry Dash
KJDvv9RybuI.description:
One of the best design levels I've seen recently, it's rare and impressive when you see a creation of this style have atmosphere, and this is accomplished by the quality of just about everything you can see here, the contrast between the pitch black backgrounds, that are sometimes interrupted by a very subtle decoration, and the bright purple and green neon effects, block design and lighting.

Speaking about the effects, these are incredibly satisfying to watch, with a  perfect sync, that adds a ton of detail to the complete experience, the lighting is bright and it's intensity gives everything that happens a lot more punch and impact, with the transparent block design, it's easier to appreciate.

ID: 75518661
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/469143

XDF_jG9Xs04.title: (Insane Demon) ''GUMSHOT'' 100% by qMystic & More | Geometry Dash
XDF_jG9Xs04.description:
A high pace, high intensity design level that grabs your attention, and doesn't let go, with a nice and slow buildup during the first 30 seconds, this first major section focuses more on decoration and block design, slow changes in coloring and subtle effects, but once the drop hits, this gets thrown completely out the window.

After the drop, the level goes completely crazy, from this point forward, it looks like you're going through a rave, with a thousand different lights flashing your eyes with you bouncing around everywhere, I really like the purple and blue color scheme, combined with all of the lighting effects that sync nicely with the music, this level is very satisfying to go through.

kEniudCEMcc.title: ''Tabasco'' 100% (Demon) by Talia | Geometry Dash
kEniudCEMcc.description:
A brand new level that has is reminiscent of levels that are years old, within it's atmosphere you can see remnants of older creations, that being said, it doesn't mean this looks outdated, completely the opposite, this is an extremely satisfying level to play and the design is smooth and easy to look at and appreciate.

The orange and black color scheme works to this levels favor from start to finish, giving it a sleek look and makes it easier to play through, it's simplicity is it's biggest strength in my opinion, with it's lack of backgrounds and straightforward effects, this level really gets straight to the point from the very beginning.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/999571

8h_Zx25MQP0.title: (Extreme Demon) ''SubSonic'' 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
8h_Zx25MQP0.description:
Sonic series finally done, one of the most requested extremes ever.
The learning process was really fun but from 0% It's something else. First half is very consistent but after that it's all about nerve control, which I'm not very good at and caused me around 5-10 deaths at the last dual. Think this took me around 3 or 4 days to do this playing 5 hours everyday, with about 5-6k attempts, I don't really keep track of level stats lol.
GG :)

JtxAFpv5UDo.title: ''Backasswards'' 100% (Demon) by Wav, TriStorm & Kale | Geometry Dash

Msql9zo_ZW0.title: (Extreme Demon) ''KillerZone'' 100% by Dorami | Geometry Dash
Msql9zo_ZW0.description: Decided to give this a try since Dorami updated it once more. It was pretty fun to be honest, though there are still some timings and transitions that feel luck based, it wasn't too bad overall.

cQjWXX1mhg4.title: ''MECHA GODZILLA'' by FlacoGD | Geometry Dash
cQjWXX1mhg4.description:
A level that absolutely nails the robotic/mechanical theme, from the first few seconds you can tell it's going to be high quality, and this really shines because of it's smooth block design with it's colorful accents and the fantastic art.

When I mention art, I'm talking especially about the bossfight with Mecha Godzilla at 0:30, his design, attacks and animation are the best part about this level, it does feel alive, it's a shame it's so short, but what we get to see is still great.

jpDNCebBhKc.title: ''Pandora Palace'' by NukeIIX [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
jpDNCebBhKc.description:
A level that is inspired by Deltarune, specifically Chapter 2 that was released a little while ago, and I have to say, you can tell that an insane amount of effort and care was put into this.

This level takes us through the palace of the Queen, where we see many obstacles and enemies, such as the Swatchlings and a reference to the Rouxls Kaard boss. The designs for these characters is fantastic, and the recreation of the palace is great as well, it does the atmosphere really well especially when it comes to the backgrounds.

FXhWS2ipa2E.title: ''Deltaura'' 100% (Demon) by Klonex [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
FXhWS2ipa2E.description:
Deltaura is a journey, where you begin on the ground surrounded by grass, trees and mountains, and by the end, you're soaring through the sky engulfed in the bright white clouds. To add onto that, the backgrounds are really nice in my opinion, their simple and straightforward, but each is unique in it's own way and they complement the foreground nicely.

But my favorite part about this is the decoration that is front and center throughout the entire level, the block design is incredibly clean and satisfying to look at, and all of the moving parts that are around it, details that are both big and small, add so much to the liveliness of the experience.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/332232

Yrj4dRw2Tts.title: HELL YEAH by Dashiell10 | Geometry Dash
Yrj4dRw2Tts.description:
The newest level from a very talented creator that just keeps getting better with each release, and this is clear proof of that, this level feels alive, with it's vibrant colors, smooth and fast movements, animations and the great lighting effects that highlight the decorations, there is a lot of substance here and a lot more detail than what you see on the surface.

The design as a whole isn't the most complicated ever, it's on the simpler side of the things but it still manages to capture you from start to finish with the atmosphere that is intense but at the same time chill. The backgrounds are simple as well but do a fantastic job in complementing the rest of the design and what's going on in the foreground.

JNbrKV_Ihto.title: ''PING PONG'' by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash
JNbrKV_Ihto.description:
An incredibly fun and unique level, the entire Ping Pong tournament theme with a crowd, and all of the different places you go, is something I've never even thought about before, but with the animations, the great art and especially the song that breathes so much life into the story here makes for a really enjoyable experience.

The gameplay is also different, you have a bar at the top of a screen where you have to click at the right time to hit the ping pong ball back to your opponent, making it a sort of rhythm based style of gameplay, this also lends itself to a satisfying sync with the music.

My favorite section has to be toward the end, the giant rocket with a countdown timer, the entire scenery in display and finally the liftoff where you keep playing ping pong while flying through the night sky is fantastic, overall this is a fun and wholesome level.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/980038

a-zboyGUHk0.title: (Insane Demon) ''4 Matilda'' 100% by Jeyzor [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
a-zboyGUHk0.description:
This level is an experience and an adventure, I really enjoy the contrast between the calm sections, with their soft colors and smooth decorations, and the erratic parts with the harsher tones and more animated movements, synced perfectly with the music.

The atmosphere, it's design and the art are unique and well crafted, each part feeling and looking like it's own world, and the transititons in the form of portals is a nice touch as well.

My favorite part without a doubt is the ending, the gameplay is different because of the design choices, having multiple cubes moving at being shown by differing camera angles looks amazing.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/894590

6KbGMRI2t8o.title: (Insane Demon) ''Heritage'' 100% by Karma8, Vit12 & AgarOther | Geometry Dash
6KbGMRI2t8o.description: A level that is reminiscent of the Nine Circles style and aesthetic, although this deviates a bit from that, but the colors, a bit of the style and effects, especially the heavy use of wave gameplay, it's impossible not to think about it. The colors used here are all different and fit with the style nicely, being vibrant and having neon properties, the lighting serving to accentuate these colors, and with the starry and detailed backgrounds tying everything together and giving layers to the decoration. The block design is simple yet styllized, with a clear and smooth texture, which goes well with the colors rest of the design.

ef9eQcPrGWY.title: ''LUKOJE'' 100% (Demon) by gradientxd | Geometry Dash
ef9eQcPrGWY.description:
LUKOJE is a level that is an arch of design and gameplay, starting off with a relaxing and warm atmosphere, different shades of orange and red fill the screen, a smooth and layered block design and welcoming backgrounds, the buildup from the beginning to 0:50 when the first drop comes and the design changes is nice and gives a feeling of progression.

In the first drop the entire decoration changes, the backgrounds become completely dark and the only lighting comes from the neon coloring in the blocks and obstacles and from this point it remains similar, only increasing the intensity as it moves forward, making this large section the best for me, with the ending being a nice cooldown.

FbDzrVSCrwk.title: ''Friday'' 100% (Demon) by endevvor | Geometry Dash
FbDzrVSCrwk.description:
Couldn't upload this on friday sorry boys, but here it is, Friday is a level that buildsup nicely as it goes on, starting with just the sounds and visuals of ping pong balls falling to the ground, to the end where the screen is full of color and different shapes fly around. This is one of those cases where the gameplay and design follow the music perfectly from start to finish.

The effects are the best aspect about this level, bringing every moving part to life, since the backgrounds are on the simpler side and there isn't much art either, but what is shown is great.

2TjkvD29yaQ.title: ''Infinite Chase'' 100% (Demon) by CocoXs32 [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
2TjkvD29yaQ.description:
A level that is jam-packed with action, intensity and high stakes, Infinite Chase is a short story within a level, portrayed with fantastic art, smooth animations and beautiful backgrounds, we go through so many different places inside a larger space, all with their own unique style, colors and decorations, each section feeling connected with one another while still being high quality by themselves.

My favorite aspect about this level is definitely the comic book effects that are used here and there, specifically at 0:27, everything you see here looks like a page ripped out directly from a comic, the transitions are clean and the art is great.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1064306

NTwzO6u7X3I.title: ''The Toad Empire'' 100% (Demon) by Carnage37 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
NTwzO6u7X3I.description:
A remake of The Magma Caverns from Nasgubb, Carnage's clean and concise style is perfect for a revitalization of such an old level, with new colors, blocks and shiny effects, while still maintaining the spirit of the original intact.

What I like especially about this are the subtle yet impactful movements scattered throughout the level, it really makes everything feel alive and adds to the intense gameplay and nature of the original.

4O3sYJ5eOvo.title: ''Jam Factory'' 100% (XXL Demon) by JamAttack [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4O3sYJ5eOvo.description:
The newest level from the talented JamAttack, it's been a while since he last created something, and to come back with a XXL Demon is impressive, the Factory theme is executed perfectly, with every section being unique in it's own way, the block design, art and backgrounds intertwining with one another to give a sense of immersion, every place we visit has personality and attention to detail, which makes a longer level like this much more enjoyable.

The effects are definitely a strong point here as well, the lighting gives a bit of realism to the factory and office sections, and the backgrounds have a ton of movement without being too much, there are also a bit of 3D here and there, which looks great as well, making it's respective section feel open ended and like your travelling through different places.

Overall this is a very nice level, with great art and effects, the gameplay is fun and balanced, which is nice when the visuals are this good.

B078RLHp2Cc.title: Deadly Games
B078RLHp2Cc.description:
A level that is completely inspired by the incredibly popular show Squid Game, that has taken the world completely by storm, being taken through each one of the games that appears on the show, such as Red Light, Green Light, the Honeycomb and Stepping Stones, each with their own unique design, colors and style, with some nice art to go along with all of this.

What I like about this is that it's not entirely designed around the show, there are some sections that feature a more traditional design, that gives a bit of breathing room from the intense effects of the game.

The bossfight at 1:00 has a great design, a very detailed mask with weapons that are also nice, with vibrant effects.

YM57bl_8zcw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Myocardia'' 100% by Toughfey | Geometry Dash
YM57bl_8zcw.description:
A level with a very unique theme, showing us a representation of how the human body works, specifically the heart, being brought to life by an intense design, bright flashing colors and bits of art that give more detail to this theme and bring it to life.

I really like the moving pieces that are shown throughout the different sections, they all add a ton of detail without overbearing the player, the endscreen is especially fantastic.

The gameplay is fun and enjoyable, with the beginning section, both the cube and ball, and the ship section at 1:02 being the most difficult, still had fun overall.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/590567

dsPlW3fSYjY.title: ''Nightosphere'' by ElMatoSWAG | Geometry Dash
dsPlW3fSYjY.description:
An Auto level with visuals, art and effects that are absolutely gorgeous, levels like this, with such and intense style and non-stop movement feel like a music video, since there isn't any gameplay, the visuals only have one thing to tie into, the song, and it works very well here, the animations are smooth and add to the creepiness of the atmosphere.

The way the icon is integrated into the level is very unique and immerses you into the world even more, with the monsters that attack you and the different transitions that are thrown at you, the theme is executed really well.

BM0OOc6Wq2s.title: ''Deep Breath'' 100% by DepisH16 | Geometry Dash
BM0OOc6Wq2s.description:
A level that is full of uniqueness, from it's colors, to it's design and and layout, it looks and feels incredibly full, without going into overdecorated territory, especially in the first half.

The art and designs made for the block design and the backgrounds are the strongest point here, along with the different effects that are tied to everything, there is a lot to appreciate here, small details that are easy to miss on a first playthrough, and big details that take up a part of the screen.

Every bit of design here feels like it has a place and a purpose, which makes the level more enjoyable as a whole, and while the second half looks simpler than the first, it still looks great.

YBm1xeQgz_M.title: [2.2] In The Castle by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash
YBm1xeQgz_M.description:
2.2 GDPS by Blaze: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfPtuop90e_JzxPkiZ6Q5Q

A platformer with a lot more depth than it would appear at first glance, there is a sense of adventure here and even a bit of story. The atmosphere is great, with the stone walls and bookshelves, it really feels like a complete world, even if it is just a couple of sections.

The gameplay is also a strong point, it isn't just jumping around collecting coins, there are enemies scattered around the level and when you come into contact with them you initiate a battle, seemingly inspired in Undertale, where you attack the enemy and then have to dodge the attacks in a jetpack mode which was very fun, along with the health bars and backgrounds this is very unique.

There are two potential "routes" you can take to complete this level, the main one where you collect coins and buy the key for the exit from the shopkeeper at the top right, or wait out for a couple of minutes until the clock hits midnight where the vibe changes completely and something sinister comes for you.

hgSNrjHIIF0.title: ''Azimuth'' by Knots [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
hgSNrjHIIF0.description:
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/873398

Azimuth, the newest level from a creator we all know and love, Knots, a creator that always releases incredibly high quality levels, so it's always exciting to see a new level from him. Being of a slower nature than some of his other levels, with a slower soundtrack and gameplay, with beautiful designs to match.

Being 2 and a half minutes long, we get a bunch of sections with beautiful art, effects and some of the smoothest animations I've seen, some even adding a sense of space and depth and even some 3D effects here and there, everything about this level is top tier.

eV3E--KSaVk.title: ''Sports'' 100% (Demon) by Cubiccc [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
eV3E--KSaVk.description:
A level with incredibly high quality effects and art, some of the best I've seen recently, every section to this is interesting and entertaining, showcasing so many different sports, such as Pool, Tennis, Biking and even Chess.

There is so much attention to detail, from the colors that could be associated to the sport, which results in a wide variety of color palettes, to the art and the animations that brings it to life, you can tell from the opening animation that this is going to be great. 

The block design is also very smooth, fitting into the theme of it's part without going overboard on the decoration. At the end of the day this is a level that definitely deserves attention and is worth the time to play.

EQwnAt4F0pI.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Tenth Circle'' 100% by DeniPol | Geometry Dash
EQwnAt4F0pI.description:
Finally got around to doing this, wasn't very fun to be honest, but it still wasn't as bad as I thought it would be. Could've been the update but since I didn't play the original version much at all I'm not sure. This level has been highly requested for me to do since it came out, glad I could do it now. GG :) 

Attempts: 5114
Song: https://youtu.be/YDDfaxIpXAk

4xq5FtIFRR0.title: ''GUNGDIPANGPANG'' 100% (Demon) by SeokSo & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash

m9FhluS-YQA.title: ''Sight'' by sachikoadmirer & Echonox | Geometry Dash
m9FhluS-YQA.description:
Sight is a remake of "Scope" a level by Echonox, a creator that hadn't released anything in the last 4 years, and this iteration is much more modern and refined, focusing much more on the effects and backgrounds, with the foreground, block design and such being more of an afterthought.

That being said, what's done here is great, with the help of sachikoadmirer, there is new life breathed into every part of this level. The movements and animations are also much smoother, with the background effects being the strongest point here, and a bit of the gameplay has been tweaked as well, but it's enjoyable.

ZRq2qXv1Qsk.title: ''Higher Higher'' by Rawin | Geometry Dash
ZRq2qXv1Qsk.description:
Higher Higher has everything you would want from a pixel style level, the art is on point, the atmosphere is chill yet it has a bit of intensity to it, and most importantly, the effects are unique, very well made and fit into the aesthetic perfectly.

The colors are bright and cheerful the entire way through, using satisfying color palettes, including some rainbow sections that add variety without going overboard, and there's some shading here and there to add a bit more detail.

The effects are the strongest point by far, both in the foreground and background, found in small details like the health bar in the very beginning, or in a bigger scale, like some of the transitions, or my favorite, the 3D effect that shows up at 0:23, which looks so much more different than the rest of the level, but looks fantastic.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1070609

u2B9gi4OjLw.title: ''Freedom Travel'' 100% (XXL Demon) by DeoxLiteVG [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
u2B9gi4OjLw.description:
Another Travel level that is inspired heavily in JonathanGD's style and colors, a 6 minute experience that is so well crafted, each individual section could be it's own standalone level. Being so varied in it's colors, design, backgrounds and intensity, there is a feeling of buildup that is only amplified by the music which is fits the theme perfectly.

The main attraction of these types of levels is the art, and the atmosphere, and they don't miss in this level, the art while not the best in the world, serves to immerse you into each setting we find ourselves in, and the subtle colors make the atmosphere relaxing and fun to watch for 6 minutes.

My favorite part is definitely the dual at 4:20 the colors are bright and vibrant, the effect done in the background looks great and the part that comes right after is even better, with the scanlines making the design even more mesmerizing.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/789240

MSwLaSyjdwI.title: ''Another Way Home'' 100% (Demon) by HTigerzGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
MSwLaSyjdwI.description:
Another Way Home is a level that has a very mystical and relaxing atmosphere,  where the colors are subtle and the effects don't go overboard, it's simplistic in nature but has so much detail on it's interior that is easy to miss. The variety in the colors, the block designs and intensity really make this level feel like a complete journey you go on.

This level is the perfect example of how less is more, that when you've got the vibe figured out and executed properly, the rest is just icing on the cake, highly recommend you try this out, for a 2 minute relaxing experience.

GWHUq-4D0Vo.title: ''Orange'' by Alkali | Geometry Dash
GWHUq-4D0Vo.description:
Orange like the title would suggest, is a one minute experience from Alkali, where the entire thing uses the color orange, apart from the black that is a nice contrast to it's bright counterpart.

I think the best way to describe this level would be as smooth, the movements in the block design and it's interior, with all of the different shapes shifting around, and the more subtle ones in the background, really benefits the abstract nature of this level. Overall, this is a relaxing and unique experience I think you should try out.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/202260

8yZZnWrAo2Y.title: ''Ye its a demon'' 100% (Demon) by Zoroa | Geometry Dash
8yZZnWrAo2Y.description: This is a level that really thrives through it's chill aesthetic and simplistic yet relaxing design, the colors it uses are of all kinds and aren't abrasive in at any point, and really help to highlight the best parts about the block design. There are also a couple of sections that feature a background, whether it's different shapes or a mosaic of color, it helps to give depth and so it doesn't feel as empty with a dark plain background. There are also some animations here and there, that look great and are incredibly smooth, especially the one at 0:40, that is a unique way of transititioning into another place. Overall this is a minute of great design and it's enjoyable to play as well.

C9pvVQoADTI.title: ''THE HILLS HAVE EYES'' 100% (Demon) by ovdfo | Geometry Dash
C9pvVQoADTI.description:
A level that starts off with a rather creepy and unsettling atmosphere, with the rainfall and some sound effects being the only things you can hear, the eyes on the hills blinking at you, and the pitch black obstacles all combined can make you uneasy.

After this we gradually transition into a much more relaxed and tranquil setting, with a slow, ethereal song that fits perfectly with the rest of the design, especially the warm tones we see in the backgrounds, the reds and purples, greens and blues, all soothing colors.

The designs shown in the foregrounds are great as well, the stars, and the different shapes that are formed by thin lines and the way they light up along with the music add to the astral atmosphere we find ourselves in, highly recommended.

R0ymoh_6hb4.title: (Insane Demon) ''Neon Raver'' 100% by SleyGD [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
R0ymoh_6hb4.description:
Neon Raver is a level that uses colors and different contrasts to highlight the strongest points of the decoration, the foreground, the block design and the effects, especially the lighting, the way it pulses to the music, lighting everything up for a split second, showing the obstacles and all of the different colors and gradients is very unique and it looks great overall.

The gameplay is also very enjoyable and consistent, taking a bit of practice and getting used to, once the parts were learned it didn't take long after.

aEXP59JPqUM.title: ''Snap'' 100% (Demon) by Darite | Geometry Dash
aEXP59JPqUM.description:
A short yet spontaneous and with fast paced gameplay, Being released about a month ago, Snap's best quality is it's colors, the contrast between the void backgrounds and the bright and vibrant colors in the foreground, only amplified by the effects, these two help one another to stand out, and the tight gameplay with it's varied gamemodes and sync with the music is fun to play.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1014275

Oi_gJCuGZD4.title: ''Espionage'' 100% (Demon) by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash
Oi_gJCuGZD4.description:
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1083657

A level with a fun atmosphere that takes you on a short journey following a spy on his mission through different places within a city, which showcases some great scenery, both in daytime and nighttime, along with some neat effects that add to the depth and vibe of the many locations we find ourselves in.

The animations for the different obstacles, decorations and some of the characters we meet up with look nice, and while they aren't the craziest ever, they serve their purpose and immerse you into the world a bit more.

wT1R6ZwPnCE.title: ''Brillos'' 100% (Demon) by Vicolor | Geometry Dash
wT1R6ZwPnCE.description:
A level that is mesmerizing with an atmosphere that is what you could call, ethereal and mystical, a level that takes you on a journey and through an experience that will leave you wanting more, with it's calming aura and it's intense effects.

Brillos begins like any other level, standard gameplay with some nice effects, but that doesn't last long as we are quickly ripped out of that state and taken into a slow ascent, with beautiful effects that are only amplified by the great soundtrack, this is definitely a level you should play at least once.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/943156

rxr7ck0juT0.title: ''MAGNUM OPUS'' 100% (Demon) by Custi | Geometry Dash
rxr7ck0juT0.description:
A level that truly shines for it's theme and atmosphere, with the black and white giving it a neat aesthetic, along with the music and the overall design it almost looks like a short movie, or an entire journey for lack of a better word.

Magnum Opus has a very dark and gritty style, which works heavily in it's favor, there are big details that you can see right off the bat, but also smaller ones, scattered on the floors or hanging from the ceiling, that all contribute to the vibe, the backgrounds especially in the first half, helping to set up the drop and giving some insight to where we are.

The art is great in my opinion, there are some aspects that look a bit simple in comparison to others, but it doesn't look out of place and it fits the theme.

ZadV4-rEc6k.title: ''Scorpius'' 100% (Demon) by Team Proxima [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
ZadV4-rEc6k.description:
A level by the incredibly talented Team Proxima, with a jungle theme that is executed beautifully but manages to stay varied within it's space, whether it's the realistic trees covered with moss surrounded by fog and mist, or the more traditional sections that still have the same flair but focus more on the effects, colors and lighting.

The whole thing is 2 minutes of fun gameplay mechanics that fit into the theme and an overarching storyline as well, where the design and setting of the level changes from it's lush beginnings to a fiery hellscape towards the end, it's a great experience and enjoyable to play as well.

J5cULwobUlo.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Athanatos'' 100% by Exenity | Geometry Dash
J5cULwobUlo.description:
Was very consistent in the first half and the second is luck based. The transition at 54% is completely random, thankfully I found a way to know how I was gonna enter it. and the other 2 transitions work exactly the same, the dual wave and the second to last ship, which add a lot to the difficulty. The rest was pretty simple to learn and do since the gameplay is pretty straight forward. GG :)
Attempts: 4829

yq8plc59MmY.title: [2.0] (Insane Demon) ''Puzzle Trials'' 100% by FunnyGame | Geometry Dash
yq8plc59MmY.description:
A level that has a few years under it's belt, but in my opinion is still impressive and enjoyable to play today, the concept of short sections built like minigames was new at the time, and even though we've gotten a bunch since then, this is still really good in comparison.

Puzzle Trials is a memory demon, you have to remember which path is the correct one, when to jump before the ground turns invisible, etc, and all of this adds on to the difficulty, even the length of the level. The design is very good as well, having an arcadey retro look and soundtrack, every part is different but still meshes together nicely.

The mini bossfight at the end looks great visually and adds some needed variety, ending the level off in a satisfying way.

4qyQiVKR8QU.title: ''Sandstorm'' 100% (Demon) by Vealt [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4qyQiVKR8QU.description:
The concept in this level is executed really well, the rough and darker colors serving to portray the blocks of solid sands and the heavy clouds forming around you with rapid winds, and the different symbols and hieroglyphs add to the idea that you're going through a forgotten pyramid or something of the sort.

There are also some bits of unique gameplay here, with the tight spaces with your only light source being a flashlight, the giant boulder rolling towards you, or the giant clouds of sand that affect your visibility, all of this adds to the immersion and makes it more fun as well.

2PkBxFKtBXc.title: ''Nirvana'' 100% (Demon) by CTRX | Geometry Dash
2PkBxFKtBXc.description:
First of all, the art featured in this level is top-notch, the planets and the different structures that appear in a lot of it's sections have an incredible amount of detail, and the stars and nebolous that surround these add so much depth and immersion to this space that it looks like the real thing, and that's without accounting for the foreground as well.

The block design is on par with the backgrounds in terms of style and detail, the colors used are vibrant and fit the space theme perfectly and it's varied too, going from a metallic, alien-like design, to a rugged and rocky atmosphere, all in the span of a minute or so.

It's always nice to find levels like these, from creators that are unknown, and be able to showcase them, and this one deserves it just by it's quality alone, I can't wait to see what CTRX brings to the table next.

KX4eQpdp9dc.title: ''Ghostly Grove'' by AbstractDark [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
KX4eQpdp9dc.description:
A level from AbstractDark is always a sight to behold, even with the gaps in between levels, the wait is always is completely worth it, and this is no exception. Ghostly Grove has a lot of nostalgia tied to it, being a recreation of Donkey Kong Country, but done in such a great way, that you would think this was ripped from one of the original games.

The atmosphere is there, the old school vibes with the beautiful soundtrack, the art style really helps dive you into this world, the block design and backgrounds giving a sense of depth, along with the 3D aspects that were incorporated into the enemies and some of the designs.

The mechanics for the coins are also unique, each one requiring a different task from you, the first one being tied to the old K O N G letters that were scattered throughout the level, the second one requiring 100 bananas and the last one at the end where you have to time a jump just right to land on a pad and throw a barrel upwards to grab the coin, all of this adds a lot to the gameplay in my opinion.

jCyXRVNqQDA.title: (Insane Demon) ''Hyperion'' 100% by Kardes | Geometry Dash
jCyXRVNqQDA.description:
A level that has an amazing simplistic design that really shows that sometimes less is more, with decoration that is clear and concise, surrounded by bright colors that highlight the most important parts of the design and makes everything stand out a lot more.

The backgrounds are mostly void, but there are some patterns and shapes that fill some of the empty space that adds some depth and detail, giving a sense of a wider space.

The effects are mostly comprised of lighting that mixes well with the music and helps to accentuate some of the block design.

W8Y2CNdnT8o.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Betrayal of Fate'' 100% by Weoweoteo [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
W8Y2CNdnT8o.description: Fun level honestly, the only reason I hadn't done this level is because of the memory parts, but I pushed through and it wasn't bad at all. I was getting past the memory UFO very consistently and did it in under a day. This is definitely one of the more fun extremes out there in my opinion, GG :)
