wasXSftYiv8.title: ''Olympic Faith'' 100% (Demon) by Zhak [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
wasXSftYiv8.description:
A level with beautiful sights and visuals from start to finish, boasting a relaxing yet fantastical vibe in it's atmosphere, driven by it's bright colors and flashy effects while it takes you through many different places, each with it's own theme and strong points, it's always so impressive to me how talented creators can put so much detail into such a short time-span.

This level really does a good job of taking you on a journey; whether it's through the deserts or the skies, the foregrounds and backgrounds are bursting with detail, and the small amount of animations that are found here, adds to the immersion a ton as well.

m8A1q4bA5qo.title: ''Crying Clouds'' 100% (Demon) by Bli | Geometry Dash
m8A1q4bA5qo.description:
A level with a beautiful theme that is wonderfully executed, that brings us into a world that has a ton of detail, in every corner of each section with effects and animations that serve to take us deeper into the immersion.

This is one of those levels that you have to pause to appreciate every single bit of decoration that was created, with so many layers of detail here, in the foreground and the background, this is as complete as you can get, this is definitely one of the best in recent times.

qaQu35V3HBU.title: ''Icons Race III'' 100% (Demon) by VegasKoneko [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
qaQu35V3HBU.description:
The sequel to Icons Race II which came out almost a year ago, this one being about the same length, keeping the theme and spirit of the now trilogy intact, with the same aesthetic and animations. It's nice to see this series still going, since it's a unique idea and a fun vibe all around.
[Cut to fix animation bugs]

J2KJrB9x1qk.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Glitched Memories'' 100% by TCTeam | Geometry Dash
J2KJrB9x1qk.description:
Finally, after giving up on this level in 2018 with a 63%, I decided it was time to do this since I'm definitely skilled enough now to beat it. I honestly don't know what I was thinking back then, this was way out of my skill range but since it wasn't even placed on the list yet I had no clue how hard it would be. Coming back to it now this was still a challenge no doubt, there are tons of bugs that happened half the time and even if most parts on their own might not be very difficult, doing them all from 0% can be incredibly tedious.
Very happy to be done with this. GG :)

To6g4SKkdkk.title: ''Peripheral'' by Pyraven & More [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
To6g4SKkdkk.description:
A level that is surrounded by a chill aesthetic and vibe, from start to finish, from the first couple of seconds of hearing the music, it pulls you in and it has the design to back it up.

The predominant color here is purple, found in different tones and contrasts, but this also helps give off a relaxing feeling, along with it's slow gameplay and smooth movements. But the best part about this is definitely the animations and the unique perspectives we get to experience here, especially the triple ball section at 0:25, which is a unique concept and a good use of a larger area, including the transitions when we enter and exit this section.

The backgrounds are also worth noting here, there's a lot of detail that deserves attention, the sort of Piano/Midi section looks great and is something I haven't seen before and the spiral at the end is a cool use of a 3d space.

OxSWFGIjwo0.title: ''BREAKER ROOM'' 100% (Demon) by Split72 | Geometry Dash
OxSWFGIjwo0.description:
A short level that uses fiery bright colors in a satisfying way, using other colors such as black, gray and even white as a contrast to the flashier hues being pushed forward by the great effects used.

Breaker Room is an All-Rounder, it has just about everything you would need from a fun level, it's nice to look at, it has a friendly aesthetic, a simplistic block design and backgrounds, smooth animations within it's objects and lighting effects that add a lot of detail to what's going on.

The gameplay is also a positive, it is well balanced and enjoyable to go through.

WAeQtOzYzzA.title: ''Sinister'' 100% (Demon) by tenzk | Geometry Dash
WAeQtOzYzzA.description:
A level that's bursting with color from start to finish, with a unique block design and bright, flashing backgrounds, Sinister grabs you and takes you on a wild ride.

One of my favorite aspects of this level is the fact that it has some darker colors and a bit of black to contrast the high intensity colors, it really helps to add some depth and separate the sections between each other, especially the ending where everything slows down and is completely dark.

oiCaP5Qaql0.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Sakupen Hell'' 100% by TrusTa | Geometry Dash
oiCaP5Qaql0.description: Thanks for 800k! Been planning to do this level for a while now, so I started practicing this today and got some really good runs, then I thought it was time to play from 0%. After an hour of playing I fluked the entire second half of the level which is insane to me, I thought for sure I was gonna be stuck at the last wave for a while which happens to a lot of people, but I'm glad I was able to do it. GG :)

yUUY7jRnEaY.title: (Insane Demon) ''Pulsar'' 100% by Zhander & iIAkariIi | Geometry Dash
yUUY7jRnEaY.description:
A very visually appealing level that shines through it's use of color and effects, being amplified by the fast paced wave sections that make up the majority of this, with a nice contrast in some black and white parts that use different game modes in the beginning and end which really help to keep it varied.

The effects as I mentioned before are the best parts about this, they're smooth, fast and colorful, especially the background at 0:49, they fit the intense nature of the gameplay and song as well, with the slower sections serving nicely as a buildup and as a way to slow things down before ending.

64Qfx-PZ2Qk.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Phobos'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
64Qfx-PZ2Qk.description: I've always wanted to do this level but the first UFO held me back from doing so, after understanding how it worked I decided it was finally time to start working on this. Definitely wasn't a fun experience because of some of the parts that feel entirely luck based, while others are very straight forward. Thankfully this didn't take too long to beat after practicing. Took me roughly 3k attempts without counting the old ones from 2018. GG :)

aXE3R-kGSEI.title: ''Rendering Colors'' by Vertuoz | Geometry Dash
aXE3R-kGSEI.description:
An incredibly unique concept brought to life in a minute long experience, something that no longer resembles Geometry Dash in the slightest, but brings something never before seen.

Rendering Colors has a very heavy pixelated style, you could probably count each individual square on the screen, but it results in a mesmerizing visual, the colors that are used also help give you a rough detail of what's going on.

The final section showcases some beautiful animations connected to one another through many different colors and effects, almost looking like a kaleidoscope, very cool.

pG8cnBiegBo.title: (Insane Demon) ''MultiChromatic'' 100% by gmdmann [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
pG8cnBiegBo.description:
MultiChromatic is what you get when you know your way around colors, a very vibrant and overall enjoyable experience the entire way through.

The upbeat gameplay and soundtrack really mesh together with the colorful decorations and fast movements, and the contrast with the dark backgrounds makes all of this pop out even more. There are also some glitch effects here and there within the block design where everything shifts for a split second which ended up looking very nice.

_OcWwQmbkRQ.title: Farewell by DavJT | Geometry Dash
_OcWwQmbkRQ.description:
A mesmerizing level, the final farewell from one of the best creators this game has ever had, a level bright vibrant colors and very pleasing effects.

The very beginning is my favorite part, starting in darkness and the way the hand floats down towards you surrounded by light, only to pick you up and take you to the skies, it's very comforting.

This doesn't feel like a goodbye, it's more of an until next time as he says in the end, and I wish Dav the best of luck in anything he does in the future, thanks for all the amazing levels you've given us over the years.

UjlVTu4vdiE.title: (Extreme Demon) ''N0'' 100% by Metalface221 | Geometry Dash
UjlVTu4vdiE.description:
A great solo level from Metalface that was released more than a year ago, The majority of the level has a dark atmosphere, with a vignette in some sections, with the contrast being found in the relatively bright colors used in the block design and obstacles, which are varied from section to section, and you can tell their are inspirations and influences from different levels here as well.

The transitions are smooth and straightforward, with the exception being the glitchy pixel one at the end, which looks really good on it's own, but they're all clean.

1ynspvn8KSs.title: ''CraZy III'' 100% (Demon) by DavJT [Verified] | Geometry Dash
1ynspvn8KSs.description:
It's finally here, a level with one of the highest amounts of hype and anticipation this game has known, calling CraZy III a masterpiece is putting it lightly, this goes beyond that maintaining the highest level of quality throughout the entire 2 and a half minute duration. 

CraZy III isn't just a level, at this point it's a complete story, everything is coherent and and connected, every bit of decoration and art is intertwined with one another, through seamless transitions with beautiful art and smooth animations, all of this being amplified by the great pace this level has, being possible in part because of the soundtrack that is either slow, creepy and methodical, or erratic and terrifying, and every part of the level elevates this feeling.

The variety when it comes to places and settings is also amazing, the contrast between the run down and the seemingly perfect and clean really serves to add to the depth of the world.

But putting all of these great aspects aside for a moment, the bossfight that comes after the drop is definitely the best part about this, it's unexpected, it hits you out of nowhere, with a perfect buildup beforehand and the effects, design, everything is fantastic.

To sum it all up, this was well worth the wait, and you should play this as soon as possible.

Song: Circus Contraption - Wicked Fascinations (DirtyPaws Remix)
https://youtu.be/PCpuqjsoIns

cDmU8-ACBko.title: ''Spectrum Surge'' by BrainETR | Geometry Dash
cDmU8-ACBko.description:
A level that explodes with color from the very beginning, a high intensity and highly visual experience that will entertain and mesmerize you every step of the way in just under a minute.

The design is obviously the main point to address here, it's very in your face when it comes to the colors and the lighting effects that are used, but at the same time it has it's subtleties, within the block design in the beginning, and the small decorations in the background, wrapped up in smooth movements and animations in the surrounding area.

IYqi24pQvU8.title: ''BOSS RUSH'' 100% (Demon) by RedlixHD & More [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
IYqi24pQvU8.description:
ID: 73563312
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/952210

An extremely well made level with Project Arrhythmia style gameplay, in a boss rush setting, each boss having it's own design, attacks and atmosphere in each respective section. The movements are very smooth and the effects are high quality, it's so impressive that I could see this being a standalone short game.

The gameplay is another strong aspect of this level, normally with these types are finicky and stutter in it's movements, but this for the most part is satisfying to control, having a clear and straightforward tutorial in the beginning as well.

As I said in the beginning, each boss has it's own "lair", color scheme and design, being 4 in total, and all of them have something different to offer. They're all intimadating in their own way, whether it's because of it's art or the aggresiveness of it's attacks or just the background, every part looks fantastic.

xG7naT0x80k.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Azure Fiesta'' 100% by Dorami & More | Geometry Dash
xG7naT0x80k.description:
Azure Fiesta is a level that has an enormous variation in it's effects, backgrounds, block design and atmosphere. 

In it's artistic sections found in the beginning and towards the end with it's beach party aesthetic, the big palm trees and all the decorations surrounding these fitting together perfectly with the song, to the more barebones sections where there isn't any art or backgrounds, focusing more on the effects and gameplay, while still looking good.

Now onto the gameplay, in my opinion the difficulty and scale is a bit inconsistent, there are some sections that are easier than others. For example the ship at 77% is much harder than most parts in the level, while some other parts are Insane Demon difficulty.

bZta12T3TK8.title: ''Arcadia'' 100% by CodeNate | Geometry Dash
bZta12T3TK8.description:
Arcadia is a level that truly shines through it's effects, using every color you could think to their maximum potential, in interesting ways whether it's filling the block design, engulfing the entirety of the level or being used in the backgrounds to create optical effects. This level really is a showcase to the things that are possible in this game and how satisfying it can be to watch.

There is also a strong use of black and white throughout the level, serving well to mark a contrast between all of the strong colors being used here, adding a sense of depth as well.

The gameplay is enjoyable, not being too fast or too slow, despite the song being on the quicker side, there's a nice variation in the modes that you play and there's a bit of difficulty to it as well.

t2yYlIPpNuE.title: (Insane Demon) ''Valwec'' 100% by Shrympo & Onvil | Geometry Dash
t2yYlIPpNuE.description:
An interesting yet relaxing experience, Valwec doesn't go overboard with it's effects, but manages to make them subtle yet powerful, a level that looks full of life and is fun to play, a complete package in just under 2 minutes.

The background is mostly dark from beginning to end but it isn't completely empty, there are different shapes and colors that show up here and there, adding to the depth overall, it also looks great with all of the neon colors moving around in the foreground, with the glow lighting up the surrounding areas, adding to the chill aesthetic. Although my favorite effect is the one that shows up right in the middle, after the drop, the way the entire blocks shift slightly to the left and right looks mesmerizing.

Overall an enjoyable level.

w2e5EuJl5H4.title: Polargeist Remake | ''Polargeist Plus'' by Cubiccc [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
w2e5EuJl5H4.description:
A complete reimagining and redesign of a level that practically everybody knows of and has played at some point. The best part about this remake is the fact that you can easily see this being Poltergeist if it was added to the game today, the effects are top-notch, the atmosphere is great and fits the classic song perfectly, while still keeping the vibe of the original.

The design is also varied, each section being completely different from the last, all being filled with bright colors and smooth block designs, all while still feeling connected with one another. It's always impressive to me how creators can breathe new life into such old levels, and this is what Cubiccc has accomplished here, very fun to play and satisfying to watch.

fcZm_V7LmM4.title: ''Dizzying Heights'' 100% (Demon) by Flash | Geometry Dash
fcZm_V7LmM4.description:
A level with a very chill and relaxing atmosphere and vibe, that also has a mystical side to it, using many different colors in the form of gradients to fill in the blanks, surrounded by a simplistic yet fitting block design.

The design is very bright for the most part, using strong colors such as blue, pink and white especially, to bring forward the rest of the design, and the effects as well, which is one of my favorite aspects about this level, the fact that it's not overdecorated, it isn't filled to the brim with objects just because, everything has it's place and it's purpose, and it works out.

When it comes to transitions, it's another plus for this level, they're smooth, to the point and gratifying to go through, fitting nicely with the slow nature of the atmosphere, and since they throw you up and down, it gives a sense of space as well.

6cT3jI04cP0.title: ''Undecodable'' 100% (Demon) by Lyzard | Geometry Dash
6cT3jI04cP0.description:
A remake of the classic level Decode by Rek3dge that keeps all the charm of the original that many of us hold near our hearts, and puts it's own modern touch into, picking it back up on it's feet and giving it a bit of polish.

My favorite aspect about this remake is how smooth it feels and looks compared to the original, while on the surface it may seem very similar, once you sit down and play you can quickly tell and feel the upgrades the original had, and that's the best part about remakes, taking old and maybe even forgotten levels and giving them another shot at the limelight.

The gameplay and layout are similar as well, also feeling smoother, which adds to the enjoyment and replayability, overall this is a fantastic remake, and if you played the original 5 years ago or just started playing, you should give this a shot.

RI2dDmWMdq0.title: ''Pixel Thingie'' 100% (Demon) by tenzk | Geometry Dash
RI2dDmWMdq0.description:
A remake, or rather a remaster of Pixel Thingy by Hinds, a level that was released about 3 years ago, that when I played I felt was a bit too barebones and empty, with it just being a blank background with different colored squares filling as blocks.

But when it comes to this iteration, it does keep the spirit of the original, the song and the style of gameplay as well, but the design is so much more detailed here, and it is visible from the very beginning, the block design has texture and depth to it, there's more decoration filling in the empty spaces, each with their own animations, making the outer areas of the blocks feel much more alive.

Apart from that, there's a lot more variation in color here, using a ton of color combinations that work well together, further amplifying the atmosphere, the gameplay is similar with some changes here and there but it's enjoyable.

TJW0igkGVSw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Sunburn'' 100% by pocke | Geometry Dash
TJW0igkGVSw.description:
Sunburn is a level that uses very strong colors in an engaging and satisfying way, mainly comprised of different tones and hues of red, orange and pink, combined with the music and the lighting effects scattered across the level, it ends up being really stylish. 

The block design has a sort of disco vibe to it in some sections, where the obstacles and platforms are filled with tiny squares flashing different colors rapidly, and some other sections have a more traditional approach and design, and the ending turns simplistic with a completely black surface.

The effects are mostly lighting and some subtle animations on the edges of the screen and some objects, but I think it's great as is, it's straight to the point while still looking good.

i48ESR4IyBY.title: (Extreme Demon) ''PLUS ULTRA'' 100% by Ilrell & More | Geometry Dash
i48ESR4IyBY.description:
Based on the incredibly popular anime My Hero Academia, PLUS ULTRA is a megacollab that has all the bells and whistles, each section showcasing a different power or "Quirk" from each character in the show, which is great to see if you're a fan, each part having it's own style and decoration, being so detailed that they could've all been their own levels, showing how talented each creator that worked on this is.

The transitions are simple but they serve to connect each part well, which is a difficult thing to do when each section is so different, but nothing feels out of place here. When it comes to the sync with the music, it's also great, following the beat and building up together, completing the package.

Kvvmp4tfHws.title: (XXL Extreme Demon) ''Carnage Mode'' 100% by Findexi & More | Geometry Dash
Kvvmp4tfHws.description:
Extremely happy and proud of finally being able to say I've beaten this, something I thought impossible years ago. A level that is very straightforward and doesn't pull any punches, focusing more on gameplay and layout more than decoration and having a crazy design.

That being said this isn't a barebones or empty level at all, it has different aspects to it's design, and while it doesn't have a theme or connection in between sections, each part individually is good, having detailed block design and some cool effects that wrap everything up.

VOlRrlbfnwA.title: ''Music Factory'' 100% (Demon) by KoDTIFF | Geometry Dash
VOlRrlbfnwA.description:
Just Shapes and Beats is a game that lends itself incredibly well to be recreated in Geometry Dash, given that it's also a rhythm game, and the style can be similar in a lot of ways, these are always very fun to play, and this is no exeption.

The fact that this isn't just JS&B gameplay helps keep it varied, with the majority of the gameplay being GD, with the obstacles and bossfights from the former, using some very smooth animations and having great art to tie it all together.

3jC8R3-5Iyo.title: (Insane Demon) ''Memories III'' 100% by The4n1ma & More | Geometry Dash
3jC8R3-5Iyo.description:
A beautiful nostalgic Demon from The4n1ma and various other talanted creators, showcasing bits and pieces of classic and memorable levels from 1.9 to 2.1 such as BloodBath, SuperSonic and many more. 

This level is basically a burst of nostalgia the entire way through, if you've been playing for a long time, so many levels that were milestones for many of us condensed into a single experience, while staying true to the original and having great effects and design overall, really makes you feel like you were teleported to all these levels. I highly recommend you try this level out.

4f9SzayNS2g.title: ''RobTopCity'' by Apstrom [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4f9SzayNS2g.description:
A level heavily inspired by the 2.2 Sneak Peek, that uses a lot of the design choices and decoration that we saw in the trailer, which just goes to show how excited everybody is to be able to play the next update. 

The block design looks ripped straight out of RobTop's level, being very detailed with a modern look, strung together with very clean effects and smooth animations integrated into the player, and everything around them as well.

Can't wait for 2.2.

bzan4l3WoDk.title: Yatagarasu Remake | ''Yatagarasu AgaiN'' 100% (Demon) by SrMDK & More | Geometry Dash
bzan4l3WoDk.description:
A level that shows what remakes can really do when done right, I believe that this is what Yatagarasu would look like if it was released today, with everything creators have adapted to and learn since the original was released, elevating the original to new heights.

Yatagarasu AgaiN keeps the original's atmosphere, grand and slightly intimidating as it was, while revamping the design, the art, the animations and backgrounds, this isn't just a fresh coat of paint on top of an old level, it's so much more than that, a half year of hard work that in my eyes really paid off.

KYO328d3fQc.title: (Insane Demon) ''Layers'' 100% by sachikoadmirer | Geometry Dash
KYO328d3fQc.description:
Layers is the newest level from sachikoadmirer, with an interesting concept, and while it may seem on the simpler side, there is a lot more here than meets the eye, like the title suggests, there are many layers of shapes and colors in place, that make up the foreground, background and even the colors, giving off a sort of 3D effect.

Being a rather erratic level, it starts off slow and relatively calm in all aspects, but when the drop hits, everything turns up a notch, the movements, the colors, the flashing lights, it calms down again for a brief moment and then goes even flashier than before to end off the level, with the song being the definite driving force of this level, and adding to the difficulty due to visibility at the same time.

PXqnZoHfTmE.title: ''ZXCircleS'' 100% (Demon) by Wintter | Geometry Dash
PXqnZoHfTmE.description:
A Nine Circles styled level, ZXCircleS has a more modernized take on this design, while still keeping it relatively simple and only being a minute long, it's still an enjoyable experience. The colors mainly used here are Red, White, and some different shades of Purple and Blue, accompanied by the different flashing lights with some subtle animations within the block design.

The gameplay is more varied than you would expect, instead of being completely Wave, there are Ship and Cube sections, and even some UFO, but mainly Wave, being well balanced.

hhz0CuA8oSU.title: ''PURGATORY'' 100% (Demon) by Custi, JerkRat & Flaksy | Geometry Dash
hhz0CuA8oSU.description:
A collab with an insanely well crafted atmosphere and overall vibe, the theme is executed nicely while being backed up by the great art and the subtle yet powerful effects. The quality is consistent the entire way through and from the very beginning you can see the amount of work that went into this. 

What I like most about this level is the fact that it didn't stick to a red and black color scheme, it uses a wide variety of hues to depict different materials present in each section, whether it's the fire, ash, lava or the monster in the background, it looks varied and thus it never becomes repetitive.

IhWIN_EvFNc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''The Hell Factory'' 100% by TeamN2 | Geometry Dash
IhWIN_EvFNc.description: A classic black and red Extreme that I never beat back in the day, but decided to give it a shot yesterday, managing to beat it in about 30-60 minutes from 0%, not much to say, back when this released it was a huge achievement for anyone that managed to beat this, and it still is for newer players, still happy with this nonetheless.

dmakYMuXnJQ.title: Bloodbath Remake | (Extreme Demon) ''Legacy'' 100% by CairoX | Geometry Dash
dmakYMuXnJQ.description:
A remake of the Legendary Bloodbath, dedicated to Michigun, but it isn't just a revamp of the visuals with slightly changed gameplay, it also features an extension, increasing the difficulty even further. Remaking such an iconic level from 1.9 can't be an easy thing to do, especially when you're only one person, but this was made in about 100 days, and it came out really good.

While there are some clicks here and there that can be a bit annoying, and it isn't as consistent as it could be, it's still an enjoyable challenge, the extension does feel and look like it could've been in the original and in making the level longer overall, the difficulty spikes up a bit.

The design does have a fresher vibe to it, with my favorite section being Evasium's in terms of looks which shows that the red and black theme can still look good.

mhoy8L3tyWM.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Ancestral Calamity'' 100% by MrSpaghetti & More | Geometry Dash
mhoy8L3tyWM.description:
Not exactly a fun experience but it becomes really consistent after a while.
I've always wanted to do this level since it came out and I'm really glad I was able to do it fairly quickly.

When it comes to the design the Terraria theme can be seen here and there, especially at the beginning with the beautifully made Devourer of Gods from the Calamity Mod, the movements are smooth and true to the source material, with a very detailed design that combined with the backgrounds make for a great scene, but the same time it becomes obvious that some sections are better than others, but they all have something positive to add to the level in their own way.

AP-M69JaTm0.title: (Insane Demon) ''DragonLocked'' 100% by FrostDragonGD | Geometry Dash
AP-M69JaTm0.description:
A DeadLocked remake that hits all of the marks when it comes to levels like this, it takes something that shows it's age and completely remasters it to meet today's standards, without robbing it of it's original charm and appeal, especially when it comes to GD's main levels.

Since levels like DeadLocked or Poltergeist are RobTop levels, they are incredibly important to many people, since just about everybody who plays this game today, has tried these, and the first time that you do is special, so remaking these also comes with a challenge, since it's not just any level, but I think FrostDragon nailed it.

The star of this show is definitely the bossfight, having played the original so long ago, having multiple heads shoot fire at you was crazy at the time, but having a Hydra shoot laser beams at you is something else, things like these and the updated look on the blocks and effects do the original justice.

_2lb-ejWruI.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Gang Plank Hell'' 100% by Metalface221 & More | Geometry Dash
_2lb-ejWruI.description: Pretty inconsistent but still fun overall

4b_xam64cbw.title: [2.2] RobTop Platformer Level Recreation by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash
4b_xam64cbw.description:
Really cool to see that someone already recreated this

2.2 GDPS by Blaze: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfPtuop90e_JzxPkiZ6Q5Q

Robotic24: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCY73cgt2VEVd4cWcCKdnp0w

0hRSCW6iY7U.title: Happy Anniversary GD by AleXins | Geometry Dash
0hRSCW6iY7U.description: 8 years already, hyped for sneak peek :)

ohozbFInAC0.title: ''By Day By Night'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Vicolor [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
ohozbFInAC0.description:
ID: 72394641
Music: By Day, By Night (VIP) by 1f1n1ty + Stardew
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/873544

kne8_e-ORqs.title: ''Lava Temple'' 100% (Demon) by Michigun | Geometry Dash
kne8_e-ORqs.description:
While I never beat this level when it came out, I really liked it and it was one of my favorite 1.9 levels and it still is. Lava Temple is a legendary level at this point, the fire effects were amazing for the time, with some pieces of the block design floating around to simulate a broken wall or ceiling with lava flowing through which added some personality.

∆∆∆

KUItyH1A6s4.title: ''Supersonic'' 100% (Demon) by ZenthicAlpha & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash

y2rSPZgPmoM.title: DOLBIT NORMALNO by MaFFaKa | Geometry Dash
y2rSPZgPmoM.description:
A level that is a crazy yet fascinating experience, from all angles, the pulses and colors are on another level when it comes to going all out, driven completely by a song that is fast, loud and intimidating. 

The extreme flashes of light along with the rapid changes of color, syncing perfectly with the music, with the obstacles, the backgrounds and even some pieces of art going insane, this is one of those levels that are special simply because of how hard it is to look away, leaving you thinking about what you just saw.

That being said, I do highly recommend you try this out, unless you are sensitive to these kinds of flashing lights and colors obviously, but there is a lot to look at here.

Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/815808
MegaSphere & Crankshaft - The One Who Really Knows

dOdPoU1ncOc.title: [4k] ''Nine Circles'' 100% (Demon) by Zobros [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
dOdPoU1ncOc.description: Never actually made a proper video for Nine Circles, so here it is

1iaEUD6p_hU.title: ''Outbreak'' 100% (Demon) by SleyGD [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
1iaEUD6p_hU.description:
A level with a dark mysterious vibe, an atmosphere devoid of light, filled with nothing but bright colors and flashing lights, like something you would see at a rave party. I think that the best part about this is the way the effects sync perfectly with the music, the beat is measured and followed by the rapid changes of color and brightness and with that every part is different and it doesn't repeat itself.

Being a minute long, you get a short but very enjoyable experience playing this, the gameplay is consistent even with it's darker tones, once you get used to it, it doesn't affect visibility. The block design is on the simpler side, following the same colors as the rest of the decoration, with a small 3D effect to make it stand out.

_l48vvczJrc.title: (Insane Demon) ''Flappy Dynamix II'' 100% by RadiationV2 | Geometry Dash
_l48vvczJrc.description:
Flappy Dynamix II is a level that has everything you would want, it has a clean design with satisfying color combinations, a sleek and to the point block design, nice effects and smooth animations, and to top it all off, it features some unique gameplay elements as well that make the level a lot more varied and enjoyable, the 50k+ objects are definitely put to good use and are used to their best potential.

The gameplay is more memory-based, at least to me, you can't really sight-read what's coming next, that being said it is not buggy at all, and I didn't encounter any problems. Overall it is a very enjoyable experience and it's a treat to look at as well.

Music: F-777 - Sonic Blaster (HJfod Remix)
 https://youtube.com/c/HJfod

q1lwZ3u5oJY.title: ''Deja Vu'' by xXLOCOXx | Geometry Dash
q1lwZ3u5oJY.description:
After about half a year since we've had a level from LOCO, we have something that is incredibly unique, a concept that catches you by surprise the first time you see it. 

What makes this level so special is the fact that it is played entirely in reverse, just about every aspect is reversed, the gameplay, the effects and even the music, and it begins with you at the edge of the level having lost, but from there you revive and start moving backwards, which can be jarring but the further you go, the more fascinating it becomes, definitely an interesting concept that was executed very nicely.

NtjnxmZgC9Y.title: ''Reversion'' 100% (Demon) by 1374 & SeokSo | Geometry Dash
NtjnxmZgC9Y.description:
The newest level from 1374, after of while of not having a full release, in collaboration with SeokSo, both being extremely talented creators in their own way, and a remake of Echo by Noobas and Triaxis. 

The design has been completely revamped and remastered from the original, while still keeping the style and aesthetic of the old one, everything is so much cleaner and much more in tune with today's styles. From the block design, to the effects, the backgrounds and even the transitions. With that said, the fact that the original came out so long ago and was able to be updated like this is proof that the original design and idea was good in it's own right.

KzNcdGLjVIU.title: ''Press Start V'' 100% by Wergulz16 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
KzNcdGLjVIU.description:
The newest installment in the Press Start series of levels from Wergulz, and if you've played all of them you can tell just by playing the first few seconds, that each one goes above and beyond the previous ones, in terms of quality, design and overall atmosphere. 

This level has an ancient and corrupeted vibe to it which lends itself to feature very detailed block design, have more abrasive and agressive effects and use harsher and more vibrant colors, that being said it isn't a one-note level at all, there are a handful of sections here and each one has something that makes it stand out from the rest, whether it's the backgrounds, the art the blocks and obstacles or the smooth animations in the transitions and inserted into the foreground.

Everything ties together nicely and even though the original Press Start theme is no longer present, this is still an amazing level and deserves the attention.

p4VqX8PZ0c4.title: (Insane Demon) ''THORNS and BRAMBLES'' 100% by YoReid & More | Geometry Dash

WcPHfm6CKqg.title: (Insane Demon) ''IWannaKillTheKamilia'' 100% by Junior202 | Geometry Dash
WcPHfm6CKqg.description:
A level that is a recreation of a game that goes by the same title, and part of the I wanna be the _____ games, which is know for it's incredibly high difficulty and tight obstacles, and it's done masterfully. The design is spot on, almost appearing to be ripped from the original game, each level having a different look, showcasing the varied block design and colors. 

The gameplay is a bit complicated to get used to, but with some practice you'll be able to move quickly without thinking too much about it, there's no delay which is very important when the spaces you must go through are so small, but very enjoyable overall.

f2GeVROzfQ0.title: Hardest Minigame? | ''Falling Maze'' 100% (Insane Demon) by YoReid | Geometry Dash
f2GeVROzfQ0.description:
A level that completely changes the gameplay, movement and perception, to the point where it isn't Geometry Dash anymore. A minigame where you are constantly moving upward at a consistent pace, with the obstacles and paths you must take falling onto you, making you dodge them, while using the space bar to move left and the up arrow to move right.

The movement for your character can be buggy at times, either it doesn't move much, or it goes flying towards the wall, so the method I found to be the most effective and comfortable is to do short bursts of movement rather than leaving the button pressed down, although there are some parts towards the end where this isn't possible. But the fact that this was able to be created and turned out as playable as it is is very impressive.

The design is well done, it is separated into 5 levels including an intro level at the beginning. Each one has it's own unique style, block design and effects, even their own gameplay mechanics. Even with every section being so different, using a dark cave as a transition was a good choice to connect everything.

Overall it's an enjoyable experience, once you get the hang of the gameplay and it's speed, it becomes satisfying to go through each tricky part, if you like different types of gameplay or minigames, you should give this a shot.

dRydmyELHik.title: Only Ball | VEIL by Neigefeu | Geometry Dash
dRydmyELHik.description:
A unique and even innovative level, where you only play as the Ball, throughout the whole thing, and this might seem like a handicap when it comes to crafting the gameplay, since there's only so much you can do with only one mode, but this is where this level stands out from the rest. 

Throughout the entire level there are a set of orbs that follow you, which you have to use to get through the obstacles, it uses every orb available, which makes the gameplay varied and keeps you on your toes. I think this was a great idea and it makes an otherwise straightforward experience into something at another level.

The design is mostly effect-driven, with the majority of the block design being simplistic, it switches between light and dark colors at a fast pace, but at the same time having sync with the music.

7nxwWLflkgc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''OPSM1'' 100% by Varse | Geometry Dash
7nxwWLflkgc.description:
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/998365

It's always a joy to be able to play an Extreme Demon that has insanely good design and style, which just goes to show how far we've come when it comes to the design of these Demons, and this is definitely one of them. 

OPSM1 has great colorwork, using almost every shade you could imagine and it's effects only serve to amplify the erratic and fast-paced nature of the gameplay with it's pronounced lighting in some sections where things get high-intensity, bundled together with some subtle glitch effects. 

The block design is simplistic in nature but it has detail to it and fits together nicely with the rest of the design while still standing out on it's own.

5s2JXQvQ6yc.title: ''The Clouds Give Way'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash
5s2JXQvQ6yc.description:
The newest level from Subwoofer, a remarkable experience to say the least, from beginning to end this 5 minute story manages to capture you and doesn't let go. This creation also has a message, which is that it's always good to keep moving forward, that when everything seems fine and a storm hits, it will pass, just like everything else, to keep our heads held high and to create the future we want for ourselves and not wait around. 

That message is conveyed beautifully here, you can see the beginning, the middle and the ending of the journey, the calm beginning, the frightening and desperate middle and the liberation at the end, a great story driven by great design, colors and effects, with the song tying everything together nicely.

51RdfOMMWck.title: ''Deepvine Pass'' 100% (Demon) by J735 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
51RdfOMMWck.description:
A jungle-themed level that is heavily inspired by Rafer, another very talented creator, with the added bonus that J735 even received input from the former. It's always a treat to see somebodies style be recreated by another creator, and I think we can say that it hit the nail on the head. Going back to the Jungle Theme, it's clear and concise from the beginning with all the grass, the trees and the vines, even having a very short animated intro to kick it off, and the Soundtrack which was a great choice that includes some sound effects that are just the cherry on top and add a whole other layer of detail to this.

The pace of the level follows the song beat by beat, where the entire design changes to a more agressive setting when the beat drops, with some crazy lighting effects and faster movements, with the slower parts focusing more on color and smooth transitions. Overall this level is fun to play and it does recreate Rafer's style almost perfectly.

ct0jiM1tTrk.title: [2.0] ''Rebellion'' 100% (Demon) by Bryan1150 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
ct0jiM1tTrk.description: There's dash orbs because it was updated to 2.1

XvC4t4FH3PM.title: ''Neon Thrills'' 100% (Demon) by Oasis & More | Geometry Dash
XvC4t4FH3PM.description:
Neon Thrills is, put into a few words, a clean, sleek and stylish experience, brought to us by 4 very talented creators, with Oasis and Sley taking care of the design and the gameplay left to Dominuus and Akinawoo, a level that absolutely earned the Epic Rating that it got. The design for this is very satisfying, where both put their styles into each section, making all of them unique in their own way, while making everything cohesive and well-strung together. 

The neon aspect of the level is definitely present, mainly in the different shades of purple and blue, and it's integrated in a subtle yet satisfying way, without going overboard with the effect and making it uncomfortable, surrounding the block design which has a simplistic yet sophisticated visual. All of this only amplified by the fact that the gameplay is very enjoyable and has nice sync with the upbeat soundtrack.

NzONX0Us_s8.title: (Insane Demon) ''Golden Shine'' 100% by Empika | Geometry Dash
NzONX0Us_s8.description:
A remake of Golden Shade by Zylenox, where Empika stays true to the original style, while adding several unique elements to the overall design. The atmosphere is a bit darker and the color gold isn't as prominent and bold. At the very beginning we get to see the golden city that was present in the original, both iterations looking fantastic in their own way with some small differences you can see in the coloring, the backgrounds and the shading. After this we are greeted with a fiery red aura emanating from the floor, the color taking over most of this section, but you can still the golden shine coming through the blocks. This section is very different from the rest, but I think it's a nice change of pace and scenery.

After this we go through a dark tunnel, with a small light shining in front of you lighting the way. The shading and shadows on the block design here give the effect that they where sketched, which makes stand out from the rest of the obstacles in the level.

Both the original and this remake are very high quality and you can tell from the first few seconds, which just goes to show, a level doesn't have to be very old to warrant a remake.

y57rZ2QXjYQ.title: ''Right Angle'' 100% (Demon) by Dashiell10 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
y57rZ2QXjYQ.description:
A level that has a unique aspect, it features platforms and structures that are comprised only of squares, hence the title. This creation doesn't have a continuity or story to tell, so each and every section is different and original in it's own way, whether it's the effects that are used, the colors, the backgrounds and the block design, this helps keep you on your toes since you won't know what could come next and it makes each section feel fresh. 

Making a level like this, only being able to use certain shapes, sounds and looks like challenge, since you can't go too crazy with the design or it would look too cluttered, so the best part about this in my opinion are the effects, they definitely add a lot of life to the level, especially the ones used inside the blocks and in the backgrounds, the flashes of light in sync with the music, the different gradients flying across in waves behind everything, it all ties together in a crazy, psychedelic way.

62c-85eUqgs.title: (XXL Extreme Demon) ''Fusion Z'' 100% by PlebKIngdom | Geometry Dash

ddkUja_5XHY.title: ''Firework'' 100% (Demon) by Endevvor | Geometry Dash
ddkUja_5XHY.description:
Not to be confused with cherryteam's Firework, this iteration from Endevvor aims to be a lighter, more accessible version of that. Keeping the same grey and white color scheme with a tint of red in some areas, which helps as a small contrast from the monochrome. The design is fantastic, there are many small details that can be seen just about anywhere you look. My favorite aspect about this level is how the particles falling from above gives the feeling of ash falling from the sky, combined with the greyscale makes for a slightly intimidating atmosphere, but it works really well. 

There are also some subtle animations here and there, the giant white spikes that shoot up from the ground, the blocks that appear on the edges of the walls that move in sync with the song and the small specs of light that fall slowly across the screen that look like shooting stars, all of this added up makes for an enjoyable experience.

jGPBRhVEyKU.title: WhyMeWhyMeWhyMeWhyMe by TMNGaming | Geometry Dash
jGPBRhVEyKU.description:
ID: 71496773
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/975149 
TMNGaming: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCK3fmU97n3tha5OTZvvFAxg

This level is one of those cases where it's creator uses it as a way to tell a story, to share their thoughts and feelings, to show the world the vulnerabilities that are looming over them what for many seem to be every waking moment. This is a very strong commentary of what goes on in the mind of an artist, somebody who's creativity and the constant use of it changes the individual, and with time can become a burden, where you get to the point where you question if you're truly good enough, if anybody actually enjoys what you do and make, or if they simply say so because they feel bad, it's a commentary of all of this and so much more but at the same time this is a cry for help, feeling that he's going insane due to his mind, and at the end you can see the words "please help me", engulfed in a dark background, with nothing else but these three words. 

TMN gives us a tour of his debilitated mind, showing us many of his unfinished projects, that may have started as a project that was surrounded by excitement and hope, only to be negated by the anxiety and doubt that slowly crept in, having this happen so many times. Making something like this, as brutally honest and vulnerable as it is, is not something everyone has the strength to make, much less release, but I truly hope that with this masterpiece, people that have these same feelings realize that they are not the only ones that go through these mindspaces. 

A truly fascinating level with so much meaning and power behind it, please give this a try for yourself and support the creator.

uhujTAF5Gkg.title: ''Hallownest'' 100% (Demon) by xMrFinlandx | Geometry Dash
uhujTAF5Gkg.description:
xMrFinlandx: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCGOMBP-ua-B2Ls8x9o8V0zQ
ID: 71478504
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/644761

It's always amazing to me how creators can recreate the art styles, atmosphere and vibe of other games, being able to give us the full experience of the original inside of GD, and this is one of those levels, the way MrFinland was able to make something that seems ripped straight out of Hollow Knight just goes to show you really can make just about anything with enough work and effort. The art in this is master-tier, taking us through Crystal Peaks, The Abyss, the Dream Realm and even giving us a bossfight with The Radiance, whose design is also great, all while changing every aspect of the design to match these places perfectly, including the effects, whether it's the lasers in Crystal Peaks, the dark bubbling shade in The Abyss or the bright light emanating from Radiance, it all comes together very nicely.

osl3z5xCbyE.title: ''Omniscience'' 100% (Demon) by sachikoadmirer | Geometry Dash
osl3z5xCbyE.description:
From the creator that brought us Antichamber, serving as a sequel to Ritual, Omniscience continues the story that begun to unfold in the original, whether it was clear or not is up to every person that played that level. But something we can all absolutely agree on is that the atmosphere for both Ritual and this are top-notch, pulling us into the world that this talented creator has created with beautiful art, backgrounds and effects that tie up the vibe perfectly.

Apart from the great design, the gameplay is enjoyable as well, it's varied, the speeds that are used aren't abrupt or out of place, fitting in with what's going on with the design and it stays consistent as well.

it's incredibly fun playing sequels that have tie-ins and callbacks to the original, trying to deduce what it all means, all while being able to enjoy great design.

ae06r7FsgbU.title: ''Obsolete Travel II'' 100% (XXL Demon) by GlintZ [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
ae06r7FsgbU.description:
It's always nice to reminisce, to remember where we came from and see how far we've come, and this is a perfect representation of that, being inspired entirely by 1.0, Obsolete Travel II keeps it simple and excels at doing so, using every object and effect at it's disposal, but at the same time, being a step-up from the first, without a single dull moment in sight, managing to keep the player attentive and having so many unique sections that throw something different at you while elevating these old objects to new heights with the use of effects. Playing this is like climbing into a time machine and playing every level that was available when Geometry Dash released, but with new life.

Obviously the difficulty is due to the length, being 6 minutes long, but being as fun as it is, it goes by so quickly, and it keeps you entertained the whole way through.

GAsHxwIzhXY.title: KA by DeniPol | Geometry Dash
GAsHxwIzhXY.description:
From the creator that graced us with TUALET na kashdy den, we have a decorated layout that is a complete opposite of the year old joke level. This level is the perfect example that you don't always have to have crazy block design and hundreds of thousands of objects in the background to make a compelling experience, and DeniPol created just that, a satisfying and entertaining level the entire way through. 

The atmosphere is there from the very beginning, the slow buildup towards the drop, with nothing more than the simple blocks and different colored lights shining from above and below. And as the music and the gameplay build up, so do the effects, which are the star of this level, used in many unique ways. The usage of glow, bright lighting and quick and snappy movement combined with the epic soundtrack is very satisfying.

Szh8YsaD4do.title: ''Cold Sweat II'' 100% (Demon) by RealWhata, Rustere & EvoNuclearGD | Geometry Dash
Szh8YsaD4do.description:
btw this has nothing to do with cold sweat the name is a joke

ID: 71107449
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/925319
RealWhata: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpbVpEcKfjX4gw_oGc-QDYw
EvoNuclear: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPEUQA84YHknE3XIBmjg94A
Rustere: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCgobeW8msNlyRgWRaGHMWdg

oP2yCEJfrhI.title: ''Amnesiac'' 100% (Demon) by AvaKai [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
oP2yCEJfrhI.description:
ID: 71319483
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/877390
AvaKai: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfWSmvasWhqlSqspwuPcGDA

There have been countless levels over the years that use the red and black color scheme, a trend that grew rapidly through extreme demons and is still used to this day, but Amnesiac has so many unique elements to it that the color combination ends up being an afterthought. The effects used in this are fantastic, having a different set in each section, whether it's through lighting or the optical illusions going on in the background, including the way some of the structures add more depth to the overall scenery. All of this together topped off with a very satisfying song make for a level that has a level of mystique with a hint of unsettling.

2DrPEBEbzvM.title: Made in 3 days! | DEEP BLUE SEA by Custi | Geometry Dash
2DrPEBEbzvM.description:
ID: 71114971
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/711470
Custi: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9czG6YV6t6-bLz9fLmOqrw

It's always impressive to see what somebody is able to create in such a short amount of time, being able to make an entire world with it's own vibe and atmosphere, full of life and small details, and that's what Custi was able to accomplish. DEEP BLUE SEA nails the underwater theme, having sea caves filled with rocks, seaweed and different sea creatures, even including more fantastical aspects such as the giant treasure chests and sunken ships. 

But the best part of this level is the fact that Custi managed to fit in a bossfight into the mix, in the form of an enormous eel that follows you while you barely escape it's grasp, which is reminiscent of the eel that was in SM64. Overall this is an enjoyable experience and I can't wait to see what comes next.

LftO_nFJMOY.title: "Fall Apart" 100% (Demon) by Bli | Geometry Dash
LftO_nFJMOY.description:
ID: 70511594
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/976432
bli: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3HAsAJaHumVypeYI3F-0VQ

Fall Apart is a level that takes you on an adventure, taking you through different places inside of an even bigger environment, and when this concept is well-executed, it really adds a sense of scale to what you're playing and makes the level feel that much more vivid. Throughout you're playthrough, you'll visit various places such as the workshop, the kitchen and the library, each one with it's own unique gameplay, especially in the library where you are in place and must dodge everything that starts falling from above without losing all of your health, which is a welcome change of pace and was very fun. 

Every section here tends to follow the same design the entire way through, so there aren't any sudden changes in decoration which I think was a good choice so it looks consistent and supports the idea of being in a larger space. You can tell that Bli put a ton of work into this and it does show, so try this out if you get the chance.

utim7mVmIWY.title: (Extreme Demon) ''PPPPPPPPPPPPPPPPIXEL'' 100% by Renn241 | Geometry Dash
utim7mVmIWY.description:
ID: 69729105
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/891009
Renn241: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_M7L9OVg1XzTXEnPuJVBvA

Sometimes you can tell that a level is going to be full of style from the very beginning, and this is one of them, and to top it off it was built in only 2 days, which makes it all the more impressive. Pixel effects, at least for me, never get old, especially when they're done well, it lends itself really well for fast-paced and exciting gameplay, while being visually pleasing, with a ton of different colors and objects flying across the screen in sync to the music. The block design is what you would expect, filled with pixels and squares of different sizes, of various hues, moving very rapidly simulating a static effect and while there isn't muich when it comes to backgrounds, the vignette effect that was used covers it up.

3VzOQ_7wSgk.title: (Insane Demon) ''Rearmed'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
3VzOQ_7wSgk.description: A rebeat of a classic level from KrmaL, one that you can recognize just from listening to the first 3 seconds of the song, Rearmed had some great effects for the time, and while the design has aged, it still has some great elements, especially the giant beating heart in the background, which looks great and fit the theme of the level as well. This is one that should definitely be enjoyed in full quality.

scw4TGu2gug.title: ''Buh'' 100% (Demon) by MazZedy & More | Geometry Dash
scw4TGu2gug.description:
ID: 71084738
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/509014
MazZedy: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwOy1naLBE55xzaOXgkeQeA

Buh is a new Insane Demon collab hosted by MazZedy, with PDKGD making the layout that was later decorated by a bunch of talented creators, including MazZedy, that is officially the sequel to Dak, that was also worked on by PDKGD and GDNeoz along with a different set of decorators, and after 3 months of work it really payed off, the design for this is fantastic, the effects are consistent in quality and quantity, including some glitch effects, and various monsters and objects moving around following you onscreen with smooth animations, and the dark and brooding atmosphere along with the Silent Hill remix work great together, elevating the slightly creepy vibe even further.

GEykS9KGkTI.title: ''Flat Major'' 100% (Demon) by Metalface221 & JakeN2436 | Geometry Dash
GEykS9KGkTI.description: Another classic, with gameplay from Jake, decoration by Metalface and the fantastic endscreen done by Visionary, this is one of those levels that should be preserved in all of it's glory, with it's dark and golden aesthetic coupled with some fast paced wave gameplay, brought to life by two very talented individuals.

UroyNbvuimw.title: ''ROTTEN VALE'' 100% (Demon) by Custi | Geometry Dash
UroyNbvuimw.description:
ID: 70579305
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/798648
Custi: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9czG6YV6t6-bLz9fLmOqrw


This level is what I imagine is the closest we'll ever get to playing Doom in Geometry Dash, the atmosphere is off the charts in this, the hellish landscape is done very well, when it comes to the lava flowing on the ground that animates smoothly, the enormous fires emanating in the backgrounds and the scorched block design bring everything together nicely. I will say the design and layout does get a bit repetitive towards the half, but after the boss comes in it starts changing things up. 

Speaking of the boss, the giant creature made up of fire shown as Vulcanalis has a simple yet effective design, being a type of worm, it's design stays consistent from head to toe, it's movements are smooth and it does manage to stand out among the rest of the design, with the health bar being a nice touch.

After you've beaten the boss there is a tiny bit more, the screen fades to white and you find yourself in a more peaceful setting, with watterfalls and trees surrounding you, which is a nice contrast and a good way to end it off imo.

IjS3E3FD1Fg.title: ''VOGUE'' 100% (Demon) by Presta | Geometry Dash
IjS3E3FD1Fg.description:
ID: 70667617
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/933688
Presta: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCO0_ag61Nz1eSoBbyTe_rzA

VOGUE is one of many levels that makes me question how it's even possible or viable to create on mobile, let alone make something as good as this, but here we are. You could sum this level up as a relaxing and satisfying experience from start to finish, but there is a lot more detail than what you can see at first glance. The color combinations work great, the dark purples and blues that fill the background work as a contrast to the more vibrant accents that can be seen on the dark obstacles in the foreground.

This level is a testament to the fact that even when there are limitations, you can make great things, and this is in my opinion, Presta's best work, so give it a try if you get the chance.

J90L73YOR3k.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Cataclysm'' 100% by Ggb0y [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
J90L73YOR3k.description: If you were to make a Legendary Demons list that included some of the most impactful levels to ever be released, you would have to put Cataclysm up there. A level that is important for so many people, including myself, having beaten it over 3 years ago, it still is one of my proud achievements in this game, and it certainly deserves to be rebeaten and reuploaded in 4K, a fantastic level, that new players aspire to beat as one of their first few extremes and that older players can remember.

63sr55FXqsI.title: ''Poltergeist'' 100% (Demon) by Andromeda GMD | Geometry Dash
63sr55FXqsI.description: An Extreme that I beat on stream almost exactly 4 years ago, which is crazy to think about since it doesn't feel like it was too long ago, but this level was a blast to beat again, it is one of those that instills a bit of nostalgia while playing, reminding you of simpler times. But I couldn't go without giving this classic the 4K treatment, hope you all enjoy watching this in the best quality possible.

dvoGyFs9EK8.title: ''Sideways 8'' 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax & More | Geometry Dash
dvoGyFs9EK8.description:
Name: Sideways 8 by Cirtrax & More
Level ID: 70794278
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1048844

SIDEWAYS 8 is a collab by Cirtrax and many more, that shines above the rest for its black and white theme, with some RGB splitting and shifts in between. Even though this level is incredibly fast-paced, with the exception of the short buildup in the beginning, you are able to appreciate every bit of detail that was packed into this, the contrasting colors only helping this effect. This is one of those levels that I can't really attribute anything bad to, it doesn't miss a beat when it comes to sync, and the design is fantastic in my opinion. My favorite section would have to be 0:52 and beyond, the giant flower that shows up in the background is beautiful and the animation for it is really smooth and all of the effects that come after this, the hundreds of symbols flying across the screen are mesmerizing in a way.

ZH_6pzUbRZ4.title: [2.0] ''The Badland'' 100% (Demon) by Edicts [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
ZH_6pzUbRZ4.description: A level that was considered one of the best when it was initially released, and to many was their favorite bossfight at the time, The Badland was and still is in my opinion an extremely enjoyable level. You could even go as far as to say that some aspects have aged well, the effects, the colors and some of the animations still look good, considering so much time has passed, and there have been various remakes and remixes of this level so that alone should be a testament to it's popularity.

QE3oVDW-jUM.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Sigma Interface'' 100% by Platnuu | Geometry Dash
QE3oVDW-jUM.description:
ID: 62551239
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/922309
Platnuu: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCv0Lp2X6BchO8ujfmbASa2Q

Sigma Interface is the sequel to Delta interface, also from Platnuu. A minute long Extreme with a very prominent purple design that is brought to life with a ton of small and intricate details when it comes to block design. The mix of different shades of purple at different brightness works well to make certain parts of the design stand out above others, whether it's to accent something in the design or make a section easier to read, and that's without mentioning the bits of bright yellow we get here and there. 

But I think the best part about this is the block design, it's where most of the detail is found, being practically different anywhere you look, it's varied and uses glow to it's advantage. To top it all off, the endcard looks amazing, you can tell a ton of objects went into that.

gliPAvWvXtQ.title: ''Clubstep Reborn'' 100% (Demon) by BoyOfTheCones [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash

cZwf8-CcYZk.title: ''Star Party'' 100% (Demon) by Dominuus & Marwec | Geometry Dash
cZwf8-CcYZk.description: A collab between the very talented Dominuus, who did the design for this level and Marwec who did some of the gameplay. specifically the drop. I really enjoy the color combinations in this, the different purples, blues and pinks in tune with the yellow work well, while the black and white contrasting between themselves add another layer of detail, complementing the color palette. Another thing I enjoy about this level is how alive and upbeat it is, with the fast-paced song that was chosen, it lends itself to a ton of different effects and movements, making the sync extra satisfying.

w-OyrxnpQ_4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Glide'' 100% by Crohn44 | Geometry Dash
w-OyrxnpQ_4.description: An Extreme Demon that was released just over 2 years ago, a good balance when it comes to difficulty and enjoyability, with a very dreamy and mesmerizing design, and an epic soundtrack that wraps everything together up nicely. I really like the way the dark obstacles collide with the various shades of red, pink, purple and white, it makes for a satisfying contrast. The buildup that begins from the start of the level serves it's purpose well, being slow and calm, but the drop is definitely my favorite part, all of the colors go absolutely crazy and there are so many animations and effects going on at the same time, it's great to look at.

2DJk_BxNK7U.title: ''Last Abyss'' 100% (Demon) by TroxxP1 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
2DJk_BxNK7U.description: It's always a pleasure to see how themes that we've seen countless times and are basically the go-to, continue to evolve and get better and better throughout the years, the Hell theme in particular and this level is the perfect example of that. The more vibrant reds and oranges, the slightly cartoony art style that doesn't try to take the atmosphere or itself to seriously makes these types of levels feel like a breath of fresh air from the norm. The backgrounds are definitely the star of the show, with the art grabbing your attention more than once when you play it, whether it's the giant cross, the beating heart or the 3 headed demon watching over you, there is a ton of detail and attention put into these aspects and it shows, with the final animated sequence being the perfect way to end it off.

SYG6UZUBsfE.title: ''Dream'' 100% (Demon) by Rawin | Geometry Dash
SYG6UZUBsfE.description: Levels that have a certain duality to them are some of my favorites, the perfect example being Peaceful, that starts off as a relaxing and slow-paced adventure, that takes a dark turn when you least expect it, levels that keep you on your toes at all times are a joy to play, and this does it every step of the way. The glitchy and abrasive effects when you transition from a beautiful landscape to a hellish nightmare are great, their smooth and terrifying all in one. There are many different block designs throughout the level, ranging from simple hand drawn obstacles, to more serious and symmetrical shapes that look a lot more threatening.

jJIcx44_4-8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Deception Dive'' 100% by Rustam & More | Geometry Dash
jJIcx44_4-8.description: Yet another rebeat for quality, this one's a classic, the fifth Extreme Demon I ever beat, from the first few seconds of the song, you can tell what level it is, this is a pretty nice megacollab, though inconsistent in gameplay, it's still fun.

w9QgHZVTuXc.title: ''Escuro'' 100% (Demon) by Classic10 | Geometry Dash
w9QgHZVTuXc.description: A level with an incredibly unique theme and atmosphere, being mysterious but at the same time creepy in some sections, especially when it comes to the giant insect monsters that appear to be following you through the backgrounds that vaguely remind me of Hollow Knight, with the smooth animations that were created for them only amplifying the creepiness. The monochromatic color scheme that was used for this fits really well in my opinion, since it gives every aspect of the decoration a nice contrast and makes it all feel like a bad nightmare, including the various glitch effects. This is level is a fascinating experience and you should try it out.

pQc8KL-n20Y.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Blade of Justice'' 100% by Manix648 & LazerBlitz | Geometry Dash
pQc8KL-n20Y.description: One of the greatest Extreme Demons of all time, a level that 2-3 years ago I wouldn't even dream of attempting, but this time around I've managed to finish it in a single day. A staple of what Geometry Dash is, with it's older and newer elements, the royal blue mixed with a bright and vibrant white, the varied block designs throughout the level, ranging from classy yet simple, to more complex and aggressive and the beautiful background that appears at 1:08 that just ties the entire theme together and serving it's purpose of a break zone well too. I really enjoyed playing it and finally being able to say I beat it.

kecIs-61WOo.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Cosmorush 21'' 100% by Pennutoh [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
kecIs-61WOo.description: Got 79% on this in 2018 and never touched it again, feels great to have this done now. The simple design and color scheme is the perfect example of "If it isn't broken, don't fix it", especially when it comes to the elegant backgrounds that show up at 0:22, the spiral and flower pattern looks fantastic with the vibrant red hue covering it, and if it's your first time playing it, it might even distract you from the gameplay.

SwcFG6bAVsU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Red World Rebirth'' 100% by Riot | Geometry Dash
SwcFG6bAVsU.description: Another rebeat for better quality and audio, this was fun to do again. One of the classic all red and black extreme demons, with it's simple design and easily recognizable soundtrack, I'd say this is a must try if you want to start getting into beating extremes.

6KvgiKA3bLQ.title: [2.0] ''Fusion II'' 100% (Demon) by Manix648 | Geometry Dash
6KvgiKA3bLQ.description: One of the best levels that came out in the 2.0 era of this game, and it's Manix, what more can you say, the master of making epic levels, always nailing the atmosphere and vibe of his creations, and this is no exception, some people say that just sticking to one single color for the entire level will make it boring or repetitive, but the fiery orange in contrast with the deep black work perfectly with the mechanical theme, and ultimately make the bossfight so much more satisfying.

OORTa66iwFg.title: [2.2] ''Fresh'' by AldoraGDPS | Geometry Dash
OORTa66iwFg.description: Probably the best Friday Night Funkin' recreation I've seen until now, the animations are on point, with each frame being unique and true to the FnF style and vibe, along with the background with the cube sitting on the boombox, the grey cityscape completing the big picture, all of this wrapped up in the great soundtrack from the original game.

TNikugMGZGc.title: ''Slozhno Lvl'' by MaFFaKa | Geometry Dash
TNikugMGZGc.description: A level that is what I imagine to be the closest we could get to having Hotline Miami in Geometry Dash, the only thing that was missing was the fighting, but apart from that, the colors, the music, the atmosphere, even the character selection screen pay a fantastic homage to the already classic game. There are 10 stages in total, each one increasing in length and because of that, difficulty, apart from the fact that the control takes a bit of getting used to, since you have to click to move forward, but doing so changes the direction of the spin, so you have to take that into account if you want to move fast, and if you want all 3 coins, you'll have to.

fzmWQQ_t7bc.title: [2.2] ''Particle Effects II'' by PepinoCosmico | Geometry Dash
fzmWQQ_t7bc.description:
2.2 GDPS by Blaze: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfPtuop90e_JzxPkiZ6Q5Q

To be honest I didn't expect to see another level like this so soon, but here I am, sitting in awe at the amazing detail these effects have, I can't over the fact that all of these particles look like they're from a completely different game, the day that effects like the ones in this level become the norm, we will truly be in a whole new era of Geometry Dash.

OpMUMQx_HbQ.title: [4k] ''Utopian Delusions'' 100% (Demon) by Nahuel2998 & Shaday97 | Geometry Dash
OpMUMQx_HbQ.description: Rebeat for quality, love this level

fOEM7d8w6Ec.title: ''Phantasmagoria'' 100% (Demon) by Zest | Geometry Dash
fOEM7d8w6Ec.description: Felt like playing a nine circles level today, then I found this level that's still unrated after a year, not perfect but still rate worthy for sure, the effects are what sell this to me, the great sync it has, having a sort of equalizer effect on the interior of the obstacles, the block design is very detailed, having different shapes and patterns in each section, all while changing colors frequently to keep things fresh. There isn't much when it comes to the backgrounds, but with everything that's going in front and center makes up for that really well.

deIE-wBqCbA.title: ''The Hydragaryu'' 100% (Demon) by Manix648 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
deIE-wBqCbA.description: A remake by Manix of one of his own levels, The Yatagarasu, where he remade the boss and some other aspects of the original, making it even more iconic. I wanted to re-upload this as well so it could be seen in the highest quality possible, so every detail can be seen. Both are older levels at this point, but I truly believe they stand the test of time quite well, especially this one, having a set of fantastic bossfights with different dragons that looks amazing, with fluid animations and vibrant attacks, each looking varied from the previous, all wrapped up in a setting that has a really neat atmosphere.

HF6IQg9gYXI.title: ''Omega Cosmos'' by quid68954002663 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
HF6IQg9gYXI.description: A remake of one of my favorite levels, Alpha Cosmos by Zenthic Alpha and FunnyGame, a remake created by somebody who has the same amount of love and respect for the original, quid manages to create a tribute worthy of being called a true remake, keeping what made the original as good as it was, while adding some newer elements here and there to give it a touch up for more modern times, and I have to say it is a success, when you can breathe new life into an older level, it's both a testament to the history of this game and talent as well.

HE2UiNpTYTo.title: ''Plasma Dominator'' 100% (Demon) by PlasmaGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash

0LNtPLfQsIk.title: ''Bliss'' 100% (Demon) by Buragoz & Marwec | Geometry Dash
0LNtPLfQsIk.description: Not sure what to call this but this is genuinely one of the most fun levels I've ever played

l4JBaKp__kE.title: "Crystal Corridor" 100% (Demon) by Knots [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
l4JBaKp__kE.description:
ID: 69954089
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/844801

Crystal Corridor is the newest level released by the already established and insanely talented creator, Knots, definitely one of the best when it comes to art and design, always managing to create satisfying atmospheres and ambiances with a ton of personality and charm. The crystal theme is executed perfectly, with a ton of variation from section to section, using so many different colors to breathe life into every bit of decoration, driven by the backgrounds that have a great depth to them, having several layers of detail everywhere you look, wrapped up in some very smooth animations. You can tell when a level is something special, from the moment you feel immersed, if it is capable of taking you to a whole different space or world, with it's own beings and structures, feeling grounded but surreal at the same time, and this level has that and a ton more.

CaYcZbAfYeU.title: ''The Only One'' 100% (Demon) by Dienid | Geometry Dash
CaYcZbAfYeU.description:
ID: 69353268
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/977184

The Only One looks and feels like the closest thing to a Geometry Dash Music Video we could get, from the aesthetics, the buildup, the epic soundtrack, the drop with all the effects that Dienid created and implemented for this, which are on a completely different level, especially the infinite reflection effect seen at 0:37, an amazingly unique effect that gives off a ton of personality and was just a great idea all around. The effects that come before and after this section are similar, being hectic and all over the place, fit the theme perfectly, feeling like your going through a storm, trying to reach the end so you can make it out alive. It's a great concept executed in a great way.

yFwPswAfvqw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''HyperSonic'' 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
yFwPswAfvqw.description: One of the most important levels for me personally and for this channel as well, I still remember all the streams I did when I first attempted to beat this, and to all the people that were there when I did, thank you for going along with me for the ride, and even if you just found out about me through this video, I appreciate each and every one of you. This is another level I've decided to rebeat so I could have a high quality archive of it, though this is a level that already shows it's age but it's still incredibly fun to play in my opinion.

h4XE5xQmO-s.title: A Memorable Note by Zoroa | Geometry Dash
h4XE5xQmO-s.description:
A truly beautiful level, A tribute to the life of a person that was important to so many people, an icon, an inspiration and a friend to so many should be, from the music to the presentation, the soft and subtle effects, the dark colors, everything fits together perfectly and you couldn't ask for more, the message that this level conveys is an important one and the story that it portrays is true to life and told in a fantastic way, I don't know what else to say other than thank you Zoroa.

We'll miss you Michigun. ∆∆∆

Sm7bfxygSGE.title: ''Hypocrisy'' 100% (XL Demon) by FunnyGame [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash

izdpReFMPXg.title: "The White Knight" 100% by KittyDoge | Geometry Dash
izdpReFMPXg.description: Decided to reupload this level in 4k because I absolutely love it and it hasn't been rated in 9 months. The pixel art is masterful, being simple in concept but very complex in it's execution, bringing forth so much detail and personality to all of the characters shown, brought to life by incredibly smooth animations that just elevate the metroidvania vibe to a whole new height.

PrN3EVKs5zk.title: [2.0] (Extreme Demon) ''Retention'' 100% by Woogi1411 | Geometry Dash
PrN3EVKs5zk.description: I decided to rebeat one of my favorite Demons from 2.0, a level that is beloved by so many people, by one of the greatest creators to ever grace this game, a reminder of the simpler times, a relic that paved the way for so many other amazing levels and creators that maybe wouldn't exist without this level.

pM0B0PPlx2c.title: ''Eternal Flame'' 100% (Demon) by James | Geometry Dash
pM0B0PPlx2c.description: Eternal Flame is a Demon that despite being relatively fast-paced, is surprisingly relaxing to watch and play, the design is very clean and slightly futuristic in some sections, backed up by an ethereal soundtrack, the colors are managed in a satisfying way as well, the shifts in between hues are smooth and make sense, making for some nice combinations, changing to the beat of the song as well, which adds to the overall atmosphere and vibe of the level.
