The block design is on the simpler side, but at the same time, has a ton of small details that help to distinguish in between sections with the different styles and decorations. All of this covered in great effects as well, the particles and the lighting especially, really driving forward the "dreamy" feel this entire level has.

93rdESI1IFo.title: ''Horizon'' by Zhiana | Geometry Dash
93rdESI1IFo.description:
ID: 68846058
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/912103

Horizon by Zhiana is a level that is just under 5 minutes long, but for all acounts and purposes, feels too short, since you find yourself mesmerized by the aesthetic, the design, and the fanastic sync with the music, that all come together to form a satisfying experience, especially in the second half right until the end, where the build up pays off and a bunch of new effects, especially the one at 3:25 that simulates vertical gameplay, which was a great idea and added to the fun factor of the level.

K_Tjjzbc5W4.title: ''Coeur Lambeaux'' by Dyzex | Geometry Dash
K_Tjjzbc5W4.description:
Coeur Lambeaux by Dyzex is in my opinion, a masterpiece, an experience, from wherever you look at it, there is so much intricate detail and attention put into this, a level that has beautiful contrasts, both in it's design and the atmosphere, starting off slow and cute in way, with lively colors and and upbeat soundtrack that wraps everything together in a soft voice, that slowly takes a darker turn in the second half, reminding me of those dreams that are soothing and relaxing at first, only to turn into a horrible nightmare towards the end as we wake up in a cold sweat. 

With so many different colors together to create a lush landscape landscape, combining together light and dark hues, all contained inside beautiful shapes and patterns. And all of that is without even mentioning the art, which is my favorite part of this level, being incredibly varied, and well-made, but most importantly, full of emotion, it isn't just random drawings floating around in the background, the backgrounds are telling a story, and you can tell from the very beginning, where it's calm and smooth, growing more erratic as time goes by, this is what makes a level feel alive to me.

Level ID: 69582529
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/910975

ebshN28FDWE.title: [2.2] ''Badland Full Version'' by Music Sounds | Geometry Dash
ebshN28FDWE.description: Badland Full Version is a level that came out a while ago, but even looking at it today, it seems like something from the future, showcasing only a small portion of things that will be possible in 2.2, the camera control, free movement, and even some small platforming, making for a fun "preview" of what's to come, and being almost 5 minutes long, you get a lot of it, all wrapped up into an exciting and refreshing experience. I truly believe these tools and everything else that will come out are going to bring Geometry Dash into a completely new era, and breathe new life into the community, and I can't wait.

uXvmDODwci0.title: ''Deathstep III'' 100% (Demon) by RehanZ | Geometry Dash
uXvmDODwci0.description:
Deathstep III is the newest level coming to us from the already well known and incredibly talented RehanZ. The deathstep series is the perfect example of how a creator can grow and learn new tecniques to shape their own unique style, with the first level of the series having a much simpler approach when it came to the block design and the details in the art and backgrounds, with the second, which I uploaded over a year ago being a clear improvement and a step in the right direction in every aspect. 

Now when it comes to the newest installment, the same can be said again, this is the cleanest by far, with the styllized art and rounded edges on the decoration are most prominent, and that's what gives it personality, along with the unique gameplay elements such as the elevator or the red flashlight that appears at the end. All of this together makes for a very enjoyable experience, and a great sequel to the other 2 levels.

NEHG9qHZxXo.title: [2.2] ''Particle Effects'' by PepinoCosmico | Geometry Dash
NEHG9qHZxXo.description:
2.2 GDPS by Blaze: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcfPtuop90e_JzxPkiZ6Q5Q

Levels like these that utilize tools that will be available in 2.2, only make me more excited for when it releases, and this is just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to the things that will be possible when the update comes out. Incredibly impressive stuff.

NKAbyWaAI8w.title: [2.0] ''InsanitY'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Serponge [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
NKAbyWaAI8w.description:
One of my favorite levels that came out in 2.0, and this year will be it's 5th birthday, which is incredible when you take a step back as to how fast time goes by. Considered a classic by many, many players, including myself, so much so that I decided to beat it again and upload it in the highest quality possible, so it's enjoyable in it's full splendor by as many people as possible.

One of Serponge's many masterpieces, and XXL Demon that's full of style and personality, whether it's from the music and it's sync, the pieces of art and the simple backgrounds, or the sleek animations such as the one at 2:11.

This level was amazing for it's time, and it still is, so I think it's important that we remember just how long we've come and how creators keep evolving and take inspiration from levels such as these.

#geometrydash

VgD_NSOxgok.title: Brainfugd by Spu7nix | Geometry Dash
VgD_NSOxgok.description: Spu7nix is one of the most creative creators that this game has ever had, and has already become a legend in his own right, every thing he puts out is even more amazing than the last, composing levels that to a regular player shouldn't even be possible, but here we are. Spu7nix managed to integrate a programming language into Geometry Dash, better know as Brainf***, that can only use 8 characters, hence the number of cells that are available, that alone is incredibly impressive, but the fact that he managed to make it interactive and give you missions at the same time just elevates it into a new level. And that's without mentioning the beautiful effects that he created for the backgrounds, having a surreal vibe to it, apart from the 3D effect that makes it feel like you're inside a computer, and the music amplifies this effect even further. If things like these are possible now, I can't wait to see what 2.2 is able to bring to the table.

m1osReVni1Y.title: (Insane Demon) ''SALO'' 100% by IvashkaUA | Geometry Dash
m1osReVni1Y.description: SALO is an Insane Demon that plays with your senses in an interesting and fun way, taking advantage of many different glitch effects that shift, distort and almost corrupt the entire level, all wrapped up in a song that is just as disorienting, all of this adding onto the difficulty without making it difficult just for the sake of it. The level is mostly comprised of a white and black contrast, with some deeper grey tonalities hidden in the backgrounds, accompanied by the popular colors we see in glitch effects like these, green, red, blue and yellow, among some others. The block design is interesting as well, being made up of tons of jagged lines and broken shapes, giving you the sensation that's something isn't quite right. If you're into these types of levels and are looking for a challenge, don't hesitate to give this level a try.

BKyxtM24Bv0.title: ''Daydreamer'' 100% (Demon) by Linus02 & More | Geometry Dash
BKyxtM24Bv0.description: A level that is immensely satisfying to play and watch, an Easy Demon that I would describe as clean and to the point. The usage of so many different shades and hues of purple, pink and blue, among many, many others is done tastefully here, put together with all of the lighting effects, the flashes and sudden dimming in certain areas in sync with the music is great attention to detail. That being said, I do feel the final section drops a bit in quality, looking a bit empty compared to the rest, but I believe this was done for a CC so it was done quickly. Speaking of the music, meganeko is always a fantastic choice for levels that are fast paced and varied as well, and this is no exception, the great buildup with the drop changing the song into a more rock oriented piece gives the level a more epic feeling to it, and separates each section quite well in the process.

_L-SMRua_jc.title: ''HellisH SparK'' 100% (Demon) by Wintter [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
_L-SMRua_jc.description: A solo level that was made in just 7 hours, which by itself is an impressive feat, something not everyone can do, but this isn't just some layout that was decorated willy-nilly just to release it as fast as possible, there is obviously thought and a ton of effort that went into this, the hell theme was executed in a great way, the lighting along with the vibrant reds, yellows and oranges give off the feeling of heat, combined with all of the smaller particles that emulate ash and amber eminating from all the fire, the atmosphere is very present and the music was a great choice as well, being the driving force for the rest of the decoration. If something of this quality can be put out in such a short amount of time, then I can't wait to see what Wintter comes up with next.

LVMokAJhg9w.title: ''Beautiful Brushes'' 100% by Furorem [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
LVMokAJhg9w.description: A creation unlike anything I've ever seen, from the music, to the art style, all of the hundreds of beautiful colors, I guess the title does make the level justice, Beautiful Brushes can be described simply as a relaxing experience, something that can take us back to simpler times, when we would wait for art class or draw and color in our free time when we were younger, and if something like that was the intention for this level, then Furorem hit the nail on the head. Something that's special about this is the fact that it isn't just different colored lines all crumpled together, there is a different style in each section, whether it's the watercolor in the beginning, to the color pencil strokes and then onto what appears to be paper mache at the end, every section has something special to it and feels like a different piece of art all on it's own.

x6hhuplCCoU.title: ''War Of The Worlds'' 100% (Demon) by IlHyperBotlI & Xine101 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
x6hhuplCCoU.description: A level that truly shines for it's design, especially the bosses, having a sleek style and great art that combines well with the colors they implemented, the block design also fits really well with the otrher aspects of the design, being mechanical in some parts and more gritty and alien-like in others, not to mention the asteroids that show up in the beginning. Also the gloomy apocalyptic vibe that comes off the backgrounds adds to the atmosphere in my opinion, it really does make it feel like the end of the world has arrived and the machines have taken over. The gameplay on the other hand from the bosses was made to be completely noclip after some comments about it being unbalanced, so I didn't get to play that version, but I did enjoy the sections that I experienced.

8xHGPMLPM-k.title: ''The Devourer'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Whirl | Geometry Dash
8xHGPMLPM-k.description:
A level themed around Terraria and it's calamity mod, that adds a plethora of items and bosses as well to the base game, and one of them is showcased here, The Devourer. Making something that's based off of another game is tough by itself, but Whirl managed to make this whole experience over 3 minutes long, with a game that has so much detail and nuance such as Terraria and nailed it perfectly. From the backgrounds that show all of the different biomes you can explore even having the parallax effect we're all used to seeing when moving around, to the colors of each section which are colorful and vibrant, just like the original, to the epic final battle against this giant Lovecraftian creature.

The boss is hands down the best part of the level, and not just the bossfight itself, it's the fact that it's appearance is hinted at throughout the entire thing, up to the point where you can see it flying around behind the obstacles, waiting for the perfect moment to strike, I feel this adds to the tension and immerses you so much more into the world. The bossfight is just the icing on the cake, the bosses movements are fluid and accurate, it's design is perfect as well, getting even the smaller detailes right and the addition of a life bar adds to the experience as well.

Overall if you're a fan of Terraria or even if you've never played it before, you should go and play this level as soon as possible.

xob96Hu8jCA.title: ''MindForkOS'' 100% (Demon) by TheRealXFuture [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
xob96Hu8jCA.description: MindForkOS is a level with a very interesting concept that was executed in a great way by it's creator, simulating an entire operating system within the level, including a boot-up screen with tons of different UI messages and processes you would be able to find on your very own PC, and on top of all of this, it has one of the most unique coins I've come across recently, scanning the QR code that shows up at the beginning takes you to a pastebin with custom instructions that Future made himself detailing the features that come with the OS and giving you all the info you need in order to obtain all 5 keys required to get the coin, this is the level of effort that goes above and beyond expectations, and it gives a whole new layer of personality and detail to the level as a whole.

yDTyrOZgLDY.title: FFFFFF by Vlacc | Geometry Dash
yDTyrOZgLDY.description:
A simple, yet satisfying level, sticking to a completely white color scheme from beginning to end, having a relaxing and mellow vibe the entire way through, this is the newest creation from Vlacc, who hadn't released a level in over a year now, so it's nice to see he's still active. 

Some people may find the choice to do a level with just one color, even moreso being white, but the fact that he was stille able to make every bit of design and gameplay visible and even achieving a nice contrast between different elements using different tonalities and saturations of white, along with some darker borders that serve as an outline, is impressive to say the least.

The block design and backgrounds are made up of different shapes mostly, triangles, lines and squares, keeping it simple with a level of this nature is the right call in my opinion, since it would be hard to tell the difference between everything if it was overdecorated, so the subtlety is great.

hE4unVwBeD8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Broken Signal'' 100% by Grax | Geometry Dash
hE4unVwBeD8.description:
Grax has mostly been known for his great work on collaboration levels in the past, but now he has a solo level that he should definitely be proud of, working on it for a while now you can really see the fruits of his work as plain as day all throughout this level, both in design and gameplay as well, being a challenging yet fun experience overall. 

The effects take center stage when diving into this level, being based around glitch effects, which are very hard to implement without comprimising the visibility and playability of a level, but Grax nailed it in my opinion, the effects have cohesion and a sensible build up in tune with the harsh and agressive electronic beat blaring in the background. The inclusion of some text and numbers on different parts of the screen are also a nice addition, adding to the style and atmosphere of the experience, so it does make you feel like you're going through a failing system.

4sHBvU6iI4Y.title: ''Pista Arcobaleno'' 100% (Demon) by RoyalP | Geometry Dash
4sHBvU6iI4Y.description: A beautiful remake of Rainbow Road by Elvii, a level that was already special in it's own way, both fantastic in terms of quality, to the point where it can be hard to choose which you would prefer. It would come down to the gameplay and design aspects of each one, with Pista Arcobaleno having an upgraded and more polished design, while Ranbow Road has more consistent gameplay in my opinion at least. One thing is for sure though, the art that RoyalP created and implemented into his remake is on a completely different level, especially the Bowser and Baby Bowser that show up towards the end, crafted with so much detail while having smooth animations that drive their movements and attacks, all while being surrounded by so many vibrant colors and vivid lighting.

VAbTfMm6Bwc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Annihilation Nation'' 100% by Zylenox | Geometry Dash
VAbTfMm6Bwc.description:
An Extreme Demon that has a lot of style and aesthetic for something that was released 2 years ago, boasting aa mechanical theme with a very agressive soundtrack to back it up, the incredibly vibrant red, yellow and orange hues serve as a great contrast to the brownish grey bodies of these machines. 

The block design is just what you'd expect from a level of this nature, being very robust and menacing in it's own way, while having a bunch of small details inside and outside that give it more personality with each passing section. 

When we look at the backgrounds they're on the simpler side, but they serve their purpose well, being more of a complement to everything that goes on in the foreground, with the mechanical structures and the walls of fire that fill up what would otherwise be empty space.

Gameplay-wise it's on the easier side when it comes to Extremes, with the only harder section is the wave that shows up at the end, otherwise you can tell this is an older level, that being said it's very enjoyable.

IKj-CUOGva8.title: ''Undyne The Undying'' 100% by JustMax1M | Geometry Dash
IKj-CUOGva8.description: One of the best recreations of another game I've seen done in Geometry Dash, a perfect recreation of the Undyne bossfight from the well known and beloved game, Undertale. If you showed this to somebody who's never played the original, you could completely convince them this was ripped out of there, from the movements which in this can be said that are improved, since the animation has been bumped up to 60 FPS, the animations for the attacks and Undyne are incredibly smooth and true to the game, to even the smaller things such as the rain falling down adding onto the ambiance to the attack animation that can be seen as you widdle away her health. If you're a fan of Undertale or even if you've never played it, this is definitely a level you should try, it's incredibly fun and a joy to experience.

le10Vvapvh0.title: ''Dark Odyssey'' 100% (Demon) by JonathanGD | Geometry Dash
le10Vvapvh0.description:
After 4 long years, we have a remake of the level that gave one of the most talented and beloved creators his big break, the level that propelled him into a completely different level among the rest, a complete redo of Dark Travel. 

First things first, it's always incredibly satisfying to see how somebody can grow artistically and creatively as the years go by, gaining more and more experience with every new piece you create, and this is no exception, after many many months of hard work and over a hundred streams where he would build this piece by piece, in order to reach a level of detail that would be surprising for a megacollab, we finally get to play it and enjoy it for what it is, a new and improved version of one of the best levels of it's time, receiving a massive upgrade from start to finish, which already puts it as one of the best of this year. 

The most impressive part to me is the fact that this isn't just a fresh coat of paint on top of an already great level, it's built upon in new ways, using the teqniques he's learned over the years with all of his other amazing levels, pouring it all into the one that started it all, refining the effects, colors, block design, making everything look and feel so much smoother and giving it a hint of difficulty to make it a challenge as well. Overall this is what all remakes should aspire to be and I can't wait to see what's next.

X_ztPgP161I.title: (Insane Demon) ''Eyesore'' 100% by tenzk | Geometry Dash
X_ztPgP161I.description: A unique level, to say the least, Eyesore is basically a 1 and a half minute rave, a level that some people won't be able to play or even watch, since it's such an attack to the senses, but the most impressive part is the fact that you can see as plain as day the amount of attention to detail and effort that was put into this in order to look and feel as jarring as it does. You can also tell it was fun to make this, since it doesn't try to take itself incredibly serious even though it's an Insane Demon, there are a bunch of jokes and references you can spot, such as Among Us and TrollFace. But being as abrasive as it is, it isn't just random lights and colors flashing on top of a layout, there are so many different styles and aesthetics, switching various times from the beginning to the middle of the level, and especially at 0:44 where you go through a dozen different mini sections, each being completely different from one another with many more appearing after this. This level is definitely an Eyesore, but it knows it and it pulls it off fantastically.

W0d8QgCUuDw.title: ''Double Trouble'' 100% (Demon) by RoyalP & NateRaven | Geometry Dash
W0d8QgCUuDw.description: A beautiful XL collab between two incredibly talented creators, with different styles and aesthetics, managing to mesh them together to create something great, with Royal showcasing his fantastic block designs, feeling and looking futuristic, yet elegant, simple yet full of life and detail, while Nate uses effects, including glow and lighiting effects, driving even more the aspects that I mentioned before, even going as far as including a short bossfight in the middle of all this excitement, which also looks very nice, it's simple yet imposing, the colors he used work well with the foreground and the animations are also smooth, all while the excellent music choice brings it all together, elevating the enjoyment you can get out of this level even more.

gyRjfhKYQeU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Down Bass'' 100% by Spectruh [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
gyRjfhKYQeU.description: Honestly had an okay experience with this, gameplay's pretty straight forward in my opinion and it gets consistent decently quick. The part I had the most trouble with was definitely the first dual, luckily that's only in the beginning of the level so it's not too big of a deal. gg :)

wx-WKvKT8Xw.title: ''Beauty Underneath'' 100% (Demon) by kDarko | Geometry Dash
wx-WKvKT8Xw.description:
The final level in the Storyteller Collection from the incredibly talented Darko, being a direct sequel to Angel of Music, and I have to say, this is as good as it gets when it comes to ending a series, the expectations were completely blown out of the water, so much so that you can tell just by playing the first 30 seconds of the level that we can come to expect great things from this creator in the future. 


From the simple things like the color schemes, the elegant and regal, yet rugged red and brown combination that can be seen in the first half of the level, to the mystical blue, white and yellow seen in the latter half, and it doesn't surprise me since the orange and blue combo can be seen in movie posters for some of the most popular movies out there, so these contrasting hues were an excellent choice. 

But that's just speaking about something as basic as color, but there is so much more detail to be found here, just about everywhere you look, there are layers upon layers of work put into this, you could play throughout this level many times and still see something new each time.

DScZ1qK7mjk.title: ''Cinci De Mayo'' 100% (Demon) by Pan & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
DScZ1qK7mjk.description: It's very strange but at the same time kind of nice to see a level that shows any level of Mexican culture and heritage, and even having a sometimes cutesy and jokey style at times, I feel this came out looking fantastic and is a complete joy to play as well. The colors are vibrant and lively, especially in the first two sections, having just about every color you would expect to see in a 5 de mayo celebration, surrounded by a subtle yet powerful glow that gives off a satisfying bloom effect, all while having some very nice art in the backgrounds that add yet another level of detail and personality, whether it's the cute characters with mustaches the moon surrounded by beautiful stars. The block design is very different from section to section, taking into account the colors and overall aesthetic of that specific part, without trying to be the center of attention, and serving more as a complement to everything else that's going on.

4wcU-UTAkVw.title: ''NADRR'' 100% (Demon) by Ardolf | Geometry Dash
4wcU-UTAkVw.description: A level that has a simplistic but at the same time, incredibly clean and satisfying aesthetic, NADDR hits all the marks when it comes to making something that's straight to the point, short and sweet, being fun to play and nice to look at, without going overboard on the decoration. Another aspect about this level that I enjoyed it is the contrast that can be found when you look at the big picture, having 3 major sections, each one being different in their own way but managing to intertwine with one another smoothly, whether it's the thick lines around the obstacles in the beginning, the icy block design with the vibrant purple background or the golden glow that appears in the end, giving you a warm exit to the experience, each of these design choices serving their purpose.

khTHzIWMZj8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''CMYK'' 100% by Ewop & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
khTHzIWMZj8.description: CMYK is an incredibly interesting level, one has been in the works for a little while now that has finally been released, and I have to say this is worth more than the wait. Primarily using the color model that the title suggests, being comprisede of Cyan, Magenta, Yellow and Key, the tones are washed out at the beginning, and while still being recognizable, it has a more monochromatic vibe to it, and the effect that is used here, the way the edges of the block design pop out as vibrant colored lines looks fantastic and adds a lot of style to the decoration in this section, it also serves as a really good buildup towards the final sections, where all of these different colors are flashing and moving around on the screen, which contrasts in a satisfying way with the monotone start.

mFHkcnltXko.title: ''Ablaze'' 100% (Demon) by TheAlmightyWave | Geometry Dash
mFHkcnltXko.description: Ablaze is one of those levels that once you beaten it, you think back and you can say that it has it all, it's satisfying to watch and look at, with it's incredibly smooth animations in the foregrounds, backgrounds and even in the transitions, driven by it's fiery color theme, the different tones of red and orange with some flashes of blue here and there, and some flashy effects to tie it all together. This level throws you into the fray right from the beginning, bombarding you with flashing lights and colors, being in perfect sync with the insanely fast beat, but at the same time on top of relatively slow gameplay, building up slowly through a variety of gameplay modes before getting to the drop where the really good stuff begins, the animations used here as I mentioned before are top tier, the objects flying across the screen, and the fluid movements of the obstacles, elevate this level to a completely different level in my opinion.

uIf7M0ngC6k.title: ''Memories II Redux'' 100% (Demon) by The4n1ma & More | Geometry Dash
uIf7M0ngC6k.description: A level that takes us down memory lane, taking us through a bunch of iconic demons from past versions of the game, such as Phobos, Yatagarasu and many many more, some even being considered the hardest at some point in their lifespan, taking us from one to the next being fast paced in the process, even having some interesting transitions that sync nicely with the music. The designs for these throwbacks are well made, staying true to the originals, while a few look like a slight downgrade, but it's going so fast that you probably won't be able to tell. But apart from that this level as a whole is a great tribute to these levels that have become stepping stones to some that we have today.

YkcYtF_Wi_A.title: ''Blighted Stronghold'' 100% (Demon) by SunCOMoon [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
YkcYtF_Wi_A.description: A level that is a recreation of Count Blecks Castle, the last and final level in Super Paper Mario, and I have to say right off the bat, the execution is near flawless and there are so many layers of detail to appreciate in each and every section, every bit of art that you encounter is a masterful representation of the charm of the original game, the colors being on par with this aspect as well, managing to maintain the eerie vibe that the level has, being mostly dark with some purple to brighten up the sky a bit with a gloomy hue, having some other darker shades of orange and green to give a bit of contrast so it isn't just grey. The block design is elegant, staying on the simpler side as to not clutter the screen with some spikes as obstacles, but what really draws my attention are the spinning fireballs, this really seals the deal when it comes to immersing yourself in the level.

5D5U-e2q05M.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Ulon'' 100% by OliSW | Geometry Dash
5D5U-e2q05M.description: An Extreme Demon that is so colorful and vibrant that it almost distracts you entirely from the gameplay, but in a good way. The colors are beautiful and varied all across the board, with the glow effect around the borders breathing even more life into the overall atmosphere and vibe of the entire experience. There are also some really cool animations that we get to see in the backgrounds, featuring a ton of different shapes and lines that move around in sync with the music, which was also a fantastic choice. Another thing that I enjoy about this level is how the brightness also changes from one section to another, where you become near sighted and the screen flashes along with the beat, adding a bit of difficulty as well.

dlu4Ao9h_wM.title: (Insane Demon) ''Nocturne of Midnight'' 100% by Farva | Geometry Dash
dlu4Ao9h_wM.description: Recently, there have been a couple of Castlevania themed levels, each one with their own take on the aesthetic and atmosphere of the classic game, while staying true to the source material, and this one is no exception. Nocturne of Midnight doesn't take it's name lightly, having a very dark and brooding ambiance, which I think fits this theme and adds a bit of realism, since it would actually be that dark if the only source of light you had was the giant moon floating above you menacingly in the background. The colors don't go overboard either, they stay dark and simple, using some reds, purples and blues to highlight certain objects or serving as a border to the block design.

fhTbWNOz6u4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''GewErbiX'' 100% by Wintter | Geometry Dash
fhTbWNOz6u4.description: An Extreme Demon that has a lot more style and personality than you would expect from a level of this difficulty, looking and feeling like you're riding through a rainbow or looking through a Kaleidoscope, not having a single boring moment or a pause the entire way, the transitions are fantastic and the animations that come with them as well,  especially the bits of text that appear and float on screen, in sync with the music, having a ton of fluid motion behind them, being as erratic as all of the color changes and all of the lighting effects going on in both the foreground and background, but at the same time, they don't affect the gameplay in a negative way, being short and to the point, while still being flashy in their own way.

7OJtNJZdoB0.title: ''Eta Carinae'' 100% (Demon) by Xatz [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
7OJtNJZdoB0.description: A short level that takes advantage of the glow effect to it's fullest potential, combined with very bright and saturated tones, that lend themselves to provide a vibrant and stylized experience, featuring some color combinations that are beautiful as well, in the beginning with the pink and blue that give off a vaporwave-esque vibe, that slowly shifts to a more powerful red and purple or the green and yellow that appears after the drop, it never looks or feels mismatched at all. The backgrounds are also a major positive for this level, being varied from section to section, whether it's the shooting stars followed by the giant red sun, or the more abstract lines we get to see in the final section, every bit of decoration has it's place and serves it's purpose, breathing life into the galactic theme that is presented.

zhD89VPiTik.title: (Insane Demon) ''CHROMA'' 100% by Renn241 | Geometry Dash
zhD89VPiTik.description: An Insane Demon that attacks your senses right from the get-go, starting off relatively slow, with low lighting and a very nicely timed sync with the pulses and music, the best part being the buildup it serves as, since as the level keeps moving forward you get the sense that something big is about to happen as it keeps getting more intense and then the drop hits, exploding with sound and color in spectacular fashion, to the point where it can become difficult to see where you are. The block design specifically is my favorite aspect of this section, it has a sort of crystallized effect, with a ton of different colors wrapped around in shapes and lines going absolutely crazy, fitting perfectly with the music.

3DZc663qPPg.title: ''Wubister II'' 100% (Demon) by Gachristian1 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
3DZc663qPPg.description: A level that's just a relaxing experience from beginning to end, being driven by it's beautiful and vibrant colors surrounded by a subtle yet imposing glow, with a nice variety when it comes to backgrounds as well, adding another layer of detail, with every section having a unique block design and color scheme, even using some 3D effects on the obstacles in the beginning. We also get a bit of art in the backgrounds with different shapes and lines appearing intermittently and the underwater section close to the end as well which has a very calming ambient, being surrounded by bubbles while moving at a slow pace. This is definitely a level that you can just sit back and appreciate all the small details that make it a relaxing experience.

B9RLFaI9Q3A.title: (Insane Demon) ''woOoO'' 100% by Zodacx | Geometry Dash
B9RLFaI9Q3A.description:
An insane demon that has a lot more style than you'd think, being just under a minute long, the effects that you'll encounter while playing this are some of the most mesmerizing I've seen recently, although being an Insane Demon, you'll probably be more focused on not dying than the decoration. Starting off with a completely grey color scheme, the level quickly breaks out of this shell, taking you on a joruney through a bright pink landscape, with some other colors sprinkled in between, and in order to contrast this, the block design is mostly white or dark, making it easier to see where you're going, which is essential for a level of this nature. 

That being said, the effects that are implemented into the background are definitely the best part, there are so many lines and objects shifting around that create what you could call optical illusions, and a 3d perspective, almost feeling like an equalizer you'd see on Windows Media Player back in the day, giving a nostalgic feeling, personally, so overall this looks fantastic all around, and if you're into more difficult levels, I suggest you give it a shot.

tWxZPc1DYMg.title: [Update Verified] ''Omicron'' 100% (Extreme Demon) by Team Proxima | Geometry Dash
tWxZPc1DYMg.description: Here it is, the balance update that hopefully will make this more playable. the first version had a lot of issues with the first 20% being way harder than the rest of the level so we significantly changed it and a couple more spots in the other half. As someone who also played the first version I can say this was way more consistent and fun to play in comparison, I don't know what this is gonna place now but I hope it isn't too far down since I took 15k+ attempts to verify. Thank you Splash for giving me another opportunity to verify and the people who helped with this update :)

3nZq3mLhu30.title: GenePlay by Cronibet | Geometry Dash
3nZq3mLhu30.description: Levels that simulate the behind the scenes of Geometry Dash are some of my favorite, creations like Player vs. Creator quickly come to mind when talking about autos like this. The animations that were made for this are incredibly smooth, while still having a lot of weight to them, but my favorite part about this is the theme, you basically go through a short selection screen where you get to pick what you want your level to have and look like, and once you're inside, you get to see each version of Geometry Dash up until now, how the designs have changed so much with every tool that has been added, giving a small hint of nostalgia when you see just how far this game has come over the years.

v9J7PHs_VAY.title: ''TuSOvKa KreVetKa'' 100% (Demon) by Wintter & More [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
v9J7PHs_VAY.description: A collab between Wintter and a handful of other extremely talented creators, a level that is very well crafted, having a clean design the entire way through, having a similar vibe from beginning to end, while still managing to feel different and unique in every section, whether it be the block design, switching between an older classic aspect to a more modern take, taking advantage of a wide variety of colors, using vibrant and lively tones to bring out the design a bit more, even managing to look a bit surreal with the giant shrimp holding a rocket launcher that you have to fight towards the end, all of this combined in just over a minute can be a lot to take in, but it results in a short and sweet experience, a level that is pleasing to the eyes and is fun to play.

WudqsU779L0.title: ''Screen Punk'' 100% (Demon) by Rawin [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
WudqsU779L0.description:
This level is short and sweet, throwing you straight into the fray from the beginning, that results in it being just over a minute of fun gameplay and a clean design, the latter being 8-bit and pixelated, that serves it's purpose of bringing out and highlighting the vibrant colors that are used just about everywhere, being tied together with the music that is just as intense and upbeat as just about everything else that's happening on screen.

The block design has various different styles, each one being unique in it's own way, while still fitting in with the rest of the decoration in their respective sections, but at the same time their all simplistic, which I feel was the perfect choice for a level that has a pixelated style. The effects are definitely the star of this level, from the small things such as little borders that appear when you click an orb or quick glitch effects that at the same time cover the level in scanlines, to the more prominent effects such as lighting and the transitions, all of these adding a ton of personality and detail to the whole experience.

There is also a relatively short bossfight that we find ourselves in towards the final stretch of the level, where we fight an alien from Space Invaders, it's design is spot on, the attacks are clean and the life bar at the bottom is a nice touch.

VwPZSj9vA4c.title: ''Temple of Time'' 100% (Demon) by DavJT | Geometry Dash
VwPZSj9vA4c.description: A level that is truly special, DavJT started working on this a couple of years ago but gave on it after some time, but ultimately decided recently to finish it and release it as a tribute for his friend, his comrade, somebody that is incredibly important to many people and the entire community, somebody that will never be forgotten, Michigun, and this creation is an homage to all of the Temple levels, a series that was amazing for it's time and will go down in history, if there were such a thing as a Geometry Dash museum, those levels would be center stage. Dav kept the original style and vibe of these levels, their charm being found in their simplicity, in this case only giving them a bit of a touch up here and there and to me, that is the best way to pay tribute to the work of someone you admire.

C6NnThdjVIQ.title: ''Conformity'' 100% (Demon) by HTigerzGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
C6NnThdjVIQ.description:
A level that has an epic feeling to it, from the very beginning when you find yourself in a rainy cityscape at night, evelating yourself more and more as the level goes on, taking you as far as the sky will take you, eventually being able to see stars and comets flying beside you, all the while in complete sync with the beautiful soundtrack, truly making this creation feel more like a journey, having a clear starting point and an ending, and everything is high quality the entire way through.

The block design is different in each section, but it does stay consistent in quality, being slightly transparent in some areas, specifically in the beginning, and having a more rugged and rocky design towards the end when you're in space, these changes make sense and fit the theme quite well. The effects are mostly lighting, having some flashes here and there, or changing the intensity to fit in with the music. The backgrounds are also one of the highlights here, each one being unique while managing to feel connected with one another, having great art in the process.

HxzIWsgFCjE.title: ''Hue Slider'' 100% (Demon) by TeamHFC | Geometry Dash
HxzIWsgFCjE.description: Hue Slider is one of those mega collabs that is constantly changing, featuring a very wide variety of talented creators, each with their own unique style, being able to show it in any way they want, each one being about 3 seconds long and even though they don't combine or fit together in any way, it's nice to see such a diverse lineup of designs and ideas. Some focus more on the overall design, having some effects and a different block design, having a simplistic and minimalist take or approaching their bit with a ton of microdetails on their blocks and foreground, while others add some art and even a couple of backgrounds, which add a bit more personality to the part, but each one is great in their own right.

vrNZEINlDLo.title: ''Exodus'' 100% (Demon) by qMystic & More | Geometry Dash
vrNZEINlDLo.description: Exodus is a level that was just finished a couple of days ago after months of hard work from Mystic and a team of really talented and underrated creators, featuring more than 10 of them, each one showcasing their ideas and styles freely, and this level manages to combine them in a great way, while still being unique in their own right. The majority of the sections are more effect oriented, focusing more on the color aspects, with some pulses and lighting effects to lighten up the ambiance and add some sync to the music, apart from that it's rather simple when it comes to block design and backgrounds, but even so, the quality of the rest of the design is excellent in my opinion.

fZl-knNnHmU.title: ''Funkin'' 100% (Demon) by Bluskys | Geometry Dash
fZl-knNnHmU.description:
Friday Night Funkin in Geometry Dash, first of all the feel and look of the characters is beyond amazing, the assets were made by torchiczk, phantomarcade and evilsk8r, the boyfriend and girlfriend and the cube guy have style, you truly get the best of both worlds here, the arrows that you would press look 1:1, the way the animation shakes when it presses a key, and the colors are also spot on, in the background look ripped straight from FNF and the sync is also great.

Now the design of the level is a layout style, using basic blocks, spikes and orbs, but if it were decorated or used complicated paths it would obstruct the true star of the level, the background, that being said I think this simpler style really fits, it gives off a more serious and competitive vibe.

The gameplay is also a strong point for me, it's a bit repetitive at times but the fact that it's two player and it shifts from one person to another just as it would in Friday Night was a great choice, the changes are smooth and quick and the sync is also there.

_7H2pF5s1XM.title: ''No Limits'' 100% by TheCheeseNugget [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
_7H2pF5s1XM.description:
No Limits is a level that boasts a very interesting theme, seemingly combining the most popular aspects and meshing them together, you have a mechanical, or robot aesthetic in the block design, even going as far as having some of the obstacles attack you with smooth movements and lasers towards the end, some of the monsters that appear in the background, and the cartoony finish on most of the decoration, having ink black outlines and vibrant colors.

The cute cat bossfight is probably going to be the thing that grabs your attention the fastest, it does look out of place the first time you encounter it, since it isn't everyday you encounter a giant mecha cat, and it's the only piece of the level that is like this, so it doesn't really fit in with the rest of the design, that being said I really liked it, the art is fantastic, it's movements are smooth and the attacks have great effects as well.

36t2cJLbHB8.title: OVCA na kashdy den by DeniPol | Geometry Dash

IHou_bcHxas.title: ''FAST ASLEEP'' 100% (Demon) by Tribbles | Geometry Dash
IHou_bcHxas.description:
From the erratic and desperate beginning, as you go through an almost pitch black corridor, with everything around you moving and glitching, you don't know where you are or how you got there, to the calm and blissful ending, surrounded in puffy white clouds, that drifts you into a blank space, before the journey finally ends. With a section in the very middle of the level, which feels like a sort of intermission, your mind transitioning from one state to the other.

FAST ASLEEP is an experience, the entire levels looks and feels like a giant transition, from a dark and frightening nightmare, to a beautiful dream from which you don't want to wake up, and if that was the idea, then it was executed perfectly. Starting with things as essential as the music, which continues to change from beginning to end, completely carrying the design on it's back as it takes us through the different stages of sleep, highlighting the contrast between the beginning and the end. 

The effects are also one of the main driving points to this, they are so different from one section to the other, that if you were to split them up, they could be their own level, the rapid flashes and movements, and the ever so light fog with clouds all around, every bit serves it's purpose.

Music: Zo by 1f1n1ty 
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/905921

jdhKxiWkoIQ.title: ''3D World'' 100% by GirlyAle02 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
jdhKxiWkoIQ.description: A level that is made to have a 3D perspective, angle and design the entire way through, you can tell 3D World was crafted with extreme care, in order to have the best effect possible, and I think the creator nailed it, the design for the obstacles is well done, it doesn't feel jarring at all when you're traversing through, which if the perspective isn't done correctly can happen, the colors, being mostly light pastel colors, different shades of blue, pink and purple, even some orange and yellow, in conjuction with the overall design and the music, all fit together very well. My favorite part definitely has to be at the beginning when you have to hold the dash orb and it takes you into a loop and the gameplay with the design begin to go backwards, the animation was smooth and it felt interesting as well.

Dt9LeTjK_JE.title: ''PsyWorm'' 100% (Demon) by IvashkaUA | Geometry Dash
Dt9LeTjK_JE.description:
PsyWorm is a level that is simply fun to play and very appealing to the eyes, being exactly two minutes long, it takes you on an adventure through a psychedelic landscape, being comprised completely of all the colors in the rainbow and more, using different gradients and combinations, adding animations on top of them to give a sense of movement and fluidity to the backgrounds, which combined with the slow and chill lofi beat playing in the back, ties everything together beautifully. 

Now let's talk about the most creative part about this level in my opinion, the trail that follows you around, using the same color scheme as the rest of the design pretty much, being so long it trails off screen, turning you into the PsyWorm, which twists and turns according to your movement, and it came out looking great, the slithering is very smooth and it doesn't bug out at all, and it just makes the level more fun to play.

-Kr3LPGbZRQ.title: ''Ac4571c0ph081a'' 100% (Demon) by Kwol | Geometry Dash
-Kr3LPGbZRQ.description:
A level that has replaced some letters with numbers in the title, which restored to it's intended form, says Acousticophobia, which is the fear of sound, in cases even of ones own voice. This is definitely one of the more interesting creations I've come across this year. 

Using primarily Red, Green and Blue, along with a pitch black surrounding and background, really gives this level a sense of eeriness, even feeling unsettling at times, apart from the fact that you can't see the level until the music starts playing, which is an excellent choice as well, being electronic with a slow pace, even sounding off rhythm at times, fits in with the phobia theme perfectly, and all of these elements combined keep you on your toes the entire way through. 

The effects are also great in my opinion, they are relatively simple from a general standpoint, having some pulses and glitchy effects in sync with the song as well, further adding to the strange atmosphere.
 
Music: Unknown Destinations by Undervania

uZceNvamPDc.title: ''Retrograde'' 100% (Demon) by Codex [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
uZceNvamPDc.description: A level that was in the works for quite some time, from a creator that is already established and an icon at this point, comes to us with an old school level, as the name would suggest, having a 1.9 inspired design, but at the same time, combining elements from 1.9 and 2.1 so you could say this is the best of both worlds. The layout is much like those older levels we grew to love and would see so often, having a ton of vibrant color combinations that would tie everything together, the purple, green, red and orange, among some other ones. The block design is also very reminiscent, keeping it simple with various squares and rectangles on the inside with some pulses in between, you can't help but feel nostalgic playing this.

tEqZ9P0tRvI.title: (Insane Demon) ''Gregory'' 100% by CornFungi | Geometry Dash
tEqZ9P0tRvI.description:
Gregory is a level that feels like a 2 in 1, you have the half where it's filled with interesting color combinations, the purples and the bright and vibrant pinks, with a clean almost alien-like block design, featuring the same colors as the backgrounds, all while maintaining a slower pace, but at the same time serving as a great buildup to the more erratic parts of the experience. 

The other half is the exact opposite, the level becomes engulfed in a gray nightmare, with the speed of your ship along with the music is as fast as possible, the block design keeps the same shapes and patterns as the previous section, but it matches the dark colors we see now and has a more serious design on the inside, which I enjoy, since you can feel the desperation and turbulence that should be present in these more difficult levels in my opinion. 

But even though these two sides of the same coin are so different, they manage to work together in a great way, they serve each other as a contrast, the transition from one to the other feels and looks natural as well, and it serves so you don't see the same design the whole way through.

QwLjX0yZM4U.title: (Insane Demon) ''Shallow Dive'' 100% by GMDBlue [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
QwLjX0yZM4U.description:
A level that makes you feel like you've been teleported back to the 80's, driving through the night passing by a town filled with bright colored neon signs, seeing video stores with a chill soundtrack blasting through your radio without a care in the world. The ambiance for this level is fantastic, but it isn't just that, there are also a ton of effects to go along with all of this stylish decoration. 

Right from the very beginning we get to see some high quality glitch effects, the colors distorting into darker shades and tints, tiny bits of the level shifting around ever so slightly, we get some RGB shift as well, giving off the 3D lens effect. There are also a couple of parts that have various layers to them, really giving a sense of depth, further amplifying the effects. 

But my absolute favorite section you get to play in this comes at 0:34, the effects that you encounter tripped me out a bit the first time I saw them, which I think should be the goal when making effects of this nature, the level moves at a broken pace but at the same time doesn't appear to be moving, which must be hard to pull off, so major props for that.

hFv_H0_xW6k.title: ''A Final Hymn'' 100% (Demon) by Artherr & More [Verified] | Geometry Dash
hFv_H0_xW6k.description:
Song: Dunderpatrullen - Singularity https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1NzlzJwBMS4

A Final Hymn is a megacollab featuring Artherr and a handful of other incredibly talented creators, the full list will be at the bottom of the description, and their styles and aesthetics along with their ideas shine beautifully in this level, each one of these sections could be their own standalone level and it would be fantastic, but the fact that all of these fragments fit together so nicely with such different designs, is impressive by itself.

Whether it's the very beginning of the level, with it's cartoony vibe, having a ton of vibrant colors with a very subtle but clean block design, or the cityscape that appears at the very end, with a powerful orange tint emitting from the sunset, illuminating the incredibly tall buildings, giving off a cozy ambiance, this level as a whole has so much to offer from wherever you look at it, every bit is executed with love and you can tell from a mile away.

Members: CastriX, Kips, Drag747, Uriun, Subwoofer, Goose, Arth, SpaceDust, Xender Game, Geo, Novasidious, Xaren, Marwec, and Zeptoz.

tfcTpTAWZHQ.title: ''NO WAY OUT'' 100% (Demon) by Dominuus | Geometry Dash
tfcTpTAWZHQ.description:
A level that is completely black and white, plus some very subtle colors that highlight some parts of the design, NO WAY OUT is a 2 and a half minute experience that feels like 30 seconds, it is such an enjoyable experience all across the board, starting from the music, beginning as a slow drone, that by the end is an epic masterpiece, with light synthesizers playing a soothing melody with an off-beat, before switching to a more classical piano, which has fantastic sync as well by the way, which never seems to go away or falter at all, that makes this even more satisfying to play.

One of the things I appreciate most about this creation is even though the design is so similar and is basically the same style from start to finish, you never feel like you're going through the same place, the block design, the slight change in effects, even switching up the size and playable area of the level, helps give it that variety that is so important nowadays. 

There are also some backgrounds that appear towards the end, a beautiful spiral of shapes that you can see just as the level is hitting it's peak, that is animated as smooth as silk, along with some mountains and other landscapes with a moon shining down on all of it, wrapping everything together perfectly.

OjOJo1B-K7w.title: All Paths | ''Choose A Way'' 100% (Demon) by Zhiana, GameWaveDank & Foldy [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
OjOJo1B-K7w.description:
Levels like these are really interesting to me, the fact that you have a choice and several options to go through adds a certain replayability to the experience as a whole, to the point where creations of this nature feel like a bunch of mini-levels combined into one. There are a total of 3 major paths you can diverge into, with several smaller ones being found towards the beginning of the level, but these don't really affect anything as you end up at the same 3-path choice regardless of which way you go.

Now let's talk about the design, the star of this show being the different usages and implementations of color we can find all over the place, using almost every tint and hue imaginable, combined with some flashing lights and some level shake in perfect sync with the music. All of these aspects rolled into one creates a very vibrant and uplifting experience, which is good since you're going to be playing this for a while if you want to see all of the possible paths.

x-JlpxwLROY.title: ''Kolossus'' 100% (Demon) by TroxxP1 [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
x-JlpxwLROY.description:
A level that I was recently reminded of and to my surprise hasn't been rated after 8 months of being released. This is a remake of the incredibly popular level that was released 4 years ago, The Colossus from the already established and at this point legendary Manix648, and as per usual with great remakes the visuals are completely revamped and improved upon, while still maintaining the aesthetic and the spirit of the original alive. 

The entire first half of the level, both in terms of gameplay and design, serve their purpose as a buildup towards the inevitable mechanical boss fight, featuring very vivid neon colors with a beautiful cityscape filling the background with different towers and structures, combined with a sleek mechanical block design, nothing that goes overboard that takes away from another element, everything fits together nicely. Now onto the boss fight, which is fantastic as well, boasting a very clean design, vibrant colors to brighten this giant beast up, and small details such as the life bar and small UI that can be seen in the upper left corner that add another layer of detail to the fight.

After the boss has been defeated we find ourselves in a cyberspace of sorts, with the different shades of blue and purple, the best part about this section in my opinion is the way the coloring gets more and more erratic as the section is coming to a close, along with the music, a very nice touch.

Music:
Emphatic Outcry CUT by MegaSphere
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/732047
Level ID: 62874130

xrFYMHb-cQU.title: ''SIoppy'' 100% (Demon) by Darite | Geometry Dash
xrFYMHb-cQU.description: Being filled with vibrant colors and an almost surreal aesthetic, sloppy comes to us as a level that is just a chill experience overall, the slow pace that you get with the gameplay, the sluggish movement of the blocks and effects in sync with the mellow and dreamy chill step beat, with the star and highlight of the whole thing being the parallax effect that is used within the block design which is what you're eyes will be most drawn to the majority of the level. All of the different shapes and colors floating around inside, when suddenly on the second and third beat the entire level is filled with this effect, can be a bit jarring at first but is beautiful nonetheless. The back of the level is mostly pitch black, but with the effects you get in the foreground it serves as a nice contrast and prevents the level from being completely oversaturated with all of these lucid colors.

6gTENVZk_H0.title: ''Russwell'' 100% by ZubwaR [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
6gTENVZk_H0.description:
Russwell is a level that uses a remix of an old Russian pop song from what appears to be the 80's or 90's, and as is typical with this genre of music, it's very upbeat, which fits perfectly into this level since from the very beginning from a design and atmospheric standpoint you feel like you're going through a rave or a party, with all of the different flashes and pulsating colors going around the screen in perfect sync with the music. 

Especially in the beginning where we get a subtle equalizer effect that serves as a great buildup, along with the straight wave section we get after the opening sequence, which is a giant open space with different objects and obstacles of various sizes flying at you at different speeds, linked with some very smooth animations before hitting the massive drop. 

The section that comes after is also a straight line, but instead of the wave, you're the UFO this time, my favorite aspect that we get to see here is the lens flare effect that can be seen in between pulses, this combined with all of the different colors that appear on the edges of the screen serve their purpose of elevating the atmosphere of the level in a great way.

My favorite section has to be the one at the very end of the level, preceded by a very interesting animation of you going through a 3D box, TV or some kind of strange structure, which was well animated that takes into the final stretch, which in the first second seems completely empty, before exploding with movement and color, a rainbow effect that illuminates the cityscape in the background, adding on to the party vibe the level already had going for it.

4e99rXr_cuc.title: ''Widder'' 100% (Demon) by 2003Devin | Geometry Dash
4e99rXr_cuc.description: Devin is somebody who has established himself as a creator with a very unique and peculiar style, with most of his levels having a very cartoonish and sometimes outlandish design with some very interesting pieces of art as well, although this is really tame compared to other levels. Starting from the song that is used, being the first time I've encountered something like this, being a remix of the incredibly popular song "Back in Black" isn't something I'd expect to hear in a level but I think it actually fits relatively well with everything that's going on. The effects are clean, and it doesn't go overboard with them at all, I especially like the old film reel borders that appear in the beginning since details like this make a level stand out. The rest of the effects that I noted are some particles here and there that serve to add some detail and liveliness to the rest of the design.

rjJlvVnURfY.title: ''MARENOL'' 100% (Demon) by SwagMasta001 | Geometry Dash
rjJlvVnURfY.description: A unique level brought to us by a creator who definitely deserves a lot more attention for his creations, MARENOL is more of an experience and a visual level more than anything else, the uneven pace of the gameplay along with the music that you can tell from the very beginning that it's going to be very different from others, really sets the tone for all of the other aspects of the level, not to mention all of the crazy effects and art you get to see in the first half, the distorted art and all of the rapid changes in speed and color, with some flashing lights here and there to emphasize the desperation in some of these parts, especially when it cuts from one section to the next in a very abrupt manner, almost seeming as if it were two completely different levels spliced together, which fits the creepy theme perfectly.

dasnvOsDSO0.title: ''Starlight Bloom'' 100% (Demon) by Horneet | Geometry Dash
dasnvOsDSO0.description: It's not often when somebodies first level is as impressive as this, having the enjoyability and the style of something you'd expect from a seasoned creator, from the basic things such as colors, to the more advanced such as movement and custom backgrounds with all of the different shapes, pieces of art and structures, which are all well defined and fit in to the level very nicely, there is so much quality to be found here, the atmosphere is nailed perfectly, being slow, beautiful and dreamy, the block design is simple yet fitting, not being overdecorated to shift the attention towards the rest of the design.

E2bv0pd-10Y.title: ''Paranoid Android'' 100% (Demon) by Charky [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
E2bv0pd-10Y.description: A level that could be defined with only one word, both in terms of gameplay and design; smooth. Being a robot themed level, as you could probably guess from the name, which is hard to pull off with this specific style, since most of those levels are always rugged and a bit more serious, but this is a really nice change of scenery and pace. From the animations that you see in every transition right from the beginning, the different robots moving around in the background with the mechanical block design. The multi phase bossfight is also fantastic, the android that you have to dodge and go through looks great, it's movements are also really smooth, and have a great sync with the music.

nRjU74lnZUg.title: ''Eclipse'' 100% (Demon) by Sqiddo | Geometry Dash
nRjU74lnZUg.description:
Eclipse is a level that shines to me simply because of it's atmosphere, which in my opinion is one of the hardest things to get down when creating a level, you could have the greatest effects or the most beautiful art, but if it doesn't all fit together or if a single thing looks or feels out of place it loses a lot of detail, my favorite levels are the ones that tell a story, that are more of an experience, that take you through different phases and scenes that also fit together nicely with the music, completing the package. 

The fast paced electronic beat sets the tone for the level right from the beginning, rather than being a dark and depressing hellscape, it's more of a desperate nightmare, along with all of the creepy art that appears in the background, the Joker with trails of blood seeping from his eyes, the eyes looking around in a crazy manner, or the distorted cityscape that comes up towards the end.


The level is 99% monochrome, only using different opacities and shades of black and gray, with very small hints of red here and there to add a bit of contrast on the more intense parts. This level is definitely rough around the edges but that's what makes it different in my opinion, if it was too refined or perfect it would lose some of it's creepy factor and uncertainty, so for levels of this nature it works.

LCyuaQBW_QQ.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Monstercat'' 100% by F3lixsram & More | Geometry Dash
LCyuaQBW_QQ.description: An extreme demon that was released just over 11 months ago, one of the more enjoyables ones for me, but taking this into account it's still a bit inconsistent in some sections, the timings at the very beginning were brutal for me, and the parts that come after feel like RNG to me, as if certain jumps and movements were luck, having said that it is easy to learn once you've practiced it, but if you try to beat it fast you're gonna have a bad time, that doesn't mean the level is bad or unenjoyable, if you take you're time to get used to it and learn it, it's actually fun to play, at least that's how it was for me.

bTrJuNWgMH0.title: ''Topaz Temple'' 100% (Demon) by CreatorToile [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
bTrJuNWgMH0.description: Topaz Temple is a great remake of the very popular and classic level from Serponge; Gold Temple that came out in 2.0, that was seen very highly at the time since it was impressive visually for the time. So it's always nice to see when a creator takes a level that's already established and had it's time and gives it a new and improved look and feel, having enough changes to set it apart from the first iteration, which is the case here, while still managing to stay true to the spirit, style and gameplay of the original. The biggest change you'll notice from the original is the mini flying section, which has been practically changed completely, leaving behind the golden sand with the sword in the back, now being filled with purple and green vines all around the edges of the blocks with the background being a giant stone wall with various glass mosaic windows that you'd find in a cathedral placed throughout, which is a nice touch in my opinion. The gameplay you could say is very similar, keeping the difficulty and the part at the middle that is trickier than the rest of the level so not many changes there.

iOKmDBwcmAI.title: ''FOME'' 100% (Demon) by Nectaroso | Geometry Dash
iOKmDBwcmAI.description: FOME is a level coming to us from a new and upcoming creator, Nectaroso, and I have to say, this is something you would expect to see from a top creator, with months even years of experience, there is so much quality to be seen here, from things as basic yet important as the colors, the scheme, the vibrance, brightness and hues, although being contrasting with one another meshing together perfectly, the effects are also great, the pulsating backgrounds, the different bits of text showing up in the background, the giant X that appears on top of the player, the changes in brightness and color inside the clean block design, highlighting the song and the sync it has with it and all the satisfying jumps, orbs and transitions.

aoAx0hfew2c.title: ''Boom Slayer'' 100% (Demon) by AmorAltra & More | Geometry Dash
aoAx0hfew2c.description:
One of the greatest mega-collabs to be released this year and maybe even of all time, a level that I can say with certainty is going to be nominated for collab of the year, a team made up of top-level creators, both in the gameplay, being mostly AmorAltra, and in the design department with so many others including DavJT, HHyper, Subwoofer, Knots, ScorchVx and a bunch more. The most special part about this creation to me is the fact that Boom Kitty, the very talented artist that made the song used here, actually worked together with the team to make the song for the level, tailoring it so it would sync perfectly with every transition, every animation, every jump and movement, which is a complete opposite from what a creator would normally, which is build their level around the music, so this is awesome to see. The theme that they went for here, which is a Doom slayeresque hell, is portrayed perfectly from the blood red block design, the intense flames coming from everywhere while you go through hell, all of the different backgrounds and settings.
Now the best part about the level, for me at least, the bossfight, made with the combined talents of two of the best and most creative boss makers in this game, with Scorch being in charge of the design of the bosses and HHyper making all of those smooth animations, all while having great sync musically with the attacks, it looks amazing and is super satisfying to play.

ID: 67646176
Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fI2pqFqlB-M

FcUTdjKxMVk.title: ''Dreams'' 100% (Demon) by FunctionSquad | Geometry Dash [2.11]
FcUTdjKxMVk.description: The first official level from FunctionSquad, a level that has been in the works for quite some time now from a team comprised of a handful of talented creators. First of all let's talk about the atmosphere, in my opinion it's the best part about this, it really does pay tribute to the name, when you take into account all of the colors, using primarily blues and purples, with some other stronger colors used here and there such as green and yellow, the effects that are subtle and to the point, being mostly lighting and some glow in order to accent some of the decoration and pieces of art, and the similarly clean block design you encounter throughout, with all of this combined it does feel and look as if you were going through a dream. Each part is good in it's own way while still managing to mesh together relatively nicely with the rest, even the neon Wendy's sign at the very end which is a nice touch, although unexpected, I'm excited to see what they come up with next.

CNmx-craWvY.title: "Once" by VictorinoxX, Thomartin & Filaret | Geometry Dash
CNmx-craWvY.description: A level that completely deserves it's Epic rating, created by three very talented creators, combining their three styles and ideas to make something incredibly satisfying to look at and beat as well, and what's most impressive to me is that if you didn't know, you'd probably assume this was made by a single person, since every section meshes and fits together so well, transitioning smoothly in between each one. One of the things that I enjoy the most about this level is the block design, making it clear so you can see more of the backgrounds they created is very appealing to the eye, giving a cleaner aesthetic to the level as a whole. The colors are very vibrant and as a consequence make everything else look vivid, along with the way they change along with the music helps the sync a lot.

9ZomBg0rj0s.title: ''idk dummy'' 100% (Demon) by EnZore [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
9ZomBg0rj0s.description: A level that was built in just 7 days, having a bunch of EnZore's typical effects and style, with a more modern and simplistic twist on some aspects, such as the block design and the obstacles, idk dummy is still a wonder to look at and extremely fun to play. A level that in the first 10 seconds is a completely different style and design than the rest of the level, more "generic" you could say, but after the drop, the level completely explodes with color, the backgrounds are vivid and alive, with a ton of smooth animations to go along with them, the pulsing of the blocks and orbs combined with the upbeat Undertale remix bumping in the back. There's no theme persay, this is just a fun and short experience, something you can enjoy and beat in a couple of attempts.

_DiMaDeK6tE.title: ''Megalodon'' 100% (Demon) by Subwoofer [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
_DiMaDeK6tE.description: This level is truly something special, simply because of the fact that Megalodon has a comic tied to it's story, in the forms of an intro and an outro, something we rarely see, I highly recommend you go and check Subwoofer's video so you can see it for yourself, but here's to hoping we get more levels with a whole story and lore tied to them in the future, which is a really interesting concept in my opinion. The theme for Megalodon is basically action movie, you sneak in, take the plans and get out, which is what we get here. Right from the beginning you get sucked into the atmosphere and story of the level, The animations are fantastic, combined with the art, really breathing life into the theme that Subwoofer was going for, the pacing is well done too, not a single section feeling too long or too short. The effects are just the icing on the cake, the lasers, the explosions, the underwater sections and all of the lighting fits together with every other piece of decoration perfectly.

T-wtCcqa8Vo.title: ''Chapel'' 100% (Demon) by Toughfey | Geometry Dash [2.11]
T-wtCcqa8Vo.description: A level that emulates the architecture, the colors, the sounds and even the ambiance of a pristine Chapel or a Cathedral from the 1600's, it hits the mark perfectly from all aspects. I think the very chill music also adds to the level of appreciation you can achieve for this, taking it relatively slow so you can take in every block, every color and piece of decoration in the foreground and background as well. First of all, the block design fits the theme in a great way, using a combination of grey and blue blocks along with some more colorful ones here and there to highlight and accent the backgrounds, the design is clean, having some patterns and different shapes and lines in different parts really does feel like some of the old architecture you'd see in one of these structures. As you progress through the level you see more and more animations come out, whether it's from the blocks themselves or some transition it's all very smooth. My favorite part about this has to be the crystal/glass window patterns that come in at the halfway point of the level, the design is great and accurate as well, with some beautifully vivid colors filling in these shapes.

DZFiBwv8j0Y.title: ''BABYLON'' 100% (Demon) by Splash, Zoroa & Belonzik | Geometry Dash
DZFiBwv8j0Y.description:
A solo project that Splash started in April of 2020, but ended up being collab between him Zoroa and Belonzik, all very talented creators and I have to say the wait was 100 percent worth it, this is one of the most impressive levels when it comes to effects that have been released recently. Going from the most basic aspects of the level, starting from the music, the sync is there and it's great, it fits the dark monochrome vibe of this perfectly, both in the slower parts and in the most erratic sections, including some very satisfying sync. The block design has basically a couple of styles you can spot throughout each part, being more rustic with some sort of sketched edges, or the cleaner 3D obstacles that come a bit later. 

But the star of this show are definitely the effects combined with the backgrounds and art, right from the beginning you can tell how much work went into the vibe and atmosphere of this level, the creepy yet desperate and distorted pace of the level, the 3D colors and effects with some text appearing here and there with some very smooth animations as well. This beginning section is relatively slow, at least compared to what comes at the drop, something that can catch you completely off guard, the level explodes with all types of effects, the flashes of lights and colors, the way your ship and the obstacles themselves appear and reappear very rapidly, the scanlines as well, all of this while still having an incredibly satisfying sync. All of this before going back to a slow crawl that takes you through a star ridden abyss with different shapes and lines floating in the back.

GqHbkd03Axg.title: ''Drill Hood'' 100% (Demon) by Snailgang | Geometry Dash [2.11]
GqHbkd03Axg.description: A brand new level by Snailgang, a group of very talented creators that have taken a couple of old levels that they enjoyed and remade them, such as Whirlwind and Airoz Chaozflow, and this time they've chosen Grind District by Evasium and Terron. This is one of those levels that shine especially because of their gameplay rather than the design, being very satisfying to play even repeatedly, with it's great sync combined with the changes in pace and smooth flow, that's not to say the design is bad in any sense of the word, every section is unique to the creator, having a wide variety of colors, a very clean block design, using some 1.9 and other more modern elements.

IayNZEPOW74.title: ''Endo Resu Akatsuki'' 100% by NateRaven | Geometry Dash
IayNZEPOW74.description: An incredibly unique level with the effects to back it up, it's 100% black and white the entire way through which I think fits perfectly with all the trippy effects, movements and animations going on in the background, the contrast between the clear and the dark makes it a lot easier to take note of the smaller details, while making the bigger ones pop out, giving them the crazy optical illusion effect. The level is fast paced for the most part, and while in some cases this takes away from you're ability to appreciate the decoration, it doesn't happen here at all, on the contrary you could say it helps all of these different effects, especially the long cylinders with what appears to be a net on them. The block design is on the simpler side but since we're focusing on what's going on in the background the cleaner obstacles work great here.

UkMJrbde1c8.title: ''Poseidon'' 100% (Demon) by Ardolf & More [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
