UkMJrbde1c8.description: Ardolf's first ever mega collab featuring himself and a bunch of other incredibly talented creators, and after 6 months it's been released, and I have to say the end result is nothing short of fantastic, starting with the song, having music that heavily resembles one of those old shanties is perfect to set up the atmosphere of these underwater levels with a pirate side-theme, it really does set the tone right from the beginning, grabbing you're attention and adding another layer of detail. The color palette is mostly comprised of a light and glowy blue, with some yellow here and there to serve as a contrast, since we're talking about Poseidon here, these colors work perfectly, whether we're underwater or on the surface blowing through a thunderstorm. The block design is clean and simplistic, which I think was the best idea here, since we're going to be focusing more on the backgrounds and the overall vibe of the level rather than a specific aspect. Speaking about the backgrounds they came out looking great in my opinion, there is a wide variety of sceneries, the underwater structures, the shipwrecks and the waves crashing into you on the surface with lightning trying to hit you, nothing feels out of place and helps to detail the level very nicely.

4hlhCPmUTOU.title: (Insane Demon) ''The Far Sky'' 100% by NaneSae [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4hlhCPmUTOU.description:
NaneSae's Channel: https://youtube.com/channel/UC-V8GAvOVey1V6q7pjzbsdQ/featured

One of the best Sky themed levels in recent memory, having a simplistic yet very clean block design, given the fact that this is more focused on the atmosphere, ambiance and overall feeling, the backgrounds are definitely the star of the show. While the theme is very straightforward and linear, it isn't just a single sky that fills the background, simply moving from one side to the other, there's a ton of variety here whether it's the more simplistic clear orange tinted sky with 2D clouds that appear at the beginning, or the much more detailed ones with balls of light filling up the sky like stars and sunrays beaming through that come up just before the ending. 

But this isn't everything the level has to offer, there's a more conventional part that comes up at 0:30 that takes you through what appears to be an abandoned and ruined city, with different stone structures, buildings and even a monument as far as the eye can see, I appreciate this section since it's sets itself apart from the rest of the design, and parts like these also serve as a sort of transition in between the main attraction.

My favorite part, and the most unique in my opinion comes at the very end where you enter a different dimension after a star at the end of the previous section appears to explode, you're taken to cyberspace judging from the color scheme and lines on the ground, with a gigantic purple structure with what seems to be an eye in the middle watching over you from afar, it might seem out of place but simply because of the design it's my favorite.

7elGyk8TXDA.title: 0dd Place | Geometry Dash
7elGyk8TXDA.description:
Level ID: 67266849

It's really nice to see the Parallax effect starting to appear more and more in levels, I think it has a lot of potential to make incredible things and can be used in a ton of interesting and unique ways, you can make a super trippy level with hundreds of shapes and lines shifting and moving before your eyes or you can make a more conventional level with a background or block design that moves along with you, and most of the time this effect is used in a great way, and this is no exception. The level is mostly in greyscale, which can sometimes inhibit a levels potential, but you're not here for the colors, you're here for the effects. The way the lines are made to simulate a 3D space, 3D objects and platforms, is mesmerizing to say the least, feeling like nothing ever before, and it can even be a bit disorienting if you're not used to it, but it's still amazing to say the least. My favorite section is the short tunnel sequence at 0:10, that makes the level appear and feel as if you were seeing it through a fish eye lens, which grabs your attention right away. The music also fits perfectly for me, being slow and ominous in this setting adds to the strange and different atmosphere.

ItEy6gh6G3M.title: (Insane Demon) ''Golden Shade'' 100% by Zylenox | Geometry Dash
ItEy6gh6G3M.description: A level that serves as a follow up to Zylenox's other level, Silver Shade, trading out the bright metallic chrome aesthetic for the shiny and prestigious golden hues. I have to say, my favorite part about this level is definitely the shading effect that he managed to create, adding a lot of depth to the coloring and the shadows, giving the level a sort of old-timey comic book feeling to it, there is also a shimmer effect on some of the gold pieces closer to the end of the level, preventing the level from just seeming like a ton of yellow blocks, along with the various buildings that can be seen in the background throughout the level which adds a ton of detail to the overall design and atmosphere, there are also some lighting effects here and there, some spotlight effects that give the vibe of a solitary street lamp illuminating you in the middle of the street.

2eglnJ6SQxw.title: ''Octagon Force'' 100% (Demon) by JamAttack [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
2eglnJ6SQxw.description:
A level heavily inspired by the original Hexagon Force created by RobTop and I have to say it doesn't dissapoint in the slightest, with the recent release of the Hexagon Force sequel, Octagon Force, JamAttack went and made an awesome level to it, respecting and paying homage to what made the original so great, while still adding on his on flair and style on top, with a couple of extensions here and there, but at the same time only using gameplay and design elements from 1.9, with the exception of some move triggers here and there. This is one of those levels that use older stuff from previous versions of the game and if they were to have been released back then, it would have been very impressive, but that doesn't take away from the fact that this level is still fantastic from wherever you look at it.
 
ID: 67300705
Music: Octagon Force by Waterflame
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1000121

_S10Ag0pC1Y.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Effect'' 100% by MrSupremeGD | Geometry Dash
_S10Ag0pC1Y.description:
An Extreme Demon by a very talented and upcoming MrSupreme, that is heavily inspired by the style and essence of an already established and well known creator MaxyLand, being an Extreme Demon I'll write about the design and then the gameplay. 

In terms of design it's very nice to look at, I always enjoy levels that have a rainbow design, whether it's within the block design, the backgrounds or various effects that can be utilized, in this case it's all of the above, using a very wide spectrum of colors to breathe life into each and every section in a unique way, feeling as if the level was in reality just black and white but with a colorful lens on top of it. There are also short instances where the majority of the deco becomes black and white, with only certain objects retaining their color, which I feel makes for a very nice contrast and prevents the level from feeling bland or repetitive. 

The block design is pretty much the same the entire way through, having a clean and slightly mechanical style to it, but if it's full of color or monochrome it looks great. There are some animations here and there, mostly coming from the obstacles and blocks moving up and down in sync with the music, or some heavier animations appearing in the background with different lines and shapes coming in and out of view.

The gameplay on the other hand could use a bit of work, it feels inconsistent at times and some parts seem to be difficult just for the sake of being difficult, so with some minor tweaks and nerfs it could a lot more enjoyable to try and beat.

8d_1MZjLFs4.title: ''BAD OMEN'' 100% (Demon) by Custi [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
8d_1MZjLFs4.description:
This level is truly something special, and you can tell right from the beginning just from hearing the first few seconds of the music, which in this case is an orchestral version of Bowser's Theme from Super Mario 64, which by itself is an iconic soundtrack, but used in this context in a level of this spooky and twisted nature fits perfectly from all angles, so it's always very nice to see pieces of internet and videogame culture be used in a great way. Another thing that I feel is a great addition to the detail and depth of the level is the fact that there are chapters, making the level feel like it's own game almost. 

The level begins with you slowly entering through a dark and misty forest with red and green moss covering the ground, with an endless array of trees filling the background, and to top it all off you get to see the full moon in all of it's glory lighting up everything in a white and ominous glow. I think this is the perfect way to start the level, the slow pace of the music and gameplay along with the way the creepy atmosphere is established right from the beginning.

After that we get a short transition with a giant white hand getting closer and closer to a bloody heart with looks great with it's simplistic style that takes us to the next chapter: The Catacombs, which is definitely my favorite part of the level, ramping up the creepiness and adding a bit of shock factor as well, from the moment you go inside, all of the different skeletons and skulls scattered around on the floor and even the ones that are trapped in cages, small details like these are what make a a level feel alive and even a bit interactive. There's even a mini bossfight in this part, a few seconds after you enter the catacombs, a relatively large black skeleton with wings appears in front of you, shooting dark red balls of energy at you in the form of spirals, so you have to control your ship perfectly to get through. But the surprising part about this section isn't that, it's what comes straight after, the giant tunnel of flesh in the form of an obstacle, covered in veins with teeth sticking out from the middle and eyeballs protruding from the sides. The first time you see it, it does take you by surprise, but the great part about this piece of decoration is the fact that it doesn't feel out of place at all, since it is something shocking you could find at the bottom of dark and abandoned catacombs.

We then find ourselves in the Cathedral, which is a complete 180 from the Catacombs, an enormous contrast to the dark and gritty to the clean and beautiful, a place full of light from the moonlight coming in through the very nicely decorated glass windows, making the bright yellow flowers scattered on the ground even brighter while still maintaining the dark and dirty castle floors and walls. The most attention grabbing part of the cathedral comes in the middle, after you go past a couple of windows, you see a giant yellow cross with a pit of dark flames at the bottom, suggesting the dark rituals that could be performed in this place. This section and the one that comes after, the Royal Gardens, are relatively short compared to the rest of the level, so I think it's best to treat them as a single entity before we reach the climax to the level. The Gardens are also a breath of fresh air from the chaos of the beginning of the level, serving as a sort of respite before the storm. We go through a long hallway composed of shiny white marble with different plants and vines wrapping around everything, with the moonlight hitting us directly once again.

The final chapter, The Escape, is probably the shortest part of BAD OMEN, but also the most intense, from the moment we exit the Royal Gardens a giant dark mass comprised completely of shadows and demonic beings begins to chase you, trying to drag you back into the catacombs, to trap you forever, but with skill and a bit of luck you can manage to escape this hellish landscape within a couple of seconds.

The level as a whole is fantastic, there is beautiful art, from the lush and dark forest in the beginning illuminated by the giant moon, to the wet, bloody and musky stone walls in the catacombs and the cathedral, to the shiny marble that makes up the garden, every bit is high quality, not to mention all of the effects that were used, the fog used in the first section that adds to the gloomy nature of the forest, the different lighting effects that emphasize the contrast between the dark and the light or the pulses of color in sync with Bowser's Theme, which help the rhythm of the level a ton. The block design fits each section perfectly, without repeating itself in between, which is always a plus in levels like these that focus on the atmosphere and style more than anything else. One thing I would improve although, would be the transitions, the only one we get is the hand with the heart at the beginning, but after that it's a fade to black, which works but could've been more imo.

n62HvtB1cAA.title: ''spwipi'' 100% (Demon) by scrumpy, para & 13spades | Geometry Dash
n62HvtB1cAA.description: A level that is almost the complete opposite of the previous one I uploaded, being extremely colorful with a relatively fast pace, but instead of having a completely black background, it's completely white the entire way through, although not nearly as hectic as the former. spwipi is very unique in it's own right, being comprised mostly of different shapes and lines in the decoration, but the thing that piques your interest the most is the background, which appears to have a parallax effect with the different shapes of different brightness, moving around inside, making it seem as if there are different layers to the level. And although it's under 45 seconds long, there is so much to see here, and at no point does it feel empty at all.

vIqHYRSxODU.title: ''Brainwash'' 100% (Demon) by TheAlmightyWave | Geometry Dash
vIqHYRSxODU.description: Brainwash is exactly what the title suggests, something you would expect a bunch of scientists to blast on a tv screen while you're tied to a chair being mentally brainwashed. Right from the get go, the level attacks you with hundreds of colors, flashing in and out, only using the black background as the contrast to all of these bright hues. After this we go into a very slow and psychadelic section, where the level finally becomes solid, changing in between colors very slowly along with the gameplay, only to send you into a final frenzy after only a few moments of respite which I think is always important in these types of levels, having a break from all of the chaos in the first half. The effects that come with all these colors are fantastic as well, using some glitch effects that makes the level feel like you're in a rave, along with all the pulses and flashes.

QCcpshXeov0.title: ''Sakio'' 100% (Demon) by Lyomi | Geometry Dash [2.11]
QCcpshXeov0.description: A level that deserves all of the attention it can get, the outer space and galaxy theme is one of those I can't get enough and never gets boring for me, the decoration for this is fantastic on all fronts, the combination of colder and warmer colors, the hyperrealist art for the planets of all sizes, some with strange patterns inside of them with a ton of different colors, and some that appear a lot more similar to our own Earth, accompanied by all of the stars and asteroids that also have a bit of movement to them to add a ton of life to each section. The level also has a nice variation in pace, starting off slow along with the music and ramping up until the drop where every aspect of the level hits it's highest point. The block design also fits the theme perfectly, having alien like patterns and shapes while still sticking to the same color palette as the rest of the deco.

07a9b4Q0jes.title: ''Ivashka'' 100% (XL Demon) by IvashkaUA | Geometry Dash [2.11]
07a9b4Q0jes.description:
A level with beautiful colors and exceptional effects to go with the seemingly minimalistic design that Ivashka was going for, having a wide variety of gradients in each section with colors that fit really well together both in terms of the block design, using darker tones and hues and especially in the backgrounds, with the purple, pink, blue even some green and yellow, while still managing to keep it modest. There are also a ton of animations to be found and seen here, in the obstacles, the spikes and saws, the transitions and the different shapes that appear in the backgrounds, especially at 0:49.  There are also some sections that go completely dark, while using different effects to inject different bits of color here and there, that adds a lot of contrast to these parts.

ID: 66957897
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/727539

iZk6sjkRp8g.title: ''Madness'' 100% (Demon) by Alkali & YunHaSeu14 | Geometry Dash
iZk6sjkRp8g.description: An Industrial themed collab between Alkali and Yun, based on the very popular animated series featured on NewGrounds that goes by the same name, created by Krinkels and I have to say it's beautifully recreated, these types of levels have always been Alkali's specialty so it's nice to see that he hasn't lost his touch. The pacing of the level is fantastic, the effects work great with the orange and green theme they went with, and the usage of darker and lighter tones in certain places to give a bit of depth perception is always a nice choice and finally the music fits really well with the mechanical block design and backgrounds.

3fFrbC-WUWQ.title: (Insane Demon) ''Swirling Fire'' 100% by Jenkins GD | Geometry Dash
3fFrbC-WUWQ.description: Swirling Fire is fast-paced, hectic and crazy from start to finish, looking and feeling like a rave party, from the lighting effects, all the pulses and flashes that are used with the fast paced music, combined with all of the vibrant colors, mostly consisting of fiery oranges, some whites and blues, fitting in perfectly with the Fire theme that Jenkins was going for. The best part about this level for me are definitely the effects on the outer edges, the different patterns and lines flashing in and out of view in sync with the music, really amplify the frantic vibe the level has.

FBA3ILlppXU.title: Made in 1.9! | (Extreme Demon) ''Goldcrest Palace'' 100% by GrenadeOfTacos & PauL333 | Geometry Dash
FBA3ILlppXU.description: Goldcrest Palace is a level that was created only using 1.9 objects, effects and it's limitations, but I have to say, GrenadeOfTacos has completely mastered this version of the game, taking every single color, which even though there are only 4 color channels it still manages to look very colorful and vibrant, with some nice color combinations as well, object and effect and using it to it's fullest potential, creating something that could rival even some of the newest levels in 2.11. Even though there's not much in the backgrounds department, there is so much decoration in the forefront that the blanks just fill themselves in, whether it's because of the decoration on the block design, the different lines and shapes, or all of the objects that are scattered around with glow effects on them. There is so much detail at every corner which is impressive for being from 1.9. The gameplay was all done by PauL333, which he did a great job with. In terms of difficulty it's on the easier side of Extreme Demons, even though it took me 5000 attempts to beat, I still had a lot of fun playing, and most of the attempts are just learning and practicing.

J79huEAnOnM.title: "Sanctus" 100% (Demon) by iFuse | Geometry Dash
J79huEAnOnM.description: Sanctus is a level that is sorely focused on the unique usage of colors, using only rainbow blocks to decorate the level, using different combinations of purple, blue, green and red, in just about every part of the decoration, from the block design, the backgrounds, and even the effects, working extremely well together. The level also has a nice sense of pace, having a really nice sync with the music and the pulsating effects as well. The transitions that Fuse implemented into his level are also incredibly smooth, using various almost psychadelic effects, including blur and some 3d as well.

M61Vqi6ryj8.title: ''Sakupen Egg'' 100% (Demon) by Sivlol & More | Geometry Dash
M61Vqi6ryj8.description: A remake of the incredibly popular level Sakupen Hell, with completely revamped decoration while still managing to keep the spirit of the original alive. Sakupen Egg is the definition of what a remake should be, updating the style of the original in terms of effects, colors, backgrounds and block design, without deviating from the style. I think the best part of this is the glow effect, it adds so much detail to the theme, especially with the bloody red hue that is so popular in these types of levels, it gives it a more demonic and even creepy vibe at times, which fits perfectly with the sakupen theme.

OpUG1Aim0wU.title: ''Still Life'' 100% (Demon) by Empika | Geometry Dash
OpUG1Aim0wU.description:
Empika's Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoVlbs58goOyhstC5HpwMvw/featured

A level brought to us by another unkown creator, this time it's Empika, and just like the previous level I uploaded, it's incredibly impressive, and especially unique in this case, the first minute or so of the level is very simplistic in design, seeming like something you would see in someone's sketchbook, with every bit of decoration and even the obstacles adopting this style, that being said in this case it's definitely a positive, working really well with the theme and even the music that was used. Now the best part of the level in my opinion comes right after this, Empika uses the famous Parallax effect that was also used in the very popular level HOW, it's always nice to see techniques this complex implemented into levels at this level of quality. After this we reach the final section of the level, a sort of dungeon crawler part where you're jumping over and going through different machines and bricks with mechanisms moving around in the background, making this part feel and look very full, while adding some flair to it with the lighting effects.

ID: 66960655
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/888517

vNZNBv-yYG8.title: "RAT LAB" 100% (Demon) by ArtaxFerSarh | Geometry Dash
vNZNBv-yYG8.description: Artax is a creator that is basically unkown in the community, so for him/her to release something of this quality is incredibly impressive, since RAT LAB is something you'd expect from a seasoned creator, especially when we talk about all the effects that are used, the lighting, the rapid changes in brightness and contrast in certain parts, the spotlight effect that can be seen at 0:40 combined with the scanline effect they used really helps the scientific lab theme they were going for. The level is exactly a minute long but there is so much detail to be seen while still managing to keep it simplistic.

GpuCLV4tqoU.title: ''Unworthy'' 100% (Demon) by Nightlex | Geometry Dash
GpuCLV4tqoU.description: A level that nails the "Rouge-Like" theme perfectly, the pixel art for the block design, the backgrounds from the lush forest with it's tall trees and even a tall castle in the middle of it all, to the dark stone-walled caves and dungeon that appear later in the level, but the star of the level is definitely the massive dragon that appears as a bossfight starting from the second half of the level. His design looks fantastic, with an incredibly detailed face, you can see the texture in his skin and the shadow work makes him look a lot more menacing along with his glowing red eyes, he reappears later in the level from a farther angle where you can see his full body, which is up to par with what we saw before, the red and grey contrast really works well together along with all of his attacks that have some neat effects tied to them, all while having it's dark atmosphere intact.

CG5f-MDTG8M.title: (Extreme Demon) "Ikaros" 100% by Pavlaxan & More | Geometry Dash
CG5f-MDTG8M.description: A beautiful collab between Pavlaxan and a bunch of other talented creators, which apart from having an excellent design is also very fun to play but it does have it's difficulty since it took me 3 days and 5000 attempts to beat. The level is just over 3 minutes long with some really nice effects,vwith each creator having his own section and imprinting his style onto it, while still maintaining the level cohesive and connected. I alsoy enjoy how each section has it's own prominent color, whether it's green, red, purple, etc.

6fgtoDddsR8.title: ''BEATDEMON'' 100% (Demon) by YoReid [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
6fgtoDddsR8.description: BEATDEMON is a level that has incredibly clean and smooth animations all around the board, from the level itself and it's block design and obstacles, to the backgrounds, all the monsters and creatures moving around in the back, along with all the tiny details you can find. The level only uses two colors pretty much, green and red but they're used in such a way that accentuates the decoration very nicely, bringing out the best parts of the level.

dAf8Dfda6fw.title: ''Tokyo Tour'' 100% (Demon) by Yoonsr & More | Geometry Dash
dAf8Dfda6fw.description: Tokyo Tour is a level that boasts a fantastic theme, that even though has been done for a long time now, never manages to get boring or stale, no matter who does it, the cityscapes always end up looking beautiful and combined with the colors and different lighting effects make for a really nice landscape overall, and this level is no different. Being over a minute long, this level takes us through Tokyo, different districts being showcased in the form of train stops, even having a sign that shows that you've arrived and left the station which looks great, you also get to see the trains in action, moving around on the screen with smooth animations and great art, also serving as transitions to the next section. I really like how each district is shown with a different color, and that way you can also tell which creator made that particular section, and everyone did a fantastic job, every part feels coherent and connected with one another.

N0ice5Vv8Sg.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Halberd'' 100% by notlsa & th31 | Geometry Dash
N0ice5Vv8Sg.description: A beautiful recreation of the original Kirby Super Star, from the pixel art for the sprites, to the level design, being carefully crafted to simulate the original perfectly, the text bubbles that appear at the bottom of the screen adding dialogue to the bossfights, to the song that was used, made into an Extreme Demon, which as a side note, it's really nice to see more and more Extremes coming out as themed levels instead of generic looking levels with impossible gameplay. The gameplay is different, having a certain uniqueness which adds to the difficulty, along with the fast pace caused by the song, definitely makes it an Extreme.

mpLmBH3psoo.title: ''Dark Times'' 100% (Demon) by Rockwizard5 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
mpLmBH3psoo.description: A level that has a duality to it's theme, which is something special to say the least, there are times in this where it's bright and upbeat, both in terms of the design and music, and there are other parts where it takes on a darker atmosphere, slowing down the game play as well. Despite being on the simpler side when it comes to decoration, it still manages to feel very complete and full of life, with black being the dominant color here, it makes for a beautiful contrast with the rest of the colors that are used, primarily on the block design and it's effects. The backgrounds consist of different shapes and lines that appear and disappear along with the obstacles that faze in and out of view intertwined with the effects, speaking of which, the parallax effect that's inside the block design looks great and is definitely the best part of the level.

AtoqvomvL6g.title: (Insane Demon) "Deep Swim" 100% by GMDBlue | Geometry Dash
AtoqvomvL6g.description: An Insane Demon that is shorter than average but is very, very sweet, Blue's best level to date in my opinion, a level that has beautiful psychedelic colors and effects, especially the lighting, using a dreamy color palette with colors such as blue, pink, purple, even some yellow and green that work extremely well together and the slow pace of the song and game play really help it out as well. This entire level feels and looks like what you'd imagine an acid trip in the 80's would've been like, the scan lines, the simplistic yet stylized block design, everything fits together very nicely, you should definitely give this level a try.

ePDkQJPa_tQ.title: ''Ritual'' 100% (Demon) by quid | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ePDkQJPa_tQ.description:
A level that nails it's theme and atmosphere to perfection, This one is completely different from other demonic themed levels out there, it doesn't just paint the level red with some demon markings and call it a day, it's stylized, and incredibly original from beginning to end, it builds a world for you, to immerse you the whole way through. From the effects, that play around with the lighting, either with flashing lights in sync with the music or subtle pulses that give off a creepy vibe, to the dark and sinister backgrounds that tie the entire theme together very nicely. The art that is present here is also well done, the giant moon in the background, the markings that appear in several places and the different shapes that fill the background from time to time. Everything about this level meshes with each other in a great way, maybe we'll see a resurgence of this particular theme, but in the mean time give this level a try.

ID: 66704741
Music: Feral by Meganeko
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/912289

lCBLooUhtPk.title: ''DNA'' 100% (Demon) by HugusTheNoob | Geometry Dash [2.11]
lCBLooUhtPk.description: A level that is very chill and stylized from beginning to end, starting from the song that's this really light lo-fi type beat, with a slow tempo and soothing instrumentals, fitting in perfectly with the bright and blue design they decided to go with, and while being on the more simplistic side, there is still a ton of detail to look at just about in every section. The effects are fantastic, the lighting, the animations in the backgrounds, the movement on the blocks, the pulsating effects in sync with the music and the transitions are very smooth.

2tcgZ37kEHo.title: (Insane Demon) ''Lustre'' 100% by OliSW | Geometry Dash [2.11]
2tcgZ37kEHo.description:
A level that is based off of the designs and effects of Sley, Bagingi and Para, so it's not 100% original, that being said, it doesn't mean it's bad by any means, every single aspect of the level is high quality and should be treated as such, the level starts off slow with a dark ambient, darker tones and hues, with heavy vignette effect on the borders of the screen, the block design being relatively simple, with neon borders and a sort of scan-line interior that comes in and out of view in sync with the music. What I like about the initial section for this is the fact that even though it is very dark, there is still a background present, a grid effect that mimics the same colors that appear in the foreground, which ended up looking great in my opinion. 

After the 30 second mark and a really nice transition featuring the sun which you see in Sley's levels, the level lights up completely, having an extremely similar style as the previous section, same colors, block design and backgrounds, only notable difference being the fact that the interiors on the block design are mostly grey, giving this section a nice contrast in color. 

The last part of the level switches from the hard hitting grey block design and flashing and vibrant colors, we go to a section that looks dreamy with it's blurry and overlapping effects, giving the vibe that you're dizzy or disoriented, before switching back to a more conventional view, which is reminiscent of the first section.

My favorite thing about this level is the gameplay, being extremely fun and smooth, the duals are very satisfying to play and don't take too long to learn. It also got consistent very quick for me, which made me like the gameplay even more. Definitely one of the most fun Insane Demons you'll play in my opinion.

jOimqUSWrFY.title: ''STRANGE BOXES'' 100% (Demon) by Flash [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
jOimqUSWrFY.description: A colorful, vibrant, yet psychedelic level coming to us from the talented Flash, a creation that has it all, a great song, fantastic effects that go hand in hand with the simplistic yet attractive block design, the colorful backgrounds that don't have any art or constructs but the different gradients of color that you can see really add a new layer of detail to the foreground, filling in the empty spots nicely. There are also some subtle glitch effects here and there, whether it's in the block design flashing in and out of view or the level moving in a jarring way all of a sudden. It's always impressive how much detailed can be packed into a minute level.

t-BwnnsV0vY.title: ''Lost Lazors'' 100% (Demon) by ZubwaR [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
t-BwnnsV0vY.description: A level that is in your face, exploding with color and detail at every corner, filled with vibrant colors, fast movements, flashing lights and neon border just about everywhere you look. But the star of the show is definitely the bossfight, technically there's 2 bosses, a miniboss that appears just before the drop, that appears to be a mechanical eye that shoots lasers at you, which has a unique design that I personally enjoyed, and the main boss, which is the giant robot that has claws that also shoot lasers and lightning at you, while trying to hit you at the same time, his design is also great, and his movements are really smooth.

CX4pGAtkJsA.title: ''Hypercharged Rhythm'' 100% (Demon) by NateRaven [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
CX4pGAtkJsA.description: A level that is incredibly detailed from wherever you look at it, from beginning to end, in each and every section. Right from the get-go, you can tell just by looking at the background, the quality of the effects that are found here, the colors are well varied, some parts have a more vibrant tone, while some others are more serious, with a grayscale vibe to them, specifically almost at the end, the fact that it still maintains the pace and rhythm of the rest of the level while switching up the core design is impressive to say the least. There are also a bunch of animations to enjoy here, from the backgrounds, to the obstacles to the transitions, there is a lot of attention to detail in this level.

lSsvWjGc4FY.title: ''Video Game Maniac'' 100% (Demon) by Rawin [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
lSsvWjGc4FY.description: A level that is incredibly unique, colorful and stylized, feeling and looking very complete for a level that is just over a minute long. The level changes so fast between designs that it almost seems like a compilation of levels instead of just one, the gameplay modes are also heavily varied, fitting really well with the design. Something you'll notice as well, each part has it's own effects and colors, whether it's the bright colors with flashing lights or darker colors with more pulsating effects, you can see a bunch of detail wherever you look.

O1xWQvc-7rc.title: ''Rainbow Road'' 100% (Demon) by Elvii | Geometry Dash [2.11]
O1xWQvc-7rc.description: This level captures the essence and style of Rainbow Road perfectly, it's colorful, it's bright and it's fast paced wrapped up in a bunch of glow that accentuates all of the above. But apart from that the level has a lot of small details that make it stand out above the rest, from the star effects on the dash orbs and the ones that are inside the portals that give a more magical effect to the game play or the thwomps that fall from the top of the level trying to squish you. There aren't many backgrounds to show or to see, just the one at the very beginning, or the moon with the pillars in the middle of the level, but all the colors and effects in the foreground more than make up for it.

Jr7GxnoFkIw.title: (Extreme Demon) ''NecropoliX'' 100% by Namtar | Geometry Dash
Jr7GxnoFkIw.description: This was really fun, would definitely recommend this for anyone trying to beat their first Extreme Demon. Also thanks everyone for 600k :)

CHHuUIDvCUQ.title: 13k Objects! | ''tkspl'' 100% (Demon) by durianhead [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
CHHuUIDvCUQ.description: It's always amazing to see when a creator can be so creative and ingenious when it comes to object usage, the fact that this level only uses a mere 13k objects and can look this detailed is really just a testament to the talent of the creator. Not looking empty at all, with beautifully decorated block designs and great effects to go along with this. Every part is unique in it's own way, switching up the style and the colors, while still feeling connected as a whole. There aren't many backgrounds here, but durian was able to have some detail behind the blocks and obstacles to make the level have a sense of depth in some places, which is a great effort.

ij7VJw-vLR8.title: ''My Solo'' 100% (Demon) by GDSkele | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ij7VJw-vLR8.description: A level that's short and to the point, and My Solo gives you that and much more, from the upbeat and fun song that was used that makes you nod your head while you're playing, the blue and purple hues that give a "Dreamy" vibe to the level, along with all of the lighting and movement effects that breathe new life into each and every section. And while there aren't any backgrounds to note, I think there's enough going on in the foreground to make up for it, there's still a ton of detail to admire just about everywhere.

P-uUDsNKF1g.title: (Insane Demon) ''I stole this'' 100% by Shulkern | Geometry Dash [2.11]
P-uUDsNKF1g.description: A level that is unique, hectic and extremely colorful, a creation that only amplifies all these attributes as time goes on and as you move forward in the level, exploding with color and effects at the very end in a perfect climax, with the music taking you by the hand the entire way through this insane trip. A level that is completely discombobulated while still maintaining a hint of cohesion in between all the madness, all of this in just over a minute.

zezYylzzE4Q.title: ''fwocl'' 100% (Demon) by durianhead & pocke [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
zezYylzzE4Q.description: fwocl is an incredibly unique creation, simply because of the way it's colors work, using only one color channel and in order to obtain all these limited, yet strange hues of colors durianhead and pocke overlapped multiple objects, achieving the gold, purple, green and dark blue colors, that end up looking fantastic with the rest of the design, the blocks are simplistic yet very detailed with a bunch of decoration on the inside, and the fact that it's all the same color does make every block and obstacle feel like the same entity.

L7qsTHVH67M.title: ''Vitouxic'' 100% (Demon) by BaharTeam | Geometry Dash
L7qsTHVH67M.description: Vitouxic is a level that has a great design and an overall theme, with the green "toxin" hue being the dominant color, a fast paced and fun level that in my opinion suffers a bit from one of it's effects, the glow can be a bit much at times, taking the spotilight in places and shouldn't and taking away from the visibility of the level a bit, but apart from that it's a fantastic level, the rest of the effects are great, the lighting, the slight animations on the obstacles and the transitions are seamless and make sense for the theme that this team was going for.

mxVfjlNMCQk.title: ''Theory of Mangos'' 100% (Demon) by Mangosteen [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
mxVfjlNMCQk.description: A brand new level in the Theory of Everything spin-off category and I have to say, just about everything that this level has to offer is fantastic, the block design is very detailed while not going overboard, which is a lot harder than it looks, the effects are on point using the classic song to it's advantage with it's lighting effects and shake effects that really give the level a new layer of detail and weight especially, and even though there are virtually no backgrounds for this, there's enough going on in the foreground to make up for it.

mdskXfDe1ZY.title: (Insane Demon) ''Blaster'' 100% by Rustere | Geometry Dash [2.11]
mdskXfDe1ZY.description: An Insane Demon that has each and every aspect of the level complementing one another to perfection, everything from the fantastic song that was used that gives off a Spacey and slightly Futuristic vibe while still keeping everything chill, the clear and simplistic block design, filled with different colored shapes to give it vibrance and form flashing on and off in perfect sync with the song. The background basically has 2 different variations, either it's completely dark, leaving room for the forefront to shine, or it takes on the same hue with various shapes serving as filler moving around in the back. Overall a great level with a great vibe.

XJnCtXwPk8Y.title: ''Albedo'' 100% (Demon) by Akinawoo [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
XJnCtXwPk8Y.description: Albedo is a level that uses lighting effects to their greatest potential, the way that the entire level is only visible when you see these brief flashes of light, featuring different intensities and colors, starting off slow at the beginning and ramping up as the level goes on, all the while being in sync with the song. There aren't any backgrounds, only focusing on the block design, that even though isn't visible 100% of the time is still very detailed and the various effects that are implemented.

wnPpYds_qj0.title: ''2021'' 100% (Demon) by Mulpan [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
wnPpYds_qj0.description:
2021 has some great effects, which is something I think Mulpan really specializes in and has gotten better at as time goes on. All of the pulsating flashes/beams of light, the different animations that incorporate art into the block design, the backgrounds and even the transitions, combined with the rays of electricity emanating from the borders of the level, in sync with the music. This level as a whole is a spectacle, and a perfect way to start the new year, with all the bright lights and colors, fast paced game play that builds up a lot of hype for what's to come.

Music: 2010 by GRGEMUSIC
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/951139

9vkncb3Y8ks.title: ''Nandertale'' 100% (Demon) by Im Fernando & More | Geometry Dash
9vkncb3Y8ks.description:
The newest mega collab coming to us courtesy of Im Fernando and a group of incredibly talented creators that got together to craft this beautiful level for us. His most previous collab was Nantendo, that came out about a year ago, which was a huge hit and I have absolutely no doubts that this will be the same thing. Being based off of the very popular game that was released a couple of years ago "Undertale" it's no wonder why this level will be really popular as well. 

The level is just over 4 minutes long, with an intense amount of detail and care put into every single section, with each one feeling connected to the other, while at the same time, you can see the style of the creator embedded in between their parts, having different effects and pieces of art. Starting off relatively simple, the level really kicks off once the drop kicks and only gets more and more intense as it goes on.

Brt_TftBx0o.title: ''High Spirits'' 100% (Demon) by Wulzy | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Brt_TftBx0o.description: The newest level from the very talented and already established creator Wulzy, and probably his best level to date. Every section is consistent in quality, the effects are top notch the whole way through, having a very chill vibe from the cold color palette that is used, switching from purple to an icy blue, the relatively simplistic block design and the various pieces of art that can be seen in the background with a bunch of lighting effects to bring it all together, making the level feel very complete as a whole. The game play is also consistent, the difficulty is Easy Demon, with the harder parts being in the first half of the level, but it's very enjoyable overall.

50sa63uGb24.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Maybe Possibly Thing'' 100% by iNubble & YakobNugget | Geometry Dash
50sa63uGb24.description: A level that has the best of both worlds, "Maybe Possibly Thing" has excellent game play, it's fun, it's fast paced, it's consistent and since it's an Extreme Demon it has the difficulty as well. Now most of the time these demons focus more on the game play and the design is on the simpler side, often times not having any backgrounds and using relatively simple colors and block design, but this level as I said has the best of both sides, the design is just as good as the game play or even better in my opinion, it's stylized beautifully, the art is very clean with some nice animations tied to it, there are vibrant colors everywhere you look, having a great contrast with the white blocks and obstacles. There are also a ton of effects to be found here, the slight movements on the block design look smooth, the lighting effects, the gradient effect on the colors in the back, everything ties together extremely well.

HrmhJclFvNI.title: ''Trainwreck'' 100% by Knots [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
HrmhJclFvNI.description: A beautiful Christmas themed level with a very clean art style and design. The art itself is high quality, even having some smooth yet elaborated animations to make the level feel more alive as a whole, that included with the bright and vibrant color palette make for an incredibly cozy vibe. The level also includes a boss fight, with some cute snow cats firing lasers at you, the design is great and the attacks look nice and fit the theme really well too.

0w83VtlvQ7k.title: ''Sminxmas'' 100% (Demon) by xGrax & Para | Geometry Dash [2.11]
0w83VtlvQ7k.description: A more serious take on the christmas theme, being filled with snow and ice, but it has a more somber look and a slower pace, with not as much color as other levels of this theme, being dark most of the time except for the end where you can catch a glimpse of a living room with a fireplace in the center, which is a very nice contrast to the rest of the level.

WRwwoElKlOQ.title: Silent Congregation | ''Desideration'' by Apocalipse and lujain | Geometry Dash
WRwwoElKlOQ.description:
The hardest level to bot, this currently sits at #28 in the impossible levels list

Macro by @PhiPan 

Level: Desideration by Apocalipse & lujain
ID: 133493855
Song: Purgatori by KORAII
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/895761

This level is a little too dificult for me to beat, so I had to use a macro for this one

ZIlDCCzdcbU.title: (Insane Demon) ''Apollo 13'' 100% by Metalface221 | Geometry Dash
ZIlDCCzdcbU.description: Apollo 13 is a level that focuses a lot on the gameplay rather than having a bunch of decoration, which is also pretty nice. Even though it's an Insane Demon, the game play is extremely balanced and fun to play, you can tell it's a beautifully crafted level when it doesn't take long to get used to it and even learn it. There is a really nice variation in game modes, starting off with a classic cube section and switching between wave and ball respectively. The difficulty is constant and consistent throughout the entire thing, every part is clear and concise, there aren't any bugs that I encountered, and the simple black and white design with some lighting effects sprinkled here and there fits well with the contrasting fast paced gameplay.

Y3MwgJ8pnYI.title: ''Rust and Clouds'' 100% (Demon) by kDarko & GDestrys | Geometry Dash
Y3MwgJ8pnYI.description: A steampunk themed collab from kDarko and GDestrys, part of the formers "Storyteller Saga", this one being the 4th installment in the series, and I have to say right off the bat, the design, the style and the aesthetic that he was going for is perfect. The pace of the gameplay fits really well with the song that was included, switching between fast and medium pace with the overall design of the level following suit. In my opinion the absolute best part about this level is all the movement you can see all around, both in the foreground and the background, it makes the level feel alive. The art is also amazing, combined with all of the animations helps the theme a ton.

2fs-KPEgXx4.title: ''At The Top'' 100% (Demon) by Nightning & Javp | Geometry Dash
2fs-KPEgXx4.description:
An extremely colorful collab that pulls out all the stops when it comes to movement and effects. One thing I always enjoy in a level is not only a buildup in music and gameplay but also in the effects department. Starting off with lighter hues and slower movements on the objects combined with some small lighting effects to the beat of the song. Right when the drop hits is when the level practically explodes, starting off with a very nice text transition that takes us into a barrage of flashing lights and changing colors, along with the equalizer effects that are in the background that tie everything together extremely well.

Song: Summit by Creo
https://youtu.be/lk68Pdzhutw

j7fHmga6XEc.title: (Insane Demon) ''Bionic Rush'' 100% by Rustere & HugusTheNoob | Geometry Dash
j7fHmga6XEc.description: Bionic Rush is a level that knows what it wants to be and nails it perfectly, the mechanical/machine theme is well executed, the color palette, taking advantage of more muddy hues, such as the green, brown and even some blue here and there, fitting in with the 3D neon-styled block design, which by the way is my favorite aspect about this level, the 3D effect on the blocks looks fantastic, combined with the movement that was implemented to sync with the music, truly makes this level feel alive. There are other effects present all around the level, especially prominent in the first half of the level, there are some lighting effects that emphasize the transitions and other unique ones that I enjoyed like the ones at 0:35 that showcase a sort of pipeline effect within the blocks that looks nice.

Pp6fmJkZ1o8.title: ''Secret Way'' 100% (Demon) by Booglee [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
Pp6fmJkZ1o8.description: A level that takes a concept that has been around Geometry Dash for a very long time, Secret Way takes this and molds it, elevates it to a completely new level, ending up with something incredibly unique and interesting. The star of this level is definitely the sync with the music, everything, from the effects, to the blocks and transitions are made with the song in mind, combining everything very nicely. Now, the block design and the backgrounds are on the simpler side, not having much decoration or color, but the effects, especially the blur with a 3D tint added on to it, makes up for this and even more. The way this effect simulates fast movement really does make you feel like you're zooming through the level. The bossfight takes this effect and uses it to complement it's movements and attacks, along with it's clean art, makes for a great ending to a great level.

K3Gj1wJVcwo.title: Icons Race II by VegasKoneko | Geometry Dash
K3Gj1wJVcwo.description: A really nice improvement from the original Icons Race that I beat over 8 months ago, a level that basically consists of your icon being followed by a handful of famous players and content creators of GD. This time around the level is 3 minutes long, a step up from the original 2 and something minutes, with better animations, both from the icons and the obstacles, a more unique placement of the block design with some great designs and even some bits of background art that give a small respite from the plain layout backgrounds. This is one of those levels that is as fun to look at as it is to play, it's easy when it comes to difficulty, but the fact that there are others following makes it a lot more interesting.

dQjHPO3q5hs.title: ''Light Coronation'' 100% (Demon) by ExtraCrispyCroc | Geometry Dash
dQjHPO3q5hs.description: A level that has a very elegant aesthetic to it, and even honoring it's name having a very "royal" theme as well. Being comprised mostly of pink, purple and even some hints of yellow to accentuate some obstacles, the style is nailed extremely well, the soft colors really help the block design with it's beautiful decorations and even the subtle art that can be found in the background. There isn't much to say about the effects, the only one that's noticeable is the flashing lights in sync with the music and a couple of animations serving as transitions and the wings at the end. Overall, a very beautiful level that knows what it wants to do and doesn't give anything more or anything less.

RXMf26WGDOA.title: ''SYNAPSE II'' 100% (Demon) by KowZ & More | Geometry Dash
RXMf26WGDOA.description: A massive improvement on all fronts from the original SYNAPSE that was released over 4 years ago, from the block designs, to the different backgrounds with bits of art sprinkled inside, the effects are up to date as well, but at the same time there are creators on this project that participated in the original as well, so it's nice to see all the different styles come together. But with that comes a bit of inconsistency, there is no theme to be found here, it's just kind of everyone doing their own thing, with that being said, it's not necessarily a bad thing, each part has something unique to it and although it isn't very cohesive as a whole package it's still very fun to play.

9YkTURdVui0.title: ''Time Warp'' 100% (Demon) by AbstractDark [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
9YkTURdVui0.description: Time Warp is the level that marks AbstractDark's return after a couple of years of being practically dissapeared from the game, so it's always great to see someone that was so important long ago come back, and this is the perfect comeback level. Staying true to his style, Time Warp is an explosion of color from wherever you look at it, the block design, the backgrounds, the lighting and even the effects. I like the green and red combination that can be found in some parts of this, gives the level a Christmas vibe, although this was probably not the intention. The effects are really nice, mostly being pulsing lights in sync with the music and combining with all of the colors that appear on screen.

fG7KGKq2bvg.title: ''Through The Top'' 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax | Geometry Dash
fG7KGKq2bvg.description: A brand new level from Cirtrax that was released about a week ago, Through the Top is in my opinion, his best creation to date, and you can see why right away, the amount of effort he put into this really shines through from whichever way you look a it. The atmosphere is perfect the whole way through, giving a sense of progression, starting off slow, with the music and the gameplay, making the level a bit darker than usual, to then build up slowly becoming completely erratic and chaotic at the drop. The effects are fantastic, especially at the beginning, having a red and blue 3d/blurry effect along with the creature that is peeking from behind the blocks, there are also some swiping effects in between sections and even in the middle of some parts. The colors are bright yet aggresive which I think fits the vibe perfectly.

d3gqy_x7GYc.title: ''Antichamber'' 100% (Demon) by quid | Geometry Dash [2.11]
d3gqy_x7GYc.description: Antichamber is a level that uses a ton of different lines and shapes to make optical illusions and impossible geometries, making for some really nice effects towards the second half of the level. Starting off with a sketch oriented style, with a slow pace, not much brightness to the level, using very thin lines to color the block design and obstacles with some pillars decorating the background, before slowly building up both with it's design and gameplay to the climax of the level, with all of these really cool effects.

veKFi04k9GU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Daydream'' 100% by Yendis | Geometry Dash
veKFi04k9GU.description:
Yendis' first Extreme Demon, Daydream is a themed level that deviates heavily from the norm of other levels of this difficulty, having a lighthearted and vibrant atmosphere and vibe, both in terms of the design and even the music to go along with it, instead of being just a red and black layout with minimal decoration. The block design is simplistic but varied in many ways, while still staying in tune with the rest of the design, apart from taking full advantage of all the colors that were used. Same thing can be said about the backgrounds, they aren't anything super complicated but the various shapes that are implemented are clean and even have some smooth animations to go with them. 

The gameplay is unbalanced in my opinion, some sections are harder than others, becoming a bit frustrating at times, there weren't any bugs that I encountered however which is a plus.

81filhWlQqs.title: Disasterpeace II by Leoftine | Geometry Dash
81filhWlQqs.description: More than two and a half years later from the release of the first installment in the Disasterpeace series, both being remakes of the very popular game Fez, and having played it before, I have to say right away that Leoftine nailed it. Expanding upon the first level, it stays true to the game it's inspired by, while building on top of it and managing to be even better than the original. The design is incredibly clean and the art is beautiful, almost seeming as if it was ripped straight from the game. The colors are vibrant and fit together nicely with the rest of the decoration and the gameplay is a good representation of the original. Highly recommend you try this out.

DRJ5nhgunZw.title: ''Enil Noxes'' 100% (Demon) by Wintter [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
DRJ5nhgunZw.description: Enil Noxes is a level that focuses very heavily on effects, transitions and especially the bossfight aspect. Right from the beginning you can tell that this is going to be an experience, the music, the atmosphere that's created right as the level starts, the pacing, the way the colors are used, the buildup towards the drop, combined with all the lighting effects that are used to emphasize the block design, and the bossfights with their clean design, spectacular attacks and vibrant colors fit together perfectly.

29NTgRXWuMc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Napalm'' 100% by Marwec & More | Geometry Dash
29NTgRXWuMc.description: A beautiful collab with a ton of extremely talented creators on board, Napalm is an Extreme Demon that oozes style and high quality design. Right from the beginning, you can tell this isn't your ordinary Extreme, you can see the attention to detail that was put into it, using bright oranges, reds, some shades of pink to give the level the fiery aura and atmosphere that the title suggests. The block design is varied from one section to the next, and although it's on the simpler side, it fits the theme and aesthetic perfectly. There are some backgrounds to be found here, mainly chains, tubes, pipes and gears, giving a mechanical undertone to the vibrant colors in the foreground. My favorite part is at 0:56, the transition looks great as with the rest of them, but the main attraction are all the colors that appear on screen, changing from one hue to the other, in sync with the song, looks fantastic in my opinion. The gameplay is consistent, one of the more fun Extreme Demons out there, definitely recommend it if you're up for a challenge.

vx_aHQgNcYg.title: "Out of Focus" 100% by xXLocoXx | Geometry Dash
vx_aHQgNcYg.description: A level that combines art and effects incredibly well, this case being a gaussian blur effect, which is executed to perfection by xXLocoXx, definitely one of the best implementations of an effect of this nature, the way he makes it look and feel as if you're looking through a magnifying glass, simulating depth perception, is something that not everyone can pull off, the effect is really consistent throughout the entire level, adding some difficulty to a couple of sections in the process, which I think is a nice touch, the art is on the simpler side, but paired with the blur it's barely noticable.

fB_tvJ0ddj0.title: ''Interstellar Infant'' 100% (Demon) by Fault | Geometry Dash
fB_tvJ0ddj0.description: Fault is a creator that has been constantly improving and evolving his style with each new releases, and this is no different, in my opinion his best level up until now, Interstellar Infant showcases how good he can be combining colors and effects, especially lighting to emphasize them, it has a varied block design, showing different styles and designs in each section and the transitions from one part to the next are visually appealing and smooth to look at. It also has a nice sense of pace and sync with the song that was chosen, overall a great level from Fault, excited to see what he comes up with next.

qELDdjL1kAs.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Black Blizzard'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash
qELDdjL1kAs.description:
Wow, 3 years ago I couldn't even pass 10%, and now I beat it. I'm shocked at how quick I beat this, since I haven't played any harder extremes in months. About the level, I think this is one my favorite if not my favorite extreme demon, It's so fun to play and learn, the beginning can get a bit annoying but the few times you get past the first 40% you have a very good chance of beating the level, which is what happened to me. Super happy to have this done now, GG :)

Song: Dimension by Creo
https://youtu.be/MrD05HVGVIQ

nVHCWLSMJLY.title: ''Twisted Fantasy'' 100% (Demon) by ToastLord | Geometry Dash
nVHCWLSMJLY.description:
Twisted Fantasy is a level that surprises you, being almost all black and white the entire first half up until the drop, only having some flashes of dull colors weaved in between the beat, as if it's trying to pump life into itself, with the only effects being some flashes of light coming from inside the player and others from the edges of the block design and the exterior part of the level. Something that I really like about this is that it kind of baits you, when the drop hits, you would expect the level to explode when you get to this point, since it did have a feeling of buildup just before, both in terms of the design and the music, but it doesn't, it just goes slightly faster and the same flashes of colors from before are used, but that's where it gets you, just a bit after it catches you completely off-guard, you go through a small cone shaped tunnel, and then there's color everywhere.

But what I enjoy about this, is the fact that the level is still black and white, but there are so many colors accenting and emphasizing different parts of the decoration; the block design, the obstacles, even adding in some beautiful art in the backgrounds and even in the foreground. After a bit of this, the level adopts a simpler design, but it adds a really nice wavelength effect/animation, splitting the level in half basically, along with the use of the shake effect, adding a lot of depth and weight to this section. The level finally goes black and white again with some glimpses of colors here and there in different forms, with a nice animation at the end where a couple of hands appear along with a flash of light which I thought was a great effect to top everything off.

Song: Lightmare by Creo
https://youtu.be/U0hibvFfRdg

Ptswn1IYn1c.title: ''Lacheln'' 100% by ItzM1ntJelly & maplegaegosu | Geometry Dash
Ptswn1IYn1c.description: An amazing art level brought to us by a couple of unknown and underrated creators, so it's always a pleasure to see when unseen creators emerge to make something special, a breakthrough level for them, showing the potential they have for future creations. The backgrounds in this are fantastic, being varied but at the same time staying consistent in their high quality, whether it's the apartments in the beginning, the tower with the beautiful butterfly that comes right after or the bright pink forest with flowers decorating the floor. The block design also fits very nicely with the rest of the decoration, both in terms of design and color coordination, there's a bunch of detail in this, no matter from where you look at it.

X4Hu7szGmsA.title: ''Soul Searching'' 100% (Demon) by TMNGaming [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
X4Hu7szGmsA.description:
After a more than 2 year hiatus from TMN, it's very nice to finally see him release something brand new, and I have to say it's definitely one of his best, the design is amazing, starting off from the block design, there are various types and styles in this, the first one we see is a mosaic-type block, with different colors on the inside with a clear aesthetic, looking like colored glass, following the same pattern into the next section where this style is adapted into the obstacles, changing colors in sync with the music which I thought was a nice touch. We then get a gray block design with hexagons on the inside, fitting together nicely with the backgrounds. After that we switch to a similar design, but this time it has a purple hue, switching between levels of saturation depending on the intensity of the rest of the level. The backgrounds along with the effects that are used to emphasize them, we see different bits of art in each section, fitting in with the rest of the design, the color palette and the effects.

Music: Cosmos by CamicalMusic
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/868058

yNXZA974rSM.title: ''Remnants'' 100% (Demon) by Arb & More | Geometry Dash
yNXZA974rSM.description:
A themed collab hosted by Arb, having a variety of very talented creators on board, staying perfectly consistent in it's high quality, whether it's the effects, making the colors and the block design pop out in sync with the song, speaking about the block design, I really like how in some of the sections, it's extremely detailed and in others there is a more simplistic approach, while still combining the different perspectives and styles.

Music: Sharks by Infowler
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/898096

dYi54KVuugc.title: (Insane Demon) ''Arcane'' 100% by qMystic & More | Geometry Dash
dYi54KVuugc.description: A brand new level from qMystic brought to us with help from other very talented creators, a hell themed level that isn't like your standard red and black "Demon" themed levels that you see pop up every now and then. Arcane is a level that uses a ton of different colors, has a wide variety of effects that emphasize the incredibly clean block design and accentuates the beautiful art that was created for this level, whether it's the flashing lights that make certain sections pop out in sync with the music, or the us of lighting effects to give others a lot more atmosphere. Speaking about the art, there are only a few instances of it, maybe 2 or 3, but what you get is on a whole other level, the demon at the beginning is extremely detailed, wrapped up in the orange and red lava, looks amazing, definitely takes you by surprise the first time you see it, the city and silhouette of the same demon at the end are also very detailed, wrapping up the level nicely. Overall, Arcane is an XL demon that's worth giving a shot just on design alone, highly recommend it.

_tdI1ezmdYk.title: ''HIGHWAYS'' 100% (Demon) by F5night | Geometry Dash [2.11]
_tdI1ezmdYk.description:
A city themed level from the incredibly talented F5night, his levels always having a theme, and we're used to seeing them being executed very well, and this is no different, his super detailed style and art is always an enormous pleasure to look at, this one being mostly dominated by the color blue, with some red and purple accents here and there, with a ton of neon all around the block design and backgrounds, the effects are great as well, having some lighting and text effects, with some explosions to top it off. The really short gun boss that you find at the end looks great, the effects on it's attacks are nice and it's movements are smooth as well.

Music: Authority by Xtrullor
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/765333

oi3X4s9tSiw.title: ''Dream Flower'' 100% (Demon) by Xender Game & Knots | Geometry Dash
oi3X4s9tSiw.description:
KLYDIX - Dream Flower
https://youtu.be/GP4Lw1noiZA
KLYDIX: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfQcbSUdMUi4P3XOnzH6pMg

Dream Flower has some of the most beautiful art, animations, colors, effects and block design I've seen in recent months, every single section in this level has something different and unique, while still staying in line with the "Dream" Theme, while being connected and intertwine by transitions that are of the same high level of quality. Something to note as well, this level has a really good sense of pace, starting off mellow and slow, both in terms of gameplay and design, even musically, building up slowly until the drop hits, exploding with effects and animations, while having a faster paced gameplay. Another unique aspect we can find in this creation, is the fact that there are tiny bits where the gameplay and design become vertical, giving a higher sense of depth.

13umbIfSmQ0.title: ''Munacra'' 100% (Demon) by BlueRimz [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
13umbIfSmQ0.description:
Munacra is BlueRimz' entry for Hans' creator contest, which consists of you remaking one of his rated levels, this one being the level he did with Mulpan, Arcanum, and in my opinion, it came out looking really nice. There are some clear improvements you can see right from the get go, the block design is cleaner, while still staying in tune with the theme of the level, the space backgrounds are still present with some added effects on top. Apart from that it is really fun to play, there are gameplay elements that fit together really well and it has a nice pace to connect and wrap it all up.

Music: Ping! by Exyl
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/list...

EpPZlnVFdSM.title: ''Backbeat MANIAC'' 100% (Demon) by SpooFy | Geometry Dash [2.11]
EpPZlnVFdSM.description: A creator that has been getting a ton of rates recently, a rising star you could say, SpooFy comes at us with a level that is full to the brim with colors and movement, an incredibly hectic level, with fast paced gameplay that involves clicking a lot, almost entering the realm of spam, but still, it fits the music really well. Something that I enjoy a lot about the design of this, is how almost the entire level is black, with dark backgrounds and accents on the obstacles and blocks, but is very colorful in it's interiors, on the edges of the blocks and the entirety of the spikes, creating a beautiful contrast.

jhvttYUdB3c.title: ''Past'' 100% (Demon) by Neigefeu | Geometry Dash
jhvttYUdB3c.description:
A simplistic, yet incredibly charming level from Neigefeu, Past has a beautiful color palette, using a wide variety of shades and hues, the block design is extremely clean for what it is, just simple shapes, sometimes with a solid color, changing according to the rest of the decoration, or a subtle gradient effect. There are also some lighting effects here and there, accentuating the sync with the music, having the light flashing and pulsating. Something I really like about this is the fact that even with it's vibrant colors there are still some dark sections, that still fit in with the overall theme of the level, not looking or feeling out of place at all.

Music: Clocktown by 1f1n1ty
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/881941

QPvcSQwkBm0.title: ''Impostor'' 100% by Pugmaster706 | Geometry Dash
QPvcSQwkBm0.description: Impostor is a level based on Among Us, a game that pretty much everybody knows about at this point, from the block design, the art, the animations and pretty much every bit of decoration, is executed perfectly in my opinion. It showcases every map that the original game has to offer: The Skeld, Polus and Mira HQ, and each one is a perfect recreation, whether we're talking about the look of the map or the tasks that go along with it. There are also short animations showing different general events that can occur while playing, going into a vent, calling an emergency meeting and even when everyone is chatting trying to find the Impostor, with the chat box being used as the blocks, which is really unique, going as far as to show the player flying when they're thrown out of the airlock. There are "multiple endings" to this, just changing parts of the art slightly, which is a nice extra to have.

4duKIHzMshI.title: ''Capricorn'' 100% (Demon) by ItsBon & Asu [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4duKIHzMshI.description:
A level that is a perfect half and half, Bon was completely in charge of the decoration, the colors, the block design, the backgrounds, transitions and animations, while Asu was tasked with the gameplay side of things, the gamemodes, the difficulty, triggers portals and all the rest, and I have to say, they both did an amazing job. Having a sort of "mystic" theme, this level has it all, an incredibly clean color palette, using a wide variety while staying away from over-saturating the whole thing. The block design is probably the simplest part of the design, while still fitting in really well with the rest of the decoration. There are some animations here and there, mostly to emphasize the transitions or the sync with the gameplay. There are also some backgrounds to note here, small glimpses of text and landscapes, especially at the end with the giant moon in the sky, overall a very nice level, with a bunch to offer anyone who plays it.

Song: Epilogue by Creo
https://youtu.be/tOZNh8veU_Y

asyBvMbjByE.title: IO by Spark | Geometry Dash
asyBvMbjByE.description: If you were to look up the definition of a "Clean Level" there should be a link to this level alongside it, IO has an incredibly satisfying design, really nice to look at and fun to play through. Having a neon colored aesthetic, giving a "retro" vibe to the level, combined with the simplistic block design and obstacles, being comprised only of very thin lines, fit together perfectly in my opinion. That being said, there is a section that switches things up a bit, starting at 0:50, where the blocks look a lot fuller, having a color effect on it, switching them around rapidly, giving this part a more "psychadelic" tone than the rest of the level, which does give it some variety before switching back to the original design.

ISpBV8n4frs.title: (Insane Demon) ''Amuletum'' 100% by Toughfey | Geometry Dash
ISpBV8n4frs.description: Toughfey's first themed level, this one being "Black Magic", as you can see from the overall color palette, being dark in some places and vibrant in others and the various symbols and shapes found in the decoration, both in the foreground and background, building up in intensity as it moves forward, so in my opinion, he absolutely nailed the theme. There are so many small and subtle details in this that just amplify and reinforce the theme even more, the symbols decorating the back or the gems inside the block design, everything fits together very nicely. And even though it does follow a theme, every section is different in it's own unique way, while still intertwining perfectly together. The gameplay is a bit easier than most Insane Demons, there are some parts that are easier than others, but it stays consistent nonetheless.

IJpUKuqDXIs.title: ''Light'' 100% by DavJT | Geometry Dash [2.11]
IJpUKuqDXIs.description: A level from an already extremely well established and incredibly unique creator, DavJT, a creation that is completely different, separating itself from the norm in terms of design and gameplay elements as well. The first half of the level has some of the smoothest gameplay, having a sort of swing-copter like feel to it, but at a much slower pace, combining perfectly with the speed and mood of the music, along with the subtle, simplistic yet beautiful design, with it's smooth block design and calming color palette. The section that comes after this is similar in design but the gameplay is switched to the ball, and what is really unique about this is the fact that isn't doesn't play like the ball at all, it's like the cube but with a much lower gravity, making you feel as if you were floating. But as with every great level, there is buildup, both in music and design, and when the drop hits you're screen starts to get filled with all sorts of colors, flashing lights and fast paced gameplay.

ogA7Ud3yEzY.title: ''Fortune Teller'' 100% (Demon) by Scrumpy & More | Geometry Dash
ogA7Ud3yEzY.description:
From the same group that created "Wawa" and "Sminx Squad", Fortune Teller is the newest installment brought to us by this group of extremely talented creators, a psychic themed level made for halloween, and I have to say, they hit the nail straight on the head. Every section fits together incredibly well while still being different and unique in their own ways. Whether it's changes in color, both in terms of hue and saturation, or the block design, it being smooth and simplistic, or rough and very detailed, the quality in the design stays consistent the whole way through, the transitions are really good as well, nothing too flashy, but still having it's own flair to it. To top it all off, the animation at the very end of the level, when you find yourself enclosed, ended up looking fantastic, very nice to way to finish the level.

ID: 64930910
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/970981

VeZk_KTxAtQ.title: ''CastleMania'' 100% (Demon) by Serponge & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
VeZk_KTxAtQ.description:
Rapidly becoming one of the best levels of all time, CastleMania, does what so many of us in the community could only dream of when we first started playing, it raises the bar for so many other creators and levels, breaking every mold imaginable, both in terms of idea, concept and especially in execution, when we´re talking about design, game play and even from a technical standpoint, this creation has it all, checking all the boxes and more of what a great level can become so much more.

The level begins with you going through a forest with a bunch of trees surrounding you, with a dark and purple tinted night sky in the background, with even more trees to fill in the blanks, quickly becoming a mist filled graveyard with a really nice rain effect to top it off. This doesn't last long though as we see ourselves enter a giant castle (the door opening to let you in is a really nice touch in my opinion) this entire section is as great as you'd expect, the colors are fantastic, combined with the subtle yet powerful lighting effects that give it a very accurate atmosphere to what you'd imagine a castle/chapel to look like. And although it starts off with a relatively calming presence, after a bit everything gets more intense, there's more movement in the blocks, there's a more sinister tint to the effects and backgrounds, nice for buildup.

We exit the castle for a brief moment, to see that the light rain that we saw earlier has now become a full on storm, which is a nice detail, making it feel like you're playing this in real-time, the sky along with it's effects change hues a couple of times, even becoming a very strong red, adding to the "evil" vibe of this place. We then re enter the castle, and after a couple of seconds are thrown into a bossfight, the first one being the reaper, I love just about everything about this, the art for the boss, his attacks and the effects that go along with them, there are also some lighting effects that add to the intensity of the fight, which I like to see, the fight lasts for about 30 seconds, taking you outside again with the storm at it's limit. Incredible stuff, and that's just one of the routes you can take.
