The next route starts out the same as the previous, but instead of taking the bridge to enter the castle, you take a leap of faith under it and fall into a precipice, taking us to the Deep Path. Immediately after we fall, we find ourselves inside a sewer system, I really like this part simply because of the bloom effect that combines perfectly with the cyan hue that's present in this section. Almost becoming a neon color, the boxes floating around being used as platforms is a really nice touch as well, and the subtle art in the background too, lending a sense of depth. After that, we arrive at a totally different section of the sewer, with purple being the predominant color, what I like most about this is the colors that the spikes have, an almost rgb effect that is extremely nice to look at. The level opens up and we get to the first part of the boss fight, a giant skull creature with even more skulls surrounding it as a sort of shield. The design is really cool and it's animations are as smooth as butter, with the rest of the level taking a simpler tone, as to emphasize the boss itself. We escape through a long red tunnel, and arrive at a green, almost "toxic" section, and here we can see a glimpse of one of the best parts of this level, the vertical traversal makes the level feel enormous, truly making it look and feel like a metroidvania. Along withe the small details, such as the cobwebs scattered around the blocks and pretty much taking up 40% of the screen at one point which adds a lot to the overall atmosphere. After this we get to the final boss-fight of this route, but it's not the skeleton we encountered earlier, it's a giant rotating eyeball that shoots lasers, the backgrounds for this boss are practically empty, shifting your attention completely on the boss and dodging it's attacks, the design for the boss and it's attacks look great to me and is a perfect way to top it off.

In order to get the final coin in this video, the Library Path, you must go into the castle, same as the first route, but this time, you have to touch a hidden pad that can be seen at 4:11, taking you through a secret passageway, you go through some dark and dirty ducts or tunnels and when you exit you appear to find yourself in a green house, completely taken over by plants and greenery. After a while you enter a giant library, with ghosts of several different colors flying around, being illuminated only by candles that cover the ground, found bundled together with books and webs. The level then takes a darker turn, taking you to a much spookier section, having a bloody red tint in the form of a vignette, with several haunted paintings seen in the background, which serves as a path to the very short final boss fight, a book that also shoots lasers. Being simpler but just as great

M-9sMV14FBI.title: ''CastleMania'' 100% (Demon) by Serponge & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
M-9sMV14FBI.description: An enormous level that has been awaited by most of the community for some time now, being one of the most ambitious projects ever thought of and especially executed. The most amazing thing about this level is the fact that it's basically a ton of levels on top of each other, which is the reason why it took a while to come out and was delayed several times, just so it could work. The unique part about this, being the several routes that you can take, with a different ending to top off each one. The one I took, this being the Reaper Route, took me a lot more time than I thought, since you have to follow a series of steps, touch various objects in order to go the route that you want.

wFeIWcIdAxY.title: ''Mesin'' 100% (Demon) by AmorAltra | Geometry Dash
wFeIWcIdAxY.description: A really nice solo level from AmorAltra, what I like most about this is definitely the color scheme, the purple, pink, red and even orange tints you can spot throughout the level fit together perfectly, they are all on the same spectrum but they still look varied. Another thing that has to do with the colors, is the theme, being very industrial, from the block design, to the backgrounds and the art, giving all the machinery featured a smooth yet serious look. The gameplay is simple and straightforward, consistent the whole way through with some nice variety when it comes to gamemodes.

MA8ESWYR4Ts.title: ''VOIVOID'' 100% by Insidee [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
MA8ESWYR4Ts.description: A level that is just over a minute long, this has a dark, gloomy, confusing atmosphere, with a very simple block design, almost adopting a "sketch" style at some points, but the main focus of this, are the effects and the backgrounds, and we can't forget about the music, which is just as important as every other element in a level. Starting off slow, showing the contents of the level in flickering intervals, after only ten seconds, the level kicks off into 5th gear, with a very rapid pace, both in gameplay, audio and design, flashing different images and text at you, bouncing you all around in the meantime, before slowing down again from halfway all the way till the end. I always enjoy levels like this, that have a mysterious aura to them, almost becoming creepy, very enjoyable to play and see, at least to me.

K-xJwY8bano.title: ''Cempasuchil'' 100% by Dyzex [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
K-xJwY8bano.description: One of the most beautiful levels I've seen recently, Cempasuchil (this being a very popular flower used traditionally when celebrating and honoring the dead in Dia de los Muertos) is stunning on all fronts, whether it's the incredibly clean block design, being simplistic in it's way but still having enough decoration to fit in with the rest of what the level has to offer, even changing color to match the backgrounds and art. Speaking of the backgrounds, these are definitely the best parts of the level, the altar with the pictures of your loved ones and the decorations along with the offerings you send to them when they cross over, the short section with all the houses being completely decorated along with some neon lighting effects. With the part that comes right after being my favorite, the effects in this, the art, looking almost like a kaleidoscope, filled with colors and movement, leaves you in awe when you stare at it.

m0_a0zTeKP0.title: ''Speedstyling'' 100% by Dominuus | Geometry Dash [2.11]
m0_a0zTeKP0.description: A completely chaotic level, from the music, to the effects, the movement, backgrounds and especially the colors, but that being said it does have it's slower sections as well, notably the one at the beginning, being completely dark used as buildup for the drop and the rest of the level. Being built over the course of a month, I think it came out looking fantastic, the song together with what's going on in the level fit perfectly.

LZAhCsQSBTg.title: (Insane Demon) ''pointzero'' 100% by Digitalight & More | Geometry Dash
LZAhCsQSBTg.description: An amazing megacollab from Digitalight and 29 other extremely talented creators, there isn't a set or forced theme in this level, so every single creator had the liberty and freedom to do whatever they wanted, let their creativity run wild, and in my opinion it came out looking wonderful, a level doesn't have to have a theme or any cohesion to be good, if what you bring to the level is what you envision, it's going to end up working. But one thing that doesn't work as well is the gameplay, being just over 4 minutes long and with a ton of objects, there are some sections that are noticeably harder than others, and the transitions from one part to another make it really hard to react to what's coming next.

I6pEcoOpuR0.title: ''Sayonara'' 100% (Demon) by Freyda | Geometry Dash [2.11]
I6pEcoOpuR0.description: A modern level, with a very distinct and unique style and design, from the block design, to the black and white color scheme, emphasizing the obstacles while still giving a ton of detail to all the shapes and art in the background, the effects are also really nice, some lighting effects in between transitions or the section that is in diagonal, making it seem like you're going up a hill, which is always something different and nice to see, it gives the level something that makes it stand up.

PL69e9i2Rt8.title: ''Spoopier'' 100% by Unzor | Geometry Dash [2.11]
PL69e9i2Rt8.description: Spoopier, the sequel to last year's Spoopy which was a giant hit, also coming out the night before halloween. That being said, I feel that this time around the quality dropped a tiny bit, especially at the drop, falling flat, but the art and the atmosphere is still as cute as last years, the colors fit the theme extremely well and the block design is very simplistic but it serves it's purpose, overall a really nice halloween level, and although I prefer Spoopy I still highly recommend you give this one a shot.

dprq6VvD_bg.title: ''ClutterX'' 100% (Demon) by KuraiYonaka | Geometry Dash
dprq6VvD_bg.description: A level inspired by RobTop's Clutterfunk, made obvious by the name and design, elevated to a whole nother level in terms of quality, and the thing that surprises me the most about this is the fact that after 4 months it's still unrated. There are 3 main colors in this level, purple in the beginning half, a short green section and the rest is golden, there aren't any crazy changes in color or anything of the sort, which sometimes is a good things, helps keep the focus on the design. The block design is more modern while still reminding us of the original, and there are some effects here and there to highlight certain parts of the song or the transitions.

0-QS385ttLc.title: (Insane Demon) ''Zacarias'' 100% by BrazilTeam | Geometry Dash
0-QS385ttLc.description: A Nine Circles themed level coming from the extremely talented BrazilTeam, right away you can tell this is going to be high quality, from the effects, some small glitch effects, the rapid flashing lights, the changes in brightness and opacity, to the block design, being a great style all the way throughout, simple yet elaborated, the transitions being seamless and straightforward, focusing on making the gameplay good and the colors, along with the few backgrounds that can be seen in various points.

zZctLGOUZms.title: ''Lambda'' 100% (Demon) by Tchotchke | Geometry Dash
zZctLGOUZms.description: Movement is the name of the game for this level, and Lambda takes advantage of that anywhere it can, being a decorated remake of 19ZZ by BBosom3, a layout that came out a while back, there is some pressure put onto this to be good, and it is a major improvement, you can really see this level come alive with all the decoration, design and effects put into it, having a simpler, monochrome style and even though there aren't any vibrant colors or crazy effects, it still looks great, and the gameplay is where this shines, the movement as I said in the beginning is extremely unique, whether it's the level shifting around, moving you around so you can get through the obstacles, or just glitching out, it's something we don't see very often, only in layouts, but being decorated is a breath of fresh air.

cF8XMgV55Fc.title: ''Oscars Voice'' 100% by Bluskys & AmorAltra | Geometry Dash [2.11]
cF8XMgV55Fc.description: A pixel style Halloween themed level, and a very good one at that, I've always felt that the "Pixel Art" design fits GD perfectly, overall it's a very pleasing aesthetic, fun but at the same time can be used for almost anything, for something pretty, for something epic and even more horror oriented, such as Oscars Voice. Right from the get-go, the art is spectacular, from the ghost that's following you around throughout the level, to the different sceneries we get to experience, whether it's the haunted library, the spooky forest, or a dark and damp cave, with different colors and lighting effects to pump up the atmosphere wherever it can, every section is different but at the same time stays in tune with the theme.

jIBs3R90tYE.title: ''Lennoxtourious'' 100% by Gachristian1 & R4NGER [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
jIBs3R90tYE.description:
Gachristian's "magnum opus" as he called it, Lennoxtourious is overall just an incredibly clean level, something that's almost soothing to look at, the theme is clear from the very beginning, with the purple hue being the predominant color all throughout, contrasting with the yellow squares that look like windows and all the stars that fill the empty space with varying sizes. The art is exceptional as well, whether it's the planets, the stars or the different shapes decorating the background, the animations that come with them are very smooth, especially towards the ending.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/704018

YlAFOwYRKFM.title: ''Flicker'' 100% (Demon) by SirHadoken [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
YlAFOwYRKFM.description: A brand new level from SirHadoken, deviating from his typical style, just as he did with the one before this, CONK. I always enjoy seeing creators work outside of the box or break their own mold when it comes to effects, designs and styles. As the title of the level states, the most dominant and obvious effect that we're going to see is the "flicker" effect, from the block design, to the obstacles, backgrounds and basically the entire level, coming in and out of frame, appearing and disappearing in sync with the music, a style we don't see to often as it also adds another layer of difficulty to the creation, despite that, the rest of the design is really well made as you'd expect from Hadoken.

MXvr-u6s6jc.title: Ledge by PotatoBaby | Geometry Dash
MXvr-u6s6jc.description:
A simple, slick and clean level from PotatoBaby, I really enjoy levels like these, they have a clear theme, they stay consistent in design and quality all throughout, without needing to go overboard on decoration. Something that I found interesting are the sections that surprise you with sudden bursts of color, using so many different shades and hues at different contrasts, making the level look and feel extremely vibrant for a couple of seconds towards the end of the level beginning from the second half. The first half is just as good, being very simple with a couple of lines comprising the block design and the obstacles, with giant text accompanying you as you go through changing rapidly in between frases, the wave section that comes after has some really nice glitch and hue shift effects, drawing your attention making it seem that the level is rotating for a fraction of a second, small details like this make a level stand out.

Music: Waterflame - Precarious
https://youtu.be/srXxpuDUwBE

mNaXAjk_t4Y.title: ''Sedulous'' 100% (Demon) by Samifying [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
mNaXAjk_t4Y.description: A level by Samifying that has been in the works for 3 years, and you can tell from a thousand miles away the incredible amount of detail that was put into every single inch of the level, every single pixel you turn to see is beautifully crafted, the block design is decorated with a ton of thought, bringing it to life in ways I haven't seen in a long time, and even though it's a very fast paced level, you still somehow get the opportunity to appreciate the colors, the effects, the beautiful pieces of art scattered throughout this creation, there are so many bits of detail with so many vibrant colors almost feels like you're going through a carnival, seeing all the lights and all the rides in their glory. A true masterpiece that should be remembered for years to come.

g4nN56H1QfY.title: ''Emojipedia'' 100% by Bluskys | Geometry Dash [2.11]
g4nN56H1QfY.description: A colorful level by Bluskys with an extremely consistent theme and really nice art to back it up, this being comprised of emojis. I think he did a great job of implementing each piece of art in different parts of the level, whether it's in the background or foreground. Something that I enjoyed quite a lot from playing this is the fact that almost every bit of decoration has animation, moving around from side to side, up and down or in sync with the music, things like this really breathe life into the level and gives it a happy and vibrant vibe overall.

WFacDNzKubA.title: Made in one day! | ''Three'' 100% by 1374 & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
WFacDNzKubA.description: A megacollab that despite what the majority of people would believe at first sight, was made in just one day, so the fact that all of these different styles and designs were able to be put in in such a short amount of time and still look as good as they do, while giving the level cohesion and all the sections blending in with each other relatively well is really impressive. The only part I'd say that doesn't fit in with the rest is the very first, having a completely different style than the rest, these being a more futuristic and techy approach, that being said, it still looks really good on it's own, and the rest of the sections are of the same quality. Gameplay-wise, what you see is what you get, it's pretty straightforward.

vm9K2QLf7Tg.title: ''Luminant'' 100% (Demon) by Akinawoo & More | Geometry Dash
vm9K2QLf7Tg.description: A collab by Akinawoo and several other talented creators, although it took much longer to be released than originally intended, it still is a really solid level, the effects are the star of this creation, from the very beginning, you can tell by the way that the colors change slowly, with the level not being illuminated in it's entirety, and it's very slow pace, travelling through the very clean block design, that adopts each color entirely as it changes along with the sync of the music. There are almost no backgrounds in this level, except for the single lamp that appears behind everything at 0:44, with the rest appearing in the front of the blocks, which I think is a nice touch given the name of the level.

SB_kd4JI_z0.title: ''Rewind'' 100% (Demon) by Darwin | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SB_kd4JI_z0.description: A brand new solo level from Darwin, that has been long overdue in my opinion, being a bit more challenging than his usual levels, but the effects and design are what you'd expect from him, high quality as always, being half and half this time around, being a good combination of both, a clean yet detailed block design, beautiful backgrounds with all the art that was implemented, and to top it all off, the effects together with all of this give this creation a whole other layer of detail, making everything pop out, and emphasizing the most important parts of the decoration.

kAflH54XsBc.title: ''Long Live The King'' 100% by Hannn | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kAflH54XsBc.description: An incredibly nice and detailed XL level by Hannn, another beautiful creation we can add to his list of his most recent art levels, although those have been quite short, so it's always nice to see when creators take their time to flesh out levels as long as this. The overall aesthetic of the level is a crystalline, clear and very clean, nothing too over the top, just beautiful art combined with simple yet effective effects and a simplistic block design.

-PClYRMzE6c.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Thanatophobia'' 100% by Artumanka & More | Geometry Dash
-PClYRMzE6c.description: I love absolutely everything about this level, from the incredibly dark atmosphere, combined with the lighting effects, and some fog and smoke to give the level a bit more of a thematic feeling and aesthetic. Speaking about the lighting effects, they are used to perfection in this, the rythmic flashes and moments of darkness help the theme a ton, small details like this always makes a level stand out above the rest.

S5tQ9qacDSM.title: (Insane Demon) ''Cursedfunk'' 100% by TCTeam [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
S5tQ9qacDSM.description: A level that came out over a year ago, a megacollab by TCTeam, a creation that has great effects, great colors, good pace with the music and although there aren't many backgrounds apart from the cityscape at 1:05, which came out looking great, the combination of the red and black and dark atmosphere make this section stand out above all the rest. The block design is a bit on the simpler side, but I feel it does accentuate the rest of the decoration very nicely.

P_ViWp18FOg.title: ''Majesty'' 100% (Demon) by FunnyGame | Geometry Dash [2.11]
P_ViWp18FOg.description: A level that came out 2 years ago, yet another creation that more than deserves a rating, for the time the effects, the colors, the animations and the overall design are astounding, completely ahead of when it was released, the gameplay is also really good, accentuating and really helping the decoration shine through. My favorite section is the one at 0:42, the use of black and white looks great, and so different from the rest of the level, the flashes of light along with the art in the background and the animations at the end fit together perfectly.

FWliM5oMLnE.title: ''4 Your Eyes'' 100% by AlmanzaAR [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
FWliM5oMLnE.description: Another beautiful level by a completely unknown creator, a masterpiece by Almanza, somebody who has no creator points to his name, but after seeing this, that fact just boggles my mind. A level that was uploaded 10 months ago, and hasn't been rated to this day, these are some very original effects from start to finish, this is a treat, both from a design and a gameplay standpoint. There is something completely different offered to you in each and every section, effects used in unique ways intertwined with several pieces of art placed around the level, everything mixes together beautifully.

mwd_Ncrgw7Q.title: "Motivation" 100% (Demon) by Rockwizard5 | Geometry Dash
mwd_Ncrgw7Q.description: This is Rockwizards' first serious level, and it blew away all expectations, with color being the main focus of the level, from just about every aspect, whether it be the blocks and obstacles, the backgrounds or the effects, it's a perfect mix of vibrant colors and darkness.

ActntBwUaCs.title: ''Violent Silence'' 100% (Demon) by Zoroa | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ActntBwUaCs.description: A level that incredibly has stayed unrated since it's release 9 months ago, a level that has it's effects nailed down perfectly, whether it's the lighting effects, showing you the way, highlighting the decoration, the block design and backgrounds, or being used in transitions, the animations inside the block design, especially in the wave sections, or the part at 0:14, with more than half of the level being hidden in darkness for a few seconds, an effect that I haven't seen in a while that adds a lot of depth to these different parts, The part at 0:30 is also really nice, with the two halves joining together, the colors are also used in a great way.

SgNE5kXCrqI.title: ''Sky Tower'' 100% (Demon) by Rafer [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
SgNE5kXCrqI.description: A level that has it all, the effects are amazing, they blend incredibly well with the block design, with the backgrounds, especially at 0:26, where the gameplay is also very unique, shifting from side to side almost like a bullet hell, it controls really well and the effects that are used to emphasize the gameplay also fit nicely. There is a ton of detail in just about every corner of this level, and it has so much variation in it's design and style, some sections could even be their own creations, that's how good they look.

l5G7cwVAiqc.title: ''Zetrallio'' 100% (Demon) by Terron | Geometry Dash [2.11]
l5G7cwVAiqc.description: Zetrallio is the newest level from already established and very popular creator, Terron, it's been a while since he's made anything, so this is a bit of a welcome back for him. The effects are fantastic, from the block design, to the backgrounds, to the different bits of art scattered around the level. Having a dark, demonic, yet futuristic theme fits every piece of decoration perfectly as well.

GToCvKbiPzA.title: ''Armadillo Dash'' 100% (Demon) by DYZEX [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
GToCvKbiPzA.description: A level that takes advantage of it's colors to their fullest potential, from the block design that has a 3d style to it in some sections, and 2d in others,  but what makes it stand out from every other piece of decoration is it's interiors, with it's shapes moving around inside, changing colors rapidly in sync with the music.

rJOQHJnCWPY.title: ''Shiver'' 100% (Demon) by Dienid & Nectaroso | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rJOQHJnCWPY.description:
Shiver is a very unique level from every aspect, the design is different from anything I've seen recently, being completely black and white, and some short sections that explode with hundreds of colors accompanied by glitch effects. The backgrounds are also very impressive, especially the section at 0:54. I truly feel like this is one of those levels that you have to play yourself to get the most out of it, it's an experience rather than a straightforward level. And that's only speaking about the design, the game play is incredibly varied, especially the parts that show the same thing in different windows, moving around on the screen, requiring a bit of memorization and a lot of attention, and it's mesmerizing to look at as well.

ID: 64246771
Music: https://m.soundcloud.com/false-noise/shiver

s2gFer3BoHc.title: ''Myriad'' 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax | Geometry Dash [2.11]
s2gFer3BoHc.description: Myriad is a level that recreates a ton of different creators' styles from the ground up and I think he did an amazing job of capturing the originals designs and vibes, all while maintaining the same color scheme so it feels like a long, cohesive level. Cirtrax has all the creators referenced in his creation on his channel.

-wRhzvUqYVU.title: ''Z911'' 100% (Demon) by Insidee | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-wRhzvUqYVU.description: The effects for this level are simply phenomenal, the sync with the music is perfect, using only black and white with a relatively simple block design, really lets all the attention and spotlight go to all the effects that are used in this, the flashes of light, the different movements and animations added in the backgrounds and the block design, the backgrounds aren't extremely detailed but they do add another layer to the theme of the level.

cJ_81ykKq9Y.title: ''Planetary Sector'' 100% (Demon) by Presta | Geometry Dash [2.11]
cJ_81ykKq9Y.description: Planetary Sector is a level from an unknown creator and by far the most impressive part about this is the effects, the block design and the small but effective details you can find in the background. The small specs of light floating around in the back especially give the level a very spacey vibe, along with the "alien-like block design", makes the theme for me, the rapid changes in color also give it an extra layer of detail, using an almost psychadelic color scheme, with the purple, blue and even green hues.

0n2W-uDXapo.title: ''Press Start IV'' 100% by DepisH16 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
0n2W-uDXapo.description:
A level that you can tell is going to be special from the first few seconds of gameplay, Press Start IV is the newest entry in the "spinoff" series of Press Start, where different creators create sequels in their own unique ways to the level that was born in SubZero, most of them have been great, and this is no exception, from the effects, the colors, the backgrounds, the different bits of art that are scattered throughout, the animations, and especially the bosses, just about everything is top-notch in this. The boss has the same appearance as the original monster, but a lot more damaged, which I think gives it a nice touch, not much in the attacks department, since all it does is follow you while biting down, but it still looks great in my opinion.

ID: 64199783
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/953433

wAAtMerIqfU.title: ''Protoss'' 100% (Demon) by NeogamerGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
wAAtMerIqfU.description: A level that is completely dominated by the color blue, Protoss is a creation that checks all the boxes when it comes to something cool and unique, the lack of variation in color is made up for by the excellent block design, the great use of lighting effects, especially at 0:15 when you're going through the circle obstacles, the different backgrounds, along with all the small touches of animation that can be found in various parts of the level, whether it's in the back, or in different transitions or in the block design and obstacles themselves. The gameplay is consistent along with the design, it's fun to play so I highly suggest you give it a shot.

V0LJW16_geQ.title: ''Find It'' by PENTpresents | Geometry Dash [2.11]
V0LJW16_geQ.description:
Find It is a very unique level that is mostly comprised of a very wide variety of shapes, lines and pieces of art, with some text sprinkled in here and there, apart from all this, all of these bits of decoration have a ton of animation linked to them, which turned out looking extremely fluid and smooth. The colors are all very vibrant, making the rest of the decoration jump out all the more. The transitions are also really nice, whether it's with black cinematic bars on the top and bottom or rapid changes in between frames of the level, especially at the end.

ID: 64039031
Music: Amp It Up by DJVI
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/778607

Ymff5vwXuM8.title: Rush E by ValkyrieMaster | Geometry Dash
Ymff5vwXuM8.description:
Rush E is a very unique level, using only red and white flashes to illuminate the simplistic lines and shapes that decorate the level, the block design being rectangles and squares with various white outlines and circles to give a fuller look. But the best part about this creation are the backgrounds, there is so much variation but in small doses, whether it's the skulls moving around in the background, or the cityscape, or the giant letter E with a starry plain behind, especially the end of the level with all the E's spinning around rapidly, looked great with the red and white flashes.

ID: 64026102
Music: https://youtu.be/Qskm9MTz2V4

6vMtCV6Dh98.title: ''Walkman'' 100% by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
6vMtCV6Dh98.description: The double sided road is so cool, I love this level

ESHc3nLcptY.title: ''SFW'' 100% (Demon) by hiavl & notpara | Geometry Dash
ESHc3nLcptY.description: An amazing effect level from an unknown creator, the level does start a bit slow but as the level progresses the colors and effects become crazier and crazier, the sudden changes and bursts of different colors, the backgrounds shifting and glitching, it is a bit disorienting and jarring, but from a design point of view it's different. I especially like the effect that the orbs have at 0:30, the splash of color that comes out looks really nice and is a good detail to have.

BW8YCMPa6Zg.title: (Insane Demon) ''The End'' 100% by Zylenox | Geometry Dash [2.11]
BW8YCMPa6Zg.description:
A level that has a ton of themes and styles rolled into one, the star definitely being the art and the block design, from the snowy mountain cabin, going through the plains and icy caves, only to transition into something completely different, a dark glitched out nightmare, where your vision is severely impaired, barely being able to see the obstacles that are in front of you, with different distorted lines and shapes moving quickly in the background, it's unexpected, jarring, but it's something different and unique that I like to see in levels. I also really like the section at the end, at 2:09, the purple ambient looks really nice, and the animation with what seems to be a black hole in the background also looks great.

ID: 63915746
Music: https://youtu.be/RJoxs41Wias

w7ybJ9My9LM.title: ''SmashBit'' 100% (Demon) by Achievess | Geometry Dash [2.11]
w7ybJ9My9LM.description: A level inspired by BrawlBit by KJbeast1000, SmashBit follows a 1.9 design style and aesthetic, but this by no means is just any 1.9 level, BrawlBit uses every bit of decoration, effects, blocks and animations to enormous potential, the level as a whole is a complete package, it takes advantage of everything it can to make this creation feel and look alive, the color combinations, the block design, the gameplay elements, especially in the bossfight, are all top-notch, each section has something different, there is a ton of variety when it comes to design for this level.

5t9n2opeTf4.title: ''Enlightenment'' 100% by Ragnarus | Geometry Dash [2.11]
5t9n2opeTf4.description:
Having a silver and blue theme, with a ton of art and decorations to back it up, Enlightenment is one of the most detailed levels I've seen recently, from the elegant yet slightly gothic block design, having different patterns and lighting effects to make it stand out a lot more, to the star of the level, the backgrounds and their art, whether it's the dark and gloomy forest that can be seen at the beginning, the colorful, mesmerizing and vibrant shapes and structures that come right after, the plain landscape with constellations and stars filling the background, or the art for the deer towards the end, with animations and all, which look really smooth as well. Or the structure that's found at the very end, with various decorations and flashing lights all around, which is my favorite piece of the level. Overall extremely nice to look at.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/716048

bnqnVyM-AMg.title: ''A Drop of Light'' 100% by CastriX [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
bnqnVyM-AMg.description: A level that is completely different from most of CastriX's levels, a creation that is comprised completely by art, instead of being more design oriented, but that isn't to say it's bad for being different, there's a ton of attention to detail, being completely grey scale as well, unless you go for the coin, the gameplay is fun and consistent, except for the orbs at the very beginning, but they don't take that long to get used to. Overall, this is one of CastriX best levels, something that deviates from his typical style and method of creation.

HktZINxJIP4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Mirage'' 100% by Golden & More | Geometry Dash
HktZINxJIP4.description: An Extreme Demon with a wide variety of design and gameplay, from the first half of the level to the second, there is a big difference when it comes to the design aspects of the level, being more art oriented in the beginning, especially at 0:33 with the two blackholes swirling around in the background, and especially the section that comes right after, having a unique color scheme with the yellow, pink and cyan, using a bunch of glow to accentuate the block design. The second half being more design oriented, taking more advantage of the small details found in the block design.

rhtDbS9A1Q8.title: ''Serpents Wrath'' 100% (Demon) by LmAnubis [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
rhtDbS9A1Q8.description: After a couple of years of inactivity, Anubis is back with a brand new level, I really like the design for this, even though it may feel and look empty at times, especially in the background department, the block design, the different pieces of art here and there, and especially the bosses, look great. But what makes this level truly unique are the coins, you have to beat the level 3 different times to get them all, in my case, I got the second one, you have to get 5 collectibles, but once you get them, the directions for the bosses attacks become invisible, making them even more random, which I think is a nice boost in difficulty.

wiQ2FzQYEzk.title: ''Quantum'' 100% (Demon) by BitZel & IFSGeorge [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
wiQ2FzQYEzk.description: A remake of Quantum Blender, a level by DWShin and Andro3d that came out in early 2.0, this is one of those remakes that differs a lot from the original, in this case the song is the only thing that's the same from the original. The block design, the backgrounds, the color combination, overall, there's a ton of variation in all aspects in this collab. One of the things I like most about this level is how the gameplay is so intertwined with the design of the level, especially at 0:27 where the falling blocks are part of the deco and obstacles at the same time, really unique.

w1269ZHvOk4.title: ''City Rush'' 100% (Demon) by Serponge & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
w1269ZHvOk4.description: City Rush is a level that a unique color scheme, combining purple and yellow for the majority of the level, having neon colored accents and 3D block design as well, the whole thing feels like a complete package, the lighting effects, the background, especially towards the end of the level with the purple and blue cityscape which looks fantastic, along with the different gameplay elements that were incorporated, which makes the decoration stand out all the more.

DPv2vJjv_hY.title: ''Skype'' 100% (Demon) by Golden & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
DPv2vJjv_hY.description: A level that was built over the course of three months, with a ton of talented creators involved, which according to one of the creators, started as a joke but quickly became something more, this isn't the first this has happened, there a bunch of levels that started out that way and became something great, and this is no exception, the art, the block design, the background, the effects and the colors for this are all completely Skype themed and apart from having amazing pieces of decoration the animations look fantastic, they fit the theme really well and came out really smooth.

2WvHOfe3T0s.title: ''Torn Dimension'' 100% by FunnyGame [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
2WvHOfe3T0s.description: Torn Dimension is a level that has been in the works for many years now, so some of the decoration can look a bit old, but the effects, the backgrounds and the overall theme are fantastic.The way the backgrounds mesh and combine with the foreground, the different blocks, the animations for the obstacles and the switches in color and opacity.

dSjM8ah08V8.title: ''Remonstrance'' 100% (Demon) by BlasterRobotz | Geometry Dash [2.11]
dSjM8ah08V8.description:
Remonstrance is a level that uses so many different effects to emphasize the decoration and design of the level, from the glow that can be found on the blocks and in the backgrounds, perfectly in sync with the music, to the shaking and movement effects that are used on the various obstacles and blocks to make the level look and feel a lot heavier and a bunch of color switches and changes that keeps you on your feet and makes everything feel alive.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/897494

TmzFqXJFoLY.title: ''iX'' 100% (Demon) by ExtraCrispyCroc | Geometry Dash [2.11]
TmzFqXJFoLY.description:
iX is a level that really shines because of it's amazing backgrounds and slick block design, right from the beginning you get a beautiful sight of a castle at night, with a bunch of stars and a giant crescent moon illuminating the sky with different structures decorating the front, which just sets the tone for what's to come. Most of the level has a clear purple and blue theme, with some yellow accents which I think look great, and some very short sections that are all grey. Overall there is a ton of detail to be found in this, just about everywhere you look you'll find something nice to look at, the gameplay is fun and consistent as well which is always a plus.

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/942709
ID: 63666089

bBA4XdejQsA.title: (Insane Demon) ''Artificial Calamity'' 100% by SaabS | Geometry Dash [2.11]
bBA4XdejQsA.description: Artificial Calamity is an Insane Demon that utilizes glitch and neon effects to their highest potential, which results in a fast paced, high impact creation with a ton of effects with so much variation in between them that bring it to life. The level has a high level of distortion in every section of this level, the colors never stay the same, the blocks move around, changing, appearing and dissapearing, the backgrounds glitching and and using various effects to make everything seem more hectic.

LLVbJQWdV7I.title: ''Kaleidoscopic'' 100% (Demon) by Elvii | Geometry Dash [2.11]
LLVbJQWdV7I.description: An unknown level by an unknown creator, Kaleidoscopic is one of those hidden gems you stumble upon once in a while in GD, something that you look at and say "how does this not have any recognition?". The effects for this are fantastic, the colors having a darker tone to them really adds to the atmosphere of the level, the block design is different while still blending together and adding detail and life to everything, there are animations implemented into the level.

R-z2xn_XDm4.title: (Insane Demon) ''Surge of Renewal'' 100% by N3moProd & YansSK8 | Geometry Dash
R-z2xn_XDm4.description: A remake of the Extreme Demon by TMNGaming, Surge of Creations that was released about a year ago, which was an amazing level in it's own right, but this remake is absolutely stunning, in just about every aspect and detail, every corner of this level is filled with detail, with something different and unique to look at and appreciate. This is one of those special levels that isn't just something you go through once and that's it, with your typical block design, transitions and backgrounds, it's an experience, you feel like you're going through different settings and worlds and it all makes sense, it's all connected together with amazing transitions, smooth and different from what you normally see, especially the ones at 1:03, they surprised me the first time I saw them, while being all tied together and in perfect sync with the music that was chosen, which happens to be the same as the original which is nice to see. The effects are also insane, the one at 0:29 looks amazing, the way the entire background switches between filling the back and filling the blocks and obstacles is something I don't think I've seen before, this is the quality you get consistently throughout the whole level.

B8cYo85a1Jk.title: ''Voltage'' 100% by R4NGER & LuckyTheGamer [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
B8cYo85a1Jk.description: Another entry for the GDS creator contest, a remake of Volt by Kips, this one is special, the differences between this and the original aren't that noticeable, but what you can tell, is the quality of this creation, staying consistent the whole way through, the theme is basically the same, with the block design, effects, and objects recieving a revamp, being clearer, a bit more detailed and adding some small things here and there.

KESlbLRbyVg.title: "Nebula20" 100% (Demon) by ToastLord & TheKrazy | Geometry Dash
KESlbLRbyVg.description: Nebula20 is a level that has everything nailed to perfection, everything was really well executed, the effects, the block design, the transitions, colors, backgrounds and every small bit of detail that was put into this level, the way everything meshes together, in sync with the music, both in terms of design and gameplay, definitely their best work.

CHfqMPfEUX8.title: ''Better Than Reality'' 100% (Demon) by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
CHfqMPfEUX8.description:
Subwoofer back at it again with another masterpiece, Better Than Reality, the whole level has a very heavy purple theme, from the block design that has a "crystalline" feeling and look to it having a nice variety of opacity, patterns and shapes throughout the whole thing and although it isn't the star or the main attraction, it's still really important to the overall design, even making the backgrounds jump out a lot more, speaking about the backgrounds, these are the best part about the level, the giant tv that appears behind everything has a ton of animations and effects that make it impossible to not look at, there are also some other sections with different shapes and patterns decorating the landscape, but that monster is the best part about the level.

ID: 63521602
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/864714

Yr66-fLan70.title: ''Aphectry'' 100% (Demon) by MaxyLAND [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
Yr66-fLan70.description: Aphectry is a level that's very unique visually, the best way to describe it in my opinion is as a "watercolor" creation, using a wide variety of colors and their different shades in a different type of gradient, almost mixing and meshing colors together, basically using every color of the rainbow. The effects are really nice as well, using a bunch of particles and glowing to make the colors look a lot more vibrant, which makes the level along with all the art that was implemented stand out a lot more.

wWEfTx4KBmY.title: ''C S Q N'' 100% (Demon) by Bluskys | Geometry Dash
wWEfTx4KBmY.description:
This level is quite unique, it isn't just an ordinary level, with normal effects, block design and backgrounds, if you look really closely everything looks a bit odd, a bit fuzzy and even blurry, that's because Bluskys recreated an entire music video: https://youtu.be/gE2hEebqqw4 Obviously the original has better effects and animations, but the fact that he was able to make this in GD by hand is amazing to me.

ID: 63209473
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/930438

G_0L7-Ll7cI.title: ''Disco Blitz'' 100% (Demon) by Danke & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
G_0L7-Ll7cI.description: Disco Blitz is a level that uses colors and lighting effects to their highest potential, having a rainbow theme that brings out the best in this level, almost feeling like a rainbow road in Geometry Dash. There is a ton of variation in each part, whether it's the block design, being transparent or clear at times making it easier to see the decoration that's behind. Speaking of the block design, there are also some bits of animation here and there to give the level a bit more life, even if it's on the simpler side. The backgrounds look great, especially when it simulates dance dance revolution, even adding the animatons for the arrows.

80qKgKmP8aM.title: ''Come Una Folgore'' 100% by MrLorenzo & Bronks | Geometry Dash [2.11]
80qKgKmP8aM.description: A remake of Fast as Lightning 2 by Wamiq, Come una Folgore, another entry for the GDS creator contest. The effects for this level are fantastic, the neon elements and colors fit the theme perfectly, especially the short section at 0:31, which features a human silhouette running in front of the player, which also has amazing animations as well. But it isn't just a neon level, it has many different sections with different styles and designs, some having a much darker tone to it's colors with different particles floating around in the foreground and background. The block design is also great, especially at the beginning, having a wide variety of colors, along with some really smooth animations, overall a great remake.

UKqMBAxxun8.title: HOW by Spu7nix | Geometry Dash
UKqMBAxxun8.description:
HOW is the newest unique effect creation from the always innovative Spu7nix, this time around he plays around very heavily with perspectives, but to say that he played around is nothing compared to what you get with this experience, I didn't think it was even possible to create something like this in Geometry Dash, but Spu7nix and so many other talented creators always prove that wrong.

ID: 63395980
Music: http://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/791974

OvhRDjcCuD0.title: ''This Side Up'' 100% by Knots (2 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
OvhRDjcCuD0.description: This side up is a level by Knots that has some of the most incredible art I've seen in a level recently, it's pretty much of the highest quality, each section has something different and unique in terms of block design, backgrounds, effects and colors, and not only that, it's not just a compilation of still art, it has really smooth animation as well, whether it's simulating the banging of a hammer, coins falling from the sky, a gun firing, or forklifts moving back and forth, everything is extremely well done in this. The effects are also great, various lighting and shading variations are used to emphasize every bit of detail this level has. Highly recommend this.

Wlo1iKRuGwo.title: Sound Visualization by Cdpre | Geometry Dash
Wlo1iKRuGwo.description: A level with great effects, block design and backgrounds to tie it all together, with a ton of variation in each section, being so different from each other that it could be it's own level, whether it's the futuristic/cybernetic parts at the beginning towards half of the level, the neon section at 0:47 with it's heavy use of bloom and the blue contrasts making the block design stand out, or the dark woods section that lasts till the end with it's purple color scheme and amazing atmosphere, there is something for everyone in this level.

UW5RVoEL4vQ.title: ''Lucid'' 100% (Demon) by Lacheln | Geometry Dash [2.11]
UW5RVoEL4vQ.description: A megacollab by team LacheIn that for some reason hasn't received stars in over 9 months since it's been released, and I think this level turned out pretty good, from the overall purple and pink color scheme and theme, to the block design that has a ton of variation in different parts of the level, it can be simplistic yet stylized or it can be incredibly detailed, simulating buildings with windows like at 0:45 with the amazing night sky background that brings it all together, every section in this level has something different to offer.

A4_43v-vnfM.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Armageddon'' 100% by Manix648 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
A4_43v-vnfM.description: According to Manix himself, Armageddon is a re imagining of Cataclysm with a 2.1 spin on it, and I have to say it came out looking amazing, it's so much more stylized and while there are some parts that may look simpler, at the same time, it accomplishes a much more detailed look than the original Cata. The block design is different and unique, while still staying true to the theme, it has a bunch of small details that bring it to the forefront, while accenting the rest of the decoration. There are even some blocks that have illumination that make it seem like there's fire inside, glowing and pulsating. My favorite part about this level are the sections that have neon coloring and effects, especially the part at 1:13 until the ending.

hrcdnzgQ4is.title: I by AkiAki | Geometry Dash
hrcdnzgQ4is.description:
[Cut] A level that was made for a layout creator contest. This is heavily inspired by a game called Sound Voltex, the song is the same used in the original, so the level is incredibly fast paced with a lot of quick movements, shifting the entire layout in different directions which looks amazing along with the music, the gameplay is also pretty enjoyable, it can require a bit of know how but it was pretty fun overall, with really good sync as well.

ID: 59476995
Music: Chroma - I

Wozk9sONOJM.title: ''Metropolis'' 100% (Demon) by DesTicY [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
Wozk9sONOJM.description: A level that has an amazing use of glow and colors, having simplistic yet futuristic block design, using dark colors so the borders jump out even more, but what makes this level really special are the backgrounds, whether it's the small city-scapes with the classic synthwave sun behind the buildings, the bigger variation towards the end of the level, that looks like something taken out of Blade Runner or Cyberpunk, the giant pyramids that appear at 0:25 with various little details, such as the ring of light that appears in the center, every background has something different to offer.

IvEqma5lPRU.title: (Insane Demon) ''A New Cataclysm'' 100% by RyderZ & Shocksidian | Geometry Dash
IvEqma5lPRU.description: This is a remake of Another Cataclysm by Findexi, not cataclysm, a lot of people seem to get confused about that. And this level was actually pretty fun, probably because it didn't take very long to beat.

O4HR7GcpIPs.title: ''Walkman'' 100% (Demon) by JamAttack [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
O4HR7GcpIPs.description:
Walkman is a level that took JamAttack a whopping 7 months to complete, but after finishing his creation, I can say it was completely worthwhile, the thing that I most enjoy about this is how he implemented subtle glitch effects on various elements of the level, the block design moving, fading and slightly distorting, same goes for the player itself, especially at the beginning where you fade in and out while you're advancing through the first obstacles, the backgrounds and foregrounds also feature this, gaining intensity as you progress, adding effects on top of eachother, adding red and blue to give everything a 3d effect and scanlines for an older feel as well.

ID: 63107944
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/862252

a6uWNKuFdfM.title: ''Mystical Myth'' 100% (Demon) by C4ST & EnZore | Geometry Dash [2.11]
a6uWNKuFdfM.description: A remake of Mystiric by NightXStalker, an entry to Enlex's creator contest that happened about 3 years ago, a level that pulls out all the stops, the block design is spectacular, it's sinister while maintaining an aura of elegance with all the decoration you can find inside the obstacles, the different patterns and lines creating different shapes and forms. Right from the get go, the backgrounds are amazing as well, fitting the mystical theme very nicely, the eyes blinking in the background on the windows of a chapel, a candle flickering in the darkness or taking you underwater where a kraken is slowly hunting you. This level has a lot to offer and it's one of those where you have to play it several times to catch every detail.

jOHPPf0wbI8.title: Metal Sonic Battle by Son1cBlast | Geometry Dash
jOHPPf0wbI8.description: A level that recreates the style, the art, the animations and the feeling of the old sonic games perfectly, Metal Sonic Battle is one of those levels that changes everything to the point that it doesn't look like Geometry Dash anymore, emulating a different game. From the Sonic and Metal Sonic sprite to the platforms you're running on, to the dark backgrounds with purple clouds floating around, the effects on both characters, especially the jet effect when metal sonic dashes towards, it all looks fantastic.

sIbj5kixtow.title: (Insane Demon) ''Hyper Beam'' 100% by Darwin & Yakimaru | Geometry Dash
sIbj5kixtow.description:
A remake of Techno Blaster by Defiant that came out almost 5 years ago, another entry in the GDS creator contest, and one of the best in my opinion. What really makes this level stand out above others is the quality of the backgrounds, especially the ones we see at the beginning and end of the level, the art is amazing, the animations are short but really smooth and they fit the theme perfectly. The level is fast paced and with all the lighting effects going on, you can't see the block design all that well, but from what I can tell it's simplistic but has enough detail to not feel out of place and there are small variations to it in each section which is nice to see, overall a great oldie turned insane demon, I recommend you give it a shot.

Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MfvD6g8i-Ko

2U_ba9f6UVU.title: ''Ancient Keeper'' 100% by Robotic24 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
2U_ba9f6UVU.description: A level that has it all, a fantastic theme, composed of great effects, block design, backgrounds and art. One thing that I really enjoy in levels is when it takes you through completely different sceneries, each and every one being unique while still fitting in perfectly with the theme of the level. Whether it's what appears to be a toxin lab with different vats of acid in the background, a dark cave with flashing lights filling the ambience or an old industrial city with a giant clocktower reaching the sky, there is so much variation in this. One thing to note, you have to beat the level twice to get the coin, there are two different routes you can take, I took the latter to get the coin.

bYU55AYyM6c.title: ''STARPUNK'' 100% (Demon) by FerdeFunky | Geometry Dash [2.11]
bYU55AYyM6c.description: FerdeFunky has always been a consistently improving creator, ever since the Traction days, he's changed, upgraded and reinvented his style, getting better and better with each new creation, but this, Starpunk, is a masterpiece, one of the best levels to come out in recent times, it has it all, amazing effects, the particles that move around, pulsating, shifting from place to place, the neon colors that brighten everything up, the lighting effects in sync with the music, the block design is "simple" you could say, but what's on the inside looks great, different effects, decorations, small details that make it pop. One of the things that I really enjoy is the changes in pace and scenery especially, such as the ones at 1:39 and at the end of the level.

UL-gABif-14.title: ''Adamantium Core'' 100% (Demon) by Sminx & Scrumpy | Geometry Dash
UL-gABif-14.description: A remake of Titanium Core by Kr0nos, a level that was released a staggering 5 years ago, and with a level that old, that was still amazing for it's time, it's no surprise that practically every part, aspect and detail of the level was majorly improved, the color scheme changed dramatically, the original was almost all grey with some red accents here and there to not make the level feel as bland, but in this remake it's the other way around, a powerful red takes over improving the overall theme in my opinion. Something that you don't see very often in remakes is a change in length of the level, this one having a longer intro and outro extends it by quite a bit. One of the things that improved the most are definitely the backgrounds, the original having grey shapes for decoration for the most part, while this has so much more variation. All in all, this is a great remake and one of my favorites from the GDS CC, highly recommend you give it a try.

AGdcmVxJIjU.title: ''Fangs on the Earth'' 100% (Demon) by CocoXs32 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
AGdcmVxJIjU.description: A themed level that is executed to perfection, Fangs on the Earth is an XXL creation that takes you on a ride to different beautiful corners of our planet Earth, showing all four elements, it could be inside a fiery forest that goes through a volcano that shoots you out through the top, pushing you to a red landscape that's been consumed by fire, above the clouds to a golden city where a dragon peeks it's head from under, looking straight at you, it takes you underwater, through a shipwreck, while a giant dragon passes you by, showing just how tiny you are in comparison, and many more, all with amazing effects, art, block design, fitting everything perfectly.

2WweV-SKEzI.title: ''Keeper of The Dark'' 100% (Demon) by BlueRimz & Matty2003 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
2WweV-SKEzI.description: A remake of Darkness Keeper by Abstract Dark that was released 2 years ago, and another amazing entry for the GDS Creator Contest. The effects, the backgrounds, the block design, even the boss itself has been revamped and upgraded, having a much more modern look and feel, the animations are smoother and the design looks cleaner as well, while still managing to be much more detailed than the original, which is still a great bossfight level given the time it was released, I think BlueRimz and Matty did a great job taking this level and elevating it to the next level, highly recommend you give it a shot.

lSAu5YE3TgI.title: ''Shards of Siberia'' 100% by Xender Game | Geometry Dash [2.11]
lSAu5YE3TgI.description: A level that deviates completely from what we're used to seeing by Xender Game, something completely different in terms of design, effects, block design, just about everything, an experimental level by one of the best bossfight level creators out there. The best part about this level is definitely it's backgrounds and the effects that go with them, including the transitions that are super smooth and high quality. Things like this just go to show the versatility that some creators have but don't show often, but when they do, something great is created, highly recommend you try this level out.

yO2PdKkLVnc.title: Minecraft by EvilAnvil | Geometry Dash
yO2PdKkLVnc.description:
ID: 59922292
Possibly the best representation of Minecraft I've seen in Geometry Dash yet, from the block design that emulates the different types of materials in the game, gravel, dirt, the wood that makes up the house, the hay, the slabs, the blocks of redstone and diamonds and even the clouds. The effects are also great, the glow that eminates from the fire coming from the torches and the lava, the particles that float around in the caves. If this was 3D, I think you wouldn't be able to tell the difference between this and the actual game. Another thing I enjoy is how the level has a sense of direction.

7MIacG58CJk.title: ''Apex Predator'' 100% (Demon) by Underings | Geometry Dash [2.11]
7MIacG58CJk.description: Apex Predator is a remake of the 2-year old level by Samoht, "Predator", having revamped the level entirely, the effects are more vivid and erratic, the colors are brighter and more vibrant, the background look fuller and with a bunch more detail, complementing the foreground very nicely, and even the boss got an upgrade, being more detailed and having smoother animations.

-4zvaRiNu1E.title: ''The Overseers II'' 100% (Demon) by Stratos2596 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-4zvaRiNu1E.description: The Overseers II is a level that utilizes glow perfectly, from the block design with it's smooth borders and simple decorations, changing from one color to another in beat with the music, or the entirety of the art that appears in the background, especially at the 0:40 mark, also having some nice animations here and there. There are also pieces of standalone art in certain sections, the moon that appears floating in the background or the various symbols that come up in transitions, all well made. I always enjoy seeing creations like this, since they're one of my favorite styles, I think the glow fits really well with certain themes and they're nice to look at as well.

xQWFKFgzaFo.title: ''Bee'' 100% (Demon) by kDarko & f5night | Geometry Dash [2.11]
xQWFKFgzaFo.description: Bee is a level that was made for GDS CC, that has a very well designed and fleshed out theme, taking you inside a honey bee hive, and in my opinion it's perfectly executed, from the honeycomb block design with different shades of yellow and brown that emulate honey moving around, but not only that, there are some section that change it up, whether it's the honeycomb style or a fur design that makes the blocks look like the parts of a bee, it all looks great. The art for the backgrounds and the bee look amazing, it compliments what's going on in the foreground nicely, and the animations for the bee are smooth as well.

9xxYH1bJ54c.title: ''Paperworld by TamaN'' 100% by Nasgubb [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
9xxYH1bJ54c.description: I think it goes without saying, but this level is a remake of the original Paperworld by TamaN, upgrading and changing slightly the design of the level and being Nasgubb's own layout, and I have to say that he did a really great job in my opinion, whether you're going through the paper sections, the blueprint, the chalkboard or the cardboard it all looks amazingly realistic, and being complemented by the backgrounds, the block design, obstacles and small bits of detail in the front jump out and are emphasized very nicely. One small interesting thing that I found out about this level, when you turn on LDM the level switches back to the original TamaN style, while still maintaining Nasgubb's layout.

QG9yI-ELcoA.title: SAVE AS by PAHC | Geometry Dash
QG9yI-ELcoA.description:
Save as is a very artistic level, but not in the sense of decoration, block design, colors, backgrounds or anything else in that vain. This creation is artistic because of the way it makes you feel, the emotions it evokes and the sensations it provokes. Starting off as a normal-looking level, towards the 2:00 mark the level slowly starts to glitch, from the arrows pointing you towards the right direction, to the blocks and the dark edges that limit the whole thing. But we've seen levels with glitch effects, that shift around every component and detail, this is on a whole other level, it doesn't just spam the same effect over and over again, this entire creation starts degrading and you could even say "dying", changing from a "normal" typical level, to what we see towards the end, both in terms of the design and even the music, which has a very nice sync with what's going on on screen, from what I've read, this is meant to reflect and show the effects and progression of Alzheimer's, and in my opinion it was nailed to perfection. I think this is one of the best representations of this disease created in a videogame, not just because of the way it looks, but the sounds and the way the entire thing as a whole makes you feel, rolled up into one 5 minute experience.

ID: 62757869

Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/934797

aeBGKIlqUMo.title: (Insane Demon) ''Void'' 100% by Chloe2012 | Geometry Dash
aeBGKIlqUMo.description:
I love the feeling this level gives off. And apparently this is Chloe's first serious level, I think it's really good for what it is. Obviously there's some stuff that can be improved such as the block designs, which look pretty empty, but the backgrounds are really good in my opinion, such as the one in the beginning and at 0:44.
I'd say the best thing about this level is definitely the atmosphere, the song fits so well with it, but unfortunately it's not available for use anymore, which lowers the chances of this getting rated. Overall this is great for a first level, definitely recommend you to try this out :)

GVQor0agiow.title: Not So Strange by Lespainsaucho | Geometry Dash
GVQor0agiow.description: Very creative, always nice to play levels like this every now and then

GErhBQhurlw.title: ''Try Again'' by HugusTheNoob [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
GErhBQhurlw.description: Try Again is a level with a very refined neon and pixel style and aesthetic, and while you could say that it's lacking a bit in terms of backgrounds and brightness, and even then there are bits of decoration here and then that complements everything else, whether it's different shapes and lines moving around really smoothly,  I feel that what's given to you in the foreground, the animations, the block design, the red and green color scheme makes the level feel very complete all around.

-_kxMOwbLok.title: ''Then'' 100% (Demon) by AstrixGD | Geometry Dash
-_kxMOwbLok.description:
First to beat, awesome level :) "Then" is a level with an amazing use of colors, taking advantage of every shade and hue you could think of, never having a spec of discolor, being a very vibrant level all around, not only using color to bring out the decoration of the level, but the lighting effects also look amazing, especially in the transitions. There are some sections that showcase pieces of art, mainly the section at 1:32 where you're going through a forest with giant trees and grass with rain in the background, the lighting in this section fits really well with what's going on, the section that comes after that is a lot more different to the rest of the level, being darker and feeling more closed than the other parts.
Reupload cause of production error

7nk9KV9N25w.title: Bloodbath Remake | (Extreme Demon) ''Bath'' 100% by Pennutoh & More | Geometry Dash
7nk9KV9N25w.description: This level is nothing serious by the way, only beat it for fun

6N8sMj-VKew.title: ''Sea'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 & SpooFy | Geometry Dash
6N8sMj-VKew.description: Sea is a level that has a really strong point, it's art and animations, whether it's the palm trees and tiki heads dancing around in the background or the octupus going up and down and moving it's limbs to the beat of the music, or the turtle bossfight that's found towards the end of the level that flies around the screen and hides inside it's shell while throwing different attacks at you, it all looks fantastic.

cyGXhjqZBhU.title: (Insane Demon) ''The Bandere'' 100% by Wintter & Ka1ns | Geometry Dash

mBT3PFX_Vek.title: ''Hiii'' 100% by OrotS [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
mBT3PFX_Vek.description: Pretty nice remake of Hi, I like this one because it differs a lot from the original style, while maintaining the same feel of it. The effects are much more detailed, using more lighting effects, having an overall better sync with the song and with the colors that are being used having a clearer tone and hue than in the original. There are some very noticeable differences, while there's a section in the original that's completely dark, only being able to see the tiny blocks you're travelling on, in this iteration, you can see the whole level, while it does still have the red accents, it also has scanlines to add a bit of detail on top of that.

JQ5SLlVYGJ8.title: Pause Speed Portal | Ninox by GD Jose | Geometry Dash
JQ5SLlVYGJ8.description: Ninox is a level that has a really fun aesthetic, from the bright and vibrant colors, the block design that is lightly detailed with great little accents on the inside to give it more of a pop, the backgrounds are on the simpler side, but they complement the foreground nicely in my opinion, they have nice colors and different shapes that make it feel a bit more alive.

cr0IGaNmBrs.title: ''Free Stars'' 100% (Demon) by Sminx | Geometry Dash
cr0IGaNmBrs.description: Free Stars is a level that was decorated in about 2 days, which is amazing to me since just about everything is top quality. The colors, the block design, the backgrounds all have something to offer, it also includes some text with animations that look really smooth. This level overall has a nice and clean aesthetic, especially in the beginning and at the end.

bn22WellI3s.title: (Insane Demon) ''Tropical Thunder'' 100% by Pavlaxan & More | Geometry Dash
bn22WellI3s.description: Tropical Thunder is an Insane Demon that features really nice looking effects, it could be the rain effects, the thunder that comes down at random times, the block design is pretty straightforward, but it has a clean and smooth aesthetic that I really enjoy. The lighting effects have nice sync with the music as well.

XdV8XIHTGDk.title: Kichigai by iIBlueMoonIi | Geometry Dash
XdV8XIHTGDk.description: Kichigai is a level that above all else, has an amazing atmosphere, from the backgrounds, to the art that fills everything up, to the colors, the block design, the effects that can be seen in the foreground and in the transitions, all of this and a lot more make this level feel like you're travelling through a deserted wasteland hundreds of years in the future. The best part about this level to me, is the art, especially the backgrounds, they have so much depth, a ton of small details and the usage of light makes everything pop out and feel like time is actually moving, really great level, highly recommend you give it a try.

rAWB0prPSUE.title: ''The Second Gear'' 100% by AnielChasseur | Geometry Dash
rAWB0prPSUE.description: A complete remake of Gear II by GDJose, being a much much more refined and detailed version of the original, from the block design that has a more defined aesthetic, looking and feeling more "mechanical" in tune with the theme of the level, having small details such as text or different markings that add more depth to the design, the animations are a lot smoother, in the text, transitions and especially for the Gear and the bossfights, looking and feeling more fluid, the color scheme is pretty much the same, but in this remake, they're used better in my opinion, having more effects tied to them and changing around in sync with what's going on in the level. The bossfights are probably my favorite part of the whole thing, they're on whole other level than the original, from the attacks, to the effects, to the animations, the design stayed pretty much the same, but that's a good choice in my opinion.

5FhN-Ymie3w.title: T Rex by Petter | Geometry Dash
5FhN-Ymie3w.description:
ID: 62480701
T Rex is a level that is basically just the dinosaur game that you can play in chrome when you have no internet, or so it would seem. The level starts off as bare bones as it could be given the theme, a perfect recreation of the game that I mentioned before-hand, but the special thing about this level is that it keeps changing as you move forward and progress, adding more and more effects and getting crazier and weirder, changing the color scheme completely, including a ton of really smooth animations and really nice pixel art.

dpHhy-aq-Zc.title: "Zap" 100% (Demon) by GeoStorm [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
dpHhy-aq-Zc.description: Zap is a megacollab that features a ton of really talented creators, each one contributing to different aspects of the level, whether it's design, gameplay, or the overall aesthetic of the project. As the title would suggest, the theme for this level is electric, with yellow and blue being the most prominent colors, in the block design, the backgrounds, and even with small lightning effects here and there. But that's only the first section, every section has it's own style, while still maintaining the overall theme, and staying consistent to the soul of the level, all of it being high quality. Some parts are simpler with soft block design and lighter colors, while others are much more agressive, in their pace, colors, and lighting effects, I always like seeing this kind of variety in megacollabs. This level is unique in it's own right, having 3 coins and 6 different hidden paths you must take to gather them.

38o9tSrPxn0.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Virtual Collapse'' 100% by TeamUprising | Geometry Dash
38o9tSrPxn0.description:
First victor, I beat this a few hours after it came out and just got around to uploading the video, This is the newest level by TeamUprising, a creator team that have released a bunch of megacollabs of really high quality, of various designs, themes and even difficulties, but this is their first Extreme Demon, and in my opinion it's their best level yet. First off the design for this looks amazing, the virtual theme is executed very nicely in this, the pink and blue color scheme and technological aesthetic, using grids as decorations in the background, having flashing lights and colors in sync with the song and even using scanlines to give it a retro look as well, to wrap up on the design of this level, every section fits together really well with one another and everyone did a great job on their part. The gameplay is Extreme Demon for me, simply because of the ending, which is a lot harder than the rest of the level, it elevates it to Extreme, but apart from that, the gameplay is really consistent.
By the way, the music of the level is a Remix of Cosmic Dreamer, but in hindsight I like the original song a lot more. GG :)
Attempts: 3,331

pbd4s9DuBLQ.title: ''The Factory'' 100% (Demon) by AnielChasseur [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
pbd4s9DuBLQ.description: The Factory is a level that has a great design, this one being a mechanical and industrial theme, with a grey color scheme on the block design and backgrounds especially, with different colors serving as a complement and accenting the art that appears in the front of the level. There are a couple of bossfights included in this level, one being a giant robot that shoots lasers and moves around in the background with a nice set of animations, and the other one of the bosses from Cuphead, which has really nice art. Now the only problem I have with this level is amount of glow it has, it's blinding and sometimes it's hard to read the gameplay, but nonetheless this turned out pretty good.

wNDc92bbl9o.title: ''NEon'' 100% (Demon) by LightningSL [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
wNDc92bbl9o.description: I always enjoy these types of levels, the neon aesthetic and colors is one of my favorite kind of designs and themes, and they're beginning to become more and more common nowadays, with some being higher quality than others, this level is above the average. The way the colors are mixed and combined, both in the background and foreground, the way the block design flickers as if it were a neon sign you see on the street at 3AM, while the backgrounds are a bit empty at times, only having very small details, we get to see a cityscape at 0:43 which I think turned out looking really nice. The block design has a nice transparent and clean look to it, being accented by the neon colors on it's borders. The gameplay is enjoyable as well, being an Easy Demon for me, personally.

jQ9FZK75wnY.title: ''Cerulean Blue'' 100% (Demon) by Lapis & DangerKat [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
jQ9FZK75wnY.description: Cerulean Blue is a level that has a ton of variety in all aspects, from the backgrounds, to the effects,  to the block design, even to the colors, and the entire design and aesthetic of the level almost. I think each and every section is so unique that they could be their own levels. Whether it's the cybernetic part that switches between purple and blue hues, the space section with planets in the background and a clean block design complementing in the front, or the futuristic cityscape with neon highlights on the blocks, every section in this level has something different to offer.

Bcf9wepKQ5Y.title: Alas by Tohey | Geometry Dash
Bcf9wepKQ5Y.description: One of the most incredible auto levels that have been released recently, the effects in this look amazing, it almost looks like an animated movie, the movements are super smooth, the art looks great, the backgrounds really tie everything together, the sky with the clouds, the sunlight giving everything a nice orange color, then when it changes to a darker setting with the lightning storm with the monster chasing you in the background, which by the way has a really nice design, it invokes that feeling of terror that I think Tohey was going for.

fY2w-beCTyQ.title: (Insane Demon) ''Polychromatic'' 100% by Lanfear [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
fY2w-beCTyQ.description:
Polychromatic is a level by a creator that is severely underrated and unknown, this level was released about 7 months ago, and didn't get nearly the attention that it deserved, Lanfear has a ton of potential as a creator and I can't wait to see what he comes up with in the future, so I can say right now, go play this level, give it a try, the effects are fantastic, the gameplay is really fun. The theme for this level is completely about colors, the switches in brightness and hue really complements the gameplay that makes up the level, the pace of the level also helps the theme, changing along with the song, which I feel is always a nice effect, the transitions are also really quick, and while they are on the simpler side, they look great as well.
Lanfear's channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNWiBK9v_5o65KB0tvbldrA

aB9zVIUj8Og.title: (Insane Demon) ''MINDBREAKER'' 100% by Bianox & More | Geometry Dash
aB9zVIUj8Og.description:
Mindbreaker is an insane demon level with great design, colors and sync, it has a large variety of hues switching between them along with some flashing lights in sync with the music, the block design is different in each section, my favorite part is at 0:22 when you hit a transition with slight glitch effects, then go into a black and white ship section with portals that switch your gravity. The level as a whole is really enjoyable, the design is great, and the gameplay is different, being completely memory based, which adds a ton of difficulty, making you play it time and time again in order to memorize each bit, having some really hard timings on top of it, but even though there are different types of gameplay here and there, the gameplay flows really well, and doesn't feel disjointed at all. The level is more than a minute long, having a ton of different effects, that make each and every section unique, along with the usage of colors and lighting that give the whole thing a completely new layer of detail. Audio sounds a bit different because of copyright reasons
