Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/895898
Attempts: 2538

9VtNyrHC4gA.title: [1.9] ''Japan Modern Thing'' (XXL Demon) by GrenadeOfTacos & SigRp | Geometry Dash
9VtNyrHC4gA.description:
ID: 62285738

Japan Modern Thing is by far one of my favorite 1.9 levels to date, I believe this is a collaboration between GrenadeOfTacos and SigRp  it's so much higher in terms of quality than so many other levels that use this style, from the art, to the backgrounds, the entirety of the foreground as well even the block design and colors, the effects. The first section of the level has the typical Japanese color scheme, being red and yellow, the block design is red with yellow lines decorating the inside, a funny thing about this part, I believe the lamps that appear in the background are actually Chinese lamps, but according to SigRp those lanterns are also used in Japan since he is japanese, so they still fit the theme really well in my opinion, the background is a dark blue, simulating dark night sky. We then switch to a more conventional style, with solid color backgrounds and simple floral decorations, the only thing that changes is the color, the block design is simple but looks good anyway. After that, we go through various sections that are almost completely decorated by lines, at least in the background, while the block design has glow on it's borders, emphasizing the color that is shown. The section at 1:15 is inspired by the music video for the song that's used in the level called "Ukiyo-e Yokochou", which by the way, is what to me personally gives life to this level, the pace of the song, the way it changes, the instruments syncing with the gameplay, is amazing, hence why it seems so different to the rest of the sections. After this we go through a fast paced section, similar to the ones at the beginning, what I like about this is how the whole color changes with the beat of the song, really nice effect. We go through various sections after this, being reminiscent of the ones at the beginning as well, while still maintaining the high level of quality and pace, my favorite part has to be the one at 2:38, the gradient colors look amazing, along with the "fragmented" block design, with the opaque decorations in the background. Approaching the end of the level, we go through a couple of sections that are completely different and unique from one another, whether it's the one that looks like your going through a snake, or the floral part, which is another one of my favorites, or the final part that has transparent block design with shapes decorating the back. This level as a whole looks incredible, along with the music that was chosen.

w1E_XCUln5c.title: ''Ne0n'' 100% (Demon) by Failure444 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
w1E_XCUln5c.description: ne0n is a level with a very simple theme and style, while still being amazing to look at, this one being a neon design, whether it's the block design, which is mostly made up of squares of various sizes,, changing colors, hues and brightness, the obstacles that are mostly spikes and saws that have a rainbow effect. There are basically no backgrounds, but the effects and colors in the foreground make up for it.

no_FNRDTL1A.title: ''Obelisk'' 100% (XXL Demon) by SuprianGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
no_FNRDTL1A.description:
Obelisk is an XXL Demon that is over 5 minutes long, that was verified just a couple of hours ago at the time of uploading, that has an incredible amount of variety in all aspects, the block design has different colors, different objects and lines decorating the inside, and it fits in really nicely with the rest of the level in each section. There are also a ton of effects in this level, nothing too crazy, just flashes of light in sync with the song, different lighting effects to give more of an "atmospheric" feeling to each part, whether it's a beam of sunlight shining through the top, or changes in lighting in a thunderstorm with much lower brightness. The backgrounds are spectacular, it could be a waterfall flowing that looks great with the blue colors in the front, a japanese cityscape with buildings filled with neon colors and light, a background filled with hot air balloons, surrounded by clouds and sunlight, moving upwards very slowly, or a blizzard with mountains in the back with a man trying to scale, with different wind effects on the front. The design for this level is great, there's a ton to look at without being overbearing. The difficulty is higher than your typical XXL, bringing it up to Hard Demon, including the length.
Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5iw3TFzrFs

BBYfyq6cLeA.title: ''Evil Yeeter'' 100% (Demon) by ZubwaR [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
BBYfyq6cLeA.description:
A revamped version of God Yeeter by DanZmeN, Evil Yeeter is more difficult than the original, and while it does maintain the spirit of it's "predecessor" it is better in other aspects as well, including decoration, looking a lot cleaner and much more detailed, the effects are taken up to 11 in this version, the colors are much more vibrant and have more of a "in your face" approach, the block design is also different, having a lot more variety, different styles, different decorations on the inside, various shades and hues of colors, all of them fitting in with the theme really well. The backgrounds are similar to the original, being a bit empty at times, but there are moments when there's so much going on in the foreground, between the effects, the transitions, which are also great, the colors and everything else, that you forget about the background. The boss that appears at 0:35, that includes a really nice transition, a sort of title card that says "bossfight", is also revamped, has a lot more detail and it's movements are also smoother, it's relatively short but what you get to see is great. The gameplay is a bit inconsistent at times, making it even harder, but it's still enjoyable to play. Overall a great reimagining of an already existing level, I recommend you give it a try.
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/832878

PxT4Mx64B-8.title: ''Akhmeti'' 100% (Demon) by 1374 & Lapis | Geometry Dash [2.11]
PxT4Mx64B-8.description: Another really great themed level by Lapis, this time with help from 1374, the egyptian theme for this is executed perfectly, the colors, the sand, the effects, the art for every bit of decoration that's found in Akhmeti, the styles look so good together, they mesh so much so that it's hard to tell who did what, and most importantly the quality of the design stays consistent the whole way through, which is always important to it doesn't look uneven. The gameplay is fun, it's about Easy Demon level for me, there aren't any bugs that I encountered, and there's a variety of game modes.

gSQTJCYM8yA.title: ''Insomnia'' 100% (Demon) by Whirl | Geometry Dash [2.11]
gSQTJCYM8yA.description: insomnia is a level with amazing effects, colors and an overall theme, this one being nightmares and those nights where you just can't sleep and your mind and imagination begin running wild. The level has a very strong purple aesthetic which I feel fits the insomnia theme perfectly. The level begins with  a slow paced ball section, then transitioning to wave, the background changing from an alarm clock that marks 2:00 AM, switching to the view of a brain moving around in the back, with different lines decorating the block design. This whole section is slow paced, building up to the part where there are eyes flooding the screen, with a forest behind everything, with the pace, music and effects becoming more and more erratic. We then hit the drop of the level, we find ourselves in what seems to be a living room with the tv on filled with static, which I think is a really nice touch to the whole "insomnia" theme, and at the end of this part we see a giant eye that turns to look at you directly, the art for this is great and the animation looks really smooth. The level maintains this faster pace, while we move towards a section in the woods with effects that are even more intense, with a demonic goat head floating around in the background, the purple color scheme is the same, with a bit more grey and black mixed in. Overall, the theme of the level is executed perfectly, giving that sense of desperation and dread that you get when you have insomnia, I highly recommend you try it out.

KMimVXiPhwg.title: ''Eternelle Vehemence'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Vrymer [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
KMimVXiPhwg.description:
Eternelle Vehemence is an XXL demon that's over 5 minutes long, and there is so much detail scattered around the level, from the beginning with a cybernetic and futuristic design on the blocks and obstacles, including the different hues of colors with their respective glow.

ID: 62028241
Music: Anybody Else - Panda Eyes
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/896821

erdSj6r6RVw.title: Onward Refresh by MrKoolTrix | Geometry Dash
erdSj6r6RVw.description: Onward Refresh is a very colorful level with different and unique styles in just about every new section you encounter, the effects look fantastic, especially on the text that appears on the screen at the drop and the shifts in color that give the level a ton of detail, the animations for the block design and the decoration in the background also looks great, it brings life to the level. The gameplay is enjoyable, although the main attraction of the level is the design obviously, it's still fun to play.

7IX7chvbaRQ.title: ''Falling Skies'' 100% (Demon) by Xingtik | Geometry Dash
7IX7chvbaRQ.description:
ID: 62120180

Falling Skies is a level that showcases a really unique "artistic" theme and color pallette, having really nice effects, from the lighting, to the rainfall in the background, especially the art that can be seen in the foreground and in the back. My favorite section is the one at 0:45, the way the color changes on the block design with a very nice glow effect, along with the silhouette of the ballerina flashing behind in sync with the music. The level as a whole is a delight to look at and enjoyable to play as well.

l9bnN-XiaJA.title: Hidden Creation by Jayuff | Geometry Dash
l9bnN-XiaJA.description: Hidden creation, a level by Jayuff that's unlisted, I don't know if he will release it someday, Jayuff let me play this, and here I am showcasing it to you. It's a very slow paced level with a heavy cybernetic theme, having really smooth block design with a grey and blue color scheme. The level has a unique vibe to it, from the aesthetic, block design and even the backgrounds, along with the various effects and animations that can be found. There are different gameplay elements that I think add another layer of detail, there are some sections where the every block and obstacles starts shifting, whether it's to the side or up and down, I always like seeing things like these in levels.

jj7ce9BOwBo.title: ''elo2'' 100% (Demon) by durianhead [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
jj7ce9BOwBo.description: elo2 is an effect and design level that executes it's strongest points in a great way, it does start off a bit simple, only showcasing different colors with fairly simple block design and flashes of light that illuminate the whole structure, but as the level goes on it gets more and more detailed, up to the part at 0:45 which is my favorite, the effects and colors in this section look amazing to me. The level is a Medium Demon for me, although the coin route does add another layer of difficulty to it, you have to grab a bunch of keys that are scattered around the level to open different paths that take you to the coins, I always enjoy mechanics like this since it's like a "secondary level" almost.

cgIPrkpjDHI.title: Morse by Jayuff | Geometry Dash
cgIPrkpjDHI.description:
Level: Morse by Jayuff
ID: 62133986
Not showing coin route cause it's secret-y, have fun

This is one of those levels that's more an experience than an actual level, the first time you play it or watch it, you see all these messages on the screen, all these glitching effects, the slow and dark pace of the level along with the disconcerting sounds that appear every so often, but the most impressive part about this level to me, is the fact that the mechanic and effort put into the coin is amazing, one of the most unique I've ever encountered. I highly recommend you try this level out.

vErK_HfcaZ0.title: ''MO'' 100% by Knots & M3nhHu3 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
vErK_HfcaZ0.description: MO is a level that has some of the smoothest animations I've seen in a geometry dash level, from the block design, to the effects, to the art that can be found in the foreground and background especially, to the obstacles and shapes that form every part of the level. The whole thing has a minimalistic style to it, taking advantage of lighter colors as well, but by no means is it empty, there is so much detail riddled around in the level, that wherever you look, you can see something interesting.

8BIFzITijS0.title: Nircles by Mulpan & KJackpot | Geometry Dash
8BIFzITijS0.description: A 1.0 themed level by Mulpan, Nircles is unique to me because of the animations and movements present in the blocks, obstacles, saws and pathways, along with the flashing lights that add a bit of dramatic effect to the level, the way everything moves looks great and it also has really nice sync with the music, and it adds a layer of difficulty to the gameplay, taking a bit of practice getting used to, especially when some of the sections have fast transitions that need good timing.

wEI2oqyjgbE.title: "The Dread Bots" 100% (Demon) by FlacoGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
wEI2oqyjgbE.description:
A bossfight level by FlacoGD that is clearly heavily inspired by Technos 2, having a very technological and futuristic theme all around, whether it's the dark and grey block design, the neon colored accents and usage of glow, the robotic bosses with their laser attacks and great animations, though I feel like there should be more intensity with the pulses, and shake triggers, the backgrounds also felt kind of empty. The gameplay is very fun, it does take a bit of getting used to in some places, but overall this level turned out really good.
Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8B0wuNoCFvs

nh-by0IcReY.title: Fur Elise by Partition | Geometry Dash
nh-by0IcReY.description: Fur Elise is one of those levels that relies very heavily on the sync with the song, being classical piece of piano music, the block design being keys on the piano or musical notes on sheet with dark and white backgrounds, there are some very unique sections as well, where Partition takes advantage of the orbs and portals to emphasize the music, the reflection effects looks really good too. I think it's a nice touch and adds more detail to the overall theme of the level.

8pxqzjstJk8.title: (Insane Demon) ''Upbeat Universe'' by OptaWolfGD & More [Verified] | Geometry Dash
8pxqzjstJk8.description: Upbeat Universe is the newest and final installment in the "Upbeat" series by OptaWolfGD and many other talented creators, and I can't tell you enough how amazing this level is, there is so much variation in just about every aspect, the block design, the colors, the effects, the transitions, the art; both in the foreground and background, the pace of the level, the gamemodes, just about every section is unique in it's own way, that being said, the overall theme of the level and everything in it is a minimalistic style, soft borders and color combinations, neon accents on the block design, with a ton of animations in different places, while still having a bunch of detail. The gameplay is great as well, it's an Insane Demon for me, but it stays consistent the whole way through, and there weren't any bugs that I encountered, overall an amazing megacollab.

RpDeh1L8XP4.title: Sayonara Sekai by Reunomi | Geometry Dash
RpDeh1L8XP4.description: A brand new level by Reunomi, and as usual, it's really high quality with amazing effects, really nice art and an overall great design, I believe it was created for a creator contest hosted by Izhar, for me this level has it all, the futuristic style with scanlines to give it an older feel or the neon borders on the block design, the gameplay is also great, especially the "dual" piggyback section at 0:38, being different and unique in it's own way. This level is another amazing creation by Reunomi and I'm excited to see what he creates next.

RkKn5HWqpIM.title: (Insane Demon) ''SIGSEGV'' 100% by Sminx | Geometry Dash [2.11]
RkKn5HWqpIM.description:
SIGSEGV is the extended version of Sminx's other level, "Segmentation Fault", the original being only 30 seconds long, Sminx ramped it up to a whole minute and a half. This level is very unique, starting out in dark landscape, with a simple white block design, with lines in the backgrounds simulating hills or mountains, transitioning into a more technological setting, with a countdown timer in the background, building up to the section at 0:40, which is honestly the most impressive part of the entire level, riddled with glitch effects, hundreds of different colors and shapes flashing and moving around on the screen, as if you were on a psychadelic trip, with the gameplay being also very unique, implementing swing copter and dash orbs to guide you through the level, adding a bit of difficulty to it in the form of memorization.
Attempts: 1449

lni5zO4qLng.title: (Insane Demon) ''TANTRUM'' 100% by DanZmeN & More | Geometry Dash
lni5zO4qLng.description:
Tantrum is an insane demon that has great design, the effects, the transitions, every section has something different to offer, whether it's a darker background with different glitch effects or a more colorful section with flashing lights and different hues in sync with the music. Unfortunately the gameplay is where this level falls short for me, it's inconsistent at times and in my experience it isn't enjoyable to play, and some of the effects are a bit jarring so it makes it a bit harder. But if you want a serious challenge then I do suggest you give this level a shot.
Attempts: 1222

TaB2gcE9IIQ.title: ''The Antagonist'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Mulpan | Geometry Dash [2.11]
TaB2gcE9IIQ.description: An amazing bossfight level by Mulpan, this level is very resemblant of Against The God by 1374, the design for the bosses as well as their attacks look great fitting in nicely with the theme and color pallette of the level, even though they're taken from another game, the animations are really smooth, especially for the dragon at 1:00, the wings and it's limbs move in a realistic way. The second boss at 2:28 is basically a giant demon goat head, it's design is cool, having a lot of detail on its face and horns, it's movements are much more simple, floating around in sync with the music, and it's attacks are different and add another layer of difficulty to the level, since it requires a bit of memorization.

XTM_q85JYFY.title: ''Inverse'' 100% (Demon) by UniqueMindsTM [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
XTM_q85JYFY.description: Inverse has great colors and usage of glow, a wide variety of colors that make every bit of detail pop out in it's own unique way in every section. The block design is very detailed, having neon colored borders most of the time, with different shapes and lines decorating the insides, switching brightness and hue in sync with the music. The backgrounds are mostly darker hues of the main color in the foreground, but it adds a layer of depth to the whole thing. The transitions are simple but effective. The gameplay is about Easy or Medium demon level, but it isn't inconsistent or buggy in any sense, I recommend you try it out.

py6JEPFQ-UQ.title: Prescript by Flash | Geometry Dash
py6JEPFQ-UQ.description: A remake of genericqueso's level Postscript, this level was created for the GDS Creator Contest, my favorite part about this level is the fact that the colors of the entire level change according to your player colors, I always like to see things like this in levels since it gives it a more "personalized" feeling to it, being different for everyone who plays it. The block design and overall design is a lot more detailed, having different shapes and lines filling the blocks, obstacles and even the backgrounds, everything comes together very nicely.

JmohuhGTOFA.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Bye'' 100% by AlrexX | Geometry Dash [2.11]
JmohuhGTOFA.description:
Bye is a remake by the really popular level Hi by KrmaL, being a lot harder than the original, and improving on a lot of fronts, but let's talk about the decoration first, right from the get go, you can tell that Bye maintains the same spirit as it's predecessor, but it is much more refined, having more color where it was absent before, and filling in the blanks, whether it's with more obstacles or animations, especially the one at 0:30, which in the original was just a dark screen blocking almost everything. The colors feel more vibrant and more diverse, changing in between hues much more often in sync with the music, which is the same this time around as well. The gameplay is another story, it is much harder than the original, but it takes a long time to get consistent at it, but I felt that you can't truly perfect this level, it's all over the place, that being said, I think it's a good remake, and if you're into hard levels, try this one out.
Attempts: 2489

ILkOvJ8CrnM.title: ''Potal'' 100% (Demon) by Sillow | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ILkOvJ8CrnM.description: Potal is a very unique level, it's very different to his other creations, which for the most part are design levels, this one is completely composed of portals and speed pads, every obstacle, and most of the decoration is made up of these, the gameplay is wave the whole way through, but if you touch one of the portals or speed changers it could mess you up completely and make you lose, so you have to make an effort to dodge all of them. And despite the design choice, I'm impressed by how good it looks, he gave everything a nice shape to make it look coherent without making it too difficult just for the sake of it. For me, it's one of those levels that's more fun to watch than to play, it's still looks great though.

G3mD3d_3yrE.title: ''Conn'' by Rekiii & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
G3mD3d_3yrE.description: Conn has a cartoony, technological yet simple feeling and design to it, the block design having various different colors, lines and other decorations that give it a lot of detail, the colors are so varied and vibrant, that the level pops out at every section in every corner. Some backgrounds are more detailed than others, with some just being simple lines and shapes, and others, such as the one at 0:55, that even have animations that came out looking very smooth that even sync with the beat of the music. There's also some pieces of art and animation in the forefront of the level, whether it's small obstacles that move around with faces on them or blocks that move around in the transitions along with some glitch effects that I always like to see. The gameplay is fun, there weren't any bugs that I encountered, but it could take some practice getting used to, apart from that, you should try this out.

e9Y_sLlnP2c.title: (Insane Demon) ''Wawa'' 100% by PokeChatt & More | Geometry Dash
e9Y_sLlnP2c.description: This megacollab was made in about a week, featuring a ton of creators that are just climbing the ranks in terms of creator points and recognition, and even though this level was made in such a short amount of time, it's still a really nice level, it doesn't have a set theme like many other MC's, considering the time, but the block design, the colors and the effects, especially the lighting, including glow, are still of a high quality. The song was also a really good choice, it fits well with the fast paced gameplay, and the changes in light intensity and color hue, along with the pulsating orbs, add another layer of detail to the whole thing. The gameplay is a bit inconsistent, but again, they put a week time limit on themselves, there aren't any bugs that I encountered, it's still enjoyable to play.

4kc_QrE4yfo.title: ''Haze N Blaze'' by Unzor | Geometry Dash [2.11]
4kc_QrE4yfo.description: Haze N Blaze is a level by a creator that's already become very popular, with a lot of people waiting for and anticipating his next level, this time with a very defined game theme, it boasts great colors, effects animations and art, both in the background and foreground of the design. My favorite section is the very beginning of the level, with a green and pixelated style, looking like something out of a Gameboy game, with scan lines to give it an older feel. The level also has a short boss fight, which I always appreciate the inclusion of, the design is very unique and well executed, and the attacks look very nice in my opinion, overall this is another really good level by unzor, highly recommend you try this level out.

rZ17mGOVX2Y.title: (Insane Demon) ''Arcane Ascent'' 100% by Alkali & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rZ17mGOVX2Y.description:
Arcane Ascent is more of a reeinvision instead of a remake of Artificial Ascent in the form of a megacollab, that's been in the works since mid-2019, that has been a difficult task to complete according to Alkali, in terms of decoration, it's basically each creator doing their own thing, using their styles, colors and effects however they want, there isn't a theme to the level, but everything looks great in it's own right. In terms of gameplay it was balanced to be an Insane Demon, and it's actually fun to play.
Attempts: 967

zciE5a2qDeg.title: ''Smile'' 100% (Demon) by Nikce [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
zciE5a2qDeg.description: Smile has a unique design in my opinion, it's a nice mix of various creating styles with a modern twist on it, showcasing dark and vibrant colors in different sections of the level. The block design looks great, being with neon borders most of the time, which I always like to see, with different lines and small details on the inside of the obstacles. One of the most important aspects in my opinion is the sync with the music, and this level does it in a nice, subtle way, with pulsating lights in time with the beat of the music, switches and colors and transitions. Gameplay-wise it's pretty straightforward and easy, so I'd say this will receive an Easy Demon rating.

7xJJ5v_qIWQ.title: (Insane Demon) ''Edens Blessing'' 100% by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash
7xJJ5v_qIWQ.description:
Edens Blessing by Subwoofer is one of those levels that I really enjoy, because not only does it have challenging gameplay, it has great design, colors, blocks, art and effects. The theme is exactly what the title might suggest to you, you're in Edens Garden, a beautiful place filled with water, flowers, grass, shrubbery and clouds, basically an island floating in the sky. One detail that I really like about this first half is how there are trees that appear and pass in front of the level, blocking your vision for a fraction of a second, things like that add another level of perspective to levels and I think it looks great. That's the first half of the level, the second half has a slightly darker tone to it, ditching the vibrant colors and decorations, for a grey and black aesthetic, while still maintaining a clear background. One of my favorite parts is the ending, the use of glow really makes the decoration stand out. Overall this is a pretty good insane demon, it has good gameplay, and a great theme and design.
Attempts: 2047

gZZ3GhvqytI.title: ''Comatose Dreamscape'' 100% by Knots (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
gZZ3GhvqytI.description: Knots has slowly become one of my favorite creators over recent times, and his levels only seem to get better with time. Comatose Dreamscape is a level with a futuristic and cybernetic theme and style, starting from the block design and obstacles, having different shapes and lines running through the inside and outside, something I like about this level is the small amount of color that's found in different sections, whether it's green, blue, pink or grey, being a very light hue, I think it adds a bit of life to the level. The backgrounds are also great, the art, the animations and movements, all add another layer of detail to the overall theme.

bQRRvIRN0kQ.title: ''The Social Media'' 100% by BurritoGamerX | Geometry Dash [2.11]
bQRRvIRN0kQ.description:
The Social Media is the newest level by a rising creator, BurritoGamerX, being the sequel to brug this, which I also uploaded about a month ago. This has a cartoony style, with a ton of art and effects to make everything pop out even more. The focus of the level are social medias, whether it's Facebook, Instagram or Reddit, the art for the logos and objects that acompany them looks really good, there are switches in colors, fades in the transitions, movement tied to the decoration and other aspects that take the detail in this level up a notch. The block design also fits the theme really well, combining it's colors and design with what's going on in the background. one thing to note is that he recreated the swing copter, both in terms of the feel of the gameplay and the way it looks. My only complaint about this level is the gameplay, It's pretty inconsistent, and the transitions are kind of hard to read, but overall I'd say this turned pretty good.
Thumbnail by Burrito Gamer X: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIRfEbrW-w4tL7vXy3rKOLQ

1_rjbI9OZkc.title: ''Interphase'' 100% (Demon) by CastriX | Geometry Dash [2.11]
1_rjbI9OZkc.description: A really great design level by CastriX, his levels have always been high-quality, but this is something completely elevated from his other creations, the amount of detail that is put into every single part and aspect of the level is amazing, you can tell it took him a very long time to make this. From the impressive block design with a shiny, glowing almost carnivalesque, extravagant aesthetic, the backgrounds that compliment the block design perfectly, with art, lines, looking as if you were in a temple of sorts. The effects are also great, the glow, the flashing pulsating lights in sync with the music, the movement of the blocks, there isn't a single complaint I have with this level. The gameplay obviously isn't the focus for CastriX in this level, so it's an Easy Demon for me probably, but overall it's definetely a level worth playing.

QxV_PvhXvec.title: ''What is it'' 100% (Demon) by Booglee [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
QxV_PvhXvec.description: "What is it" is a level that if you didn't know any better, you would think it's a megacollab between a whole bunch of talented creators, every couple of seconds the whole level changes, from the decoration, the block design, the colors, the style, the effects, even the song, which is a mix in in of itself. Even though the level switches design so rapidly, being done by a single person, it stays consistent the whole way through, especially in terms of the transitions, being really smooth from one section to the next. There's a ton of variation in this level, some parts may be better than others, but as a whole package it's a great level with a bunch of detail put into it.

-mdxQcXudvk.title: ''Hub'' 100% (Demon) by Jenkins GD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-mdxQcXudvk.description: Hub is a level by Jenkins, an already established creator that has made a variety of levels, from easy and accessible ones, to extreme demons that make the list, this time around he's created what I consider to be a Medium Demon, but the focus of the level in this case isn't it's difficulty, it's the decoration and effects that Jenkins has put into his level. Having a cyberspace, neon style, and as the title would suggest, you feel as if you're inside a hub, travelling through connections and bases, relying heavily on the sync with the music, this being a slow synthwave type of melody, the level has very few backgrounds, the ones that can be found add a bit of depth to the scenery of the level, but the main attraction is the neon block design, the changes in color, flashes of light and various glitch effects that can be seen throughout the level. Overall, the theme is perfectly executed in my opinion, and it's a fun level to play as well.

SLTwBsYioGI.title: ''Honey'' 100% (Demon) by SpooFy [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SLTwBsYioGI.description: Honey is a remake to the really popular level that was released 3 years ago by Motleyorc, the level has the same spirit as the original, but, as with most remakes, improving on a few aspects, whether it's the effects and animations. Though in my opinion the rainbow pulsing didn't really fit into theme, and for example some parts like 1:00, the block design is less detailed than the original. The most noticable thing that changes between this remake and the original is the Bee Bossfight, this time around, SpooFy added cannons, that move and spin around along with the boss, that fires lasers in your direction that you must dodge. Overall, I'd say this is a succesful remake, adding a bunch more detail, while still staying true to the original level.

fy5pqFjZI2A.title: ''Enigma'' 100% by KittyDoge | Geometry Dash [2.11]
fy5pqFjZI2A.description:
Enigma is a level by KittyDoge, a creator that already has a nice amount of creator points under his belt, and with this creation we can only assume they will increase in the coming months. This level is quite unique because during the whole thing you are a type of worm creature, and the thing I like the most is the fact that there are different game modes, and the creature changes form to match the game mode. The colors are very cozy and light, matching nicely with the block design and decoration found in the front and the background of the level.

Song: Enigma by Creo
https://youtu.be/bVuvRtSbvtU

afrdM8ao3S8.title: (Insane Demon) ''Kidsmoke'' 100% by GmD SamUL | Geometry Dash
afrdM8ao3S8.description: Kidsmoke is an incredible level, I'd call it a "psychological horror" level, the very dark atmosphere, brought together with the various elements of decoration, it could be the different obscure figures popping in and out of view in sync with the song, which I have to say is really bizarre and almost unsettling, the art is also very fitting for the level, the demons, the objects and shapes that sometimes fill up the whole thing, in combination with the glitch and distortion effects that can be found here and there, the flashing lights, the quick changes in color, that highlight these different parts of the setting. The gameplay is also quite different, there are a couple of sections that switch between red and white, where the "real" pathway is revealed and you must remember where to go through when the "fake" path is on screen, it has a nice variation of game modes even though it does stay at the same speed the whole time, it fits the theme and song quite well.

8xhPSJfBGzQ.title: ''The Valley of Souls'' 100% (Demon) by Manix648, Terron & Findexi | Geometry Dash
8xhPSJfBGzQ.description: The valley of souls is an old 2.0 collab between 3 creators, Manix ,Terron and Findexi. This level has a red and black theme with different effects that go perfectly with the theme of the level, the flashes of lights, the way the block design switches from black to white and vice-versa, the different demonic art that appears in the foreground and background of the level, my favorite being the section at 0:51, where you switch from spider to cube and back, the effects here are great, the animations for the block design, the effects that make it seem like you're going faster, it looks really nice in my opinion. The gameplay is about Easy Demon difficulty, the beginning is easier since it was made so long ago, but the rest does pick up.

LRJib9DTEOE.title: (Insane Demon) ''Beetle'' 100% by Cirtrax & More | Geometry Dash
LRJib9DTEOE.description: Beetle is an Insane Demon that's over a minute and a half with a ton of variation in it's decoration, whether it's the block design, especially the color combinations, the use of glow, and even though there aren't any backgrounds or art, the change in hue in sync with the song makes this level enjoyable to play in my opinion. One thing I enjoy about this level is the change of pace in some sections, there are some that are very fast pace that slow down all of a sudden for a couple of seconds along with the music. The gameplay is very consistent so as a full package this is a very nice level.

SrBdhJbY0Os.title: ''The Dark Guardian'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
SrBdhJbY0Os.description: The Dark Guardian is a remake of Abstract Dark's level "Darkness Keeper", it keeps the same spirit as the original, while still improving on a bunch of aspects, the lighting, the effects, the colors, the block design, the backgrounds, the art, just about everything is a step above from the original. One thing that I would improve in this level is the first boss, the design is good, but it's movements seem a bit stiff and clunky at times, and the animations could be a bit smoother, other than that it looks great and fits in really nicely with the level. The second boss is definitely my favorite, I really like it's design and the movements and attacks are well made.

YCozR0srrRA.title: Minecraft 3D by Takayama | Geometry Dash
YCozR0srrRA.description: Minecraft 3D is a 3D recreation of a small Minecraft map, with your very own house, trees, and other various objects. It's inspired by Davoxt's level, 3D Adventure. The objective of the level is to grab all 5 diamonds that are scattered around the terrain, which helps to admire every bit of detail that Takayama put into this small map. These levels are always impressive to me, switching from a completely 2D game, to a 3D landscape, and each one has something unique every time.

GzM9QXY-u1Y.title: Xolis by Spu7nix | Geometry Dash
GzM9QXY-u1Y.description: A sequel to Tianxia, a level that was released about 9 months ago, that had a lot of eyes on it for it's uniqueness and innovation, that one was made strictly with triangles, which made it a bit hard to tell what was going on in the screen. This time around with Xolis, Spu7nix used circles instead, which give a much clearer image, making it easier to make out the "movie". The "video" is also a bit smaller when you play it, which makes slightly easier to run. What I find most amazing about this level is the fact that Spu7nix used a Script, grabbing and composing different videos, to make it all into a level.

BkqW1yvIDZM.title: ''Fancy Me An Object'' 100% (Demon) by Jeyzor | Geometry Dash
BkqW1yvIDZM.description: Jeyzor's comeback level, taking a completely different direction than his previous levels, that being said, this level is still great and up to Jeyzor's typical standards, the amount of detail that can be found in the back and front of the level is great. The transitions are probably my favorite part of the level, they're all very unique, fitting in perfectly with the theme and having really nice animations and color combinations to go along with the art and design and makes the level flow a lot better, while still connecting each section with one another. This level has a very "fancy" feeling and vibe to it, as the title suggests, using clear colors, such as purple, pink, green and others, with a clean and symmetrical block design, with flowers decorating the borders. The gameplay is easy and straightforward, there weren't any bugs or inconsistencies that I encountered, although there are some parts that require timing, but with practice they should become easier.

H0-UF3jBtRI.title: "Retro Maze" 100% (Demon) by Foxydolly & More | Geometry Dash
H0-UF3jBtRI.description: Retro Maze is a level that has a very distinct computer theme, with green being the prominent color, as it was in the early 2000's with old computers. It has a pixel art style with a very technical feel to it, it does have some variation to it as well. Where some sections are more retro and some look a lot more modern, while still having their own set of effects that highlight each part of the decoration, and it's all high quality. Given it's a collab, some parts are going to be a bit better than others, my favorite being at 0:32, that section alone could be it's own level, but all together, everything fits nicely with one another.

l7zjp9j3qoU.title: ''Oyasumi Nasai'' 100% (Demon) by KittyDoge | Geometry Dash
l7zjp9j3qoU.description: Oyasumi Nasai is a level with amazing art and effects, with a scary atmosphere that is perfectly executed, whether it's through the spooky faces that appear on the background when you least expect it, the dark and gloomy landscapes, the sections that have a neon design, with Japanese architecture and symbols, the various effects that highlight every aspect of the decoration, while maintaining   great sync with the music that was chosen, although I feel the song is a bit fast paced at times given the theme of the level.

IfJbA508Afg.title: ''Techno Punk'' 100% (XXL Demon) by SuprianGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
IfJbA508Afg.description: Techno Punk is a level with a future funk theme, with neon lights, bright colors, and 80's inspired art, backgrounds and block design. I really enjoy how varied the level is, there are sections where the main focus is the art in the background, which is really nicely made, whether it's the colorful and nostalgic cityscapes with palm trees in plain sight, the more cybernetic parts with the sun and graphical lines in the back, or simply different shapes and lines shifting around with various colors. There are sections that are much simpler, but these are short lived and quickly transition to the more lively and colorful style.

HUIRw8pslGQ.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Mandragora'' 100% by GD ParaDoX & More | Geometry Dash
HUIRw8pslGQ.description: Mandragora is an Extreme Demon collab that is simply incredible all the way through, there isn't a section in this level that doesn't look amazing, from the simpler things like the colors and block design to the more complicated and detailed backgrounds and art that fills the entire scenery. There is a lot of diversity in this level, every part has something different to offer visually and in terms of gameplay as well, some being longer than others, some focusing more on block design, with a simple background or with a more monochrome color palette, others focusing more on art, whether it's in the front or the background, and others on effects and animations, with flashing lights and objects moving around the screen, but still fitting in with the theme of the level and having great sync with the song that was chosen. The gameplay is great as well, it's consistent and there aren't any bugs that I encountered, there aren't any sudden spikes in difficulty just for the sake of it being extreme, which I always appreciate.

50ri-NLjnSU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Leyak'' 100% by EnZore | Geometry Dash [2.11]
50ri-NLjnSU.description: Leyak is an Extreme Demon that has a fantastic design, it isn't just a solid colored background, with no decoration or block design with really hard gameplay, it has a theme, it being "leyaks" or people who practice black magic. The level begins with an already incredible design, but it begins to ramp up in intensity as it moves forward, having a more sinister vibe and feel to it, whether it's through the darker colors, the flashes of light or the pieces of art that appear in reference to the overall theme that's being portrayed. The gameplay is good but one thing that I didn't enjoy is that there are various sections that require you to spam, which makes it inconsistent and a bit frustrating, other than that it's a good level overall.

RmLGMt6LmrA.title: BruG This by BurritoGamerX | Geometry Dash
RmLGMt6LmrA.description: This is a level by BurritoGamerX, which is one of those creators that surprises you when you find out that he doesn't have any creator points to his name, since he does have other creations, including this one, that in my opinion display enough quality. The art and animations for this level are fantastic, the logos for each website, whether it's twitch, youtube or discord, look great, including the animations that he added to them, floating and moving around in the background. One gripe I have with this level is the text transition at 0:25, it looks extremely blurry, and doesn't fade out properly.

xbDXsTDXvmQ.title: ''Angel of Music'' 100% (Demon) by kDarko | Geometry Dash [2.11]
xbDXsTDXvmQ.description: Angel of Music is another level that has been released for some time now and it still hasn't been rated yet. This is completely themed after the Phantom of the Opera, the colors, using white, gold, red and pink for most of the beginning, to end off on a more golden note, to emphasize every bit of decoration, the objects and block design. This has really nice art too, like the roses that sometimes appear on the screen, and the masks that are on top of the spikes, I think they fit the theme perfectly and give the level a whole other layer of detail.

qTE6hE1a_vU.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Acu'' 100% by Neigefeu | Geometry Dash [2.11]
qTE6hE1a_vU.description:
Acu is an extreme demon that's very colorful and geometrical, having really vibrant colors that combine differently and switch around right from the getgo, all the way to the end of the level, combining this with all the shapes and lines, whether it's in the background, or in the foreground with the block design, making the level feel complete and high quality. The level starts out at a relatively slow pace, before building up to it's most intense moment at the drop, to finally slow back down a bit towards the end. This is one of those levels that's nice to look at and enjoyable to play, the gameplay is consistent, which is something that's always very important in an extreme demon, there aren't any bugs that I encountered, so if you're up for the challenge, try it out.

Song: Epilogue by Creo
https://youtu.be/tOZNh8veU_Y

EprvmWUoo8k.title: ''Dasein'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Reunomi & LeafCloud [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
EprvmWUoo8k.description: Dasein is a collab level that came out almost 2 years ago, with Reunomi working on design and decoration, and LeafCloud on gameplay, this is a level with one of the nicest, coziest and chill atmospheres and vibes I've seen recently, the art for each section, whether it's a city-scape, a valley filled with grass and mountains in the background, a desert with sand and cacti all around, an underwater shipwreck or a compilation of planets and galaxies glowing in the back, looks incredible. This level has a ton to offer from every point of view, the block design combines perfectly with each section's theme, colors and design, each section could be it's own level by itself and be succesful. It also features a bossfight with a warship, it has an HP bar at the bottom of the screen, which I think is always a nice touch, and you have to dodge cannonballs with a spam mechanic at the end of the fight.

dZZHqcbSKbQ.title: ''PURPLE SPLASH'' 100% (Demon) by CastriX & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
dZZHqcbSKbQ.description: Purple Splash is a collab level that to my surprise, hasn't been rated in over 4 months since it's been released, taking into account the quality in terms of design, whether it's the block design, the colors, the backgrounds, the pulses of light and color in sync with the music, the animations for the objects and obstacles or decoration that's seen in the back and the overall calm and pleasing aesthetic that every section has. Every part has something unique to offer, it could be a slow paced landscape with bright colors, taking advantage of the slow parts of the song, or it could be a faster paced view of geometrical shapes, while still being connected perfectly one with another, one think I could say is how most of the creators sections have a piece that transition nicely between each other, but werewolf gd's art feels a bit out of place in comparison to the rest of the decoration found in the level, but I'm not gonna let a 4 second part downgrade the great quality of this level. That being said, his art is still high quality and I hope this level gets rated soon.

MFDh_rTa2ng.title: "Mr CrazyHands" 100% (XXL Demon) by ExtoPlasm | Geometry Dash
MFDh_rTa2ng.description: Mr CrazyHands is an XXL level with art, backgrounds, and animations that give it a very defined theme and style, though the block design is bland in most of the parts but this creator has a ton of potential to become really good, there is a lot of unique ideas in here and the theme is executed very well, in this case being a spooky setting, The song fits really well with what's happening on screen, whether it's the transitions the flashes of light, or the art in the background syncing with the beat of the song. There are a couple of mini bossfights, though I wish the attacks were more varied. The first is section is well-done, the colors fit nicely with the backgrounds and obstacles and the animations look smooth, the second is the same enemy but seen from a different perspective, which also looks nice.

8w40A5pSPDw.title: ''ViPriN'' 100% by BlowMyPooh (1 Coin) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
8w40A5pSPDw.description: This is a joke level that is basically the same gameplay, making reference to the old copy and paste joke, although it could've been at a smaller scale, block design, and even music, with the only thing that changes is the background, showcasing different emotes. The block design fits really well with the theme of the level, the backgrounds are well done, the art and colors fit nicely together. The block design is unique and also in line with the rest of the decoration. The coin was pretty difficult to find since there wasn't any video showing how to get it, I guess going for it can slightly change the gameplay.

EfE3jaP5_Ec.title: Mashup by Jayuff | Geometry Dash
EfE3jaP5_Ec.description:
ID: 54724490
Mashup is just what the title suggests, a compilation of different types, styles, designs and concepts, but taken to a completely other level, it isn't just a bunch of levels tacked on one after the other, with a simple transition, you could say the whole thing is done as if you were watching tv and you're switching between channels, finding something completely different each time. We begin with a slow paced section, design wise it's space themed, but not super realistic or detailed like other space levels you can find in GD, this one has a simple vibe to it, with only white dots in the background depicting stars and drawings of UFO's in front, the colors at the bottom add a nice touch, so the section doesn't feel monotone. We then go to a more modern style of level, with clean white backgrounds decorated with shapes and in the forefront, simple platforms with a dark tone, contrasted by different boxes of color, which I really liked. One detail I really liked about this whole thing is the fact that when you transition into the next part, the text for the number of attempt you're on appears, making it feel as if you started a completely different level, which takes us into the next part, a darker and creepier setting, with fog and trees filling the background, as if it were a haunted forest. The level glitches out heavily at the end of this part, and takes us into a simpler, more generic looking space, it doesn't last very long so no more to comment on this. For the next 5 seconds we find ourselves in a completely gray landscape, with shapes and different lines of color moving around, what I really liked about this part was the block design, the platforms looking almost 3D, nice touch. After this, we see a landscape, with trees and mountains, with clouds and beams of sunlight decorating the top, which could be a piece of art within itself, but before we get the chance to get a better look, it deconstructs and takes us upwards into the real section. Which seems to be space themed as well, reminiscent of the beginning of the level, with a dark background, different colored stars filling the empty spaces, I also really like the block design in this part, and the small pieces of decorations and details you can find, the lines of colors shooting out of the platforms, the pulses of light emanating from the borders, this it's just nice to look at. We then start switching between "levels" much faster, we travel through a pixel art world, with bright colors, a blue sky, vibrant grass with butterflies flying around, followed by a purple section, that I personally really liked, especially because of the wave effect that was implemented, making it feel as if you're underwater or inside a piece of jello, almost being a bit disorienting, after this, we go through a neon colored and themed section, mainly in the block design and obstacles, contrasting really nicely with the dark background. And finally, we travel through a couple of starry, glittery and colorful areas, with a slower pace, just right to end the level off. Overall, this is a level with an interesting concept executed very nicely, highly recommend you try it out.

QpzuH9OD4kk.title: ''PERIHELION'' 100% (Demon) by Galzo & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
QpzuH9OD4kk.description: Perihelion is a brand new megacollab just released by Galzo today, his previous level being released over 2 years ago, so his big return is starred by a megacollab that has been in the works for over a year. It's an art and effect centered level and I'd say it turned out amazing, every section has a unique style to it, whether it's the block design, backgrounds, and the effects that come with them, while still maintaining their connection to the rest of the level. The transitions also look really good, each one is unique and adds another layer of detail to the level as a whole.

tL2X3Fy0BUQ.title: ''Ultra Violence'' 100% (Demon) by Xender Game | Geometry Dash [2.11]
tL2X3Fy0BUQ.description: Ultra Violence is the newest level by Xender Game, and as always it's amazing, the colors, the effects the backgrounds especially, the movement, animations, block design, and just about everything is high quality. I really enjoy seeing how Xender has honed and polished his creating style, and you can see it clearly with this level. As with most of Xender's levels, the main focus is the bossfight, having different fases and designs, while still implementing different gameplay elements, and having buildup with the decoration and musical sync. The design for the bosses is unique, having different attacks and styles, having a different set of animations as well, which every single one came out looking really smooth. Overall this level is what you'd come to expect from Xender, a level with a design that is very defined, with bossfights that are fun to play and nice to look at.

lBDTI_7qXmY.title: ''Nostalgic Journey'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Team Throwback | Geometry Dash [2.11]
lBDTI_7qXmY.description: Nostalgic Journey is the sequel Nostalgic Travel, It has been in the works for some months now, It also focuses very heavily on design, effects and colors to make this really long level stand out above the rest. Something I always enjoy about XXL levels is how they implement the song very nicely into the gameplay and design elements, having great sync most of the time and using it to their advantage, having colors change rapidly during the hectic sections, flashing lights along with the beat, and changing the speed of the gameplay to match the tempo of the song, and it is done very well in this level. Team Throwback also implemented backgrounds, not every section has one, and some being simpler than others, but the way they used the basic objects to create new ones turned out looking great in my opinion. Overall this level has a lot to offer, using every piece of decoration to it's fullest potential to create a fun experience.

GagwZjE0Ku4.title: ''The Lost Faith'' 100% (Demon) by Zoroa GD & FunnyGame | Geometry Dash
GagwZjE0Ku4.description: A brand new effect level by Zoroa GD, an effect creator that constantly pumps out high quality levels, this time he's collaborated with FunnyGame, a well-known effect creator as well, a veteran in that field which brings for a really interesting level, combining the "older style" with a more modern one. The level has a very distinct dark theme, with dark tones and colors, mostly using to it's advantage purple, pink and grey accents. That being said, the effects themselves are very good as well, whether it's the flashes of light that sync with the music, the bits of lightning that fall from the sky, illuminating the level, the subtle glitch effects found in some parts of the level, and my favorite part of the level, which begins at 1:53, the buildup for this section, from the music, to the effects, the way the level feels empty for a few seconds, that takes to the final section which is heavily inspired by Black Blizzard, the song is in it's climax, the black snow is falling along with the gradient light effects inside the blocks is great, a fantastic end to the level in my opinion.

FdjKd-RuqLc.title: ''Toxitic Mash'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
FdjKd-RuqLc.description: Toxitic Mash is a level with a very defined theme and style, being cartoony and smooth all throughout. The colors fit nicely with the toxic theme, as do all the monsters and obstacles that were created for each section, each having their own set of animations and movements that turned out looking very nice. The art that's found in the backgrounds is great as well, blending in with the gameplay.

NrTjEIhLejs.title: Arcturus (Demon) by Team Proxima [Verified] | Geometry Dash
NrTjEIhLejs.description:
Another megacollab by Team Proxima, an already established group of creators, this time they bring to the table a design level that uses glow very well, quality block design and effects. Something I always enjoy about their levels is the fact that each section combines very nicely with the next.
ID: 60784748

SljDix3m244.title: ''Doodle'' 100% by Glory & HotoCot | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SljDix3m244.description: This level is visually impressive, the artwork created for this level is on a completely different level from anything I've seen before. Absolutely everything you see in this level is made by the creators themselves, every single piece of decoration, in the foreground and in the background, the blocks, the art, the obstacles, the combination of colors. While this level doesn't have a set "theme", the incredible art found in each section makes up for it. This level has been rated already but it didn't get epic, I think the reason is because it has over 200K objects, which may cause some lag on certain devices, so keep that in mind, apart from that, just for the visual aspect of it, it's worth giving it a try.

jL_2QADpB48.title: Icons Race by VegasKoneko | Geometry Dash
jL_2QADpB48.description: Highly requested level, not much to say about this other than the concept is neat but the animations need a lot of work.

4MveJtXl8F8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''HURRICANE'' 100% by Bianox & More | Geometry Dash
4MveJtXl8F8.description:
Probably my new favorite megacollab, HURRICANE the sequel to CYCLONE, has it all, from the style and decoration, being a 10/10 for me, the colors used throughout the level are unique, they make the most important bits of deco stand out, bringing them to life and even though the level has such a fast pace most of the time, it's almost impossible not to notice the amount of detail that went into creating this. Even though it's a MC, the quality and theme stay consistent from beginning to end, every part connecting perfectly to the next, the transitions are seamless, both in terms of design and gameplay, and have great sync with the song. Now onto the gameplay, this level is something special in my opinion, it's one of the few Extreme Demons that I've had fun playing. The difficulty stays consistent, there aren't any bugs that I found or encountered, everything combined just makes for a fun experience, at least to me. So if you're into these types of levels, I highly recommend you give this a shot.

Attempts: 3639

Syg3tZctvC0.title: "Multition" 100% (2 Player Demon) by Partition & Mulpan | Geometry Dash
Syg3tZctvC0.description: Multition is a great example on how to do a two-player level right, from the design and decoration that's pretty much split into two, looking as if each player is in a completely different level, having contrasting block design, colors, backgrounds and effects, adding onto the effect of "splitscreen". Putting aside the design of the level, what really makes this level shine is the gameplay, being exceptionally fun, it's rated as "Insane Demon" ingame, but I assume that's the rating people that tried to play it solo gave it, if you play it with another person, I'd say it's a Medium Demon. The gameplay stays consistent all throughout, having various gameplay modes and has great sync, highly recommend you play this with a friend.

eSpS_gYXZxE.title: Marenol by Ph4lip | Geometry Dash
eSpS_gYXZxE.description: Awesome effect layout, glad too see more Leaf songs being used in GD levels.

683rOnNY6aE.title: ''The Voidlands'' 100% (Demon) by Dolphe | Geometry Dash [2.11]
683rOnNY6aE.description: The Voidlands is a level that throws you right into the action from the get go, showcasing it's lighting effects, it's futuristic and robotic block design, colors and backgrounds, being dedicated to HHyper and Xender Game, it has a lot of time with bosses, having 3 fases or so in this instance, using every bit of decoration possible to highlight the design of the bosses, their attacks and movements, which in this case all turned out great, becoming very reminiscent of The Eschaton. One thing I really enjoyed is the fact that HHyper and Xender are basically both of the bosses you encounter, even integrating a story into the level, going as far as creating 3 different endings to the level, one where you attack HHyper, another where you attack Xender and a third one where you let HHyper eliminate all Cats. Amazing level overall, don't know why it didn't get epic.

rodLpWw3gas.title: ''Computer Talk'' by 1374 (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rodLpWw3gas.description:
It's been a while since we've seen a level by 1374, last time we saw him was when Against the God was released, which was one of my favorite levels when it came out, Computer Talk is a lot different, but that doesn't mean in any way that it's not a good level. Having a retro style to it, a green theme like old computers used to have, it's very nicely executed, the animations for both the block designs and objects and "enemies" in the back, the effects and sync with the song are done really well. The stickman section at 0:49 is infact 2-player, it isn't mentioned in the level, but I assume 1374 will clarify that. Overall this is a nicely done level with a solid theme and great decoration to back it up.

tfj_0GoH0aY.description: Pretty big milestone for me, this is one of the harder insane demons out there, so I thought I should beat it for the 100. Maybe 100 Extreme Demons next? I'm more than half way there. GG :)

OW9Kq7yS-i8.description:
One of the most accurate game recreations I've seen, makes me wonder what 2.2 has in store for us, you all should definitely go play this.
ID: 60538768

Yg2ASjAFceA.title: ''Postscript'' 100% by Genericqueso | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Yg2ASjAFceA.description: Postscript is a level that in it's essence is an "empty" level, being only comprised of shapes and lines, but what I find especially unique about this, is the fact that the colors of the level, found in the blocks obstacles and effects, all change according to the players colors. The main aspect of this level is the sync the gameplay and effects have with the music, flashing and shifting along with it. The movements of the blocks, the obstacles and the little decoration that's made of lines that can be found, are very smooth, making the level satisfying to look at. Overall, this is a level that may look simple at first glance, but when you play it all the way through, you can see how every aspect makes it complete.

4cZPITzxNZw.title: ''Tree of Life'' 100% by 70UNIKITTY (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
4cZPITzxNZw.description:
Tree of Life is a Just Shapes and Beats level with a very defined simplistic, modern and technological style, starting off with a slow, clear, calm pace and perfect music sync, but changing almost completely when the drop hits. Having a lot more detail, both in the foreground and background, having a bunch of shapes, lines and arrows shifting in both places, with characters matching the different colors appearing with each new section, which I think is very unique. The colors and art are really good, they combine really well with each other, also having sync with the song, whether it be the transitions or the pulses of objects and orbs. Overall this is a diverse level with a solid theme, fun to watch and fun to play, highly recommend you try it out.
ID: 60501308

wBBK91LJ_mM.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Mischievous Run'' 100% by OptaWolfGD & More | Geometry Dash
wBBK91LJ_mM.description:
Good level, Opta always puts out great megacollabs, this was previously very unbalanced but it's been updated to be much more enjoyable now and that made me give it a go. GG :)

eR5cNaYHSvA.title: I Love You by Samuraychik | Geometry Dash [1.9]
eR5cNaYHSvA.description: One of the best 1.9 levels ive come across, truly remarkable.

i4Gg7V76rM0.title: ''Experiment 204'' 100% (Demon) by HHyper [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
i4Gg7V76rM0.description: It feels like it's been forever since I first found HHyper and uploaded Beast Mayhem II, and I'm happy to say that since then he's only been improving, from that to Surgeragon to Mayhem War and now this level, Experiment 204. It's only a minute long but has 100k objects, which means there's a lot of detail compacted into the level, which may cause some lag and fps drops, putting aside whatever bugs and performance issues the level has, if we're talking about the design of the level, it's fantastic as usual, it's basically just one long bossfight, something I noticed is that you fight in 2 different perspectives, the first time you encounter the boss, it's seen from a side angle, the second time it's from the front, where you can see it's movements and facial expressions much easier. The attacks, the colors and animations are great, in sync with the music, it's very fun to watch.

3QZcZ7Pd5zo.title: ''Super Mario Bros 2D'' by Takayama (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
3QZcZ7Pd5zo.description:
Super Mario Bros 2D is a complete recreation of the original Super Mario Bros. and it turned out great, the blocks, the movement, the animations, everything looks as if it were completely ripped from the original. There have been other recreations of this game but I think this one is my favorite, especially the end screen when you beat the level, being from Super Mario Maker, the colors and animations are really smooth. Overall this is one of those levels that aren't even GD anymore, and they're fun to play once in a while.

b6qdqkv4f4E.description: Fun Insane Demon by Shocksidian, this doesn't have a lot of effects but the design is pretty nice, with good color combinations to go along with it. The dual section has really unique gameplay, and being the hardest part of the level it can take some time to learn a pattern to do it consistently.

9K6BJAInpSU.title: Checky by KJackpot | Geometry Dash
9K6BJAInpSU.description:
Checky is a layout level that plays heavily on the sync with the music that was chosen, starting off slowly and building up along with it, flashing lights along with the beat and even implementing various effects that match up perfectly. Being a very upbeat song, the gameplay is varied, having a lot of unique gameplay elements and movements, taking advantage of the layout style, moving the whole level around, shifting blocks and changing speed. My favorite section is the one that starts at 1:22 until the end of the level, it's very unique, using the blocks and their movements to give the illusion of being inside a wheel. Overall this is a very fun level, I recommend you try it out.
Music: https://youtu.be/zhIScvlFn2w

sAYGQN_xzrI.title: Stereo Madness ISO by BrunoDash | Geometry Dash
sAYGQN_xzrI.description:
Pretty cool recreation of stereo madness in an isometric view, not much to say other than its executed really well, but It would've been a lot better if this had a custom made 3D Icon like the rest of the level. We need more levels with this concept, I think it's very unique. I thought this level would be rated by now but apparently not, hope it is soon.
Level: Stereo Madness ISO by BrunoDash5430

8_ox7DNPmYg.title: LIGHT by Krawler | Geometry Dash
8_ox7DNPmYg.description: Very unknown level by Krawler, this has great effects, backgrounds that are really creative and with a well executed atmosphere. There is a lot of animation throughout the level that makes it feel more alive and complete, with the backgrounds and structures that are constantly changing. Though this could some tweaking because of some of the visual errors it has, such as pieces of glow that stick out of the ceiling when you enter a transition, and at the beginning where the spikes aren't properly alined with the moving structures, I think this could easily be fixed. In my opinion this turned pretty good and is very unique all around.

99NUqoucAW0.title: ''Mechanical Realm'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Maxie25 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
99NUqoucAW0.description: A level that shows just how much Maxie25 has improved over time, Mechanical Realm has gameplay elements that fit perfectly with the theme, having a grey with neon colors that make the important points of the level stand out in between all of the monochrome decoration. Having a great use of glow and lighting effects that along with the music, give the level a new level of detail, bringing every piece of decoration and art together. The various animations that are found within the level, whether it's in the blocks, or the backgrounds, all of them are well-made and very smooth. I really enjoy when levels have "halfway points" where the gameplay slows down almost to a halt and it gives you a few seconds to breathe before going to the most intense section of the level. In this case it builds up for a bit before hitting the last drop. Something else that surprised me about this level are the unique gameplay sections that can be found, especially the ones that start at 1:56, the platforming, having to time your clicks with different buttons and spamming to escape a monster, while still relating to the mechanical theme. Overall this is a great level, a major improvement from previous levels, I highly recommend you try this out.

-9JJnBLlXEA.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Math'' 100% by Sminx & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-9JJnBLlXEA.description: A pretty nice remake of Aftermath, took me 23 attempts to beat it and a couple dozen of attempts I had in a copyable so about 40 or 50 attempts in total. It took that few since I already beat the original pretty recently and this has really heavy nerfs, I even had a 98% and beat it the next attempt. This level will probably be downgraded to Hard Demon soon which I think is the correct rating for it. GG :)

wh1B_Q9gwD8.title: Misanthrope Layout by Brittank88 & More | Geometry Dash

The most ambitious project in this game.
