kXdfc_DYBCQ.title: (Extreme Demon) ''A2Marbl'' 100% by Pennutoh & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kXdfc_DYBCQ.description: Extremely fun level, I have no complaints about the gameplay or deco, we need more levels like this. I forgot to show the other attempts I had in a copyable which were around 2k, so it took me about 3k attempts to do this, probably gonna try to beat ATMarbl now since I dropped it almost 2 years ago. GG :)

OJvmV_-tzSI.title: ''Universal Travel'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Dragn3el & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
OJvmV_-tzSI.description: Universal Travel is another installment in the series of "Travel" levels, this one completely being space-themed, being in the works for almost 3 years, Dragn3el was finally able to release this project with the help of various other creators, and in my opinion, it was worth it, you'll find yourself staring more at the effects, art, colors and objects in the background than the block design and gameplay in the front. The planets, the stars, the landscapes and just about everything found in the background really tie the level together, it makes you feel like your travelling through different parts of the universe. Most of the block design stays consistent with the colors of the section they are in, although some parts can look way better, it makes a good combination all together. The level stays hyperrealistic most of the way through, except for a small section at 2:08, where the level becomes more cartoony, which was a nice change of scenery and pace, after that the level stays with it's initial style. This level is about Medium Demon difficulty I'd say, since travel levels last 5 minutes or more most of the time, but it's fun to play and a pleasure to look at.

h6JsFI5-M0Y.title: ''Vacuum Wave'' 100% (Demon) by BrazilTeam | Geometry Dash [2.11]
h6JsFI5-M0Y.description: Vacuum Wave is BrazilTeam's first megacollab and I have to say, it turned out pretty good, the level is very colorful, using glow very nicely along with some lighting effects that make the decoration stand out even more. MC's are generally pretty tricky, since there are a bunch of different creators working on a level, sometimes it can feel disconnected or all over the place, but I think BrazilTeam did a great job of making the level feel complete, with every section having it's place, while still maintaining each creators style. The art at the end of the level is great as well, props to whoever made that. The gameplay is about Medium Demon difficulty, it's consistent and enjoyable to play.

lDDyBBzSTuo.title: ''My Style Is No Style'' 100% (Demon) by Ellisha [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
lDDyBBzSTuo.description: An effect level that has 150K objects, which I think is mostly used up by the backgrounds and triggers, since the block design is on the simpler side, giving it only a bit of glow, some 3d effects in a couple of sections and color fill. Going back to the backgrounds, this is where the level shines, the effects that he created are great, especially at the end of the level. The gameplay is Demon difficulty, but it stays consistent throughout the whole thing, which is always appreciated.

oPmkbRKkQGw.title: ''Memories II'' 100% (Demon) by The4n1ma | Geometry Dash [2.11]
oPmkbRKkQGw.description: Memories II is a level that, like Ultimate Demon Mix, showcases a ton of popular levels that came out throughout the years, but unlike UDM, this level, every section has it's own layout, going from levels like Death Moon to recent levels like Astral Divinity, having styles and decoration identical to their original counterparts, only changing it's gameplay. The transitions are pretty fair once you've practiced them enough. I'd say this is about Medium Demon.

VGmnTeziHeE.title: Snow White by Hoek | Geometry Dash
VGmnTeziHeE.description: I have mixed feelings about this

9Dma-JBdU3w.title: ''Imminent Ruination'' 100% (Demon) by Moosh & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
9Dma-JBdU3w.description: A level that in my opinion stays very consistent decoration-wise pretty much throughout the whole thing, considering it's a megacollab, none of the sections feel out of place or disconnected from the rest, even though some transitions are very apparent, making the whole level feel complete both in terms of gameplay and design. One thing I really like about this are the color choices, pretty much being orange, yellow red and a bit of purple and pink. Another thing I really enjoyed about this level is the sync the gameplay has with the song that was chosen, the section at the beginning that starts off slow, flashing different colors along with the beat, things like this are a nice touch in my opinion. The gameplay is about Easy Demon or maybe even Medium, it's fun to play because as I already mentioned, it has really good sync, and playing along with it is enjoyable. Overall I'd say this was a succesful collab, and I'm excited to see more from all of these relatively unknown creators.

Df9bXmjLNzE.title: BLay Out by Booglee | Geometry Dash
Df9bXmjLNzE.description: Yet another pretty cool level by booglee. This level was an entry for kjackpots layout contest and it got second place, and it turned out really good. You can see there was effort put into it although the gameplay gets a bit repetitive.

-14dWHgPj2M.title: ''Call The Colors'' by AlesitoGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]

EfqCYZ0kpmU.title: ''Ultimo Universo'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Nacho21 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
EfqCYZ0kpmU.description: Ultimo Universo is Nacho21's latest level, a well known and already established creator, sad to see that he quit, I've always liked his levels because he always brought something new to the table even though the decoration wasn't spectacular. So Nacho uploaded this as his final level since he couldn't finish due to problems with his PC, this definitely has the potential to be really good.

aabREtJT3o8.title: ''Rapture Poetry'' 100% (Demon) by ExtraCrispyCroc | Geometry Dash [2.11]
aabREtJT3o8.description: Rapture Poetry is a polarizing level for me, on one hand, the decoration and design that was created for this is great, from the slow and monotone colors, block design and effects found in the intro to the level, to the colorful and faster-paced change that comes after the drop, while still maintaining it's theme intact. On the other, the gameplay is inconsistent, some parts are simple and straightforward, and others seem unnecessarily complicated, which is why this took me longer than I thought to beat. But as a complete package, this level is still really good.

fmLu3bt1HQM.title: ''Chu War'' 100% (Demon) by ItzDubu | Geometry Dash [2.11]
fmLu3bt1HQM.description: Chu war is an ice-winter level that showcases great design, blocks, colors, backgrounds and art, executes it's theme perfectly, I only have one complaint though, the glow effect is a bit over-used, which causes lag, making it very difficult to play on mobile and even PC. I really like the design for the bossfight, although the attacks look a bit basic for how good the rest of it looks. The gameplay is straightforward, I'd rate it between Insane and Easy Demon difficulty, being fair without any bugs or inconsistencies.

Fhow8X8WQPA.title: 19ZZ by BBosom3 | Geometry Dash
Fhow8X8WQPA.description: 19ZZ is a layout effect level, that uses every bit of movement to it's advantage, in perfect sync with the music that was chosen, almost being led by it. The most unique parts of this level in my opinion, are when you can see the diamonds from practice mode, and a new attempt, number, this may confuse some people but it is completely intentional and part of the level, also the sections where the whole level turns and shifts, giving a whole new perspective to it. As with most layout levels, the gameplay is very much dependent on the sync with the song, glitching, repeating, distorting along with it, but I wouldn't say this goes past an Insane difficulty.

hMDsmKRO8YI.title: Peaceful by Zylenox & Small (Full Version) | Geometry Dash
hMDsmKRO8YI.description: So Zylenox went ahead and finished this level, so I thought why not upload this version as well since it's really good.

ea8lSlM0-3M.title: "The Dark Lord" 100% (XXL Demon) by Alex112300 [1 Coin]  | Geometry Dash
ea8lSlM0-3M.description:
As some of you know, I got GD moderator! Will do my best to help the community. Thank you for all the support :)
I made a form so you can send me your levels here: https://forms.gle/Su5HHGDNEU6WWG7k9

Probably Alex's best level to date, The Dark Lord is a sequel to his previous level, Demon Lord, being a huge improvement to basically all of the levels that have come before, in terms of design, blocks, backgrounds, effects, colors and art, if I had to nitpick one thing about the decoration are the borders on the ghosts that appear after the drop, looking a bit jagged around the edges, I don't know if this was intentional but it could've looked smoother in my opinion. Another thing are the attacks that the bosses use, they fit the theme perfectly, but the execution could've been better as well. The gameplay is another story, it is quite inconsistent, in terms of difficulty, but it's still enjoyable to play, although it does take a bit of getting used to, especially the coin, which requires a complicated timing to get. Overall a fantastic level that is worth trying out at least.

QpwiNNDZUUA.title: ''Supreme'' 100% (Demon) by CrispyCrepes & EnZore [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
QpwiNNDZUUA.description: Supreme is a level that has incredible effects, and overall design, the level does start off a bit slow and bland, in comparison to what the rest of the level has to offer, that is up until 0:30 when the drop begins, that the level goes from 0 to 100, we hit a dash orb that distorts the entire level, the level practically breaks apart, everything shifting to the side and giving the colors almost a 3d effect. After this, we find ourselves in a ship section, the great part about this is the effect in the background, we see what appears to be a soundwave or equalizer, following the beat of the music with a very smooth animation. The rest of the level features various effects and backgrounds that really make the level stand out, the flashes of light, the sudden change of colors, the different shapes and obstacles that appear in the back with excellent animation and movement, everything comes together very nicely.

d5SobOSIriA.title: ''Dream Travel'' 100% (XXL Demon) by SuprianGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]

iz3igPPwtn4.title: ''Flipside Upwards'' 100% (Demon) by KFAOpitar [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
iz3igPPwtn4.description: KFAOpitar doesn't have a ton of levels under his belt, but the ones he does, are always levels with really interesting colors, decoration, block design and effects, and this time is no different, although having a more modern style than his previous levels, showcasing vibrant colors in the blocks, the effects, and even the backgrounds which bring the whole level together very nicely, almost giving it a psychadelic feel to it. Overall this level is really nice to look at, every bit of decoration has it's place and adds to the next in a different and unique way.

-9XxpD3ZzPA.title: Peaceful by Small | Geometry Dash
-9XxpD3ZzPA.description:
This level was highly requested, vid not intended for children.
Peaceful is a very unique level, something that you would see come out of a creepypasta, the execution is flawless, and the intended effect of the level is done really well. The level starts off with a pretty background with birds flying towards the sun, with clouds in the front, the title showing up shortly after, the animations for this small intro are done really nicely. The actual level begins with you in the same sunny landscape, you are surrounded by what appear to be trees and mountains, with different shapes with cute faces on them, the sun and clouds still in the background, jumping up and down. The only things that change in this first big section, is basically the gameplay mode and the layout of the obstacles and blocks. You keep going for a couple more seconds, the song building up towards something, everything appears to be continuing as it should, but then everything changes, and this is where the real level begins, in my opinion. Everything starts flashing in between red and black, the landscape changes completely, you can't see the sun anymore, you can only see the silhouettes of the "cute" shapes that were keeping you company, but this time, they have dark figures and red eyes. the music is happy again, and the cute figures have returned as well. But this doesn't last for long, as everything goes dark again, you can still see the colors of the shapes, but this time they only have a bunch of black holes on top of them, with some even having full sets of teeth, at the very end of the level, we go back to the "normal" setting, but it's empty, we can only see the blue sky in the back with default blocks and spikes. this recording isnt legit, just to show the level without lag.

0XFOggS5AqU.title: ''Baldis Basics 3D'' by Takayama | Geometry Dash [2.11]
0XFOggS5AqU.description:
Level Name: Baldi Basic 3D
ID: 59397222
Very good game recreation of Baldis Basics, I think it deserves more recognition since not many people have seen it. This level was made on mobile and it's easier if you play it there. Would recommend you all to check this level out!

1V9cLXPavl8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Fingerdash v3'' 100% by Noriega | Geometry Dash [2.11]
1V9cLXPavl8.description: Fingerdash v3 is a remake that took Noriega almost 3 years to finish creating, and I think it was worth it, the decoration, the design and style of the level is really nice, even though some of it is a bit outdated, considering it's been in the works for so long. You can tell straight away that it's a good remake when it keeps the spirit of the original level, while still adding a new twist to it, depending on the creator, giving it a more modern look. In this case, Noriega added a lot of detail to the backgrounds, making the level feel a lot more complete, he updated the block design a bit, giving it a newer look and even added in a bossfight. it fits in with fingerdashes theme in my opinion. The gameplay is extreme demon, it took a while to beat actually, it does take a lot of practice, especially the duals.

XN6him6ViWY.title: ''Less Than Three'' 100% by DanZmeN (1 Coin) | Geometry Dash [2.11]

5_R8jB6ZMcg.title: ''Come Back To Earth'' by Wulzy | Geometry Dash [2.11]
5_R8jB6ZMcg.description: Come back to earth is a level that uses incredible effects, we can see that this level is going to be very stylized, abstract and artistic, the way the colors mesh together, changing around with the movements of the objects that are behind, along with the simplistic block design in the front, I like how it's a bit transparent, so you can still see what's going in the back and the colors of the objects in the back changes when they pass through, as if you were looking through a colored glass. The song that was chosen is a perfect fit in my opinion, it gives a more futuristic feeling to the level. The gameplay is straightforward, changing it's pace along with the song, it's pretty much just a long section, switching between various modes. Overall this is a very enjoyable level, both to play and to watch.

sQfikpT0Bik.title: ''The Legend of Nando'' 100% (Demon) by Im Fernando [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
sQfikpT0Bik.description: A level based on The Legend of Zelda, that features block design that is kind of lacking but I think it fits well to the theme anyway. This level is not as long as you'd think, but it still takes you through a wide variety of spaces, from a valley, to an underground cave and even the sky with the clouds all around you. I really like how there are elements from GD implemented into the level, in this case, being various icons that represent different players, with animations included as well. The art is also top quality, especially the end screen with the forest and the sword in the middle. The gameplay isn't the most complicated in the world although there are some transitions that can feel a bit sudden, apart from that this is an excellent level that was executed very nicely.

rYfqzSuIHuk.title: ''Intermission'' 100% by Knots (2 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rYfqzSuIHuk.description: Intermission is a modernistic level that boasts incredible effects, block design, colors and backgrounds, both in the foreground and background. The level starts you off in what appears to be a living room in the night-time, with the tv on and shelves in the background, this section is rather simple, as it's slow-paced and uses dark colors. The section that comes after is a complete 180, the most colorful part of the level in my opinion, taking place in what appears to be a city park, with pink grass and trees and a bunch of buildings in the back and flashing lights in the front. After this, we have another colorful section, with a pinwheel in the background with a very smooth animation of it spinning around, the block design looks to be of a technological or futuristic style, I feel it doesn't go perfectly with the background, but it's still well made. What comes next is one of my favorite parts, the animation of the piano in the background is amazing, the way it drops down along with the microphone makes this section. This section is a bit longer than the ones that came before, but it doesn't feel like it drags at all. The part soon after feels really nice to play, it's created in a huge space with umbrellas in the background, and you move up and down, and the objects stay in place, giving a feeling that you're actually travelling through. The purple starry night section is what comes next, slowing down the gameplay and the song along with it. The art in the back, the trees, the mountains and the stars look really nice with the purple coloring that was chosen. It seemed only fitting that after this we would go to a space section, with the planet earth in the back floating very smoothly, flashing different colors as if it were a neon light. Before this part ends we have a very brief moment where almost every section that came before flashes for about half a second, in sync with the song, which I thought was a very nice touch. After we hit the second drop, we find ourselves in a yellow landscape, with a giant tree, holding a bird house and a dart board, I like the block design in this part, since it has tiny leaves on the front, which I feel fit perfectly. We then go through a pair of colorful sections, with beach balls and avocados, both of these are very similar, flashing various colors in sync with the song with different shapes floating in the foreground. At the end of the level, we go to another big, open-spaced section, it's night time again and there are trees, stars and mountains in the back, having a more blueish tone to it, keeping the same block design as before, with the leaves, the only thing that changes is the color on the edges, the song builds up, and at the drop we see a bunch of lines, letters and shapes flash in front before the level finally ends.

P5s4IpejVVg.title: ''YouTube'' 100% by PocoPukich | Geometry Dash [2.11]
P5s4IpejVVg.description: This level is a simplified recreation of Youtube, there are sections where it looks as if you were navigating youtube through a browser, showing the video, which is the level that you are playing, which I thought was very unique, the subscribe button and the recommendations on the right side and there are other sections where the video goes "Fullscreen" and you can see the progress bar on the bottom and the title of the video on the top. The design and idea for this level is very creative, and nothing like we usually see, the gameplay is easy but it has it's place, especially the "2.2" section in the middle.

ntDR6CPu1mg.title: ''Garden'' 100% by Bananabomber (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ntDR6CPu1mg.description: Garden is a level that has it's theme, gameplay and design executed really well, by Bananabomber, a relatively new creator, that to this day, still has 0 creator points, which is incredible to me. The effects, the block design, the backgrounds, the art, the colors, the bossfight that appears from 1:09 to 1:35, everything fits the garden theme perfectly. The bossfight has a nice variation of attacks and I really liked the way it looks, it fits nicely with the rest of the level, the attacks and patterns do take a bit of practice though. Overall this level is very enjoyable, in all aspects and I'm excited to see what Bananabomber releases in the future.

r1I6cEwi4Us.title: ''Future Funk II'' 100% (Demon) by JonathanGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
r1I6cEwi4Us.description:
That was harder than I expected, no fails at 99%, GG :)
We reached 400k subscribers! Thank you everyone, let's aim for 450k for this year.

S_fa687gOzs.title: ''Puma Dash'' by Izhar (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
S_fa687gOzs.description: Puma Dash is a relatively simple level, both in terms of decoration, design and gameplay, but what makes this level stand out amongst the rest, is the custom gamemode that Izhar created that pops up at 0:13 and stays until the end of the level pretty much. In terms of gameplay, this new mode is pretty much a combination between the cube and the robot, because of how it feels when it jumps and how high it can go. The design of the puma is what makes it feel unique, and I think it came out looking great, definetely something that RobTop would consider making.

-NjCNDnDsgI.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Elliptic Curve'' 100% by Mulpan & KireiMirai | Geometry Dash
-NjCNDnDsgI.description: It's been a while since I've beaten an Extreme Demon. The beginning is definitely easier than the the rest of the level, It mostly had fun gameplay but some of the transition were pretty difficult to adjust to. Mulpan's design looks great and the effects fit well with the song, In my opinion this is a low-end extreme demon and I think it's level worth checking out.

i4Uiso9MLaY.title: ''Arcus'' 100% by Ilrell & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
i4Uiso9MLaY.description: Arcus is a simplistic level with simple block design, backgrounds, and effects. What really shines in this level though, is it's color scheme, color usage, and color combinations, making it feel like you're travelling inside a prism, looking at every single color of the rainbow with different shapes, patterns and shades. The level starts off relatively simple, with a ship section that has you go through really easy obstacles and as the level progresses, it goes faster and faster, making it more difficult, and the colors start to shift and switch at a faster pace, adding unique backgrounds to the mix, and at the very end everything becomes very saturated and the song is at it's peak, sounding distorted almost. Overall this level is really nice to look at.

r025bj54oJs.title: ''Judgement'' 100% (Demon) by Subwoofer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
r025bj54oJs.description: Judgement is a level that executed it's theme perfectly, being very reminiscent of Wings of Angel, beacuse of the fact that you go between heaven and hell a bunch of times, changing the design completely, the block design, the colors, the effects, the art and the backgrounds are exact opposites between these two settings and both look really great. Heaven has these green and blue tones that make it feel like you are up above the clouds, and Hell has purple and red tones, which do make you feel like you just went falling all the way there. The gameplay does take a bit of practice, being so fast-paced, so I'd rate it at about Easy or Medium Demon, and it definetely deserves an Epic Rating.

MUidyhvnLWY.title: "A Town Called Home" by Artherr & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
MUidyhvnLWY.description:
A very unknown level that was released a month ago and it still hasn't been rated yet, hopefully it can gain more traction now :)

UpYUVYhQ5LQ.title: ''Cydonia'' 100% (XL Demon) by JacobROso | Geometry Dash [2.11]
UpYUVYhQ5LQ.description: It's been a while since JacobROso's last level, I'm glad to see him back and creating again, and this time we have an XL Demon, with really great effects, and especially a boss fight that's unlike anything he's done before, the design of the boss is super cool in my opinion, the art is great, and the attacks are nice to look at, the only thing I'd improve on this is to add a bit more movement to the boss itself, since it seems like it's just floating forward without much, but apart from that, this is a great level.

qe5vyh4TTws.title: ''Skilled Jumper'' 100% by Alfred PKNess [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
qe5vyh4TTws.description:
Skilled Jumper is a level that is inspired on Jumper, a very colorful level, that uses every bit to it's fullest potential, it makes the level look much more alive with the use of glow and the effects; the flashes of light, the beams of color moving around in various sections, every bit of decoration and style poured into this level ties it together really nicely in my opinion. The block designs was also inspired by the ones RobTop uses and it turned looking pretty good too. 
The coins are pretty weird so I'm going to explain how to get them.
The first one is fairly simple, it's located at 0:31, it can be tricky to grab it since it's a tight space. To get the second coin you need straight fly correctly through the arrows at 0:50, then the coin will appear later on in the spider section at 1:00. The third coin is right after, as the robot you need hold the button before hitting the jump pad to fly on the top of the obstacle where the coin is. You don't need to hold too much for it to work.

5O7Sk8mlGog.title: "Amethyst Valley" 100% (Demon) by Fufafac | Geometry Dash [2.11]
5O7Sk8mlGog.description:
Incredible design level by Fufafac, as you can see I dropped some frames there, since the level has 336k objects.
ID: 59139787

Uw_SXtEA7uU.title: The Entire History of Geometry Dash
Uw_SXtEA7uU.description:
The level is called The Eras of GD and was made by TomekD. It took him 6 months to make this and the details and animation are incredible, definitely a level worth checking out. And I hope too see more from this creator in the future, thanks for watching :)
ID: 59311939

aNDu2wOLvs8.title: ''DaShy'' 100% by BitZel [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
aNDu2wOLvs8.description: DaShy is a really unique level simply because of it's gameplay concept. You start out the level as you would with any other, going through each obstacle, switching modes, then, at 0:30, you enter "RubRub Mode" where you basically become invincible, you can keep dying but the level doesn't stop, which is what I think it would look like if GD had a "God Mode". It also shows various elements of levels as part of the decoration, showing stars, orbs and coins, it even has a fake victory screen, which is just a clever transition to the final part of the level. The effects, the colors and the backgrounds are all well done, apart from the gameplay elements I just mentioned, so I highly recommend you try this level out.

j-PX9htXV8o.title: ''HASH'' 100% (Demon) by Flashmick72 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
j-PX9htXV8o.description: HASH is a fast paced level that boasts a really consistent design and level of quality, just about every section in this level has something different and unique about it, whether it's the colors, the effects, the block design, or subtle changes to the backgrounds. The gameplay is about Hard-Demon difficulty, it's a bit longer than most levels nowadays, there are some sections that do require you practice them many times in order to get the hang of them, especially the parts that are at 4x speed. That being said the difficulty does stay consistent the whole way through, I recommend you give this level a shot if you want a challenge.

mV010xitkiY.title: ''Meow'' 100% (Demon) by BlowMyPooh [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
mV010xitkiY.description: Meow is a level that is very reminiscent of B having the same cartoony style with the backgrounds and art. What I like a lot about this level, is that it doesn't just focus on the art, design, backgrounds and block design, it also pays a lot of attention to it's gameplay, being really fun to play, but at the same time staying simple, balanced and without any bugs. My favorite part of the level is probably at 0:35, the background looks really nice, the animations came out looking very smooth, and overall it's makes the level more enjoyable overall.

_B5DYtVOHHw.title: 99% | ''Double Dash'' (Demon) by Zoroa GD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
_B5DYtVOHHw.description: Another 99% fail, this is definitely my favorite level from Zoroa, always nice to play some very unique levels like this one.

BPJH6_lwDgg.title: 2.2 Level in 2.1 | Geometry Dash
BPJH6_lwDgg.description: Jamon the Boss is a 2.2 level that was created by Izhar, a platformer where you click the right side of the screen to move, changing direction each time you click, and press space on the left side of the screen to jump while standing still or while you're moving. You start out coming out of a green tube from Super Mario, you jump over some obstacles, and you arrive at the boss, a green turtle creature with giant legs and feet. This bossfight is in a closed space, so you can only move around in this small area, but the controls are well made so it isn't much of a problem, the only thing that took getting used to is the fact that each time you move, the direction switches, but by the time I beat it, it was really easy. The boss is in the center of the room, jumping up and down after a certain time, there are platforms and orbs that you can use to go upwards towards the top of the level, where there are two triggers, one on each side, that activate green triggers that deal damage to the boss when you touch them, the problem is, they appear right on top of the boss, so you have to wait for him to move so you can touch them. You have to attack the boss 5 times until he dies. The 3 coins are obtained depending on how long it took you to kill Jamon, you get one for finishing with more than 30 seconds, another with 60 and the last one at more than 90. I think this level is very unique, it's always nice to see levels like these be released even before 2.2 comes out.

2za10epdj7c.title: ''Google Inc'' 100% by Arkonite (1 Coin) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
2za10epdj7c.description: This is a really good themed level, there's a lot of creativity behind it and it's rare to see that in levels these days. There isn't many objects but it still manages to look good, the block designs are very clean and there is a lot of movement going on in the background and foreground that makes this level feel more alive. The colors are also very well executed and adds so much to the theme. And the logos are definitely my favorite part of this level, they look exactly like the original ones. Great level overall, sad too see that arkonite quit creating after releasing this.

rO171tkjQL0.title: (Insane Demon) "Segmentation Fault" 100% by Sminx | Geometry Dash
rO171tkjQL0.description: RobTop needs to rate more levels as unique as this one.

zE405RuqdUM.title: ''nyoom'' 100% (Demon) by Ceruglyphy [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
zE405RuqdUM.description: nyoom is a bit of a weird level, it uses knots style but they should've added their own aspects to it, the design looks a lot like Rush Hour, the only aspects that really change are the colors that are prominent and the intensity of the colors and glitch effects, makes it seem a bit uninspired but it still looks really good. In the sense that it's basically just one long section, there aren't any huge transitions or changes in the block design or backgrounds, and the music doesn't have any pauses either. The level starts off throwing you straight into the action, with a blue and pink color theme, a futuristic yet simplistic block design, and a really satisfying background, featuring a bunch of different shapes, lines and other small details that make everything feel very complete. We start in a UFO section right off the bat, switching to a short wave, you have to avoid the red triggers which can be tricky, then to a cube, showing the title of the level with text that looked really well animated, which is something I always appreciate. After a couple of seconds of this, we touch a dash orb that glitches the level out for a second or two, turning everything pink, even the music changes in this mini section. We keep switching between modes after this, it has very fast paced gameplay while the backgrounds move along with you, at the ending we enter a dual ball section, but as we change, the level turns completely black, with only two white bars filling the screen, being the platforms, closing more and more before the level ends. This is definitely easier if you play it with LDM, since most of the glow covers the level.

36b0q2bOvKM.title: ''Kanna'' 100% (Demon) by oc3andark [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
36b0q2bOvKM.description: Kanna is a level with Xender Game's style, I always enjoy levels with this sort of futuristic theme, even though most of the time the most prominent color in the level is gray, the effects, the backgrounds and the block design always make up for the lack of color. The amount of attention to detail that goes into levels like this so everything looks and combines together perfectly is something I appreciate, well this level is no different. The RobTop icon at the end is pretty random but unique at the same time. The gameplay is solid in my opinion, I'd give this level an Easy or Medium rating, if it was up to me. The difficulty stays consistent through the whole thing and is fun to play.

nCuXVVKHCSY.title: "Artistic Illusion" 100% (Demon) by Team Artistic | Geometry Dash
nCuXVVKHCSY.description: Artistic Illusion, by TeamArtistic, is an art level that to my surprise, and probably to many others, has not recieved a rating in over 10 months, which just boggles my mind, considering the level of detail and quality that this level has. We start off in a warm enviroment, with grass, water, and the sun shining down on everything, the colors fit this section perfectly and is a great start to everything in my opinion, just a really cozy vibe. After this, we jump straight into a space section, with a more futuristic style to the block design, having neon borders and bright colors, with stars and planets moving in the background as you progress through this part. I always enjoy stuff like this because it always turns out looking great, especially when it looks realistic. We then find ourselves in a mountain landscape, with what appears to be a hermit or a monk, standing atop, looking at the horizon. The fact that every obstacle and block is transparent, to showcase the background was a nice touch, without losing focus on the gameplay. A couple of seconds pass, and we arrive into a snowy mountain section, the thing that I like the most about this, apart from the excellent art in the background, the trees and the mountains, is how the block design stays consistent and in direct relation to what's going on in the back. In this case, the blocks are blue and almost transparent, as if they were blocks of ice. We pass that section and go to the next, a darker setting, where we can see the night sky, full of stars and a beautiful mountain, that makes everything else stand out, along with street lights to illuminate and give a sense of depth. I enjoyed the more abstract block design in this part, having a sort of robotic or alien feel to it. Soon after, we are in a huge metropolis, with the sun in the background, giving everything an orange shade, making the buildings that make up the city look alive. The block design is a bit simpler in this section, but the art that makes up the back makes up for it in my opinion. The final part of the level is most definitely my favorite, a hellscape, full of dark mountains and rivers of lava, with a purple and gray sky that makes it look as if there were volcanoes erupting everywhere. The block design fits this part well, making you feel like you're inside one of them. The very end of this level, is an end card with the names of the creators that took part in making this amazing level, with a really nice background to top it all off. The gameplay is about Easy Demon difficulty, there are a lot of game mode switches throughout the level, which I think keeps things new, so you don't get bored midway through. Most of the level is at about 2 or 3x speed, so it shouldn't be a problem for most players, something I always appreciate in a level is when the difficulty stays consistent throughout, it makes it easier to practice and get used to. I highly recommend this level to everyone, just so you can see every detail up close.

TgGsXtcGGSU.title: ''Incursion'' 100% by Waffl3X | Geometry Dash [2.11]
TgGsXtcGGSU.description: Incursion is a level with amazing effects, colors, backgrounds and just about everything else you could imagine. There is a lot of attention to detail, the way the colors mix together, the movement of the objects that are found in the foreground and the backgrounds, the gameplay also goes together really well with the design of the level, having build up that goes along with the music that was a nice choice in my opinion. The gameplay is about Insane or Easy Demon, there aren't any bugs and it's fun to play because of the excellent design that Waffl3x implemented.

5uCBeGfdRVM.title: ''Necromantia'' 100% (Demon) by RadiationV2 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
5uCBeGfdRVM.description: Necromantia is a really nice design level, starting off relatively slow, and building up as the level moves forward, in terms of the gameplay, decoration and song, which is a cover of Megalovania, from Undertale. The beginning of the level starts off with not much color, movement or much else design-wise, you could even call it a bit boring. But after a bit of build up, exactly at 0:42 is when everything, even the music, really picks up and in my opinion, the level really starts. The gameplay is faster, there are more flashes, more color changes and especially towards the end of the level is when it looks very complete. The difficulty for Necromantia is about Medium Demon level I'd say. Overall this is a really nice level and I think you should give it a shot.

SvufZTBgpt8.title: ''Lovecraft'' 100% (Demon) by kDarko | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SvufZTBgpt8.description: Lovecraft is a level that is based around a monster from H.P Lovecraft's series of novels and books. We don't see horror themed levels that often anymore, but when one is released, it always turns out looking great. From the block design, to the backgrounds, to the color choice, to the boss fight itself, are all top quality, the animations and art for the monster that's in the background look amazing, they're very fluid and complement the look of it very nicely. The flashes, the sudden changes of color and the tentacles that come out to grab you every so often really make everything stand out. The gameplay is about Medium Demon level, very consistent and no bugs that I encountered.

xI_3yFwhILE.title: ''Retro Funk'' 100% (Demon) by N3moProd | Geometry Dash [2.11]
xI_3yFwhILE.description:
Retro Funk is another unknown level that only has 200 likes, which is incredible to me since this has excellent colors and backgrounds which I think was marshmello in there, it makes everything blend together very nicely, although some of the block designs feel out of place. The future funk theme has been growing recently and I've always enjoyed the songs and levels that come with them, they are super enjoyable, levels that make you want to play them over and over again, and this is one of them. The gameplay is about Easy or Medium demon level. I recommend you try this level out as soon as possible.
ID: 54763009

a-8R49uqiY0.title: "DeathStep II" 100% (Demon) by RehanZ [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
a-8R49uqiY0.description:
DeathStep II made by RehanZ and verified and elze, I was very surprised when I saw that nobody had uploaded this level yet. This is a really good modernistic level in my opinion, my favorite aspect of this level is how each and every section is different yet unique in it's own way. The level begins with you in a grim setting, in what appears to be a castle at nighttime with the moon and stars just outside the window and although it's only about 10 seconds long, it's one of the best looking parts of the whole thing in my opinion. After a transition showing the title of the level, we come to a slow spider section with a very nice looking background, the block design is pretty simple and I would've preferred that the background had more movements, same goes for several other backgrounds in this. What comes next is a fast paced wave section, that changes between a couple of other modes, being spider and a very short dual, that features a cityscape background that looks really nice, especially the movement, making you feel like you're traveling through the city. The block design is just semitransparent but I think it blends well. The part that comes later is my probably my favorite in terms of design and mechanics, there is a bar at the top of the screen that shows toxicity and it fills up as you touch the smoke, also the Pokemon, Koffing, shown in the background came out looking very cool. We then encounter a swingcopter section, with a sort of desert background, gameplay is straightforward and the decoration looks nice. As we keep progressing through the level, we find another Pokemon, this time a Chandelure, I really liked the color combination that this part has to offer, the red and blue makes the minimalistic style stand out. The final section has you flying very slowly through obstacles, while there is a sort of recap of every part in the background, I think this whole section is very unique, but once again, the block design is a bit too simple for what's being shown. But overall this level is phenomenal and I hope we see more from this creator soon.
RehanZ' channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCt5SWgVlxgFLbqtSErIDeOg
ID:56369889

dnCDna1EiRk.title: ''NormDanchik In JSB'' 100% (Demon) by DeniPol [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
dnCDna1EiRk.description: NormDanchik In JSB is a level that has it's theme and design based fully on the PC game Just Shapes and Beats, and in my opinion, DeniPol nailed it. The colors, the effects, and especially the bosses are spot on even though the gameplay is a bit inconsistent and can be a bit frustrating at times, I feel that the decoration makes up for it. The song also syncs really nicely with the effects and gameplay, with the transitions, the flashes and the attacks that the boss fires at you. Overall, I'd recommend you play this, based on the design alone.

EbH7kfUyGaQ.title: ''Rebirth'' 100% (Demon) by Genericqueso | Geometry Dash [2.11]
EbH7kfUyGaQ.description: Rebirth is a level that uses great effects and colors, the glow works really well in every part of the level, and the way the colors switch around in such a smooth way is very nice to look at. It also offers a nice design overall, everything has it's place and blends together very nicely, along with the excellent sync it has. The gameplay is about hard demon difficulty, and is very consistent overall.

4htb7ouCNEU.title: ''Ji Ral'' 100% by Booglee [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
4htb7ouCNEU.description: A level that came out 5 months but I think it deserves a spot on the channel. This has a very distinct theme and style, having cybernetic and futuristic decoration, whether it's the block design, the colors or the effects. The level as a whole feels like you're floating through cyberspace, along with the song that fits perfectly in my opinion. The skull animation is really good and I love the way the effects flow with the music. The Gameplay is simple and straightforward, so I'd rate it Harder difficulty.

ziqGlsCDO7Y.title: ''Speedballing'' 100% by Jayuff | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ziqGlsCDO7Y.description: Speedballing is a level that looks fairly simple, having no backgrounds and limited block design, but what makes this level really stand out, are it's colors and flashes that bring this level to life, making it feel like your on some sort of trip. The gameplay isn't difficult but it is unique, most of it being orbs and switching between different modes rapidly. It's a level that screams Jayuff, and his levels are always different, which is something I've always liked.

2orzqqWyC58.title: ''FZz'' 100% by SpooFy [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
2orzqqWyC58.description:
FZz is a level that uses every single color to it's fullest potential. The backgrounds may be empty for the most part, but the way that SpoofY implemented them in a way that syncs perfectly with the song and makes every section stand out, made this level really unique in my opinion. Apart from that, the animations came out looking very smooth, which is always something nice to see. I also appreciate the flashes of light that emphasize certain parts, such as the dash orbs, with a little bit of shake on top of it.
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/739005

IlJA59DzJ4M.title: ''Spherio'' 100% (Demon) by VictorinoxX & Marwec | Geometry Dash [2.11]
IlJA59DzJ4M.description:
A really cool design level by Victorino and Marwec, the thing that stands out the most to me about it are the effects and the backgrounds, blending in perfectly with every bit of decoration this level has to offer. It's one of those levels that's very satisfying to play and to look at, there are some tricky parts towards the end that do take some practice. The gameplay is well made, consistent and not buggy at all, I would rate it at from Easy to Medium demon difficulty.

Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pXbs9YfNjP0

YUbO2hTpBOw.title: ''The Demon Lord'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Alex112300 [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
YUbO2hTpBOw.description: The Demon Lord is probably Alex' best level so far, I like the art and effects. The block design is good but it can get a bit repetitive. The level is about 3 minutes long, the level stays consistent in it's quality all throughout, The theme is very colorful with every section, and the music having really good sync. This is a medium demon in my opinion, only because of how long it is, but there aren't any bugs or inconsistencies that I found.

N5ZInhVe7x8.title: ''Les Go 2'' 100% by Unzor [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
N5ZInhVe7x8.description: Last upload of 2019, happy new year 2020 everyone! :)

iQO7LcYfB7w.title: ''Memories'' 100% (Demon) by Xender Game & DspectrumNGK [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
iQO7LcYfB7w.description: A level that diverts from Xender Games' typical style, being more of a design level. But even though it's different from what we usually get from him, it still has really nice effects, colors and a unique theme.

XpWPO9VfcLw.title: ''UNRENDERED'' by Flashmick72 [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
XpWPO9VfcLw.description: A conceptual level, that simulates the preview mode from the editor. It uses the same color combination as it, but still manages to work with the rest of the decoration. And it's really cool how Flashmick made all the triggers visible, it adds so much to the theme. There are also some nice animations and movements found in various parts. The logo at 0:19 is also nicely done, the glitch effect blends in with the transition and with the song.

3zQg49_mEP8.title: ''Labyrinth Zone HD'' by S0nic X [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
3zQg49_mEP8.description: Labyrinth Zone HD is a remake of a level of the same name that came out almost 3 years ago created by AbstractDark. Improving upon a lot of things, both in terms of gameplay and design, this level is much more refined when it comes to the decoration and overall atmosphere of the level. Having a bunch more detail in various places and sections, switching up the gameplay as well, I'd say this is a remake that surpasses the original.

ZbQAkHFcguE.title: ''Sans Arcade'' by TheOnyxGuy | Geometry Dash [2.1]
ZbQAkHFcguE.description: Sans Arcade is a level that is actually quite old, and went mostly unnoticed when it was released. A recreation of Sans' bossfight from Undertale, featuring unique gameplay and really nice art to go along with it. Some of the gameplay does get buggy sometimes, especially the swingcopter, but other than that, taking into account how old the level is, the rest of the gameplay is consistent at least.

K9uMcYY2wTE.title: ''Winter Memory'' 100% (Demon) by Saabs [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
K9uMcYY2wTE.description: A level that a year ago wasn't rated, Winter Memory has a really nice atmosphere, being christmas themed. The block design, the snow falling throughout the level, the pixel art that makes up the christmas lights, the presents in the background, and my favorite pieces of decoration, the dancing Santa and the Grinch that comes after. I also think this level needed more air decoration. The song also fits this level very well in my opinion, especially when the drop hits and Santa comes out. This level is Easy Demon level for me, there aren't any parts that are challenging, but it still takes practice to get everything down.

SM4T3JtiVzg.title: (Insane Demon) ''Leikhpaz'' 100% by TheHuevon & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SM4T3JtiVzg.description:
That was fun and annoying at the same time. 
Merry Christmas people :)

BOWhL1Xc7Jo.title: ''NVIDIA'' 100% (Demon) by 70UNIKITTY | Geometry Dash [2.11]
BOWhL1Xc7Jo.description: nvidia is a level that's very unique in it's design, with the green and grey color scheme, the industrial block design and the several bossfights that can be found throughout the level. The art for the bosses is really well done, along with their effects and the  backgrounds, tie the level together nicely. This level is about Easy Demon difficulty, though the gameplay could've been better executed.

gNdGMjLq9jU.title: Layout by Alkali | Geometry Dash
gNdGMjLq9jU.description: Awesome layout by Alkali, the gameplay is really fun and it has very good sync, but I'm not sure about it being featured.

-wsk28wImF8.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Volume'' 100% by Metalface221 & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-wsk28wImF8.description:
Fun level except for the wave section in the middle of the level, which is where most of my fails were. I only got past it twice, the second time I fluked it to the end, got really lucky there. More extreme demons soon.
Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OK3cx6aGPT0

_tqeY5TX7ow.title: ''Breaking Point'' 100% (Demon) by HelpegasuS & More | Geometry Dash
_tqeY5TX7ow.description: Breaking Point is a collab between Helpegasus, GMDParallax and Creeper4, this has a colorful design and style, paired along with amazing effects and backgrounds. Every part transitions really nicely to the next, both in terms of decoration and gameplay. My favorite section definetely has to be the second half, the art for the background looks very nice, along with the decoration and block design in the front. The gameplay is about Medium-Demon difficulty, it's fast paced and fun.

yBpvgZ-4NAg.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Aftermath'' 100% by Exenity & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
yBpvgZ-4NAg.description: Trilogy complete, I honestly expected to take more time to beat this but it took me only 3 hours, found this level pretty fun actually. Thanks for watching, hope you enjoyed my clicks :P

nwsbMtRJuBo.title: ''Mechanical Area'' 100% (Demon) by MakFeed & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
nwsbMtRJuBo.description: Mechanical Area is a level that executes it's theme perfectly, from the block design, all the way to the boss and effects, that come together really nicely with the background and art. The color pallette that was used also fits very well with the mechanical style of this level. The gameplay is about Easy-Medium Demon level, there were no inconsistencies or major bugs that I encountered and combined with the visuals, it was really fun to play.

XXqLNO645SQ.title: ''On My Own'' 100% (Demon) by TeamUprising | Geometry Dash [2.11]
XXqLNO645SQ.description: Fantastic design level by Team Uprising, I love the colors and all the parts that ended up fitting very well together. They worked over 8 months on this and I think all of their effort really shows. The gameplay is about Medium-Demon level, although it does take a bit a of practice, the difficulty stays consistent all throughout, which is always nice to see.

I1C8qNIjx-g.title: Swing Copter Challenges | Geometry Dash
I1C8qNIjx-g.description:
The swingcopter works similar to the ball, but it's floating instead, inverting it's own gravity with each click. It has 3 jets, the middle on is always on and is the one that moves you forward. The one on top turns on when you want to go down, with the one on the bottom switching off, and vice-versa when you want to go up. It's nothing like the ship, you can't leave your click held down. Thanks for watching! :)

Got this version from SMJS: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCwEsWDs9kGN2vvoiNTJKdaQ

YzGCtA2TdNk.title: Some Swing Copter Gameplay | Geometry Dash

cT-w5H6FFfg.title: ''Two The Top'' 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax | Geometry Dash [2.11]
cT-w5H6FFfg.description: A new solo XL Demon by Cirtrax, one of his most unique levels to date, very different from all of his other creations, but personally, I think it's one of his best. The theme of the level is executed really well, the song may be a bit strange and could seem out of place for some, but in my opinion, along with the sync, the effects, especially the parts that glitch and slow down along with the song, come together perfectly. The gameplay is fun, there is a jump in difficulty in the second part of the level, but nothing too inconsistent.

qOgExNJYbSw.title: ''Dedication'' 100% (Demon) by Scrumpy, Hollow & Koolboom | Geometry Dash
qOgExNJYbSw.description: A collab between Scrumpy, Hollow and Koolboom, Dedication is a level that boasts an incredible design and really fun, satisfying gameplay to go along with it. In my opinion, what makes this level stand out among the rest is the rainbow color effect that can be seen in the background and especially inside the objects, blocks and obstacles. The colors, along with the movements, also synchronize perfectly with the song that was chosen, which is something that I always appreciate. The gameplay is incredibly fun, it isn't complicated, it doesn't have any annoying parts, only a small section that can be a bit tricky and need some practice, the section that comes at 0:40, since it transitions from one mode to another relatively fast. But overall this level looks very lively and colorful, and has good gameplay to back it up as well.

9OiQQgK2BuA.title: ''Peer Pressure'' 100% (Demon) by Nico99 & Geom3zon [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
9OiQQgK2BuA.description: Peer Pressure is a collab between Nico99 and Geom3zon, featuring an amazing design consisting of really great effects, colors, animations, gameplay and sync. The level starts out with a ship section, which is pretty simple when it comes to gameplay, but what really makes this part stand out is the effect that was used, there's a camera overlay and every couple of seconds the level turns gray and time stops for about a second, which is something that is very unique imo. This part is followed by a short ball section which is also simple gameplay-wise, but I liked the spikes movements that turned out very smooth. For the drop, we go into a mini-section where everything turns black and white and there's only a handful of obstacles, you jump onto the platform and you stop mid-air, then for about a second we see the no-signal color bars that were on old TV's, after that, we return to the same style and colors that were at the beginning of the level. I think this transition ended up looking nice and doesn't feel abrupt in terms of gameplay. What stands out to me in the following part is the yellow and black bars that come up from the top and bottom of the screen, I feel like the movements make the level look more lively and add a lot of detail. After that, we have a short spider section with the similar colors and effects that were found in the ball section that was came earlier in the level, nothing much to say about this, but the quality stays consistent throughout the whole thing. This part leads us into another drop, where the gameplay, along with the effects, colors and movements gain a faster pace, almost every obstacle and object are moving faster, there are flashing lights and colors and there are rapid changes in gameplay mode, from UFO to ship, to cube and vice-versa. There's a transition that caught my eye especially, that comes at 0:34, where the background turns completely black, the platforms and obstacles become really simple, with just a white or red outline, along with your cube. Apart from this, it has really nice sync with the song, which I think was the intention of this transition. This transition then leads us to a dual section that's fast-paced with gameplay that complements the design. After this, I believe we have Geom3zon's part, which right off the bat, we can see that it has a much, much darker tone when it comes to colors and lighting, keeping a fast pace to go along with the music. There are a lot of effects, movements and small details that may go unnoticed since it's moving so fast, but everything has it's place and ties the section together up nicely. At 0:56, the level slows down, objects are moving at a much lower pace, there aren't as many flashing lights or shifts in color and the level ends just when the next buildup to the song begins.

VrzsAMusoh8.title: (Insane Demon) ''Blast Insanity'' 100% by TheDevon | Geometry Dash [2.11]
VrzsAMusoh8.description: Blast Insanity is a remake of Blast Processing and according to TheDevon, his last level he will ever create, this level fixes and improves a lot of aspects of the original, adding a bunch of new details as well. The gameplay is really fun, yet creative, it does take a lot of memorization, in almost every section, but once you get the hang of it, it's really satisfying to play.

IjTaX9_OkVU.title: (Insane Demon) ''Deadlocked v2'' 100% by Small | Geometry Dash [2.11]
IjTaX9_OkVU.description: Deadlocked v2 is a remake thate came out almost exactly 4 years ago of the original Deadlocked that was created by Robtop, I really like the improvements that were made to the design, it stayed really similar to the original, staying true to the theme and style, only adding small details that make it look a bit more polished. The gameplay is very inconsistent in my opinion, some parts are a lot more annoying than others, and some are harder than others.

9OcVCVickjY.title: ''RUSH HOUR'' 100% (Demon) by Knots [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
9OcVCVickjY.description: If I recall correctly this is my first time uploading a level created by Knots, an already established creator with a lot of levels and a ton of creator points under his belt. Rush hour is an exceptional level, with it's bright theme, with white and pink colors, unique effects, it's modernistic style and fun gameplay. It's fast paced which is something I've always liked in levels, the coins are really satisfying to find and get and the sync is also consistent. I never really payed much attention to modern-style levels, but a lot have been released recently and they've all been high-quality.

liXw_ImwO00.title: ''Calibre'' 100% (Demon) by Carlosart16 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
liXw_ImwO00.description: Carlos really outdid himself with this, the colors are visually stunning and I like how he kept changing styles throughout the level so it doesn't entirely look the same, it's really nice too see and I think there should be more levels that do this. The sync is also on point and I found the gameplay really fun and satisfying to play which in my opinion is crucial when making a level. Something very original that I noticed is the end part how the tiles were being colored as you passed through and it syncs with song as well. Awesome level overall.

N1KTg2mFs7c.title: K U R O S H I by WhiterBlack | Geometry Dash
N1KTg2mFs7c.description:
K U R O S H I is another 1.0 themed level, created by WhiterBlack, a creator that already has 4 rated levels under his belt. Mainly focusing on decoration, I really like when creators use blocks, spikes and objects to make unique looking obstacles. The song is one of the best parts of this level, but I feel like it could've had better sync.
ID: 58383262
Music: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/883736

Nao8ncRyfMQ.title: ''Upbeat Dimensions'' 100% (Demon) by OptaWolfGD & More | Geometry Dash
Nao8ncRyfMQ.description: Upbeat Dimensions is a modernistic megacollab that has great and original design which is hard to find in a modern level, and all the parts fit well together in my opinion. I also really dig the colors since they blend really well, and the movements flow nicely. It is impressive to see a level this consistent in quality. A thing they could've handled better is some of the transitions but the gameplay was definitely better than the first one. Overall great level, I really liked Upbeat Illusions and this is definitely an improvement from it.

Db2gF-hnaMg.title: [2.2] ''Escape The Skull'' by Izhar [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
Db2gF-hnaMg.description: A really cool mini-game level by Izhar, featuring the skull monster that was found in Press Start from Geometry Dash Sub-Zero. The gameplay is kind of confusing when you jump into it, since you have to click the right side to move, changing direction each time you click, and the left side to jump. But once you get the hang of it all you have to worry about are the obstacles. Not much to say about the decoration, the block design is simple, the backgrounds as well, the skull has good animations and fits in with the rest of the level, but the main focus is the gameplay and the fact that it's basically a platformer.

_cb-x_X0R-U.title: ''Lumina'' by Reunomi | Geometry Dash
_cb-x_X0R-U.description:
Don't usually upload auto levels but this is an exception since this is absolutely incredible, arguably the best art level in the game.
Happy Thanksgiving people 8)

Reunomi's channel: 
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCeDZ0Of7W1wdoooxX9L0OUQ

ID: 58246921
Music: Lumina by XomuEDM
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/887400

LhWPa7qgn2U.title: ''Simplist Disco'' 100% (XXL Insane) by JamAttack [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
LhWPa7qgn2U.description:
Simplist Disco is a level that's just about 5 minutes long, with a lot of different styles, blocks, and backgrounds. But what makes this level stand out to me above other XL levels is how simple everything is while still maintaining a nice level of detail into every aspect of the decoration, every section in this level has a very defined theme and style, with simple effects, colors and blocks. JamAttack used a lot of movement, both in the objects in the foreground and in the background, which I think was a good idea since it emphasizes all the small details that were added. The thing that surprises me the most about this level is the fact that all of it was done in under 30,000 objects, which is quite impressive taking into account the length of the level and all the thought and detail that can be seen in every section. Very original.
And thank you JamAttack for dedicating :)

t2GcCPj1xSE.title: (Insane Demon) ''Cosmic Festival'' 100% by Mazl & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
t2GcCPj1xSE.description: Cosmic festival is a really good level all-around, there are some things that I would change though. The level is kind of inconsistent, both in design and gameplay. In terms of design, some parts look really detailed and different, and others look very simple, in terms of gameplay, some sections are very hard and others are really easy and require little practice. Despite all of that, Cosmic Festival turned out to be a very nice megacollab.

NvPIHoD3xqU.title: ''Fracture Breaker'' 100% (2 Player Demon) by TroxxP1 | Geometry Dash
NvPIHoD3xqU.description:
Fantastic art level, the art and block design match very well which is hard to pull off. The variation in backgrounds is also really impressive, with almost all of them having movement which looks very smooth. I'm very surprised this didn't get an epic rating. Other levels with a high object count have gotten it too.
Music: Hypocrisy by Derpcat https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/852510

EAiG8WvT3vs.title: ''Destroy Me'' 100% (Demon) by MaxyLAND | Geometry Dash [2.11]
EAiG8WvT3vs.description: Destroy me is a level that is based and inspired on Terraria, with a DanZmeN style at the beginning, it's rather short so you only get to see the Moon Lord and the Eye of Cthulu. But the art for the Moon Lord is some of the best I've seen in any level in a long time, the detail that was put into it, and the smooth movements to go along with it are really nice to look at. One thing that I felt could've been different are the attacks, I think the lasers should be coming from his head, not from the hands but I'm not sure though. And the eye doesn't fire lasers at all, there also could've been more variety with the attacks. Another thing that I found to be unique is the outro, it looks like there was a lot of effort put into it and it shows. So overall, I really liked this level despite of it's flaws.

h0-SheEE8c4.title: All Toxin Lab Levels: by Xaro | Geometry Dash
h0-SheEE8c4.description:
The complete saga of Toxin Lab Levels that Xaro created, all in one video, in order.

Toxin Lab I came out in 1.9, so it makes sense that it's the least detailed out of all 4. But even though it was released so long ago, it was still a great level at it's time and still holds up nicely to this day in my opinion.

ID: 6531884
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/593661

Toxin Lab II was released 3 months later, adding a ton of improvements from the previous installment, having more effects, better design and an overall better atmosphere and vibe to go along with the theme of Toxin Lab.

ID: 8469744

Toxin Lab III was the point when Xaro really shined for me, being my favorite level out of all 4 Toxin Labs, even though it's the most difficult, it's the one I enjoy to play the most. It may look really hard at first glance with all the decoration it has, but with practice,the gameplay starts making more sense.

ID: 13965242
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/590533

Toxin Lab IV is the latest installment in the series as of today, it definitely is the best in terms of design, decoration and overall style. It's my second favorite after III, having a very unique and original design and the best sync out of all 4 levels.

ID: 29917082
Song: https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/696406

Overall, the Toxin Lab series has been extremely consistent in quality, both in terms of gameplay and design. I hope we get more Xaro levels in the future. :)

RB8g4CZLik4.title: ''Reanimation'' 100% (Demon) by Terron [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.0]
RB8g4CZLik4.description: A legendary level that came out in 2.0, one of the very few levels that still looks great using the red and black theme that is so popular with demons nowadays. I beat this level when it came out but I didn't have my channel yet so I didn't upload it, that's why I decided to rebeat it. Amazing level in its time.

0TYQdcqHD7Q.title: ''Dem Journey'' 100% (Demon) by Goose | Geometry Dash [2.0]
0TYQdcqHD7Q.description: A 2.0 level that came out about 3 years ago, I beat it when it was uploaded but I wasn't on Youtube at the time. So I decided to beat it again since it was one of my favorite levels in 2.0. The design is really nice, it has a great use of different colors, something that was always Gooses' specialty. But what makes this level unique is the bossfight at the end, although it's a bit short, the art and gameplay is fun to play and nice to look at.

xvVu8Kbpuqg.title: ''Nantendo'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Im Fernando & More | Geometry Dash
xvVu8Kbpuqg.description: Nantendo is one of the best themed megacollabs I've seen in a while. This is just over 5 minutes long, each section being either a reference or a flat out recreation of a game, whether it be an indie game, a retro game or more recent ones and even mobile games. Every single part in this level has such a unique style and design, that goes perfectly with the game that it's representing. From Super Mario Bros, to Sonic the Hedgehog, all the way to Five Nights at Freddy's and Undertale. The art is what really makes this level shine, although there are some inconsistencies here and there, with some pieces of art being better than others, but every section is unique in it's own way, while still maintaining a high standard. I'd rate this as an Easy or Medium Demon, simply because of it's length, being an XXL, you do have to remember what comes next and memorize the transitions or you go all the way back to the beginning.

9k2MXxlfg34.title: ''Magmatic Mash'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 & More | Geometry Dash
9k2MXxlfg34.description: Magmatic Mash is a level that has a really defined style and theme. The colors, the block design, the backgrounds, the art that's scattered across the level that adds a lot more detail and layers to the decoration. Everything that this level has to offer in terms of style is nicely done. The gameplay is fun and fast paced, but there is one thing that I found a bit jarring, some of the transitions happen way too fast and abruptly. Another aspect that can make some sections a bit more difficult is the fact that the white flashes happen in the foreground instead of the background, making it hard to see sometimes. But apart from those 2 things, I really enjoyed playing this and I hope it gets rated quickly.

ZLCNegi5OOE.title: ''Krasnodar Region'' by iISpaceDustIi | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ZLCNegi5OOE.description: Awesome level, hope it gets rated soon.

vr1zhv2z8Hk.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Excessive Compliment'' 100% by Pennutoh | Geometry Dash
vr1zhv2z8Hk.description: This level came out about 2 years ago, I did 2000 attempts but ultimately gave up on it. Started playing it yesterday and beat it in a couple of hours, so in my opinion it's more of a Hard or Insane Demon now. One of Pennutoh's best levels in my opinion, Excessive Compliment is an Extreme Demon that's not only really nice to look at, with great decoration in general, and sync with the song. It has fun gameplay, which is hard to find in Extremes. It does have some bugs here and there, but nothing too bad.

c0uYDognikE.title: ''One Point Nine'' 100% by ISariaI | Geometry Dash [2.11]
c0uYDognikE.description: One point nine is a level that only utilizes decoration that were present in 1.9, and in my opinion, it was all used to the fullest. The level is longer than you'd expect, but every section offers something different, and some parts have some really unique effects. And if you also played in 1.9 this level will be very nostalgic :)

m-TOHvwnA0U.title: ''f3hcs'' 100% (Demon) by durianhead | Geometry Dash [2.11]
m-TOHvwnA0U.description: Another level that only uses 1.0 objects, f3hcs stands apart from a lot of similar themed levels because of it's level of detail. The amount of detail and quality of the design is insane, taking into account that it was created with old objects. My two favorite parts definetely have to be the one at 0:31 and 1:07, which are very creative in my opinion. Even though this level has some tricky sections, it doesn't pass from being a Medium Demon at best.

FsRkyVHm3Hs.title: ''GOLDen'' 100% by DanZmeN & JerkRat [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
FsRkyVHm3Hs.description: GOLDen is a level that despite not being the most detailed, visibly lacking when it comes to backgrounds, still has a lot to offer. The effects that were used, the block design, along with the gameplay, make this level feel complete anyways. The gameplay is pretty fun, standard and straightforward. Good level overall.

q95qrwa9sdQ.title: "Black Ice" 100% (Demon) by ToastLord | Geometry Dash [2.11]
q95qrwa9sdQ.description: Black Ice is a level that is very unnoticed and a really solid level, both in terms of design and gameplay. The theme of the level being the same as the title, it has a transparent and crystalline feel, with the majority being black with some sections changing color. The gameplay is fun but some parts can be tricky, especially the duals. Hope this guy gets the attention he deserves.

8ezxvpMpAR0.title: ''Red is Bad'' 100% by Subw00fer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
8ezxvpMpAR0.description:
A level that diverts from Subw00fer's usual designs and style. This one, more focused on the gameplay and design being directly related to the theme of the level. The name and song are also related to the design, every obstacle that can kill you in this level is red, and every safe spot is green. This concept is really cool and my opinion and I think it was executed well. Apart from the design, the gameplay is quite fun, it isn't difficult at all and it has replay value because of the coins.
ID: 58105590
Music FWLR & Twistex - Break Out
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/728237

wzcxmLvZ044.title: ''Elevatia'' 100% (Demon) by Team GeoForce | Geometry Dash [2.11]
wzcxmLvZ044.description: Another pretty unknown level by TGF, I really like the design though the gameplay can be way better in my opinion, since half of the time it doesn't work. But overall this level is really good and I hope to see it rated soon. And I know they released another level recently, but that might be too hard for me to do right now lol. So I recommend you to check their levels out :)

kBZepAQHH5s.title: "Mulpan" 100% (Demon) by Mulpan [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kBZepAQHH5s.description:
Mulpan is a level that came out about 7 months ago, and strangely hasn't received a rating. Created by Mulpan, an already established creator, this level has great design, that goes along with gameplay that's fun yet simple. Overall this is a really good level that deserves a rating in my opinion, being that it's been out for so long.
ID: 54884884
Music: Glassing - WhiscasKaat
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/832065

C-0PJxByVMk.title: "Jajagarasu" 100% (Demon) by PlebKingdom | Geometry Dash [2.1]
C-0PJxByVMk.description: Jajagarasu is a level that I beat about 2 years ago on stream, being one of my favorite joke levels, I decided to rebeat it and upload it again for better quality. This level is a remake of Yata, adding a ton of detail, from the block design, adding a lot of color, some art and cool effects to wrap it all up.

XGRvkP5cSOc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Zettabyte'' 100% by JenkinsGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
XGRvkP5cSOc.description:
For anyone wondering why I changed the music, I did it because of copyright reasons. :P

Zettabyte is in my opinion, one of the best Extreme Demons that have been released recently, I don't know how this level didn't get epic. Jenkins really deserves it for all the effort he put into this level. The technology theme that he went for was executed perfectly, the effects that he implemented, especially the glitchy ones came out looking great, along with the block design, the colors and overall decoration. To me this level was not only fun to play, but nice to look at. The gameplay did take a bit of getting used to, especially the first wave that was tricky, but apart from that, everything else gameplay-wise was really smooth. This recording is two weeks old and just got around to upload it.

vX2dryLHGIE.title: ''The Mayhem War'' 100% (Demon) by HHyper | Geometry Dash [2.11]
vX2dryLHGIE.description: The Mayhem War is one of the best levels I've ever seen, created by HHyper, that created other insanely detailed levels, such as Beast Mayhem and Surgeragon. Just about everything in this level is top quality, from the block design, to the backgrounds, to the effects that are implemented, even the music fits perfectly with the monster theme that this level has, and all of this is without mentioning the main attractions in this level, the bossfights. These bosses have so much detail put into them, from their design, to their effects, to their movements and attacks, all of HHypers bossfights are definetely top 5 worthy. Even though the level has so many objects that it is a bit laggy, it is still worth it to give it a try, just to see everything that the design has to offer up close.

ghF9qP_W-KI.title: "TouchArcade" 100% by Acors [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.1]
ghF9qP_W-KI.description: TouchArcade is a level that came out about 2 years ago, filled with recreations of popular mobile games, 10 to be exact. The gameplay is the most important aspect of this level, every single one has a different style, I think the recreations are really well done.

R0ixSqv7AMk.title: ''Luminous Reaction'' by Xender Game [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
R0ixSqv7AMk.description: Another great level by Xender Game, that is heavily inspired by Knots style. But the most surprising part is the fact that it was made in only 5 days, considering the quality of the level, it's very impressive. The colors, the effects, just about everything design-wise in this level is great. And this music by Geoplex fits really well with the level too, and to top it all off, it even has a bossfight, the animations are smooth, along with I mentioned before.

kcXv1no83RY.title: "Forever Bound" by BobRatchet [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.0]
kcXv1no83RY.description:
Music: Harmony of the Heart - Forever Bound http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RH_pWAp2et0
Forever Bound's Channel: http://www.youtube.com/ForeverBound

Forever Bound is a classic 2.0 level, that in my opinion, still looks great up to this day, especially the robot rainbow section. But despite that, the rest of the level is still pretty good, the effects, the colors, and movements. That being said, the rainbow section still looks amazing, even with todays standards, the animations are really smooth and the 3d effect that BobRatchet created with the tiles and monsters is very satisfying to look at.

hn7_WEz205c.title: ''MORYO'' 100% (Demon) by EnZore [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
hn7_WEz205c.description: Simply put, MORYO is a level that has an overall excellent design, great colors, effects, transitions and perfect sync with the song that was chosen. The lightning, the flowers, and the subtle hints of art that can be found in this level add a lot of detail in my opinion, and make this level stand out from other demons. This is without a doubt EnZore's best level to date, I hope he keeps creating at this level or even higher, because I'm excited to try his future creations out.

JJGzoc7gwsU.title: [Verified] ''TM18'' 100% (Demon) by Moosh & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
JJGzoc7gwsU.description:
A megacollab by that has been in the works for a whole year has finally been released and I'd say it turned out pretty good. Thanks Moosh for letting me verify, I had a lot of fun playing it. And I recommend you all to try this out! :)
ID: 57903107

Creators: Cotchy, Sagascius, Moosh, EOTS, Mixer, Zenith, Neso, At9, Starky, Yoonsr, Yoshikawa, Lem, Acno, Kiba, OasisX, Exylem, Saturn.

rbuvTu6Bz-Q.title: ''Celerity'' 100% (Demon) by Stardevoir [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rbuvTu6Bz-Q.description: Celerity is another demon created in a 1.0/layout style, like many others we've seen recently. It has a very barebones and simple design, but as with most of these levels, the appeal is in the gameplay and the elements that the creator implements into it. Something that makes this level stand out to me is how Stardevoir gave the level a bit more detail using the blocks to make a sort of 3d stair effect. Overall this level is fun to play and not difficult at all.
