ZHXt4HKzAN0.title: ''Falling Up AgaiN'' 100% (Demon) by mdk642 & kDarko | Geometry Dash
ZHXt4HKzAN0.description: A remake to the well known Insane Demon, Falling Up, this level builds upon what the original was, the effects are really well done, the colors as well as the backgrounds and bits of art that can be found throughout. The beginning section is what improved the most in my opinion, it has a much more refined look. Something that could have been better, atmosphere-wise was the drop, the original was dark and gloomy,  and this one is colorful and vibrant. This level is a good remake, the gameplay is fun as well, even though some parts could have been executed better, I recommend you try it out.

QbyY1Dw8KTE.title: "Greetins User" by DavJT & Xender Game | Geometry Dash [2.11]
QbyY1Dw8KTE.description: Greetins User is another amazing level by DavJT, this time with the help of another talented creator, Xender Game. Right from the beginning you can already tell that this level is going to be high quality, the animations, the colors and the use of glow and detailed backgrounds, make the level look extravagant but at the same time not overly-complicated.

d1vgoManOgg.title: (Insane Demon) ''Thanos'' 100% by Agils & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
d1vgoManOgg.description: Thanos is a level that starts off relatively simple, with medium paced gameplay and good decoration, but I think the level really picks up after the drop. Some sections could've had better decoration, feeling a bit empty at times, especially in terms of backgrounds. But the bossfight in my opinion is really well done, although it could have better movement and more animations, the drawing is quite good. Don't know why it's called Thanos though, apart from the bossfight this pretty much has nothing to do with that. The gameplay is also fun, and although it is challenging, I wouldn't call it an Insane Demon, but a Hard Demon imo.

HBGuQBoRHG8.title: "Upbeat Illusion" 100% (Demon) by OptaWolfGD & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
HBGuQBoRHG8.description: Upbeat Illusion is a level that has a really good mix of colors, effects and backgrounds, really tying the modern yet simplistic style that I feel the creators were going for. The gameplay is very easy, but at the same time, it's fun to play and just nice to look at, I'd rate it an Easy Demon.

Dd9peZQ9QSI.title: ''Hallow Hills'' 100% (Demon) by Alex112300 [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Dd9peZQ9QSI.description: Hallow HIlls is an level that was clearly, heavily inspired by ScorchVX's creative style, specifically Magma Bound. Showcasing a wide variety of colors, backgrounds and art, with a song that feels really appropiate to the design of this level. The gameplay is quite simple, the main focus of Hallow Hills is the decoration.  In my opinion, the inspiration is clearly there and was executed extremely well. One of the best halloween levels I've ever seen.

UoMLaNpALsA.title: (Extreme Demon) "Artifice" 100% by F3lixsram & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
UoMLaNpALsA.description: Artifice is one of the few extreme demons I've played in a long time that has gameplay that I actually enjoy, that isn't hard just for the sake of being an extreme, that is satisfying and fun to play. The decoration and design is absolutely on point. Apart from all of that, the song that was chosen for this level fits really well, along with having great sync. Overall I can say that this is one of the best extremes that have come out recently.

mvuzOOIOwC8.title: (Insane Demon) ''Digital Entropy'' 100% by TeamUprising | Geometry Dash
mvuzOOIOwC8.description:
Digital Entropy is a very unnoticed Insane Demon level by Team Uprising. With it's fast paced gameplay and great design and colors, this level is probably one of my favorite Insane/Hard Demons in recent memory. The gameplay was very fun, none of the parts felt overly complicated or unfair, very smooth all throughout. You can tell a lot of effort was put into this level, highly recommend you to try it out :)
ID: 56182442

EP18XqBDRjw.title: ''Dim'' by Spu7Nix [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
EP18XqBDRjw.description: One of the most unique levels that I've ever seen, completely changing Geometry Dash, turning it into a sort of 3D maze game. There are 10 levels, each one increasing in difficulty, where you must find your way to the exit, while you avoid crashing into red obstacles, some of which are moving and shifting. You only have to reach level 5 in order to beat the level, but if you want to go for 100% including all 3 coins, you have to get to level 10. Overall, this level is amazing, and the fact that things like this can be made inside GD never ceases to surprise me, definitely recommend you give it a try if your device can run it.

xtUS3CmGkXU.title: "Acid Rush III" 100% (Demon) by Serponge & More [Verified] | Geometry Dash
xtUS3CmGkXU.description: The third installment in the Acid Rush series, that has been in the works for quite some time, that Serponge asked me to verify. Following the theme of the other two levels, Acid Rush 3 has the same green color pallette, along with the industrial decoration, both in the foreground and background. I really enjoyed playing this level and having the opportunity to verify. One of the very few levels that has aged well.

3qR1pl31PkI.title: ''Molrock Volcano'' 100% (Demon) by AutoNick [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
3qR1pl31PkI.description: Molrock Volcano is a quality level, it may look simpler than others, but in my opinion the lava theme is executed really well. The colors, the effects, in combination with the gameplay bring every element of this level together very nicely.

CFJrt_L5ca8.title: (Insane Demon) "Kyrie Eleison" 100% by Viprin & More | Geometry Dash
CFJrt_L5ca8.description: Kyrie Eleison is one of the best levels that has come out recently, in my opinion. The theme is executed really well. The design, the backgrounds, the art and the effects are quality. The gameplay is also very fun and gets consistent very quickly, JonathanGD's part was definitely the hardest for me. and some transitions also could've been better clarity-wise, overall an amazing level. GG :)

upcynbn1hGo.title: ''Hue Effect'' 100% (Demon) by Zoroa GD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
upcynbn1hGo.description: Hue Effect is a remake of the nine circles level butterfly effect by Linco, which I'm pretty sure all of you has already played this by now. The gameplay pretty much stays the same, except for the gray part in the middle of the level and some nerfs. What really changes in this level compared to the original are the effects and colors. I think Zoroa implemented his style really well into what Butterfly Effect was, adding a lot more color to the level, although the backgrounds do look a bit empty. Apart from that, this is a great remake.

_OHDsttMjjc.title: "Nightmare Realm" 100% (Demon) by Maxie25 | Geometry Dash [2.11]
_OHDsttMjjc.description: Even though Nightmare Realm is only a minute long and an Easy Demon in my opinion, it's packed with much detail. From the hellish backgrounds, the red and gray color scheme, the monsters and enemies that were created to go along with all of this. I also really like the atmosphere in this level, I think Maxie executed that pretty well. It was also pretty creative how he made lightbulbs for the custom orbs, about the gameplay, I think it could use some polishing since sometimes it doesn't work. Overall really good in my opinion, highly recommend you try it out :)

rxL8KIFDbbA.title: ''Starlit Realm'' 100% (Demon) by JamAttack | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rxL8KIFDbbA.description: Starlit Realm is another XL level by JamAttack, and in my opinion, one of, if not, the best he's ever created. This level is very unique in it's design though it can get a bit repetitive, and most of it has a purple theme to it. Then, just before it ends, the level changes completely, the song and gameplay slow down and everything becomes more colorful. Another thing that makes this level unique is the fact that JamAttack used the song he created himself for this level, which adds to the originality.

LDAST1HXlkg.title: ''Dart'' 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
LDAST1HXlkg.description: Dart is another level that follows the theme of Trip and Flap, where a bunch of creators collab and make 1-2 second parts that transition very quickly between each other. In my opinion, this level is one of the best that has come out that uses this style. Dart uses only the wave to navigate through each section, which I really like because some of the parts have unique gameplay elements that in my opinion makes the level more exciting.

J63XvLI4fd4.title: (Insane Demon) ''Nine Paws'' 100% by MaxyLAND & More | Geometry Dash
J63XvLI4fd4.description: Nine Paws is an Insane demon that was created by MaxyLAND and a handful of other talented creators. Featuring a wide variety of colors, fast paced gameplay and a Nine Circles style to go along with it, Nine Paws really does feel like an Insane Demon both in terms of gameplay and design. The gameplay, although short, can take a while to get used to and be annoying at times, but other than that, this is a solid level.

ZlKLqn3e_Zg.title: [Layout] ''Omicron'' by Team Proxima (Upcoming Extreme Demon) | Geometry Dash
ZlKLqn3e_Zg.description:
[Cut] The official upcoming sequel to epsilon that I'm verifying, this level is pretty unbalanced atm but when the level is finished I'll try to make it more fun for everyone, I already made changes like nerfs and such.
Creators: Aquatias, Cosmic, Pocket, Matterz, TriStorm, Tex02, SlimJim, Sequex, Sedgehog, Yakobnugget, Voltex, Belonzik, Azasuh, Hyenaedon, Leo32601, ChiN3x, Skele, Splash, Peton, Lazuli, genericqueso, Wespdx, Zipiks, Surv, Failure444, Goose, Juhou & more!

rpR8Sonl0RA.title: (Extreme Demon) ''INNARDS'' 100% by Kaito | Geometry Dash [2.11]
rpR8Sonl0RA.description: This is most unlucky experience I've had with an Extreme Demon, this took about a week to do but it would've taken 2 days if I didn't die at 95%. And today I got 97% due to me getting really nervous, the difficulty of this level is really inconsistent as well so that made it more difficult to get back there. But I'm really glad I followed through, GG.

uOCLYZdvSxo.title: "BuTiTi III" 100% (Extreme Demon) by JonathanGD [Verified] | Geometry Dash
uOCLYZdvSxo.description:
BuTiTi 3 finally verified after so long, I've always been a fan of Jonathan's levels and I'm very glad I got to verify this one. I would like to thank everyone who supported me since the start, I poured all my time and soul into this level, and I'm sorry this took so long. Good luck to anyone that tries this, looking to forward to see how fast people beat this level. GG :) 
by the way this level is 10x easier if you play it with LDM so there's that.
Song: Nano Love Meganeko
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/684651

qbDw6g9z9Qc.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Master Duel'' 100% by Zylenox [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
qbDw6g9z9Qc.description: Master Duel is a remake of the popular two-player level, Duelo Maestro by Nacho21 The design, the decoration, the backgrounds, block design and art has been completely changed, updated and re-vamped to a more modern style, adding a ton of detail to each section and not leaving a single one empty. The gameplay has stayed similar for the most part, some sections have been slightly buffed, some have been nerfed and some have been completely changed, but the duals have the same feel to them as the original. Overall I'd say this is a great remake of a classic level and I had a lot of fun playing it.

TwvjJLv6_4o.title: ''True Calamity'' 100% (Demon) by Subw00fer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
TwvjJLv6_4o.description: True Calamity is a level that is based off of a Terraria mod that goes by the same name, Calamity. The boss is at the very end of the level, but you can catch glimpses of it throughout various sections, which is something I always like to see in these types of levels. I really liked just about everything that this level has to offer, the colors, the effects, the backgrounds and especially the bossfight.

seTda1s_uZ0.title: ''Time Flies'' 100% by Osiris GD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
seTda1s_uZ0.description: Time Flies is a level that showcases how Geometry Dash has evolved throughout the years and through various updates, going from the earliest years of the game, all the way to 2.1. I appreciate how it doesn't dwell on the first updates that came to the game, I feel like that would've made the level boring from the start. Using Robtops style as a base and still implementing custom movement in some of the sections really sets it apart from other levels that have this theme. Overall, I think Time Flies does a good job of showing just how much has been added to the game with each update that has been released.

H8tK1U1k0kI.title: ''neXus'' 100% (Demon) by BlueRimz [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
H8tK1U1k0kI.description: neXus is a level that has excellent colors and effects, making the level very enjoyable from a gameplay and visual standpoint. Although only lasting about a minute, every section fits perfectly with the song choice, giving it yet another layer of detail. Thanks for  the dedication. :)

JqgkrQDd1No.title: ''Abstraction'' 100% (Demon) by Spuddles & ShakeoffX | Geometry Dash [2.11]
JqgkrQDd1No.description: Abstraction is a collab between two talented creators, Spuddles and ShakeoffX, one on design and the other in charge of the gameplay. Inspired heavily on Xender Game's style, the dark backgrounds, the neon coloring, even the block design and decorations surrounding it have his vibe, which is difficult to pull off. This level has a slow buildup towards a bossfight that is really well-made, the colors, the animations and the effects that were created are top quality and even though it's quite short, I feel it tops off the level nicely.

UQNDrn-DJ1Y.title: ''World of Infinity'' 100% (Demon) by Beemil2 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
UQNDrn-DJ1Y.description: World of Infinity is an XL demon that offers great colors, great design, backgrounds and even a couple of bossfights. It begins with a relatively simple turquoise colored UFO section, that then transitions into a bit more detailed ship section, changing up the block design and adding a moon to the background. This level goes through various styles, colors, backgrounds and speeds, making it feel a bit inconsistent at times, in terms of design. But every part and every section does feel like it has it's place. World of Infinity features 2 bossfights, one at 1:30, where you enter a castle and have to dodge a Knight while he tries to kill you with his sword and axe. I think the animations and design of this boss are well-made, although the animations could be a tad smoother. The second one and my favorite one comes at 2:30, where you fight a god-like creature. The colors in this bossfight look amazing, the gameplay is simple, yet fun, and in my opinion it finishes the level off nicely. Finally the levels ends off with a short cube section that shows all the dedications.

APuu-1fdVac.title: ''null404'' 100% (Demon) by MistFix & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
APuu-1fdVac.description: null404 is a level that has very unique styles and the way that the colors change and shift throughout the level in a glitch-type effect is well-made and ended up looking really cool. The level's only a minute long but each section has something that makes it stand out, whether it be the block design, the effects or the colors.

PdRny3Hxkbg.title: (Insane Demon) "Convection" 100% by VoidSquad | Geometry Dash [2.11]
PdRny3Hxkbg.description: Convection is the latest level by VoidSquad, featuring great design, including the colors, effects, transitions and block design. All around it feels and looks like a very complete level, in terms of design and gameplay. Now the gameplay, in my opinion it's an Insane Demon, simply because the difficulty can feel inconsistent at times and in certain sections. But even taking that into consideration, this level is fun to play and I enjoyed every aspect of it.

WoW-zG5YMLg.title: ''Altair'' 100% (Demon) by ViPriN & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
WoW-zG5YMLg.description: Altair is a megacollab by ViPriN and a handful of other talented creators. This level offers great colors, effects and block design. The thing I like most about Altair is how well each section transitions to one another, very smooth. Being a relatively long level, in comparison to most levels now a days, it doesn't feel boring or repetitive at any point, due to the great color scheme and design.

SeEk9RlnES4.title: ''Mediterranean'' by Djoxy & Sminx | Geometry Dash [2.11]
SeEk9RlnES4.description: Possibly the best themed level I've ever seen, Mediterranean, although only 40 seconds long, it has just about everything you would want to see in a level. It has great colors that go perfectly with the summer theme, great art and animations to go with it and a song that wraps everything together nicely. There are so many small details in this level, either in the background or in the front. My favorite part about this level definetely has to be the way the level flows, the transitions mixed with the gameplay is really well done. Overall this is a level you can play many times and not get bored.

Br4mRGMUnq0.title: BuTiTi III 97% | Geometry Dash
Br4mRGMUnq0.description: I actually got this a while ago but I wasn't sure if I should upload it since it was only 6% progress, and it's taking me a long time to beat this level so here's 97% to let people know that I'm still trying.

dL3U507w7-I.title: "Rock Hard" by DanZmeN | Geometry Dash [2.11]
dL3U507w7-I.description: Rock Hard, although a relatively short level, it shows a completely new style by DanZmeN, I always like to see creators try new things with their levels. Featuring a purely green and black color palette, with digital and glitch effects on top, even though the block design is a bit simple, the effects and bossfight towards the end make up for it.

PWztC9bneKU.title: ''Drift'' 100% (Demon) by Darwin [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
PWztC9bneKU.description:
Drift is a level that is based on TamaN's visual style and gameplay, implementing the colors that TamaN regularly uses, flashing lights, block design, etc. Another thing I think Darwin nailed is the fast gameplay, starting slow, building up, and finally reaching that quick pace going along perfectly with the music. Even though it's only a minute long, everything that's packed into this level is well-made and fairly enjoyable to play.
This level has 1 coin, in order to collect it, at 0:03 you have to skip the blue orb and click the dash orb, go through the two portals and grab the red skull. Then, you go through the level normally and get the coin at 0:10.

vVNdOqiTiO8.title: ''Count To Twenty'' by Zoroa GD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
vVNdOqiTiO8.description: Today we have a level that I did not expect to be released, a sequel to one of my favorite levels to come out in recent months, count to ten. Zoroa GD comes with a more refined, yet minimalist approach to this level, as opposed to the original, which had all the crazy effects and colors. The level being almost completely in black and white, he has to rely on movement, animations and effects to make the level stand out like the first one, and I think it was accomplished. Even though Count to Twenty is just over a minute long, the gameplay elements that Zoroa implemented, combining vertical and horizontal gameplay, makes the level very enjoyable and replayable. Overall this level is a welcome surprise, and this is probably my favorite Zoroa level.

BS8UYWluLx0.title: ''Superlunary'' 100% (Demon) by wulz | Geometry Dash [2.11]
BS8UYWluLx0.description: Superlunary is an XL level that I really enjoyed because of the very unique effects wulz used. It stays consistent in terms of design quality. There isn't a single section or part that drops off in detail, the effects are nice to look at, the backgrounds, the colors, block design, really bring the level together and make it feel complete. Overall, Superlunary is a level that anyone can enjoy, both by it's design; since it doesn't lag, and gameplay, it being about an Easy or Medium demon.

ZcGsm4Z1D2s.title: (Insane Demon) ''Sonic Boom'' 100% by SirHadoken | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ZcGsm4Z1D2s.description: Sonic Boom is a remake of the popular level Supersonic, completely revamping the decoration and gameplay, changing and buffing the latter. SirHadoken made the level feel more complete and consistent than the original. Overall, this is what a remake should be, basing itself on the original, but improving across the board, really well-done.

X0OdndIleJw.title: "Kodou" 100% (Demon) by Koolboom & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
X0OdndIleJw.description: Kodou is yet another layout styled megacollab that really stands out to me because of the way the creators use the movements, blocks and shapes to add so much detail to the level overall. Apart from that, the great sync that was achieved with the song, the flashes, movement of the blocks and obstacles, make the level feel complete and not just another layout. And the art created by Zhander at the very end of the level is incredibly well made, one of the best pieces of art I've seen in GD.

UPKSCHet6lc.title: "Rainbow Force Z" 100% (Demon) by Alkatraz [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
UPKSCHet6lc.description: Rainbow Force Z is a really colorful level. Featuring a wide array of colors, shapes, patterns, everywhere from the block design, to the backgrounds. There isn't a single section in this level that isn't decorated, making it feel full and complete. This level isn't difficult at all, although it is longer than most levels.

kW8NxFrpk4Y.title: ''Fatal Corrosium'' 100% (Demon) by PleoSlim RMD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kW8NxFrpk4Y.description: Fatal Corrosium is by far PleoSlim's best level, it has about everything you'd want from a level, excellent design, colors, art, backgrounds, effects, blocks, even including a couple of mini-bossfights. Each sections feels like it has it's place and unique, especially the part at 0:29, you would think it's auto, but in reality you have control, having to dodge the obstacles in front of you. This is just a great level across the board, I also want to thank PleoSlim for including me in the level :).

DLSAnjoN70k.title: ''The Eschaton'' 100% (XXL Demon) by Xender Game | Geometry Dash [2.11]
DLSAnjoN70k.description: Probably the best level in the game right now

FvaRIB-m2qQ.title: ''All Inside My Dreams'' 100% (Demon) by Steven Ksttle [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
FvaRIB-m2qQ.description:
ROAD TO 300K :)

This is a level that is very fast paced, both in terms of gameplay, being almost at max speed in the majority of the sections, only taking short breaks for some transitions and musically, following the tempo of the level. A really colorful level with a lot of details that you can miss if you don't pay enough attention. Almost every section this level has to offer has a different style to it, switching up the colors, the effects, the backgrounds, the blocks, and even adding some art in some parts, which I always like to see. Some might find it confusing how the style changes so quickly, but that's the theme of the level, about dreams, where everything can change in an instant. In order to get the coin, at 0:03, you have to jump late on the slope to grab the key that's on the other side. Then at 0:49 the obstacle will dissapear so you can grab the heart that's below the platform. Finally, at the very end of the level, at 1:01 you have to click the two blue triggers to get the coin. I also want to thank Steven Ksttle for the dedication :).

NajFI7IVtgM.title: (Insane Demon) ''Explosion'' 100% by Blaireswip & SrGuillester | Geometry Dash
NajFI7IVtgM.description: Explosion is an unofficial sequel to Lit Fuse, it's a level that I really enjoyed playing simply because it's one of those levels that feels complete. I appreciate how they managed to keep the difficulty similar to Lit Fuse. The hardest part for me was the cube section at the beginning of the level, but overall, it's a level that is very satisfying to play.

wRJGG4cjFTc.title: ''Golden Future'' 100% (Demon) by SuprianGD [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
wRJGG4cjFTc.description: Golden Future is a level that is heavily inspired by Future Funk and Jonathan GD's style. The colors that were used, the effects, the way that different sections have a completely different style to them, switching just about everything up after each transition. There's also a section that I really like that is basically deadlocked, highlighting what I like about this level, each part is so different, that none of them feel out of place. I'd rate this at about a Medium Demon, since some sections can be a bit tricky, especially the duals. Also, I changed the song, due to copyright reasons.

P0iLfttm7aM.title: (Extreme Demon) ''WaveBreaker'' 100% by Lemons & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
P0iLfttm7aM.description:
Took a break from BuTiTi and decided to beat this level, which ended up taking me only a day to beat., fluking it from 74%. It's one of the most fun levels I've played recently, despite it being an extreme demon. Apart from the gameplay being well-executed, the design is great as well, in my opinion. The colors, blocks and the effects make the gameplay stand out even more in my opinion.
GG :)

Bg4UVrPn_T8.title: ''AmazoN'' 100% (Demon) by ItsAdvyStyles & DanZmeN [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
Bg4UVrPn_T8.description: AmazoN is a level that, in my opinion, is very rough around the edges, the design feels all over the place. The level and it's style aren't necessarily bad, but it could've had more work put into it. I liked the bossfights, the art and animations for them are well done, but the blocks and backgrounds feel lacking in comparison. Overall, this isn't a bad level, but I feel like it needs more polishing.

xseEWYhFeMM.title: BuTiTi III 91% | Verification Progress #3 | Geometry Dash
xseEWYhFeMM.description: 9% to go, let's hope I don't die at 99%.

Z5-sUlRoRdc.title: ''Acid Trip'' 100% (Demon) by Disp & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Z5-sUlRoRdc.description: Acid Trip is a exactly what the title suggests, the level starts out and has many sections where everything is normal, the design, the colors, the blocks, the effects. But as you move forward and the level progresses, everything becomes distorted, the colors begin to change rapidly, some sections are blurry, some have flashing colors and some just don't make sense. That's what makes this level different to me.

K_1YmBkHawA.title: ''Under Construction'' 100% (Demon) by Alfred PKNess & N R G [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
K_1YmBkHawA.description: Under Construction is a level that has a very clear theme and style to it, very mechanical and industrial. From the blocks, that look like machines, the color palette, the backgrounds that show industrial plants and factories. There are also so many small details throughout the level; objects flying across the screen, some effects like lightning and flashing lights, that add even more to the industrial theme.

8I3pcl70t-k.title: ''JK'' 100% (Demon) by PotatoBaby | Geometry Dash [2.11]
8I3pcl70t-k.description: JK is a level that has really good gameplay, features good design, blocks, colors and especially in it's good use of the glow effect. This level came out almost exactly a year ago and still hasn't recieved any stars, which surprises me.

7gUs_wsAeyc.title: ''AI TECHno'' 100% (Demon) by Maxie25 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
7gUs_wsAeyc.description: AI TECHno is a level that is heavily inspired by StubbyPinata's creative style, color choices and themes, the whole level being in a metallic gray with neon coloring on the edges of the blocks and the bosses. The one thing that really shines in this level are the designs for the bosses, being sort of animatronic robots, there's a dragon, a giant spider and a bear towards the end of the level. There is one section that really surprised me, that begins at 1:31, where you enter a sort of platforming mini-game. The game switches to two-player mode, where you use the right side to keep your oxygen at 100, otherwise you die, and the left section to jump on the platforms to get through, I found this part fun and I feel like it adds a layer of complexity to this level. The block design and backgrounds could have been excecuted better but the colors, effects and bosses make up for it.

S1sbzn6gp-E.title: ''Arcania'' by Darwin & Vip3r | Geometry Dash [2.11]
S1sbzn6gp-E.description: A level by Darwin & Vip3r where they recreate Kips style and it's executed very well. This has great colors, effects and block design. The yellow, purple and blue color pallette is something you don't see very often, but it works really well here.

LhvpS5J05tc.title: ''Chromatica'' 100% (Demon) by Darwin & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
LhvpS5J05tc.description: Chromatica is an amazing level created by Darwin and a handfull of other amazing creators, using and combining styles from several different levels. Everything about this level is great, the colors, the decoration, the block design, the effects, even the gameplay is top notch in my opinion.

B3C6XVjpSJ4.title: ''Magma Bound'' 100% (Demon) by ScorchVx [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
B3C6XVjpSJ4.description: Magma Bound is one of the most vibrant levels I've ever come across, with the cartoony style that's used makes every bit of decoration, from the blocks, to the backgrounds and art. The colors that are used mix together perfectly with the magma theme of the level and the music fit with everything. The gameplay is fun, it seems easy but some of the timings can be difficult, which will require some practice. Overall I really like this level.

0WFwVS0H3FQ.title: (Extreme Demon) ''CYCLONE'' 100% by Bianox & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
0WFwVS0H3FQ.description: Got 72% on this level 3 months ago when it first came out but I stopped playing it for some reason. So I decided to try it again and managed to beat it really quick, took me around 2 hours. This was really fun to play even though I died at 98% once. Jenkins part was definitely the hardest for me, the rest were fairly easy for an Extreme Demon in my opinion. GG :)

R_Hb3HR_83c.title: ''Decent'' 100% by SylntNyt (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
R_Hb3HR_83c.description: Decent is a level that has great color choices and changes, a simple yet appealing design and fun gameplay. What makes this level stand out to me is how Slyn recreated 2.2 effects in 2.1, making it seem like some sections have multiple layers.

oqlihIkXD_o.title: ''Pilot'' 100% (Demon) by Jayuff | Geometry Dash [2.11]
oqlihIkXD_o.description: A really unique level by Jayuff, the effects and colors really make every part of this stand out. But what makes this level truly unique is the ship that begins at 0:43, what makes this part special is the fact that you don't control the ships, you move the objects and obstacles up and down so your ship can dodge them, that's how I see it at least. It also has a lot of gameplay elements, switches, falling blocks, etc, which I found fun to play.

DMlppBu7JlQ.title: BuTiTi III 79% | Verification Progress #2 | Geometry Dash
DMlppBu7JlQ.description: Some more more progress on this level. About 2 days ago I got 68% after playing for like 5 hours, then yesterday I got 76% and 4 minutes later I get 79%. At this point I can get to the duals almost every attempt, I'm still not sure when I'll beat this though, so wish me luck :)

Fplu2cI8xAQ.title: ''not A lay'' 100% (Demon) by KJackpot | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Fplu2cI8xAQ.description: not A lay is a layout style level, and as with most of the levels like this, it's basically a normal level. But I still find these levels interesting and fun to play, I feel that the simple aesthetic emphasizes the gameplay, which is where all of the effort goes into these levels, the effects, the sync with the music, the transitions and the modes.

9SkclJR0uAc.title: ''Phases'' 100% (XXL Insane Demon) by Incidius | Geometry Dash [2.11]
9SkclJR0uAc.description: Phases isn't an ordinary level, it's practically a different game, a platformer where you can move left or right, passing through obstacles and avoiding falling to your death. The level is 9 minutes long, but you do have a time limit, if you don't beat the game withing 9 minutes you automatically die and get a 95%. The mechanics and gameplay are done really well, it feels smooth and responsive, the hitboxes on the obstacles are almost perfect. One thing I feel could've been changed are the checkpoints, especially in the first bossfight, that section is about 3 minutes long but if you die, you go back to the beginning. Apart from this, I like the design, the white representing the safe spots and the dark the obstacles you have to avoid. The backgrounds have a simple aesthetic to them but look really nice and add to the ambiance of the level. Overall I enjoyed playing this a lot, it was fun.

t4L-0_Aw95w.title: ''Nemesis Prime'' 100% (Demon) by FlacoGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
t4L-0_Aw95w.description: Nemesis Prime is a level that is heavily inspired by StubbyPinata, in terms of gameplay and somewhat in the design as well, it has a robotic feel to it. This level has great colors and effects, and the art and bossfight goes without saying. Although some backgrounds feel a bit empty, it doesn't take away from it. The gameplay is fun, the duals especially.

uKcH3qrpXNA.title: "Shaggy23 El Tortilla" by RoiMousti | Geometry Dash [2.11]
uKcH3qrpXNA.description:
A level by RoiMousti that came out 7 months ago, that features very simple block design, but I decided to upload it because I haven't found any interesting levels recently. The gameplay is fun and easy, with the music adding to this factor.

Had to re-upload this due to sound issues.

AnJcYvd57BQ.title: "Aumetras Wrath" 100% (Demon) by Cirtrax | Geometry Dash [2.11]
AnJcYvd57BQ.description: Aumetras Wrath is a level that is 2 minutes long, with great color choice, effects and gameplay. Even though there aren't any gameplay elements to the bossfights, the designs are well done. I'd rate it an Easy demon, it will take a bit of practice, but just because it's 2 minutes long.

N3Yj4b5oPg8.title: "Incandescent" 100% (Demon) by Darwin & Yakimaru | Geometry Dash [2.11]
N3Yj4b5oPg8.description: Incandescent is a level based on WOOGI1411's style. That sets itself apart from others because of how well the glow effect is implemented into it, it gives the level a lot of detail, along with the pulses, flashes and color changes. The gameplay is enjoyable, even though it does take practice, and it turns very fast paced towards the end. My favorite parts are the duals. I'd rate it a Hard Demon.

BTr8CxNbk8g.title: ''Shapes N Dash'' 100% by ZecretDash (2 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
BTr8CxNbk8g.description: Shapes N Dash is another just shapes and beats level and even though we've seen levels with this theme many times, this is executed pretty well. Like the block design and colors, The gameplay is fun, it isn't difficult at all. My favorite parts are the dual sections, the transitions from one part to the next are well done as well.

c1uNwbrEcBI.title: ''Diamond Rose'' 100% (Demon) by MrMeurick [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
c1uNwbrEcBI.description: Diamond Rose is a level I really enjoyed playing because of it's excellent use of colors and movement, it looks very vibrant, the way the blocks and backgrounds move along with the music. The gameplay is about and Easy Demon I'd say, it's easy and fluid.

_QQCxFCPCEM.title: ''Entente'' 100% (Demon) by Konsi & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
_QQCxFCPCEM.description: Sick level by Konsi and others, I really like the decoration & colors in this, and It's gameplay is really fun although quite buggy at times. Also this level has been out for 3 months and hasn't been rated yet, let's hope this video helps getting it rated :)

oPC07wlTysE.title: BuTiTi III 63% | Verification Progress #1 | Geometry Dash
oPC07wlTysE.description:
Here's some progress on BuTiTi III, been working on this level for quite a while now and I hope I can beat it soon. Bear with me :P
Also I might have to verify this with LDM, It starts to get really laggy at the dual wave, so there's that. And sorry for the low mic audio, hope you all don't mind. More progress soon!

L22WoCS3ejU.title: ''Just 4 Fun'' 100% (Demon) by Mulpan & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
L22WoCS3ejU.description: We definitely have a new trend here.

lMbM2SfpLAE.title: ''Morpho'' 100% (Demon) by F5night & FirsGD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
lMbM2SfpLAE.description: Morpho is a level that offers so much in terms of design, beautiful colors, backgrounds, great block design and that's without mentioning the best part about this level, the butterfly that can be found in the second part. The animations, effects and colors that it has really make it stand out. This level is actually quite easy, but with so many objects sometimes it's hard to see, also this is probably one the laggiest levels in the game

D-qHgLZCx8s.title: ''Core'' by KJackpot | Geometry Dash [2.11]
D-qHgLZCx8s.description: Core is basically a layout level, but even though it has practically no decoration, no backgrounds, no block design, no colors, I really like it because of the way the level moves. The parts where the level turns into a platformer, in sync with the song, I find it very enjoyable. The gameplay is easy, there are some parts that can be a bit confusing, especially at the end but it's easy to get the hang of.

hmdaIn_mp2w.title: (Insane Demon) ''EB'' 100% By Ilrell & RekindL | Geometry Dash [2.11]
hmdaIn_mp2w.description: EB is a level that has an enormous variation of colors, style, art and block design, every section is different. The gameplay can be a bit frustrating sometimes, but with enough practice it's fine. and although the intro is very long I still really liked this level, definitely one of Ilrell's best works :)

WAg6ZiS564g.title: ''Self Reflect'' by Flashmick72 (2 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
WAg6ZiS564g.description: Self Reflect is a level that stands out among a lot of others simply because of it's concept, which is very well executed, the mirror effect implemented on the blocks themselves looks really cool. Even though the level is short, what you get is well made.

2_nNXCHgWUI.title: ''Samplifirino1'' 100% (Demon) by RoiMousti [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
2_nNXCHgWUI.description: Samplifirino1 is a level that's inspired by an official level from Robtop, and despite that it still manages to feel unique. What makes this level stand out is the use of colors, the range and the changes used, the flashing lights in sync with the song. The gameplay isn't difficult at all, I'd say easy-medium demon level.

hr01ZYORPS0.title: (Preview #2) Alpha Centauri by SaturN & More | Geometry Dash
hr01ZYORPS0.description:
More progress, this is close to being done!
Montage by G-Force: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEkixnmObtT37VvmTuTplmQ

SaturN: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCuRmoWXJTo0XMcSWkphSoqA

FETrqwKjUZg.title: ''The Bone'' 100% (Demon) by AnielChasseur [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
FETrqwKjUZg.description: The Bone is a level with great effects, colors, block design and animations. The theme is very unique and the mini bossfights found throughout the level make it really stand out. The gameplay is fun and about medium demon difficulty.

btmUgdqnL9Y.title: ''Two Faced Agony'' 100% (Demon) by FunnyGame | Geometry Dash [2.11]
btmUgdqnL9Y.description: FunnyGame's latest masterpiece, although the gameplay is pretty inconsistent, the effects are super unique and It's something you don't see in your everyday gd level.

wc-YyUi6wu0.title: ''Centauri'' 100% by Team Proxima | Geometry Dash [2.11]
wc-YyUi6wu0.description:
Amazing art level and the second megacollab by Team Proxima. I managed to beat their first level which was an extreme demon, might as well complete this too :)

1XGw-7L7jdg.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Unearthed'' 100% by YakobNugget & More | Geometry Dash
1XGw-7L7jdg.description:
Really good level, one of the best extreme demons in my opinion, every part has really good design and fun gameplay. It didn't take me long to learn it. What makes it an extreme demon is that it is relatively long.
GG :)

PXkyksR9yDE.title: ''Astromium Dimensha'' 100% (Demon) by Maelstrom & Reunomi | Geometry Dash
PXkyksR9yDE.description:
Astromium Dimensha is a level that has just about everything, amazing art in the foreground and background, great color choices, block design, really solid gameplay. Every section has something great to offer in my opinion, if it's the backgrounds, the block design, the effects, you'll find something you like in every part.

sojmJjiZUEo.title: ''In Reality'' 100% by JamAttack | Geometry Dash [2.11]
sojmJjiZUEo.description:
In Reality is a 6 minute long XXL Demon created by JamAttack and was inspired by JonathanGD, this is one of the most beautiful unknown levels I've ever seen, the level takes you on a journey accompanied by the song that makes everything in this level stand out even more. It feels like you keep shifting. the effects, the backgrounds, the art and the animations created for it, are made really well. I really like how each section is detailed, it could have even been a level of it's own. This is also really satisfying to play, nice job JamAttack!

ID:55725904

https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/831414

K3oZ6C0al9Q.title: "Memory Lane" by BlockinBlocker | Geometry Dash [2.11]
K3oZ6C0al9Q.description: Memory Lane is exactly what the title says, a mix of RobTop Levels, starting with Stereo Madness and ending with Fingerdash. Even though I didn't recognize some sections which I think were filler for the level. and some transitions are pretty buggy, it's still well made, but it definitely could use some polishing :)

Xg1vmSgRx2U.title: "God Yeeter" 100% (Demon) by DanZmeN [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash
Xg1vmSgRx2U.description: God Yeeter follows DanZmeN typical style, the block design and the effects, but I still enjoyed the level, the gameplay elements are what make it fun to play. There isn't much to say about this level, but I can definitely see this getting rated get easy demon.

QyiX_F86m58.title: Minecraft by DimusLV | Geometry Dash
QyiX_F86m58.description:
Minecraft in a Geometry Dash level, this level is about 10 months old but I still wanted to showcase it because I love the way this looks, enjoy :) 
ID: 46993109

4fn750lcBQs.title: ''Citadel of the Skies'' 100% (Demon) by ML500 [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
4fn750lcBQs.description: Citadel of the skies is simply a beautiful level, everything about it, from the blocks, the colors, the backgrounds, the art that can be found throughout. I really like the sections where you're outside and the moon can be seen in the background, the way the level seems to have layers to it, different platforms moving around in the back, it gives it a lot more detail. It's rated as a medium demon, the gameplay is fun and straightforward, so it shouldn't take too long to beat with practice.

hQojK68pbbs.title: ''Blast Furnace'' 100% (Demon) by Samifying & Maboflo | Geometry Dash
hQojK68pbbs.description: Blast Furnace is a 2.0 level and one of the best demons of it's time in my opinion, and even though it's 2 and a half years old, everything still looks amazing. The gameplay, which can be difficult, but fair, that syncs up perfectly with the song that was chosen, the way color is used in each section of the level, especially in the intro, where everything is black & white, except for the edges in the blocks, and each section blends in with the previous one. FInally the bossfight, all you have to do for most of it is just play the level normally, not miss a single orb and you'll dodge the attacks, then at the end you have to straight fly to dodge it's lasers. Overall this level is great, in every aspect, satisfying to play and nice to look at.

ohKPqGxotao.title: ''B'' 100% (Demon) by Motleyorc & ScorchVx [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
ohKPqGxotao.description: B is a level that was released almost 2 years ago, I had already beaten it in a livestream but the quality wasn't as good as I would've liked, so I'm re-uploading it. This level is so good, both in terms of gameplay and especially design It's really fun to play and satisfying to look at. Practically everything in B is related to Bees, the blocks, the backgrounds, the colors, and the bee animations are really well done. Everything is great :)

dBZTOT3UhH4.title: ''TECHnos II'' 100% (Demon) by StubbyPinata | Geometry Dash [2.11]
dBZTOT3UhH4.description: This level is a sequel to TECHnos, following the same style and aesthetic as the original, great animations, lighting effects, the use of futuristic and robotic colors and the backgrounds are really well made. But the one thing that really stands out to me about these levels are the bossfights, they are incredibly made, the design of the monsters, the way they move, the effects on the attacks, I enjoy everything about them. Something else I enjoyed was the section at the very end, the way the level shifts to an empty space and the blocks change colors as you step on them. Great stuff.

iIpBm7sN7h4.title: ''TECHnos'' 100% (Demon) by StubbyPinata | Geometry Dash [2.11]
iIpBm7sN7h4.description: How did I not know about this masterpiece before.

Sur9Nxh8Q8s.title: ''Unit'' 100% (Demon) by Spectex & More [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
Sur9Nxh8Q8s.description: Unit is a megacollab that features 56 talented creators, but what makes this level unique and different is the fact that each part is about 2 seconds long. Something I really like about this level is how each section blends in perfectly with the one before and the one that comes after, and even with so many styles clashing together, the gameplay stays consistent and really fun. Everyone did a great job! :)

2ZzhOgof5Rg.title: b e p i s by wulz | Geometry Dash
2ZzhOgof5Rg.description: b e p i s is a level that stands out to me because of one thing, the effect that was created for the background, a sort of optical illusion where dozens of lines move around and cross paths with each other to create an almost 3d effect. After this section, the background changes to a series of shapes that move around and change, both in form and color. The gameplay is easy, yet fun, although you'll be distracted looking at the background most of the time, I enjoyed it.

zsylfgZM438.title: ''Sketchy'' by BlueRimz [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
zsylfgZM438.description: Sketchy is a level that is really unique to me, because of the fact that every single part of it is in a hand-drawn sketch style, the platforms, the spikes, the backgrounds, even the trigger at the beginning. I really enjoyed how despite of the design that is so different, the gameplay is still well made, I'd rate Sketchy a harder, it's short and easy, but still fun to play. Something else I liked about this level is the way the backgrounds move, and the colors inside the blocks change and shift, it gives the level another layer of detail. The song also fits in nicely with the design and gameplay.

GcVq11rNQ2Q.title: Mountain King by FunnyGame | Geometry Dash
GcVq11rNQ2Q.description: Mountain King is a level that is already more than 2 years old, I uploaded it back then, but I wanted to beat it again because I wanted it in better quality and I've been having a hard time finding good recent levels. I really like this level simply because of how the gameplay is made to perfectly fit in and sync with the song, almost every note is tied in to gameplay and the way it starts going faster and faster as the song goes on. Something else I enjoyed about this level is how, even though the design, blocks and colors are simple, that doesn't distract you from the main point of the level, which is the amazing sync it has. This level also has something unique, FunnyGame created and then implemented new speed portals into his level, 5x and 6x speed, that can be found at the end of the level, right when the song is at it's fastest, that has to be my favorite part.

egejSvfdZzM.title: ''Running in the 90s'' 100% (Demon) by Findexi & More | Geometry Dash
egejSvfdZzM.description: This is another Running in the 90s level, but this time created by Findexi and other creators, it's very well made, I enjoyed absolutely everything about it, the effects, the colors, the change in pace, going along perfectly with the song, the backgrounds fit in with what's going on in the foreground, blending in just right, the several animations and art that can be found throughout the level, the gameplay is easy, but at the same time it's fun and I enjoyed playing.

XkYyxr0DLfM.title: (Extreme Demon) "Surge of Creations" by TMNGaming (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash
XkYyxr0DLfM.description: Another level I didn't upload when I first beat it, Surge of Creations is  simply an amazing level, I absolutely love the atmosphere of the level.  The design, the colors, the gameplay, even the song is perfectly chosen to match everything this level has to offer.

kDsy_NCd6Pk.title: "Running in the 90s" by DanZmeN (1 Coin) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kDsy_NCd6Pk.description: So I was looking through my old recordings and I found this level, that I didn't upload for some reason, so here it is, my all-time favorite DanZmeN level. It has great effects, colors, the gameplay is fast-paced and fun, the stickman animation is really well done, and blends in perfectly with the level and the song, I really like everything about this level.

iS4jDprASJQ.title: "I Built a Level" by Player Time (3 Coins) | Geometry Dash [2.11]
iS4jDprASJQ.description: I built a level is a very unique creation by Player Time because of everything it implements throughout. At the beginning, where it has a very interesting perspective, showing the level as if you were playing it on a tablet, showing very basic decoration and gameplay, almost none. The section that comes after this, keeps the basic gameplay but the decoration starts changing between different styles, mostly the block design. After this, the true level begins, where almost every element, setting and button in Geometry Dash is shown, with parts of the gameplay implemented into some of it. I really like how he basically showed everything the game has and fit it into the level in such a way that it became the decoration, using all of this in a unique way like this and still making the gameplay easy and fun, is something I enjoyed, it's fun to look at, what seems to be every single button and menu that this game has. Another aspect of this level I liked was how text popped up each time a new section was coming, telling you what vehicle came next, I feel it added to the atmosphere of creating a level.

YRAxYF2RrZk.title: ''Discovery'' by Incidius | Geometry Dash [2.11]
YRAxYF2RrZk.description: Discovery is a level with a very distinct style and atmosphere, I really enjoyed it because of how every section this level has to offer has great colors, backgrounds and effects, from the beginning in the clouds, to the section in space. This level also includes a bossfight, close to the end, where an ice dragon fires attacks at you and you must collect shields in form of orbs to defeat him, after that you have a slower section where you're on a cloud floating through the sky jumping spikes, at the very end of the level is an effect that Incidius created, using colored squares that spin around, that looks really cool in my opinion. Overall I really liked this level, the gameplay is easy and straight-forward and the design has effort put into it.

kMA142QYNc4.title: (Extreme Demon) ''Esencia'' 100% by Zafkiel & More | Geometry Dash [2.11]
kMA142QYNc4.description: That was intense, this took me so long to learn because there's so much to remember with all the portals and such, and I over practiced this a lot which explains why this only took me a day. Anyways I'm glad to have this done, this was definitely harder than Idols for me. GG :)

SfcmT9DLvWo.title: (Insane Demon) ''MEMORY'' 100% by Bianox [2 Coins] | Geometry Dash
SfcmT9DLvWo.description: This level isn't as hard as it may look, with enough tries and practice, any average player could beat it. Nevertheless I did enjoy it, the gameplay is fun even if it is a memory demon and I really like the sort of neon and colorful style that was used.

Jf1o8rdqwyE.title: Animation vs Creator | Geometry Dash
Jf1o8rdqwyE.description:
Animation vs GD is an Auto-Level that is inspired by Animator vs Animation, that is extremely well-made, the animations are fluid and satisfying to look at. I really enjoy how the level begins with the creator making his stickman and traps him, and his creation begins destroying everything, it really is amazing :)

rrGXBfmbuIc.title: [2.2] ''Press Start Full Version'' by Music Sounds | Geometry Dash
rrGXBfmbuIc.description: A level created by Music Sounds, a sort of extension of Press Start, with a few more parts added, including triggers that will be featured in 2.2, the gameplay that's in the original Press Start is basically the same, with the extension having the same style, the gameplay is as fun as the original and the design fits in very well, especially the second bossfight that was created, with the mini skeletons, I really enjoy this level because of how it shows how the camera can be used in 2.2, pretty nice overall.

_rLOTpQBAKI.title: ''Evil Synthesize'' 100% (Demon) by Darwin | Geometry Dash [2.11]
_rLOTpQBAKI.description: A level by Darwin that was dedicated to Goose, pretty much using his creative style. It turned out amazing in my opinion, Darwin really nailed every aspect of Goose, while still having some of his own design sprinkled around the level. I'd rate this level a Medium Demon, the beginning is easy, but the dual in the middle bumps this up to Medium, what I did in this section is only focus on the bottom part, clicking when the arrows indicated. The gameplay is fun and goes really well with everything else this level has to offer, including the song that was chosen. Overall this is another amazing level by Darwin, definitely his best.

vvIaD_7jt4E.description:
Aleph 0 by Zhander.

vU9dztYUc58.title: DanZmeN's 10 Levels Complete | Geometry Dash
vU9dztYUc58.description: A really ambitious challenge by Danzmen, creating 10 levels in 7 days, even though they aren't the most complicated or decorated levels, they are complete.

ld0zkMZmBQ8.title: ''Oof'' by BlueRimz [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
ld0zkMZmBQ8.description: Created by a relatively unknown creator, BlueRimz, it's unique simply because of the design choices, the backgrounds, the blocks, effects, and the few animations that can be seen in this level make it one of the most lively and colorful levels I've seen in a while. The gameplay is well-made too, I would rate it at Insane, or even Easy Demon, it's fun and goes really well with the song. I really like the way he used shapes and lines to make up the entirety of the level, and the level looks different than others because of it.

JkcEKStiUII.title: A level made using only GD Fonts.
JkcEKStiUII.description:
Amethystia by Xender Game & Makfeed | Geometry Dash
Here we have another amazing level by Xender Game, this time it's a collab with Makfeed, this is one of the most unique levels I've seen, what makes this level so different from the rest, is the fact that every single part of this level, in terms of decoration is made completely out of text, shaped to make blocks, the background, the obstacles, and even the boss. Everything in this level is well placed, even though it's made out of text, the design is coherent, and every part of the level makes sense, it isn't confusing at all, to be able to pull that off despite the interesting design choice is impressive. Apart from all this, something else that makes this level great is the song choice, it syncs perfectly with everything, the flashes, the bass, even the animations, the way the level has build up with the song, makes it feel complete. Something I also enjoyed was the gameplay, I'd say it's an Easy Demon, but even though it's easy, I found it to be very fun, and being so unique stylistically, makes it satisfying to go through every time. Something I didn't expect this level to have, was a bossfight, the animations are very fluid, it's fast paced, all you have to do is follow the arrows to survive, but it still looks epic, with the backgrounds, the laser attacks, and movement. I really like the section that comes right after the bossfight, the level and song slow down, beginning to build up once again, after this there is a ship section, following the same pace, only it starts to build up, the level starts shaking and the song gets louder, only to come to a complete stop in the next section which is my favorite at 1:44, where everything slows down again, I especially enjoy this part because of the way the screen flashes and the level pulses along with the song, showing that the atmosphere of this level is well-excecuted. Then we end the level with one final drop, after a short cube section. There is a coin in this level, that can be found at the beginning, where you have to activate two switches, one at 0:03, and the other at 0:06, after the activate a small platform will rise you up at 0:08 taking you to the coin. Overall I really like this level, the design is something I've never seen before.
ID: 54861984

BijHBOcxZzw.title: (Insane Demon) ''Hi'' 100% by KrmaL | Geometry Dash [2.11]
BijHBOcxZzw.description: I'd genuinely like to see Krazy make gameplay that doesn't make me lose my mind.

fwGVziLk_Fs.title: ''The Nightmare 2019'' 100% by Alkali | Geometry Dash [2.11]
fwGVziLk_Fs.description: The Nightmare 2019 by Alkali is a remake, the gameplay remains the same as the original, but the design has been revamped, the block design, some effects, and adding to the level, giving it a modern feel, as if the level was released not so long ago, the level looks very good with everything that was added, I'd say the difficulty is exactly the same as the original, I'd give it 5 stars, since it only took me 4 attempts. Overall I like this remake, even though the gameplay stayed the same, the new design, and creative choices that Alkali made give this level new life.

0jY5I3yhRF4.title: (Insane Demon) ''Fiber'' 100% by Shocksidian | Geometry Dash [2.11]
0jY5I3yhRF4.description:
Fiber by Shocksidian, an Insane Demon that came out almost 2 years ago, the gameplay is very fluid, along with the decoration that goes well with it. And the fact that the gameplay is well-made and flows, the difficulty is very consistent in my opinion. Overall, this level is one that deserves attention even though it could be considered old, but to this day this still looks incredibly good for me.

I'll also be uploading more insane demons cause they're fun to do :P

UDjGl7G0Wt4.title: ''Rainfall III'' 100% (Demon) by Klonex | Geometry Dash [2.11]
UDjGl7G0Wt4.description: Rainfall III created by Klonex, with gameplay that is fast-paced, yet fun to play, decoration that is diverse and well-made, this level has pretty nice block design and colors, bits of art and effects, and rainfall seen throughout the level and flashes caused by lightning. This level is consistent, but needs lots of practice to beat, I really liked this level, both gameplay and design-wise.

j6Z0oMayeaE.title: (Insane Demon) ''Translucent'' 100% by Yakimaru [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
j6Z0oMayeaE.description: Translucent is a really great level created by Yakimaru, with exceptional colors, gameplay that is very enjoyable and really satisfying to play, with music that ties everything in this level up perfectly. It also has very well-made backgrounds and unique effects that look super nice with the level, Overall amazing :)

tUKJb0UfztU.title: ''Chaos Game'' 100% (Demon) by wless | Geometry Dash [2.11]
tUKJb0UfztU.description: chaos game by wless is a very unique level, apart from it's really cool effects and backgrounds, that shift along with the beat of the song, what's especially unique about it is the fact that the colors in and around the blocks adapt to the players combination of colors. The gameplay is simple and easy yet fun, although there is a part where I died a couple of times, the wave at 0:41, but aside from that the level is consistent, I really enjoyed it. Even though this level may seem simple, if you look closely at the details, you can tell he really put a lot of effort into it.

N9vB3F7Msc8.title: ''Chip'' 100% (Demon) by Fletzer | Geometry Dash [2.11]
N9vB3F7Msc8.description: Chip by an already established creator Fletzer, is an Easy Demon with fun and fast paced gameplay, with a really cool design to match, the colors used, the animations of the lava, and the objects, are well-made and the song chosen for this level goes perfectly with the pace. Overall this is a fun level that I enjoyed very much :)

PqIzmWyEoKk.title: ''Polygonal Array'' 100% (Demon) by Jeyzor [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
PqIzmWyEoKk.description: Polygonal Array by Jeyzor is a really unique level, with effects that I really enjoyed, the way the level starts disintegrating and falling apart, and then comes back together again, the use of shapes and lines, the background that shifts between different shapes and how the insides of the blocks move around. Everything in this level blends really well. I like the section that begins at 0:43, where everything goes fast paced, the level, even the music.

EkhPnc4xGGg.title: ''One Good Day II'' by PleoSlim RMD | Geometry Dash [2.11]
EkhPnc4xGGg.description: One Good Day II by PleoSlim is a level that really shines because of the art and animations that were created, it has a futuristic vibe, filled with machines and robots. The level is not that long, just over a minute, with easy but fun gameplay, so I would rate this level an Easy Demon. It also includes a bossfight towards the end of the level, that features really good animations and art, apart from the colors used, giving a neon effect to the blocks. Overall I really enjoyed this level. And thanks for the dedication PleoSlim.

25NFrHT25To.title: ''Clubstep 2019'' 100% (Demon) by AnielChasseur [3 Coins] | Geometry Dash
25NFrHT25To.description: Clubstep 2019 is a remake, created by AnielChasseur it completely revamps the design of the original, adding more color, more effects and improves the overall style of the level. The design of the level is good, I like every part, but the gameplay is where Clubstep 2019 falls a bit short, it has several bugs throughout the level, one in particular at 0:36, where you'll die as you enter the portal, the transitions could be better, the flashes that come up frequently can be distracting and make you lose. One thing I really liked that this level offers are the two mini-bossfights, one with the dragon and the other with the floating eye, both shooting lasers at you. In conclusion I think this level is well made, design-wise, even though the gameplay could be improved.

-gUdgIG_iD4.title: ''I N'' by Xender Game | Geometry Dash [2.11]
-gUdgIG_iD4.description: I N by Xender Game is a level that is amazing to me, simply because of the fact that Xender created it in only 5 days, which is very impressive. The animations, the effects, block design and colors look like they would take a month or more to finish. The transitions are something I liked, they weren't abrupt or out of place, they flowed with the gameplay that Xender created, going along with the design and music as well. This level has a sort of industrial vibe to it, the gray color, the gears turning throughout the level, the backgrounds that look like machines at work, which fits really well with the song that Xender picked and the gameplay. My favorite parts are two different wave mini-sections, one at 0:36 and the other at 0:44, I really like the way the colors change as you're passing through and how the whole level shakes and distorts, overall I enjoyed this level, gameplay and design-wise. Another part I liked was the very ending of the level, where the pace slows down and you're left in an almost empty space, with blocks floating away from you.

r3DWfPvy7JI.title: ''Nock Em'' 100% (Demon) by Osiris GD [1 Coin] | Geometry Dash [2.11]
r3DWfPvy7JI.description: Nock Em is a level created by Osiris GD, which has parts that are inspired by Sub-Zero, the gameplay is well made and easy, which makes this in my opinion an Easy-Medium Demon, the colors and effects used are what makes this level stand out, including the bossfight that has excellent effects and animations, with fun gameplay to go along.

One thing I would improve is the block design, but aside from that, this level is amazing, you can tell he really put effort into this.

The music also fits this level really well, giving it the same retro vibe as Tomb of the Mask.
